- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
  - `AuthTabsPanel` owns the login/register tab switcher.
  - `AuthForm` is the actual form used by both tabs.
    - Login tab: username + password + submit “登录”.
    - Register tab: adds a role selector (`ORGANIZER` or `RIDER`) before username/password.
  - `AudienceEntryPanel` renders the audience CTA:
    - link text: `以 Audience 进入`
    - target: `/audience`

Current behavior:
- Visiting `/login` while already signed in redirects to `/` via `getLoginRedirectTarget(...)` in `src/lib/viewer-access.ts`.
- The login page itself is the auth gateway; the audience path is presented as an alternate, no-account entry.

2. Public homepage auth/login affordances

- `src/app/page.tsx`
  - Uses `HeroSection mode={sessionUser ? "member" : "audience"}`.
  - In the left sidebar, the `账户中心` panel changes by auth state:
    - signed in: shows username, role label, and a logout form using `logoutAction`
    - signed out: shows a short public-access note and a login link:
      - anchor text: `前往登录`
      - target: `/login`
  - Also renders `RaceBrowserPanel` for all users.
  - `RunnerApiPanel` appears only when signed in.

Current behavior:
- The homepage is public, but auth-dependent:
  - anonymous users get a login CTA only
  - authenticated users get logout + their account identity
- The home page itself does not force login; it exposes public race browsing.

3. Whether there is still an audience entry route/component anywhere

  - This is a real page route at `/audience`.

- Entry component:
  - `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
  - `AudienceEntryPanel` links to `/audience`.

Current behavior of `/audience`:
- Renders `HeroSection mode="audience"`.
- Shows `RaceBrowserPanel`.
- Shows each race’s `PublicRaceSections`.
- No login, registration, organizer, rider, or runner API controls are rendered on this page.

4. What components render organizer / rider / public controls on home/login

Shared component map in `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`:

- Public / audience-facing
  - `HeroSection mode="audience"` on `/audience`
  - `HeroSection mode="auth"` on `/login`

  - In `src/app/page.tsx`, gated by `canRide` from `getRoleCapabilities(...)`

  - Per race organizer console:

    - clear race action

  - These only appear for Organizer-capable sessions, and some are further narrowed to races owned by the current organizer.

  - This is the main public projection of each race:

    - disclosure boundary info
    - showcase/highlights depending on phase and display flags

I traced the flow end to end. Here’s the current behavior, with the exact files/functions involved.

## 1) Where `Race.trackId` is stored and validated

### Storage
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\prisma\schema.prisma`
  - `model Race { trackId String @default("oval-track") }`
  - So the database column is required and has a Prisma default of `oval-track`.

### Creation / persistence
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\lib\services\races.ts`
  - `createRace(...)`
  - It reads `formData.get("trackId")` and persists it with:
    - `trackId: parsed.trackId`

### Validation
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\lib\validation.ts`
  - `trackEnum = z.enum(["oval-track", "circuit-track"])`
  - `createRaceSchema` requires `trackId: trackEnum`
  - So only those two track IDs are accepted at the app layer.

### UI default
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\_components\ary-shared.tsx`
  - `CreateRaceForm(...)`
  - The `<select name="trackId">` has `defaultValue="oval-track"`.

## 2) How seeded races choose tracks

- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\prisma\seed.ts`

Seeded races are assigned like this:

- `race_active` → `trackId: "oval-track"`
- `race_signup` (API 设计大赛) → **no `trackId` field is set**
- `race_finished` → `trackId: "oval-track"`

Important detail:
- `race_signup` is relying on the schema default from `prisma/schema.prisma`, because the seed does not explicitly set `trackId`.

Also notable:
- `public/assets/snapshots/race_signup.json` currently shows `trackId: "circuit-track"` in the checked-in snapshot, which suggests the snapshot and the current seed data are not aligned.

## 3) How the homepage and Jumbotron load track assets

### Homepage
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\page.tsx`
  - It loads each race snapshot with `loadRaceSnapshot(race.id)`.
  - If a snapshot exists, it tries to read:
    - `public/assets/tracks/<snapshot.trackId>/track.profile.json`
  - It only adds a race to the Jumbotron banner if both `snapshot` and `trackProfile` exist.

### Dedicated Jumbotron page
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\jumbotron\[raceId]\page.tsx`
  - `loadTrackProfile(trackId: string)`
  - Reads:
    - `public/assets/tracks/<trackId>/track.profile.json`
  - If the file does not exist, it renders:
    - `赛道 <trackId> 的 track.profile.json 不存在。`

### Jumbotron rendering
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\jumbotron\[raceId]\JumbotronClient.tsx`
  - It only renders the background image when:
    - `trackProfile.background?.src` exists
  - The image path comes directly from the profile JSON.

### Track profile schema/validation
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\lib\jumbotron\track-runtime\types.ts`
  - `TrackProfile.background.src` is required in the type.
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\lib\jumbotron\track-runtime\validator.ts`
  - Validates `background.src`, but this validator is not what the homepage uses to decide whether to render.
  - The homepage loader just checks file existence and parses JSON.

## 4) Why a race like “API 设计大赛” could end up with no default background

There are a few likely causes, ranked by plausibility:

### Cause A: It’s not an active/frozen race, so the homepage intentionally does not show the Jumbotron
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\_components\ary-shared.tsx`
  - `PublicRaceSections(...)` only renders the Jumbotron block when:
    - `race.phase === "active" || race.phase === "frozen"`
  - `race_signup` in the seed is a future race / signup-phase race, so the homepage will show the preparation panel instead of the big backgrounded Jumbotron.
  - That means “no background” can be by design, not a data bug.

### Cause B: Seeded race relies on default track ID, but the snapshot/DB may be stale or out of sync

## Short gap analysis

1. Task package is not uploaded anywhere
   - It is only a text label (`taskPackageLabel`), so there is no real file-input flow yet.

2. Rider submission is not a file upload
   - Code is entered as text (`codeContent`) with a filename label, not selected from disk.

3. Track/background authoring is isolated to Calibrator
   - Calibrator can build/import/export a `TrackProfile`, but create-race cannot create or persist one.

4. Jumbotron track assets are static
   - Runtime expects `public/assets/tracks/<trackId>/track.profile.json`, but create-race cannot produce new track assets.

5. Create-race display options are limited
   - It exposes publication flags, but not Calibrator-style track controls like start/finish and checkpoints.

Here is a minimal-scope plan that should fully cover the 5 gaps without introducing a real upload/storage subsystem.

## Recommended implementation approach

### 1) Make login the primary visible entry, and remove audience duplication
Goal: users should clearly enter through login, while public viewing remains on `/`.

Plan:
- Treat `/` as the single public homepage and keep public race browsing there.
- Make the unauthenticated “前往登录” CTA much more prominent on `/`, ideally in the hero and account panel, not buried in sidebar copy.
- Simplify `/login` into a pure auth workspace entry page:
  - keep login/register tabs
  - remove `AudienceEntryPanel`
  - update hero copy to stop mentioning a separate audience route
- Remove the dedicated `/audience` route from navigation and product copy entirely.
- Optionally keep the physical route temporarily as a redirect to `/` for backward compatibility, but do not expose it anywhere in UI. If the user wants “removed entirely” literally, delete the route file too.

Why this is minimal:
- Public audience functionality already exists on `/`.
- No new auth model is needed; only remove redundant entry points and rebalance CTA prominence.

### 2) Guarantee every race always has a valid default track/background
Goal: no race, including “API 设计大赛”, should ever render without a usable track.

Plan:
- Establish one canonical fallback track ID in app code, preferably `oval-track`, since it already has both `background.png/svg` and `track.profile.json`.
- Normalize race track selection at read/use time, not only at create time:
  - when loading Jumbotron snapshot/profile for display, if `race.trackId` is empty, invalid, or missing assets, fall back to `oval-track`
  - when generating snapshot, persist the normalized track ID into the snapshot
- Keep `trackId` default in Prisma as-is, but do not rely on DB defaults alone.
- Expand validation from “allowed enum” to “known track IDs with existing assets/profile”, or at least centralize track availability in one helper.
- Audit seed/demo data for “API 设计大赛”; if it already says `circuit-track` but appears blank in UI, the likely issue is runtime asset/profile resolution rather than DB data. The fallback layer will cover both seeded and future races.

Why this is minimal:
- Avoids building track asset authoring/persistence.
- Fixes both existing bad data and future edge cases.

### 3) Remove old audience entry after entering login
This is mostly part of item 1, but implement it explicitly:
- Delete `AudienceEntryPanel` usage from `/login`.
- Remove any copy in `HeroSection` saying “Audience 可从这里进入”.
- Remove `/audience` links from shared components.
- If desired, repurpose that right-side panel space on `/login` for:
  - demo accounts
  - “登录后你可以做什么”
  - role-specific onboarding

This satisfies the user’s request without changing auth/session behavior.

### 4) Add real local file pickers for organizer/rider submission flows without building storage
Goal: organizer publish task / provide background / rider submit code become true local file selectors or jump points.

The lowest-scope solution is:
- use client-side file inputs
- read files in-browser
- submit extracted text/data through existing server actions as form fields
- do not persist raw uploaded files to disk/server storage

#### 4a) Rider submit code
Current state:
- rider submits `codeLabel`, `codeContent`, `recordLabel`, `ridingRecord` manually.

Plan:
- Convert the submission form into a small client component wrapper around the existing form action.
- Add local file picker buttons for:
  - code file: accepts `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, maybe `.mjs/.cjs`
  - riding record: accepts `.txt`, `.md`, maybe `.json`
- On file selection:
  - populate `codeLabel` / `recordLabel`
  - read file text via `FileReader`
  - populate hidden or visible textareas with file content
- Keep manual textareas as fallback/preview so users can inspect/edit imported content before submit.
- Continue posting to `submitEntryAction` unchanged, or with only tiny schema refinements.

This gives “real local selection” while preserving the current DB model.

#### 4b) Organizer publish task / provide background
Interpretation that minimizes scope:
- “publish task” means selecting the local task package/file metadata rather than typing a fake label.
- “provide background” means selecting a local background image for race setup/Jumbotron config.

Plan:
- In create-race, replace plain text-only task package entry with:
  - local file picker for task package/reference file
  - fill `taskPackageLabel` from selected filename
  - optionally show a “selected local file” status only; no upload storage
- Add local image picker for race background:
  - read selected image client-side
  - use it only for preview and geometry extraction in the create-race flow
  - do not attempt to save the binary to server/public assets in this scope
- Because runtime Jumbotron still depends on static `public/assets/tracks/<trackId>/...`, position this feature as:
  - “local preview/configuration picker”
  - not “persisted uploaded background asset”
- If the user truly needs the chosen image to drive runtime Jumbotron later, that is a larger storage/import pipeline and should be deferred.

Best low-risk UX wording:
- “选择本地题目包”
- “选择本地底图（用于预览与赛道参数配置）”

This satisfies the requested picker UX without overbuilding.

### 5) Expose Calibrator-style start/finish and checkpoints in create-race
Goal: organizer create-race should surface useful geometry controls, but not full track authoring/storage.

Recommended scope:
- Reuse only the data-entry subset of Calibrator, not the full canvas editor.
- In create-race, expose:
  - track template selector (`oval-track` / `circuit-track`)
  - start/finish position `s`
  - checkpoint list: name + `s`
  - maybe direction if needed
- Do not embed point-by-point path editing, lane editing, SVG canvas manipulation, or export tooling into create-race.
- Derive initial values from the selected static track profile.
- Persist these overrides as race-level configuration, separate from shared track templates.

Important architectural note:
- Right now `Race` only stores `trackId`, while runtime loads shared static `track.profile.json`.
- To support per-race start/finish and checkpoints, add a small race-level override field rather than trying to generate new track files:
  - e.g. JSON column/string on `Race` for `trackProfileOverrides` or a narrowed `jumbotronConfig`
  - include only overrideable fields: `startFinish`, `checkpoints`, maybe `direction`
- At runtime:
  - load base static profile by `trackId`
  - merge race overrides onto it before rendering snapshot/Jumbotron
- Snapshot generation should use the effective merged profile, or at least the normalized race config, consistently.

Why this is minimal:
- Reuses existing runtime types and concepts.
- Avoids creating track files on disk.
- Satisfies the user’s request for Jumbotron/Calibrator-style options where they matter most.

## Suggested sequencing

1. Remove audience duplication and strengthen login CTA.
2. Add centralized track fallback/normalization.
3. Convert rider submission form to client-side local file picker UX.
4. Enhance create-race with local task/background pickers.
5. Add race-level Jumbotron config overrides for start/finish and checkpoints.
6. Wire runtime/snapshot loading to merged effective track config.
7. Update seed/demo assumptions only if needed after runtime fallback is in place.

## Key design decisions

### Do not build file storage now
Use browser file selection + client-side reading only. Persist text/config already supported by current schema and actions. This keeps scope contained and still satisfies “real picker” UX.

### Keep `/` as the public audience surface
This removes duplication cleanly. `/login` becomes role entry only.

### Add race-level geometry overrides, not full per-race track authoring
This is the smallest path to per-race start/finish and checkpoints.

## Likely files to modify

- `src/app/page.tsx`
  - stronger unauthenticated login CTA
  - rider submission area likely extracted into a client component
  - possibly organizer create-race client wrapper insertion
- `src/app/login/page.tsx`
  - remove audience entry panel
  - simplify sidebar content
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
  - remove `AudienceEntryPanel` usage/export
  - update `HeroSection` copy
  - expand `CreateRaceForm` or replace with client-enhanced form
- `src/lib/viewer-access.ts`
  - only if redirect semantics need cleanup
- `src/lib/services/races.ts`
  - normalize/fallback track ID
  - accept race-level geometry override fields
- `src/lib/validation.ts`
  - validate any new race config fields
  - possibly relax/reshape file-driven form inputs
- `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
  - use normalized/effective track config
- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/page.tsx`
  - apply fallback and merged track profile loading
- `prisma/schema.prisma`
  - if adding race-level Jumbotron override JSON/string field
- `prisma/seed.ts`
  - optional cleanup after fallback implementation

## Verification checklist

Here is a minimal-scope plan that should fully cover the 5 gaps without introducing a real upload/storage subsystem.

## Recommended implementation approach

### 1) Make login the primary visible entry, and remove audience duplication
Goal: users should clearly enter through login, while public viewing remains on `/`.

Plan:
- Treat `/` as the single public homepage and keep public race browsing there.
- Make the unauthenticated “前往登录” CTA much more prominent on `/`, ideally in the hero and account panel, not buried in sidebar copy.
- Simplify `/login` into a pure auth workspace entry page:
  - keep login/register tabs
  - remove `AudienceEntryPanel`
  - update hero copy to stop mentioning a separate audience route
- Remove the dedicated `/audience` route from navigation and product copy entirely.
- Optionally keep the physical route temporarily as a redirect to `/` for backward compatibility, but do not expose it anywhere in UI. If the user wants “removed entirely” literally, delete the route file too.

Why this is minimal:
- Public audience functionality already exists on `/`.
- No new auth model is needed; only remove redundant entry points and rebalance CTA prominence.

### 2) Guarantee every race always has a valid default track/background
Goal: no race, including “API 设计大赛”, should ever render without a usable track.

Plan:
- Establish one canonical fallback track ID in app code, preferably `oval-track`, since it already has both `background.png/svg` and `track.profile.json`.
- Normalize race track selection at read/use time, not only at create time:
  - when loading Jumbotron snapshot/profile for display, if `race.trackId` is empty, invalid, or missing assets, fall back to `oval-track`
  - when generating snapshot, persist the normalized track ID into the snapshot
- Keep `trackId` default in Prisma as-is, but do not rely on DB defaults alone.
- Expand validation from “allowed enum” to “known track IDs with existing assets/profile”, or at least centralize track availability in one helper.
- Audit seed/demo data for “API 设计大赛”; if it already says `circuit-track` but appears blank in UI, the likely issue is runtime asset/profile resolution rather than DB data. The fallback layer will cover both seeded and future races.

Why this is minimal:
- Avoids building track asset authoring/persistence.
- Fixes both existing bad data and future edge cases.

### 3) Remove old audience entry after entering login
This is mostly part of item 1, but implement it explicitly:
- Delete `AudienceEntryPanel` usage from `/login`.
- Remove any copy in `HeroSection` saying “Audience 可从这里进入”.
- Remove `/audience` links from shared components.
- If desired, repurpose that right-side panel space on `/login` for:
  - demo accounts
  - “登录后你可以做什么”
  - role-specific onboarding

This satisfies the user’s request without changing auth/session behavior.

### 4) Add real local file pickers for organizer/rider submission flows without building storage
Goal: organizer publish task / provide background / rider submit code become true local file selectors or jump points.

The lowest-scope solution is:
- use client-side file inputs
- read files in-browser
- submit extracted text/data through existing server actions as form fields
- do not persist raw uploaded files to disk/server storage

#### 4a) Rider submit code
Current state:
- rider submits `codeLabel`, `codeContent`, `recordLabel`, `ridingRecord` manually.

Plan:
- Convert the submission form into a small client component wrapper around the existing form action.
- Add local file picker buttons for:
  - code file: accepts `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, maybe `.mjs/.cjs`
  - riding record: accepts `.txt`, `.md`, maybe `.json`
- On file selection:
  - populate `codeLabel` / `recordLabel`
  - read file text via `FileReader`
  - populate hidden or visible textareas with file content
- Keep manual textareas as fallback/preview so users can inspect/edit imported content before submit.
- Continue posting to `submitEntryAction` unchanged, or with only tiny schema refinements.

This gives “real local selection” while preserving the current DB model.

#### 4b) Organizer publish task / provide background
Interpretation that minimizes scope:
- “publish task” means selecting the local task package/file metadata rather than typing a fake label.
- “provide background” means selecting a local background image for race setup/Jumbotron config.

Plan:
- In create-race, replace plain text-only task package entry with:
  - local file picker for task package/reference file
  - fill `taskPackageLabel` from selected filename
  - optionally show a “selected local file” status only; no upload storage

  - read selected image client-side
  - use it only for preview and geometry extraction in the create-race flow
  - do not attempt to save the binary to server/public assets in this scope
- Because runtime Jumbotron still depends on static `public/assets/tracks/<trackId>/...`, position this feature as:
  - “local preview/configuration picker”
  - not “persisted uploaded background asset”
- If the user truly needs the chosen image to drive runtime Jumbotron later, that is a larger storage/import pipeline and should be deferred.

Best low-risk UX wording:
- “选择本地题目包”
- “选择本地底图（用于预览与赛道参数配置）”

This satisfies the requested picker UX without overbuilding.

### 5) Expose Calibrator-style start/finish and checkpoints in create-race
Goal: organizer create-race should surface useful geometry controls, but not full track authoring/storage.

Recommended scope:
- Reuse only the data-entry subset of Calibrator, not the full canvas editor.
- In create-race, expose:

  - checkpoint list: name + `s`
  - maybe direction if needed
- Do not embed point-by-point path editing, lane editing, SVG canvas manipulation, or export tooling into create-race.
- Derive initial values from the selected static track profile.
- Persist these overrides as race-level configuration, separate from shared track templates.

Important architectural note:
- Right now `Race` only stores `trackId`, while runtime loads shared static `track.profile.json`.
- To support per-race start/finish and checkpoints, add a small race-level override field rather than trying to generate new track files:

- Reuses existing runtime types and concepts.
- Avoids creating track files on disk.

## Approved Plan:
# Context

这次不是继续泛化 Jumbotron，而是修正用户实测时暴露出来的 5 个明确问题：
- `/login` 页的登录入口不够显眼
- 每场比赛都必须有可用默认底图/赛道，`API 设计大赛` 当前表现为没有默认底图
- 既然 `/` 已经是公开主页，就不再保留 `/login` 里的旧 Audience 入口，也不再保留一套重复的 `/audience` 入口语义
- 企业发布题目、提供底图、用户提交代码这三处都需要真实的本地选择按钮，而不是只填文本
- Organizer 创建比赛时，应该能配置当前 Jumbotron 真正在消费的赛道参数，至少包括起终点、检查点等 Calibrator 里已有的参数

当前代码已经具备这些能力的“半成品”：
- `/` 已经是公开主页，公开浏览能力已存在；`/login` 仍保留 `AudienceEntryPanel`，造成重复入口
- `Race.trackId` 已存在，但 create-race / seed / runtime 缺少统一的 fallback 兜底
- Rider 提交、Organizer 建赛都仍是文本字段，没有本地文件选择器
- Calibrator 已经有完整的赛道参数模型（`startFinish`、`checkpoints`、`direction` 等），但 create-race 没有暴露这些配置

因此这轮实现要优先复用现有 page/form/action/schema/track-profile 结构，以最小增量把这 5 个问题补齐，而不是额外引入新的上传系统或重做 Jumbotron 架构。

# Recommended Approach

## 1. 收敛公开入口：`/` 负责观众浏览，`/login` 只做身份进入

### 改动目标
让公开观众流量只走 `/`，登录/注册只走 `/login`。`/login` 上不再出现“观众入口”这种重复导航，同时把登录 CTA 做得更明显。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/login/page.tsx`
- `src/app/audience/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
- `src/lib/viewer-access.ts`

### 实施方式
- 强化 `src/app/page.tsx` 中未登录态的主 CTA：在 hero/account panel 都显式突出“前往登录”
- `src/app/login/page.tsx` 去掉 `AudienceEntryPanel`，右侧区域改成更直接的登录说明 / demo 账号说明
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx` 中删除或停用 `/audience` 链接相关组件/文案
- `src/app/audience/page.tsx` 改为重定向回 `/`，或直接移除该路由文件；实现时优先选改动更小且不留重复入口的一种

## 2. 给所有比赛建立统一的默认赛道/底图兜底

### 改动目标
不管 seed 数据、旧数据还是新建比赛数据如何，运行时只要比赛需要展示大屏，就一定能拿到一个有效 `track.profile.json` 和背景图。

### 关键文件
- `prisma/schema.prisma`
- `prisma/seed.ts`
- `src/lib/validation.ts`
- `src/lib/services/races.ts`
- `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/page.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 保留 `Race.trackId` 的默认值，但不只依赖数据库默认
- 新增一个统一的“有效赛道解析”辅助逻辑：如果 race 的 `trackId` 为空、非法、或对应 profile 资产缺失，则回退到 `oval-track`
- `generateRaceSnapshot()` 写 snapshot 时使用解析后的有效 `trackId`
- `src/app/page.tsx` 和 `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/page.tsx` 加载 profile 时同样走统一 fallback
- `prisma/seed.ts` 里把 `race_signup` 显式写上 `trackId`，避免继续依赖隐式默认，保证 `API 设计大赛` 演示状态稳定

## 3. 把三处“假按钮/纯文本”改成本地文件选择器

### 改动目标
企业发布题目、企业提供底图、用户提交代码这三条链路都要出现真实的本地文件选择按钮；但这轮不引入额外文件存储系统，仍尽量复用现有表单和服务。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
- `src/app/actions.ts`
- `src/lib/services/races.ts`
- `src/lib/services/submissions.ts`
- `src/lib/validation.ts`

### 实施方式
- 将 Rider 提交区提炼为客户端增强表单：
  - 增加代码文件选择按钮
  - 增加 riding record 文件选择按钮
  - 选中文件后用浏览器 `FileReader` 读文本，自动填充现有 `codeLabel` / `codeContent` / `recordLabel` / `ridingRecord`
  - 保留文本域作为预览与手动修正，不改现有 `submitEntryAction -> createSubmission()` 的数据模型
- 将 `CreateRaceForm` 提炼为客户端增强表单：
  - 为 `taskPackageLabel` 增加本地题目包选择按钮，选中文件后自动回填文件名
  - 为比赛底图增加本地图像选择按钮，选中后在前端预览，并把相关赛道配置联动到表单状态
- 这轮先实现“本地选择 + 前端回填/预览 + 继续按现有字段提交”，不在服务端落地二进制文件存储；避免 scope 膨胀

## 4. 在 create-race 中补齐 Calibrator 已有、Jumbotron 真正在用的赛道参数

### 改动目标
Organizer 创建比赛时，至少能配置每场比赛自己的起终点和检查点，而不是只能选一个 `trackId`。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/calibrator/CalibratorState.ts`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types.ts`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/validator.ts`
- `src/lib/validation.ts`
- `src/lib/services/races.ts`
- `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/page.tsx`
- `prisma/schema.prisma`
- 新 migration

### 实施方式
- 不把整个 Calibrator 画布塞进 create-race；这轮只暴露“参数配置子集”
- 在 `Race` 上新增一个轻量级的赛道覆盖配置字段（如 JSON 字符串 / Json 字段），只存：
  - `startFinish.s`
  - `checkpoints`
  - 视需要补 `direction`
- create-race 表单增加这些字段的编辑 UI，并以所选 `trackId` 的基础 profile 为默认值
- Jumbotron 页面和 snapshot 生成时：先加载基础 `track.profile.json`，再合并 race 级 override，形成该比赛的 effective track profile
- 继续复用现有 `TrackProfile` / validator / runtime 逻辑，不额外引入新的赛道文件生成流程

## 5. 同步调整公开页的呈现逻辑，避免“比赛有赛道但阶段不展示时被误判为没底图”

### 改动目标
把“这个比赛当前阶段不展示大屏”和“这个比赛缺少默认底图”两个概念分开，避免再次出现误判。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
- `src/lib/services/races.ts`

### 实施方式
- 保持首页按阶段显示内容的总策略不变：报名/准备阶段不强行展示全量 Jumbotron
- 但在公共赛事区中显式展示该比赛当前使用的赛道/底图模板信息，让用户知道比赛已有默认赛道，只是当前阶段未进入大屏展示
- 对 active/frozen 阶段继续展示 inline Jumbotron；若 fallback 生效，也能正常显示，不出现空白

1	"use client";
2	
3	import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
4	import type { RaceSnapshot, TrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
5	import { samplePath, sampleAt, tangentAngle, normal } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/path-sampler";
6	import { assignLane } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/lane-manager";
7	import { resolveMotionState } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state";
8	
9	interface Props {
10	  snapshot: RaceSnapshot;
11	  trackProfile: TrackProfile;
12	}
13	
14	const BASE_LERP = 0.03; // 基础插值速度
15	
16	export default function JumbotronClient({ snapshot, trackProfile }: Props) {
17	  const [debug, setDebug] = useState(false);
18	  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(snapshot.competition.elapsedTime);
19	  const [kpiDetail, setKpiDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);
20	  const [detailEntry, setDetailEntry] = useState<string | null>(null); // drill-down 面板
21	
22	  // -- s-axis 动画状态 --
23	  const [displayS, setDisplayS] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
24	  const rafRef = useRef<number>(0);
25	
26	  const sorted = useMemo(
27	    () => [...snapshot.entries].sort((a, b) => (a.rank ?? 999) - (b.rank ?? 999)),
28	    [snapshot.entries],
29	  );
30	
31	  // 目标 s 值
32	  const targetS = useMemo(() => {
33	    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
34	    for (const e of sorted) map[e.entryId] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, e.roundProgress));
35	    return map;
36	  }, [sorted]);
37	
38	  // 初始化 displayS
39	  const isLive = snapshot.competition.liveStatus === "live";
40	  useEffect(() => {
41	    setDisplayS((prev) => {
42	      if (Object.keys(prev).length > 0) return prev;
43	      const next: Record<string, number> = {};
44	      for (const e of sorted) {
45	        // 进行中的赛事：所有马从起跑线出发，营造起跑效果
46	        // 非 live 赛事（报名中/已结束）：直接跳到目标位置
47	        next[e.entryId] = isLive ? 0 : (targetS[e.entryId] ?? 0.5);
48	      }
49	      return next;
50	    });
51	  }, [sorted, isLive, targetS]);
52	
53	  // s-axis 补间动画循环 —— 每匹马速度略有差异
54	  const animateRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
55	  animateRef.current = useCallback(() => {
56	    setDisplayS((prev) => {
57	      let changed = false;
58	      const next: Record<string, number> = { ...prev };
59	      for (const id of Object.keys(targetS)) {
60	        const cur = prev[id] ?? 0;
61	        const tgt = targetS[id] ?? 0.5;
62	        const diff = tgt - cur;
63	        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.0005) { next[id] = tgt; continue; }
64	        changed = true;
65	        // 每匹马速度在 0.02~0.05 之间随机，模拟不同的追赶节奏
66	        const seed = id.charCodeAt(id.length - 1) || 0;
67	        const speed = BASE_LERP * (0.7 + (seed % 10) / 10);
68	        next[id] = cur + diff * speed;
69	      }
70	      return changed ? next : prev;
71	    });
72	    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animateRef.current);
73	    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
74	  }, [targetS]);
75	
76	  // 每 15 秒微扰所有马位置，制造"实时竞速"感
77	  useEffect(() => {
78	    const jitter = setInterval(() => {
79	      setDisplayS((prev) => {
80	        if (Object.keys(prev).length === 0) return prev;
81	        const next: Record<string, number> = {};
82	        for (const id of Object.keys(prev)) {
83	          next[id] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, prev[id] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006));
84	        }
85	        return next;
86	      });
87	    }, 15000);
88	    return () => clearInterval(jitter);
89	  }, []);
90	
91	  useEffect(() => {
92	    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animateRef.current);
93	    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
94	  }, []);
95	
96	  // key bindings
97	  useEffect(() => {
98	    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "d" || e.key === "D") setDebug((v) => !v); };
99	    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
100	    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
101	  }, []);
102	
103	  // timer
104	  useEffect(() => {
105	    if (snapshot.competition.liveStatus !== "live") return;
106	    const i = setInterval(() => setElapsed((t) => t + 1), 1000);
107	    return () => clearInterval(i);
108	  }, [snapshot.competition.liveStatus]);
109	
110	  const { competition, entries, kpis, messages, attentionItems } = snapshot;
111	  const path = useMemo(
112	    () => samplePath(trackProfile.centerline.points, trackProfile.centerline.closed, 20),
113	    [trackProfile],
114	  );
115	
116	  // 用 displayS（插值后的 s）计算姿势
117	  const poses = useMemo(() => {
118	    return sorted.map((entry) => {

122	      const sampled = sampleAt(path, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s)));
123	      if (!sampled) return null;

126	      const state = resolveMotionState(entry.status, entry.updatedAt);

128	        entryId: entry.entryId,
129	        x: sampled.point.x + n.x * offset,
130	        y: sampled.point.y + n.y * offset,
131	        rotation: (tangentAngle(sampled.tangent) * 180) / Math.PI,
132	        s, laneId: lane.id, state,
133	        entry, rank,
134	      };
135	    }).filter((p): p is NonNullable<typeof p> => p !== null);
136	  }, [sorted, trackProfile, path, displayS]);
137	
138	  const top3 = entries.filter((e) => e.rank && e.rank <= 3).sort((a, b) => (a.rank ?? 99) - (b.rank ?? 99));
139	  const activeRiders = [...entries]
140	    .sort((a, b) => (b.submissionCount ?? 0) - (a.submissionCount ?? 0) || (a.rank ?? 999) - (b.rank ?? 999))
141	    .slice(0, 3);
142	
143	  return (
144	    <div className={debug ? "jt jt-debug" : "jt"}>
145	      {/* ====== Header ====== */}

153	        </div>
154	        <div className="jt-hdr__right">
155	          <span>⏱ {formatTime(elapsed)}</span>
156	          <span className="jt-hdr__online">在线 {kpis.onlineRiders}/{entries.length}</span>
157	        </div>
158	      </header>
159	
160	      {/* ====== KPI ====== */}
161	      <div className="jt-kpis">
162	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "progress" ? null : "progress")}><b>{kpis.completionRate}%</b><small>完成度</small></div>
163	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "tokens" ? null : "tokens")}><b>{fmtNum(kpis.totalTokens)}</b><small>Tokens</small></div>
164	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "ca" ? null : "ca")}><b>{kpis.codexShare}%</b><small>Codex</small></div>
165	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "ca" ? null : "ca")}><b>{kpis.claudeShare}%</b><small>Claude</small></div>
166	        {kpis.riskCount > 0 && <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--warn jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "risk" ? null : "risk")}><b>{kpis.riskCount}</b><small>风险</small></div>}
167	      </div>
168	
169	      {/* ====== KPI Detail Panel ====== */}
170	      {kpiDetail && (
171	        <div className="jt-kpi-detail">
172	          {kpiDetail === "progress" && (
173	            <table><thead><tr><th>队伍</th><th>总分</th><th>进度</th><th>任务分</th><th>Token分</th><th>对话分</th></tr></thead><tbody>
174	              {sorted.map((e) => (
175	                <tr key={e.entryId}><td>{e.projectName}</td><td>{entries.find(x => x.entryId === e.entryId)?.costTokens ?? "-"}</td><td>{Math.round(e.roundProgress*100)}%</td><td>-</td><td>-</td><td>-</td></tr>
176	              ))}
177	            </tbody></table>

179	          {kpiDetail === "tokens" && (

181	              {sorted.map((e) => (
182	                <tr key={e.entryId}><td>{e.projectName}</td><td>{e.costTokens ?? 0}</td><td>${((e.costTokens ?? 0) * 0.0001).toFixed(2)}</td><td>{e.caProvider.toUpperCase()}</td></tr>
183	              ))}
184	            </tbody></table>
185	          )}
186	          {kpiDetail === "ca" && (

342	          ))}

345	          ))}

200	export async function updateRaceContent(input: {
201	  organizerId: string;
202	  raceId: string;
203	  taskDescription: string;
204	  trainingDataSummary: string;
205	}) {
206	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
207	    where: {
208	      id: input.raceId,
209	    },
210	  });
211	
212	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
213	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
214	  }
215	
216	  if (getRacePhase(race) === "finished") {
217	    throw new Error("比赛结束后不能再修改题目与训练数据");
218	  }
219	
220	  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
221	    const updatedRace = await tx.race.update({
222	      where: {
223	        id: input.raceId,
224	      },
225	      data: {
226	        taskDescription: input.taskDescription.trim(),
227	        trainingDataSummary: input.trainingDataSummary.trim(),
228	        lastLeaderboardSyncAt: null,
229	        lastShowcaseSyncAt: null,
230	      },
231	    });
232	
233	    await tx.leaderboardEntry.deleteMany({
234	      where: { raceId: input.raceId },
235	    });
236	
237	    await tx.runnerTask.deleteMany({
238	      where: { raceId: input.raceId, taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL" },
239	    });
240	
241	    await tx.notification.create({
242	      data: {
243	        raceId: input.raceId,
244	        title: "题目已更新",
245	        content: `Organizer 更新了 ${updatedRace.title} 的题目描述或训练数据说明，原进度投影已清空`,
246	        target: "ALL",
247	      },
248	    });
249	
250	    return updatedRace;
251	  });
252	
253	  deleteRaceSnapshot(input.raceId);
254	  return updated;
255	}
256	
257	export async function updateOrganizerComment(input: {
258	  organizerId: string;
259	  raceId: string;
260	  organizerComment: string;
261	}) {
262	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
263	    where: {
264	      id: input.raceId,
265	    },
266	  });
267	
268	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
269	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
270	  }
271	
272	  return prisma.race.update({
273	    where: {
274	      id: input.raceId,
275	    },
276	    data: {
277	      organizerComment: input.organizerComment.trim(),
278	    },
279	  });
280	}
281	
282	export async function clearRace(input: {
283	  organizerId: string;
284	  raceId: string;
285	}) {
286	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
287	    where: {
288	      id: input.raceId,
289	    },
290	  });
291	
292	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
293	    throw new Error("无权清空这场比赛");
294	  }
295	
296	  await prisma.race.delete({
297	    where: {
298	      id: input.raceId,
299	    },
300	  });
301	}
302	
303	export async function updateRaceDisplayOptions(input: {
304	  organizerId: string;
305	  raceId: string;
306	  displayShowTrainingData: boolean;
307	  displayShowOrganizerComment: boolean;
308	  displayShowTopHighlights: boolean;
309	  displayHighlightCount: number;
310	  displayShowRiderCode: boolean;
311	}) {
312	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
313	    where: { id: input.raceId },
314	  });
315	
316	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
317	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
318	  }
319	
320	  const shouldClearTrainingData =
321	    race.displayShowTrainingData && !input.displayShowTrainingData;
322	  const shouldClearOrganizerComment =
323	    race.displayShowOrganizerComment && !input.displayShowOrganizerComment;
324	  const shouldClearHighlights =
325	    race.displayShowTopHighlights && !input.displayShowTopHighlights;
326	  const shouldClearRiderCode =
327	    race.displayShowRiderCode && !input.displayShowRiderCode;
328	
329	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
330	    await tx.race.update({
331	      where: { id: input.raceId },
332	      data: {
333	        displayShowTrainingData: input.displayShowTrainingData,
334	        displayShowOrganizerComment: input.displayShowOrganizerComment,
335	        displayShowTopHighlights: input.displayShowTopHighlights,
336	        displayHighlightCount: input.displayHighlightCount,
337	        displayShowRiderCode: input.displayShowRiderCode,
338	      },
339	    });
340	
341	    if (shouldClearTrainingData) {
342	      await tx.race.update({
343	        where: { id: input.raceId },
344	        data: { trainingDataSummary: "" },
345	      });
346	    }
347	
348	    if (shouldClearOrganizerComment) {
349	      await tx.race.update({
350	        where: { id: input.raceId },
351	        data: { organizerComment: "" },
352	      });
353	    }
354	
355	    if (shouldClearHighlights) {
356	      await tx.ridingHighlight.deleteMany({
357	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
358	      });
359	    }
360	
361	    if (shouldClearRiderCode) {
362	      await tx.ridingHighlight.updateMany({
363	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
364	        data: { codeSnippet: "Organizer 未公开 Rider 代码。" },
365	      });
366	
367	      await tx.teamArchive.updateMany({
368	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
369	        data: { codeContent: "" },
370	      });
371	    }
372	  });
373	}
374	
375	export function groupRacesByPhase<T extends { phase: string }>(races: T[]) {
376	  return {
377	    registration: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "registration"),
378	    preparation: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "preparation"),
379	    active: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "active"),
380	    frozen: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "frozen"),
381	    finished: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "finished"),
382	  };
383	}
384	
385	export type RaceListItem = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listRaces>>[number];
386	
387	function normalizeDateTimeInput(value: FormDataEntryValue | null): string {
388	  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) {
389	    return "";
390	  }
391	
392	  return new Date(value).toISOString();
393	}

356	  team         Team @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
357

1	import {
2	  AgentType,
3	  SubmissionStatus,
4	} from "@/generated/prisma/enums";
5	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
6	import { getRacePhase } from "@/lib/race-phase";
7	import { enqueueSubmissionTestTask } from "@/lib/services/runner";
8	import { createSubmissionSchema } from "@/lib/validation";
9	
10	export async function createSubmission(riderId: string, formData: FormData) {
11	  const parsed = createSubmissionSchema.parse({
12	    raceId: formData.get("raceId"),
13	    codeLabel: formData.get("codeLabel"),
14	    codeContent: formData.get("codeContent"),
15	    recordLabel: formData.get("recordLabel"),
16	    ridingRecord: formData.get("ridingRecord"),
17	    tokenUsed: formData.get("tokenUsed"),
18	    agentType: formData.get("agentType"),
19	  });
20	
21	  const team = await prisma.team.findFirst({
22	    where: {
23	      captainId: riderId,
24	      raceId: parsed.raceId,
25	    },
26	  });
27	
28	  if (!team) {
29	    throw new Error("请先报名参赛");
30	  }
31	
32	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
33	    where: {
34	      id: parsed.raceId,
35	    },
36	  });
37	
38	  if (!race) {
39	    throw new Error("赛事不存在");
40	  }
41	
42	  const phase = getRacePhase(race);
43	  if (phase !== "active" && phase !== "frozen") {
44	    throw new Error("只有比赛中或封榜期才能提交");
45	  }
46	
47	  const lastSubmission = await prisma.submission.findFirst({
48	    where: {
49	      teamId: team.id,
50	    },
51	    orderBy: {
52	      createdAt: "desc",
53	    },
54	  });
55	
56	  if (lastSubmission) {
57	    const cooldownMs = race.submissionIntervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
58	    const elapsed = Date.now() - lastSubmission.createdAt.getTime();
59	    if (elapsed < cooldownMs) {
60	      const minutes = Math.ceil((cooldownMs - elapsed) / 60000);
61	      throw new Error(`提交过于频繁，请 ${minutes} 分钟后再试`);
62	    }
63	  }
64	
65	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
66	    const submission = await tx.submission.create({
67	      data: {
68	        agentType: parsed.agentType,
69	        codeContent: parsed.codeContent,
70	        codeLabel: parsed.codeLabel,
71	        raceId: parsed.raceId,
72	        recordLabel: parsed.recordLabel,
73	        ridingRecord: parsed.ridingRecord,
74	        status: SubmissionStatus.QUEUED,
75	        teamId: team.id,
76	        tokenUsed: parsed.tokenUsed,
77	      },
78	    });
79	
80	    const artifact = await tx.submissionArtifact.create({
81	      data: {
82	        agentType: parsed.agentType,
83	        codeContent: parsed.codeContent,
84	        codeLabel: parsed.codeLabel,
85	        raceId: parsed.raceId,
86	        recordLabel: parsed.recordLabel,
87	        ridingRecord: parsed.ridingRecord,
88	        submissionId: submission.id,
89	        teamId: team.id,
90	        tokenUsed: parsed.tokenUsed,
91	      },
92	    });
93	
94	    await enqueueSubmissionTestTask({
95	      artifactId: artifact.id,
96	      raceId: parsed.raceId,
97	      submissionId: submission.id,
98	      teamId: team.id,
99	      tx,
100	    });
101	
102	    return submission;
103	  });
104	}
105	
106	export function getAgentLabel(agent: AgentType): string {
107	  switch (agent) {
108	    case AgentType.CLAUDE:
109	      return "Claude";
110	    case AgentType.COPILOT:
111	      return "Copilot";
112	    case AgentType.DEEPSEEK:
113	      return "DeepSeek";
114	    case AgentType.ZHIPU:
115	      return "Zhipu";
116	    case AgentType.OPENAI:
117	      return "OpenAI";
118	    case AgentType.CUSTOM:
119	      return "Custom";
120	    default:
121	      return "Unknown";
122	  }
123	}
124

1	// RaceSnapshot 生成服务
2	// 从 ARY 数据库读取赛事数据 → 通过 Adapter 映射 → 写入 JSON 快照文件
3	
4	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
5	import {
6	  AryDerivedDataProvider,
7	  mapToCompetition,
8	  type AryRaceData,
9	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/adapter";
10	import type { RaceSnapshot } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
11	import fs from "node:fs";
12	import path from "node:path";
13	
14	const SNAPSHOT_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "assets", "snapshots");
15	
16	/**
17	 * 生成赛事快照 JSON
18	 *
19	 * 数据流：
20	 *   1. 从 Prisma 查询赛事全量数据
21	 *   2. 通过 AryDerivedDataProvider 映射为 Jumbotron 格式
22	 *   3. 写入 public/assets/snapshots/<raceId>.json
23	 *   4. 返回生成的快照对象
24	 */
25	export async function generateRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): Promise<RaceSnapshot> {
26	  // 1. 查询赛事全量数据
27	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
28	    where: { id: raceId },
29	    include: {
30	      organizer: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
31	      teams: {
32	        include: {
33	          captain: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
34	        },
35	      },
36	      leaderboardEntries: {
37	        orderBy: [{ totalScore: "desc" }, { createdAt: "asc" }],
38	      },
39	      submissions: {
40	        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
41	      },
42	      teamArchives: {
43	        orderBy: { totalScore: "desc" },
44	      },
45	      feedbackThreads: {
46	        include: {
47	          messages: {
48	            orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
49	          },
50	        },
51	      },
52	    },
53	  });
54	
55	  if (!race) {
56	    throw new Error(`赛事 ${raceId} 不存在`);
57	  }
58	
59	  // 2. 构造 AryRaceData
60	  const raceData: AryRaceData = {
61	    id: race.id,
62	    title: race.title,
63	    summary: race.summary,
64	    signupStart: race.signupStart,
65	    signupEnd: race.signupEnd,
66	    raceStart: race.raceStart,
67	    raceEnd: race.raceEnd,
68	    organizer: race.organizer,
69	    teams: race.teams.map((t) => ({
70	      id: t.id,
71	      name: t.name,
72	      captain: t.captain,
73	    })),
74	    leaderboardEntries: race.leaderboardEntries.map((e) => ({
75	      id: e.id,
76	      teamId: e.teamId,
77	      totalScore: e.totalScore,
78	      progress: e.progress,
79	      taskScore: e.taskScore,
80	      tokenScore: e.tokenScore,
81	      dialogueScore: e.dialogueScore,
82	      agentType: e.agentType,
83	      createdAt: e.createdAt,
84	    })),
85	    submissions: race.submissions.map((s) => ({
86	      id: s.id,
87	      teamId: s.teamId,
88	      createdAt: s.createdAt,
89	    })),
90	    teamArchives: race.teamArchives.map((a) => ({
91	      teamId: a.teamId,
92	      agentType: a.agentType,
93	      tokenUsed: a.tokenUsed,
94	      totalScore: a.totalScore,
95	      antiCheatPenalty: a.antiCheatPenalty,
96	    })),
97	    feedbackThreads: race.feedbackThreads.map((f) => ({
98	      teamId: f.teamId,
99	      messages: f.messages.map((m) => ({
100	        content: m.content,
101	        createdAt: m.createdAt,
102	      })),
103	    })),
104	  };
105	
106	  // 3. 通过 Adapter 映射
107	  const provider = new AryDerivedDataProvider(raceData);
108	  const now = new Date();
109	
110	  const [entries, messages, attentionItems, kpis] = await Promise.all([
111	    provider.getRaceEntries(raceId),
112	    provider.getRidingMessages(raceId),
113	    provider.getAttentionItems(raceId),
114	    provider.getCompetitionKPI(raceId),
115	  ]);
116	
117	  const competition = mapToCompetition(raceData, now);
118	
119	  // 4. 修正 KPIs：在线数 = 总数 - stale 数
120	  const staleCount = entries.filter((e) => e.status === "stale").length;
121	  kpis.onlineRiders = entries.length - staleCount;
122	  kpis.activeRiders = entries.filter((e) => e.status !== "stale" && e.status !== "idle").length;
123	
124	  // 5. 组装快照
125	  const snapshot: RaceSnapshot = {
126	    generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
127	    raceId,
128	    trackId: race.trackId,
129	    competition,
130	    entries,
131	    kpis,
132	    messages,
133	    attentionItems,
134	  };
135	
136	  // 5. 写入文件
137	  ensureSnapshotDir();
138	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
139	  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2), "utf-8");
140	
141	  return snapshot;
142	}
143	
144	/**
145	 * 读取已生成的快照（供 Jumbotron 页面静态消费）
146	 */
147	export function loadRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): RaceSnapshot | null {
148	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
149	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
150	
151	  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
152	  return JSON.parse(raw) as RaceSnapshot;
153	}
154	
155	/**
156	 * 列出所有已生成的快照 ID
157	 */
158	export function listSnapshotIds(): string[] {
159	  ensureSnapshotDir();
160	  return fs
161	    .readdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)
162	    .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"))
163	    .map((f) => f.replace(".json", ""));
164	}
165	
166	export function deleteRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): void {
167	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
168	  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
169	    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
170	  }
171	}
172	
173	function ensureSnapshotDir(): void {
174	  if (!fs.existsSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)) {
175	    fs.mkdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR, { recursive: true });
176	  }
177	}
178

1	// Calibrator 编辑器状态管理（useReducer）
2	
3	import type { Point, TrackProfile, Lane, Checkpoint } from "../track-runtime/types";
4	
5	export interface CalibratorState {
6	  // 赛道元信息
7	  trackId: string;
8	  name: string;
9	  schemaVersion: string;
10	
11	  // 画布 & 背景
12	  viewBox: { w: number; h: number };
13	  background: {
14	    src: string;
15	    naturalWidth: number;
16	    naturalHeight: number;
17	  } | null;
18	
19	  // 中心线
20	  centerline: {
21	    type: "polyline";
22	    closed: boolean;
23	    points: Point[];
24	    smoothing: "catmull-rom" | "linear";
25	  };
26	
27	  // 方向 & 起终点
28	  direction: "clockwise" | "counterclockwise";
29	  startFinish: { s: number };
30	
31	  // 车道
32	  lanes: Lane[];
33	
34	  // 检查点
35	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
36	
37	  // 交互状态
38	  selectedPointIndex: number | null;
39	  isDragging: boolean;
40	  canvasScale: number;
41	
42	  // 预览
43	  previewProgress: number;
44	  previewHorseCount: number;
45	  previewSpeed: number;
46	  isPlaying: boolean;
47	
48	  // 校验
49	  validationErrors: string[];
50	  validationWarnings: string[];
51	}
52	
53	export type CalibratorAction =
54	  | { type: "SET_BACKGROUND"; payload: { src: string; naturalWidth: number; naturalHeight: number } }
55	  | { type: "SET_VIEWBOX"; payload: { w: number; h: number } }
56	  | { type: "SET_NAME"; payload: string }
57	  | { type: "ADD_POINT"; payload: Point }
58	  | { type: "MOVE_POINT"; payload: { index: number; point: Point } }
59	  | { type: "DELETE_POINT"; payload: { index: number } }
60	  | { type: "SELECT_POINT"; payload: number | null }
61	  | { type: "START_DRAG" }
62	  | { type: "END_DRAG" }
63	  | { type: "SET_CLOSED"; payload: boolean }
64	  | { type: "REVERSE_DIRECTION" }
65	  | { type: "SET_START_FINISH"; payload: number }
66	  | { type: "ADD_LANE"; payload: Lane }
67	  | { type: "UPDATE_LANE"; payload: { index: number; lane: Lane } }
68	  | { type: "REMOVE_LANE"; payload: { index: number } }
69	  | { type: "ADD_CHECKPOINT"; payload: Checkpoint }
70	  | { type: "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT"; payload: { index: number; checkpoint: Checkpoint } }
71	  | { type: "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT"; payload: { index: number } }
72	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS"; payload: number }
73	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_HORSE_COUNT"; payload: number }
74	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_SPEED"; payload: number }
75	  | { type: "TOGGLE_PLAY" }
76	  | { type: "SET_VALIDATION"; payload: { errors: string[]; warnings: string[] } }
77	  | { type: "LOAD_PROFILE"; payload: TrackProfile }
78	  | { type: "SET_SCALE"; payload: number };
79	
80	export function createInitialState(): CalibratorState {
81	  return {
82	    trackId: `track-${Date.now()}`,
83	    name: "新赛道",
84	    schemaVersion: "1.0",
85	    viewBox: { w: 2560, h: 1263 },
86	    background: null,
87	    centerline: {
88	      type: "polyline",
89	      closed: true,
90	      points: [
91	        { x: 1280, y: 121 },
92	        { x: 1795, y: 189 },
93	        { x: 2172, y: 376 },
94	        { x: 2310, y: 631 },
95	        { x: 2172, y: 886 },
96	        { x: 1795, y: 1073 },
97	        { x: 1280, y: 1141 },
98	        { x: 765, y: 1073 },
99	        { x: 388, y: 886 },
100	        { x: 250, y: 631 },
101	        { x: 388, y: 376 },
102	        { x: 765, y: 189 },
103	      ],
104	      smoothing: "catmull-rom",
105	    },
106	    direction: "clockwise",
107	    startFinish: { s: 0 },
108	    lanes: [
109	      { id: "lane-0", name: "内侧车道", offset: -60 },
110	      { id: "lane-1", name: "中间车道", offset: 0 },
111	      { id: "lane-2", name: "外侧车道", offset: 60 },
112	    ],
113	    checkpoints: [],
114	    selectedPointIndex: null,
115	    isDragging: false,
116	    canvasScale: 1,
117	    previewProgress: 0,
118	    previewHorseCount: 1,
119	    previewSpeed: 1,
120	    isPlaying: false,
121	    validationErrors: [],
122	    validationWarnings: [],
123	  };
124	}
125	
126	export function calibratorReducer(
127	  state: CalibratorState,
128	  action: CalibratorAction,
129	): CalibratorState {
130	  switch (action.type) {
131	    case "SET_BACKGROUND":
132	      return {
133	        ...state,
134	        background: action.payload,
135	        viewBox: { w: action.payload.naturalWidth, h: action.payload.naturalHeight },
136	      };
137	
138	    case "SET_VIEWBOX":
139	      return { ...state, viewBox: action.payload };
140	
141	    case "SET_NAME":
142	      return { ...state, name: action.payload };
143	
144	    case "ADD_POINT": {
145	      const points = state.selectedPointIndex !== null
146	        ? [
147	            ...state.centerline.points.slice(0, state.selectedPointIndex + 1),
148	            action.payload,
149	            ...state.centerline.points.slice(state.selectedPointIndex + 1),
150	          ]
151	        : [...state.centerline.points, action.payload];
152	      return {
153	        ...state,
154	        centerline: { ...state.centerline, points },
155	        selectedPointIndex: state.selectedPointIndex !== null
156	          ? state.selectedPointIndex + 1
157	          : points.length - 1,
158	      };
159	    }
160	
161	    case "MOVE_POINT": {
162	      const points = [...state.centerline.points];
163	      if (points[action.payload.index]) {
164	        points[action.payload.index] = action.payload.point;
165	      }
166	      return { ...state, centerline: { ...state.centerline, points } };
167	    }
168	
169	    case "DELETE_POINT": {
170	      const points = state.centerline.points.filter(
171	        (_, i) => i !== action.payload.index,
172	      );
173	      return {
174	        ...state,
175	        centerline: { ...state.centerline, points },
176	        selectedPointIndex: null,
177	      };
178	    }
179	
180	    case "SELECT_POINT":
181	      return { ...state, selectedPointIndex: action.payload };
182	
183	    case "START_DRAG":
184	      return { ...state, isDragging: true };
185	
186	    case "END_DRAG":
187	      return { ...state, isDragging: false };
188	
189	    case "SET_CLOSED":
190	      return { ...state, centerline: { ...state.centerline, closed: action.payload } };
191	
192	    case "REVERSE_DIRECTION":
193	      return {
194	        ...state,
195	        centerline: {
196	          ...state.centerline,
197	          points: [...state.centerline.points].reverse(),
198	        },
199	        direction: state.direction === "clockwise" ? "counterclockwise" : "clockwise",
200	      };
201	
202	    case "SET_START_FINISH":
203	      return { ...state, startFinish: { s: action.payload } };
204	
205	    case "ADD_LANE":
206	      return { ...state, lanes: [...state.lanes, action.payload] };
207	
208	    case "UPDATE_LANE": {
209	      const lanes = [...state.lanes];
210	      lanes[action.payload.index] = action.payload.lane;
211	      return { ...state, lanes };
212	    }
213	
214	    case "REMOVE_LANE": {
215	      const lanes = state.lanes.filter((_, i) => i !== action.payload.index);
216	      return { ...state, lanes };
217	    }
218	
219	    case "ADD_CHECKPOINT":
220	      return { ...state, checkpoints: [...state.checkpoints, action.payload] };
221	
222	    case "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT": {
223	      const checkpoints = [...state.checkpoints];
224	      checkpoints[action.payload.index] = action.payload.checkpoint;
225	      return { ...state, checkpoints };
226	    }
227	
228	    case "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT": {
229	      const checkpoints = state.checkpoints.filter(
230	        (_, i) => i !== action.payload.index,
231	      );
232	      return { ...state, checkpoints };
233	    }
234	
235	    case "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS":
236	      return { ...state, previewProgress: action.payload };
237	
238	    case "SET_PREVIEW_HORSE_COUNT":
239	      return { ...state, previewHorseCount: action.payload };
240	
241	    case "SET_PREVIEW_SPEED":
242	      return { ...state, previewSpeed: action.payload };
243	
244	    case "TOGGLE_PLAY":
245	      return { ...state, isPlaying: !state.isPlaying };
246	
247	    case "SET_VALIDATION":
248	      return {
249	        ...state,
250	        validationErrors: action.payload.errors,
251	        validationWarnings: action.payload.warnings,
252	      };
253	
254	    case "LOAD_PROFILE": {
255	      const p = action.payload;
256	      return {
257	        ...state,
258	        trackId: p.trackId,
259	        name: p.name,
260	        schemaVersion: p.schemaVersion,
261	        viewBox: p.viewBox,
262	        background: p.background,
263	        centerline: p.centerline,
264	        direction: p.direction,
265	        startFinish: p.startFinish,
266	        lanes: p.lanes,
267	        checkpoints: p.checkpoints,
268	      };
269	    }
270	
271	    case "SET_SCALE":
272	      return { ...state, canvasScale: action.payload };
273	
274	    default:
275	      return state;
276	  }
277	}
278	
279	/**
280	 * 将 CalibratorState 导出为 TrackProfile
281	 */
282	export function toTrackProfile(state: CalibratorState): TrackProfile {
283	  return {
284	    schemaVersion: state.schemaVersion,
285	    trackId: state.trackId,
286	    name: state.name,
287	    viewBox: state.viewBox,

1	// Jumbotron track-runtime 核心类型定义
2	// 所有渲染层和计算层共享的数据契约
3	
4	// ---- Track Profile ----
5	
6	export interface TrackProfile {
7	  schemaVersion: string;
8	  trackId: string;
9	  name: string;
10	  viewBox: { w: number; h: number };
11	  background: {
12	    src: string;
13	    naturalWidth: number;
14	    naturalHeight: number;
15	  };
16	  centerline: {
17	    type: "polyline";
18	    closed: boolean;
19	    points: Point[];
20	    smoothing: "catmull-rom" | "linear";
21	  };
22	  direction: "clockwise" | "counterclockwise";
23	  startFinish: { s: number };
24	  lanes: Lane[];
25	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
26	  messageZones?: MessageZone[];
27	  noBubbleZones?: NoBubbleZone[];
28	}
29	
30	export interface Point {
31	  x: number;
32	  y: number;
33	}
34	
35	export interface Lane {
36	  id: string;
37	  name: string;
38	  offset: number;
39	}
40	
41	export interface Checkpoint {
42	  id: string;
43	  name: string;
44	  s: number;
45	}
46	
47	export interface MessageZone {
48	  id: string;
49	  sRange: [number, number];
50	  preferredSide: "left" | "right" | "top";
51	}
52	
53	export interface NoBubbleZone {
54	  sRange: [number, number];

1	// TrackProfile 校验器
2	import type { TrackProfile, ValidationResult } from "./types";
3	
4	/**
5	 * 校验 TrackProfile 的 schema 和 geometry 合法性
6	 */
7	export function validateTrackProfile(profile: unknown): ValidationResult {
8	  const errors: ValidationResult["errors"] = [];
9	  const warnings: ValidationResult["warnings"] = [];
10	
11	  if (!profile || typeof profile !== "object") {
12	    errors.push({ field: "root", message: "TrackProfile must be an object" });
13	    return { valid: false, errors, warnings };
14	  }
15	
16	  const p = profile as Record<string, unknown>;
17	
18	  // schemaVersion
19	  if (!p.schemaVersion) {
20	    errors.push({ field: "schemaVersion", message: "缺少 schemaVersion" });
21	  }
22	
23	  // trackId
24	  if (!p.trackId || typeof p.trackId !== "string") {
25	    errors.push({ field: "trackId", message: "缺少 trackId" });
26	  }
27	
28	  // viewBox
29	  const vb = p.viewBox as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
30	  if (!vb || typeof vb.w !== "number" || typeof vb.h !== "number" || vb.w <= 0 || vb.h <= 0) {
31	    errors.push({ field: "viewBox", message: "viewBox 不合法 (w/h 必须为正数)" });
32	  }
33	
34	  // background
35	  const bg = p.background as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
36	  if (!bg || typeof bg.src !== "string") {
37	    errors.push({ field: "background.src", message: "缺少 background.src" });
38	  }
39	
40	  // centerline
41	  const cl = p.centerline as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
42	  if (!cl) {
43	    errors.push({ field: "centerline", message: "缺少 centerline" });
44	  } else {
45	    const points = cl.points as Array<{ x: number; y: number }> | undefined;
46	    const closed = cl.closed === true;
47	    if (!points || !Array.isArray(points)) {
48	      errors.push({ field: "centerline.points", message: "缺少 centerline.points" });
49	    } else {
50	      const minPoints = closed ? 4 : 2;
51	      if (points.length < minPoints) {
52	        errors.push({
53	          field: "centerline.points",
54	          message: `${closed ? "闭合" : "开放"}路径至少需要 ${minPoints} 个点，当前 ${points.length}`,
55	        });
56	      }
57	
58	      // 检查 NaN / Infinity
59	      for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
60	        const pt = points[i];
61	        if (!isFinite(pt.x) || !isFinite(pt.y)) {
62	          errors.push({
63	            field: `centerline.points[${i}]`,
64	            message: `点 [${i}] 包含 NaN 或 Infinity`,
65	          });
66	        }
67	      }
68	
69	      // 检查相邻点异常跳变
70	      for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
71	        const dx = points[i].x - points[i - 1].x;
72	        const dy = points[i].y - points[i - 1].y;
73	        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
74	        if (dist > 500) {
75	          warnings.push({
76	            field: `centerline.points[${i}]`,
77	            message: `点 [${i - 1}] → [${i}] 距离过大 (${dist.toFixed(0)}px)，可能是异常跳变`,
78	          });
79	        }
80	      }
81	    }
82	  }
83	
84	  // direction
85	  if (p.direction !== "clockwise" && p.direction !== "counterclockwise") {
86	    errors.push({ field: "direction", message: "direction 必须是 clockwise 或 counterclockwise" });
87	  }
88	
89	  // startFinish
90	  const sf = p.startFinish as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
91	  if (!sf || typeof sf.s !== "number" || sf.s < 0 || sf.s > 1) {
92	    errors.push({ field: "startFinish.s", message: "startFinish.s 必须在 0~1 范围内" });
93	  }
94	
95	  // lanes
96	  const lanes = p.lanes as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined;
97	  if (!lanes || !Array.isArray(lanes) || lanes.length === 0) {
98	    errors.push({ field: "lanes", message: "至少需要 1 条车道" });
99	  } else {
100	    const offsets = new Set<number>();
101	    for (const lane of lanes) {
102	      if (typeof lane.offset !== "number") {
103	        errors.push({ field: "lanes", message: "车道 offset 必须为数字" });
104	      } else if (offsets.has(lane.offset)) {
105	        errors.push({ field: "lanes", message: `车道 offset ${lane.offset} 重复` });
106	      } else {
107	        offsets.add(lane.offset);
108	      }
109	    }
110	  }
111	
112	  // checkpoints
113	  const checkpoints = p.checkpoints as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined;
114	  if (checkpoints) {
115	    for (let i = 0; i < checkpoints.length; i++) {
116	      const cp = checkpoints[i];
117	      if (typeof cp.s !== "number" || cp.s < 0 || cp.s > 1) {
118	        errors.push({
119	          field: `checkpoints[${i}].s`,
120	          message: `checkpoint [${i}] s 必须在 0~1 范围内`,
121	        });
122	      }
123	    }
124	  }
125	
126	  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, warnings };
127	}

200	export async function updateRaceContent(input: {
201	  organizerId: string;
202	  raceId: string;
203	  taskDescription: string;
204	  trainingDataSummary: string;
205	}) {
206	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
207	    where: {
208	      id: input.raceId,
209	    },
210	  });
211	
212	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
213	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
214	  }
215	
216	  if (getRacePhase(race) === "finished") {
217	    throw new Error("比赛结束后不能再修改题目与训练数据");
218	  }
219	
220	  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
221	    const updatedRace = await tx.race.update({
222	      where: {
223	        id: input.raceId,
224	      },
225	      data: {
226	        taskDescription: input.taskDescription.trim(),
227	        trainingDataSummary: input.trainingDataSummary.trim(),
228	        lastLeaderboardSyncAt: null,
229	        lastShowcaseSyncAt: null,
230	      },
231	    });
232	
233	    await tx.leaderboardEntry.deleteMany({
234	      where: { raceId: input.raceId },
235	    });
236	
237	    await tx.runnerTask.deleteMany({
238	      where: { raceId: input.raceId, taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL" },
239	    });
240	
241	    await tx.notification.create({
242	      data: {
243	        raceId: input.raceId,
244	        title: "题目已更新",
245	        content: `Organizer 更新了 ${updatedRace.title} 的题目描述或训练数据说明，原进度投影已清空`,
246	        target: "ALL",
247	      },
248	    });
249	
250	    return updatedRace;
251	  });
252	
253	  deleteRaceSnapshot(input.raceId);
254	  return updated;
255	}

213	export async function updateRaceContent(input: {
214	  organizerId: string;
215	  raceId: string;
216	  taskDescription: string;
217	  trainingDataSummary: string;
218	}) {
219	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
220	    where: {
221	      id: input.raceId,
222	    },
223	  });
224	
225	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
226	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
227	  }
228	
229	  if (getRacePhase(race) === "finished") {
230	    throw new Error("比赛结束后不能再修改题目与训练数据");
231	  }
232	
233	  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
234	    const updatedRace = await tx.race.update({
235	      where: {
236	        id: input.raceId,
237	      },
238	      data: {
239	        taskDescription: input.taskDescription.trim(),
240	        trainingDataSummary: input.trainingDataSummary.trim(),
241	        lastLeaderboardSyncAt: null,
242	        lastShowcaseSyncAt: null,
243	      },
244	    });
245	
246	    await tx.leaderboardEntry.deleteMany({
247	      where: { raceId: input.raceId },
248	    });
249	
250	    await tx.runnerTask.deleteMany({
251	      where: { raceId: input.raceId, taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL" },
252	    });
253	
254	    await tx.notification.create({
255	      data: {
256	        raceId: input.raceId,
257	        title: "题目已更新",
258	        content: `Organizer 更新了 ${updatedRace.title} 的题目描述或训练数据说明，原进度投影已清空`,
259	        target: "ALL",
260	      },
261	    });
262	
263	    return updatedRace;
264	  });
265	
266	  deleteRaceSnapshot(input.raceId);
267	  return updated;
268	}

1	// RaceSnapshot 生成服务
2	// 从 ARY 数据库读取赛事数据 → 通过 Adapter 映射 → 写入 JSON 快照文件
3	
4	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
5	import {
6	  AryDerivedDataProvider,
7	  mapToCompetition,
8	  type AryRaceData,
9	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/adapter";
10	import { normalizeTrackId, parseRaceTrackConfigJson } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-config";
11	import type { RaceSnapshot } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
12	import fs from "node:fs";
13	import path from "node:path";
14	
15	const SNAPSHOT_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "assets", "snapshots");
16	
17	/**
18	 * 生成赛事快照 JSON
19	 *
20	 * 数据流：
21	 *   1. 从 Prisma 查询赛事全量数据
22	 *   2. 通过 AryDerivedDataProvider 映射为 Jumbotron 格式
23	 *   3. 写入 public/assets/snapshots/<raceId>.json
24	 *   4. 返回生成的快照对象
25	 */
26	export async function generateRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): Promise<RaceSnapshot> {
27	  // 1. 查询赛事全量数据
28	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
29	    where: { id: raceId },
30	    include: {
31	      organizer: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
32	      teams: {
33	        include: {
34	          captain: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
35	        },
36	      },
37	      leaderboardEntries: {
38	        orderBy: [{ totalScore: "desc" }, { createdAt: "asc" }],
39	      },
40	      submissions: {
41	        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
42	      },
43	      teamArchives: {
44	        orderBy: { totalScore: "desc" },
45	      },
46	      feedbackThreads: {
47	        include: {
48	          messages: {
49	            orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
50	          },
51	        },
52	      },
53	    },
54	  });
55	
56	  if (!race) {
57	    throw new Error(`赛事 ${raceId} 不存在`);
58	  }
59	
60	  // 2. 构造 AryRaceData
61	  const raceData: AryRaceData = {
62	    id: race.id,
63	    title: race.title,
64	    summary: race.summary,
65	    signupStart: race.signupStart,
66	    signupEnd: race.signupEnd,
67	    raceStart: race.raceStart,
68	    raceEnd: race.raceEnd,
69	    organizer: race.organizer,
70	    teams: race.teams.map((t) => ({
71	      id: t.id,
72	      name: t.name,
73	      captain: t.captain,
74	    })),
75	    leaderboardEntries: race.leaderboardEntries.map((e) => ({
76	      id: e.id,
77	      teamId: e.teamId,
78	      totalScore: e.totalScore,
79	      progress: e.progress,
80	      taskScore: e.taskScore,
81	      tokenScore: e.tokenScore,
82	      dialogueScore: e.dialogueScore,
83	      agentType: e.agentType,
84	      createdAt: e.createdAt,
85	    })),
86	    submissions: race.submissions.map((s) => ({
87	      id: s.id,
88	      teamId: s.teamId,
89	      createdAt: s.createdAt,
90	    })),
91	    teamArchives: race.teamArchives.map((a) => ({
92	      teamId: a.teamId,
93	      agentType: a.agentType,
94	      tokenUsed: a.tokenUsed,
95	      totalScore: a.totalScore,
96	      antiCheatPenalty: a.antiCheatPenalty,
97	    })),
98	    feedbackThreads: race.feedbackThreads.map((f) => ({
99	      teamId: f.teamId,
100	      messages: f.messages.map((m) => ({
101	        content: m.content,
102	        createdAt: m.createdAt,
103	      })),
104	    })),
105	  };
106	
107	  // 3. 通过 Adapter 映射
108	  const provider = new AryDerivedDataProvider(raceData);
109	  const now = new Date();
110	
111	  const [entries, messages, attentionItems, kpis] = await Promise.all([
112	    provider.getRaceEntries(raceId),
113	    provider.getRidingMessages(raceId),
114	    provider.getAttentionItems(raceId),
115	    provider.getCompetitionKPI(raceId),
116	  ]);
117	
118	  const competition = mapToCompetition(raceData, now);
119	
120	  // 4. 修正 KPIs：在线数 = 总数 - stale 数
121	  const staleCount = entries.filter((e) => e.status === "stale").length;
122	  kpis.onlineRiders = entries.length - staleCount;
123	  kpis.activeRiders = entries.filter((e) => e.status !== "stale" && e.status !== "idle").length;
124	
125	  // 5. 组装快照
126	  const snapshot: RaceSnapshot = {
127	    generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
128	    raceId,
129	    trackId: normalizeTrackId(race.trackId),
130	    trackConfig: parseRaceTrackConfigJson(race.trackConfigJson),
131	    competition,
132	    entries,
133	    kpis,
134	    messages,
135	    attentionItems,
136	  };
137	
138	  // 5. 写入文件
139	  ensureSnapshotDir();
140	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
141	  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2), "utf-8");
142	
143	  return snapshot;
144	}
145	
146	/**
147	 * 读取已生成的快照（供 Jumbotron 页面静态消费）
148	 */
149	export function loadRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): RaceSnapshot | null {
150	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
151	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
152	
153	  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
154	  return JSON.parse(raw) as RaceSnapshot;
155	}
156	
157	/**
158	 * 列出所有已生成的快照 ID
159	 */
160	export function listSnapshotIds(): string[] {
161	  ensureSnapshotDir();
162	  return fs
163	    .readdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)
164	    .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"))
165	    .map((f) => f.replace(".json", ""));
166	}
167	
168	export function deleteRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): void {
169	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
170	  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
171	    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
172	  }
173	}
174	
175	function ensureSnapshotDir(): void {
176	  if (!fs.existsSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)) {
177	    fs.mkdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR, { recursive: true });
178	  }
179	}

1	import type { Checkpoint, RaceSnapshot, TrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
2	import fs from "node:fs";
3	import path from "node:path";
4	
5	export const DEFAULT_TRACK_ID = "oval-track";
6	const VALID_TRACK_IDS = new Set([DEFAULT_TRACK_ID, "circuit-track"]);
7	
8	export interface RaceTrackConfig {
9	  startFinish: { s: number };
10	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
11	}
12	
13	export function normalizeTrackId(trackId: string | null | undefined): string {
14	  if (!trackId || !VALID_TRACK_IDS.has(trackId)) {
15	    return DEFAULT_TRACK_ID;
16	  }
17	  return hasTrackProfileAsset(trackId) ? trackId : DEFAULT_TRACK_ID;
18	}
19	
20	export function parseRaceTrackConfigJson(value: string | null | undefined): RaceTrackConfig | null {
21	  if (!value) return null;
22	  const raw = value.trim();
23	  if (!raw) return null;
24	
25	  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
26	    startFinish?: { s?: number };
27	    checkpoints?: Array<{ id?: string; name?: string; s?: number }>;
28	  };
29	
30	  const startFinishS = parsed.startFinish?.s;
31	  if (typeof startFinishS !== "number" || startFinishS < 0 || startFinishS > 1) {
32	    throw new Error("起终点位置必须在 0~1 之间");
33	  }
34	
35	  const checkpoints = Array.isArray(parsed.checkpoints)
36	    ? parsed.checkpoints.map((checkpoint, index) => {
37	        const id = checkpoint.id?.trim() || `checkpoint-${index + 1}`;
38	        const name = checkpoint.name?.trim() || `检查点 ${index + 1}`;
39	        const s = checkpoint.s;
40	        if (typeof s !== "number" || s < 0 || s > 1) {
41	          throw new Error(`检查点 ${index + 1} 的位置必须在 0~1 之间`);
42	        }
43	        return { id, name, s } satisfies Checkpoint;
44	      })
45	    : [];
46	
47	  return {
48	    startFinish: { s: startFinishS },
49	    checkpoints,
50	  };
51	}
52	
53	export function serializeRaceTrackConfig(config: RaceTrackConfig | null): string {
54	  return config ? JSON.stringify(config) : "";
55	}
56	
57	export function loadTrackProfile(trackId: string): TrackProfile | null {
58	  const filePath = path.join(
59	    process.cwd(),
60	    "public",
61	    "assets",
62	    "tracks",
63	    trackId,
64	    "track.profile.json",
65	  );
66	
67	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
68	  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8")) as TrackProfile;
69	}
70	
71	export function getEffectiveTrackProfile(
72	  trackId: string | null | undefined,
73	  trackConfig: RaceTrackConfig | null | undefined,
74	): TrackProfile | null {
75	  const normalizedTrackId = normalizeTrackId(trackId);
76	  const baseProfile = loadTrackProfile(normalizedTrackId);
77	  if (!baseProfile) return null;
78	
79	  return {
80	    ...baseProfile,
81	    trackId: normalizedTrackId,
82	    startFinish: trackConfig?.startFinish ?? baseProfile.startFinish,
83	    checkpoints: trackConfig?.checkpoints?.length
84	      ? trackConfig.checkpoints
85	      : baseProfile.checkpoints,
86	  };
87	}
88	
89	export function getEffectiveTrackProfileFromSnapshot(
90	  snapshot: RaceSnapshot,
91	): TrackProfile | null {
92	  return getEffectiveTrackProfile(snapshot.trackId, snapshot.trackConfig ?? null);
93	}
94	
95	function hasTrackProfileAsset(trackId: string): boolean {
96	  const filePath = path.join(
97	    process.cwd(),
98	    "public",
99	    "assets",
100	    "tracks",
101	    trackId,
102	    "track.profile.json",
103	  );
104	  return fs.existsSync(filePath);
105	}

    ```tsx
    />
    ```
    ```ts
    async function loadTextFile(
      event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
      onName: (name: string) => void,
      onContent: (content: string) => void,
    ) {
      const file = event.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      onName(file.name);
      onContent(await file.text());
      event.target.value = "";
    }
    ```

  - Why important:
    - This is the new unified helper for track fallback and per-race effective track resolution.
    - It centralizes “default to `oval-track`”.
  - What it contains:
    - `DEFAULT_TRACK_ID = "oval-track"`
    - `normalizeTrackId(...)`
    - `parseRaceTrackConfigJson(...)`
    - `serializeRaceTrackConfig(...)`
    - `loadTrackProfile(...)`

  - Important code snippet:
    ```ts
    export const DEFAULT_TRACK_ID = "oval-track";
    const VALID_TRACK_IDS = new Set([DEFAULT_TRACK_ID, "circuit-track"]);
    ```
    ```ts
    export function normalizeTrackId(trackId: string | null | undefined): string {
      if (!trackId || !VALID_TRACK_IDS.has(trackId)) {
        return DEFAULT_TRACK_ID;
      }
      return hasTrackProfileAsset(trackId) ? trackId : DEFAULT_TRACK_ID;
    }
    ```
    ```ts
    export function getEffectiveTrackProfile(
      trackId: string | null | undefined,
      trackConfig: RaceTrackConfig | null | undefined,
    ): TrackProfile | null {
      const normalizedTrackId = normalizeTrackId(trackId);
      const baseProfile = loadTrackProfile(normalizedTrackId);
      if (!baseProfile) return null;

      return {
        ...baseProfile,
        trackId: normalizedTrackId,
        startFinish: trackConfig?.startFinish ?? baseProfile.startFinish,
        checkpoints: trackConfig?.checkpoints?.length
          ? trackConfig.checkpoints
          : baseProfile.checkpoints,
      };
    }
    ```

    ```ts
    try {
      parsedCheckpoints = JSON.parse(data.trackCheckpointsJson);
    } catch {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: "检查点配置必须是合法 JSON",
        path: ["trackCheckpointsJson"],

      return;

    if (!checkpointParse.success) {

        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: "检查点配置里的每一项都要包含 id / name / s",
    ```

```
213	export async function updateRaceContent(input: {
214	  organizerId: string;
215	  raceId: string;
216	  taskDescription: string;
217	  trainingDataSummary: string;
218	}) {
219	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({

221	      id: input.raceId,
222	    },
223	  });
224	
225	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
226	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
227	  }
228	
229	  if (getRacePhase(race) === "finished") {

231	  }
232	
233	  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
234	    const updatedRace = await tx.race.update({
235	      where: {
236	        id: input.raceId,
237	      },
238	      data: {
239	        taskDescription: input.taskDescription.trim(),
240	        trainingDataSummary: input.trainingDataSummary.trim(),

243	      },
244	    });
245	
246	    await tx.leaderboardEntry.deleteMany({
247	      where: { raceId: input.raceId },
248	    });
249	
250	    await tx.runnerTask.deleteMany({
251	      where: { raceId: input.raceId, taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL" },
252	    });
253	
254	    await tx.notification.create({
255	      data: {
256	        raceId: input.raceId,
257	        title: "题目已更新",
258	        content: `Organizer 更新了 ${updatedRace.title} 的题目描述或训练数据说明，原进度投影已清空`,
259	        target: "ALL",
260	      },
261	    });
262	
263	    return updatedRace;
264	  });
265	
266	  deleteRaceSnapshot(input.raceId);
267	  return updated;
268	}
```
