1	// RaceSnapshot 生成服务
2	// 从 ARY 数据库读取赛事数据 → 通过 Adapter 映射 → 写入 JSON 快照文件
3	
4	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
5	import {
6	  AryDerivedDataProvider,
7	  mapToCompetition,
8	  type AryRaceData,
9	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/adapter";
10	import { normalizeTrackId, parseRaceTrackConfigJson } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-config";
11	import type { RaceSnapshot } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
12	import fs from "node:fs";
13	import path from "node:path";
14	
15	const SNAPSHOT_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "assets", "snapshots");
16	
17	/**
18	 * 生成赛事快照 JSON
19	 *
20	 * 数据流：
21	 *   1. 从 Prisma 查询赛事全量数据
22	 *   2. 通过 AryDerivedDataProvider 映射为 Jumbotron 格式
23	 *   3. 写入 public/assets/snapshots/<raceId>.json
24	 *   4. 返回生成的快照对象
25	 */
26	export async function generateRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): Promise<RaceSnapshot> {
27	  // 1. 查询赛事全量数据
28	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
29	    where: { id: raceId },
30	    include: {
31	      organizer: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
32	      teams: {
33	        include: {
34	          captain: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
35	        },
36	      },
37	      leaderboardEntries: {
38	        orderBy: [{ totalScore: "desc" }, { createdAt: "asc" }],
39	      },
40	      submissions: {
41	        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
42	      },
43	      teamArchives: {
44	        orderBy: { totalScore: "desc" },
45	      },
46	      feedbackThreads: {
47	        include: {
48	          messages: {
49	            orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
50	          },
51	        },
52	      },
53	    },
54	  });
55	
56	  if (!race) {
57	    throw new Error(`赛事 ${raceId} 不存在`);
58	  }
59	
60	  // 2. 构造 AryRaceData
61	  const raceData: AryRaceData = {
62	    id: race.id,
63	    title: race.title,
64	    summary: race.summary,
65	    signupStart: race.signupStart,
66	    signupEnd: race.signupEnd,
67	    raceStart: race.raceStart,
68	    raceEnd: race.raceEnd,
69	    organizer: race.organizer,
70	    teams: race.teams.map((t) => ({
71	      id: t.id,
72	      name: t.name,
73	      captain: t.captain,
74	    })),
75	    leaderboardEntries: race.leaderboardEntries.map((e) => ({
76	      id: e.id,
77	      teamId: e.teamId,
78	      totalScore: e.totalScore,
79	      progress: e.progress,
80	      taskScore: e.taskScore,
81	      tokenScore: e.tokenScore,
82	      dialogueScore: e.dialogueScore,
83	      agentType: e.agentType,
84	      createdAt: e.createdAt,
85	    })),
86	    submissions: race.submissions.map((s) => ({
87	      id: s.id,
88	      teamId: s.teamId,
89	      createdAt: s.createdAt,
90	    })),
91	    teamArchives: race.teamArchives.map((a) => ({
92	      teamId: a.teamId,
93	      agentType: a.agentType,
94	      tokenUsed: a.tokenUsed,
95	      totalScore: a.totalScore,
96	      antiCheatPenalty: a.antiCheatPenalty,
97	    })),
98	    feedbackThreads: race.feedbackThreads.map((f) => ({
99	      teamId: f.teamId,
100	      messages: f.messages.map((m) => ({
101	        content: m.content,
102	        createdAt: m.createdAt,
103	      })),
104	    })),
105	  };
106	
107	  // 3. 通过 Adapter 映射
108	  const provider = new AryDerivedDataProvider(raceData);
109	  const now = new Date();
110	
111	  const [entries, messages, attentionItems, kpis] = await Promise.all([
112	    provider.getRaceEntries(raceId),
113	    provider.getRidingMessages(raceId),
114	    provider.getAttentionItems(raceId),
115	    provider.getCompetitionKPI(raceId),
116	  ]);
117	
118	  const competition = mapToCompetition(raceData, now);
119	
120	  // 4. 修正 KPIs：在线数 = 总数 - stale 数
121	  const staleCount = entries.filter((e) => e.status === "stale").length;
122	  kpis.onlineRiders = entries.length - staleCount;
123	  kpis.activeRiders = entries.filter((e) => e.status !== "stale" && e.status !== "idle").length;
124	
125	  // 5. 组装快照
126	  const snapshot: RaceSnapshot = {
127	    generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
128	    raceId,
129	    trackId: normalizeTrackId(race.trackId),
130	    trackConfig: parseRaceTrackConfigJson(race.trackConfigJson),
131	    competition,
132	    entries,
133	    kpis,
134	    messages,
135	    attentionItems,
136	  };
137	
138	  // 5. 写入文件
139	  ensureSnapshotDir();
140	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
141	  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2), "utf-8");
142	
143	  return snapshot;
144	}
145	
146	/**
147	 * 读取已生成的快照（供 Jumbotron 页面静态消费）
148	 */
149	export function loadRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): RaceSnapshot | null {
150	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
151	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
152	
153	  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
154	  return JSON.parse(raw) as RaceSnapshot;
155	}
156	
157	/**
158	 * 列出所有已生成的快照 ID
159	 */
160	export function listSnapshotIds(): string[] {
161	  ensureSnapshotDir();
162	  return fs
163	    .readdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)
164	    .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"))
165	    .map((f) => f.replace(".json", ""));
166	}
167	
168	export function deleteRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): void {
169	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
170	  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
171	    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
172	  }
173	}
174	
175	function ensureSnapshotDir(): void {
176	  if (!fs.existsSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)) {
177	    fs.mkdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR, { recursive: true });
178	  }
179	}

10	export async function createSubmission(riderId: string, formData: FormData) {
11	  const parsed = createSubmissionSchema.parse({
12	    raceId: formData.get("raceId"),
13	    codeLabel: formData.get("codeLabel"),
14	    codeContent: formData.get("codeContent"),
15	    recordLabel: formData.get("recordLabel"),
16	    ridingRecord: formData.get("ridingRecord"),
17	    tokenUsed: formData.get("tokenUsed"),
18	    agentType: formData.get("agentType"),
19	  });
20	
21	  const team = await prisma.team.findFirst({
22	    where: {
23	      captainId: riderId,
24	      raceId: parsed.raceId,
25	    },
26	  });
27	
28	  if (!team) {
29	    throw new Error("请先报名参赛");
30	  }
31	
32	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
33	    where: {
34	      id: parsed.raceId,
35	    },
36	  });
37	
38	  if (!race) {
39	    throw new Error("赛事不存在");
40	  }
41	
42	  const phase = getRacePhase(race);
43	  if (phase !== "active" && phase !== "frozen") {
44	    throw new Error("只有比赛中或封榜期才能提交");
45	  }
46	
47	  const lastSubmission = await prisma.submission.findFirst({
48	    where: {
49	      teamId: team.id,
50	    },
51	    orderBy: {
52	      createdAt: "desc",
53	    },
54	  });
55	
56	  if (lastSubmission) {
57	    const cooldownMs = race.submissionIntervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
58	    const elapsed = Date.now() - lastSubmission.createdAt.getTime();
59	    if (elapsed < cooldownMs) {
60	      const minutes = Math.ceil((cooldownMs - elapsed) / 60000);
61	      throw new Error(`提交过于频繁，请 ${minutes} 分钟后再试`);
62	    }
63	  }
64	
65	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
66	    const submission = await tx.submission.create({
67	      data: {
68	        agentType: parsed.agentType,
69	        codeContent: parsed.codeContent,
70	        codeLabel: parsed.codeLabel,
71	        raceId: parsed.raceId,
72	        recordLabel: parsed.recordLabel,
73	        ridingRecord: parsed.ridingRecord,
74	        status: SubmissionStatus.QUEUED,
75	        teamId: team.id,
76	        tokenUsed: parsed.tokenUsed,
77	      },
78	    });
79	
80	    const artifact = await tx.submissionArtifact.create({
81	      data: {
82	        agentType: parsed.agentType,
83	        codeContent: parsed.codeContent,
84	        codeLabel: parsed.codeLabel,
85	        raceId: parsed.raceId,
86	        recordLabel: parsed.recordLabel,
87	        ridingRecord: parsed.ridingRecord,
88	        submissionId: submission.id,
89	        teamId: team.id,
90	        tokenUsed: parsed.tokenUsed,
91	      },
92	    });
93	
94	    await enqueueSubmissionTestTask({
95	      artifactId: artifact.id,
96	      raceId: parsed.raceId,

54	export async function enqueueProgressEvalTasks(raceId: string) {
55	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
56	    where: { id: raceId },
57	  });
58	
59	  if (!race) {
60	    throw new Error("赛事不存在");
61	  }
62	
63	  const phase = getRacePhase(race);
64	  if (phase !== "active" && phase !== "frozen") {
65	    throw new Error("只有比赛中或封榜期才能发起进度评测");
66	  }
67	
68	  const latestArtifacts = await getLatestArtifactsForRace(raceId);
69	  if (latestArtifacts.length === 0) {
70	    throw new Error("当前还没有可评测提交");
71	  }
72	
73	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
74	    for (const artifact of latestArtifacts) {
75	      await staleActiveRunnerTasks(tx, artifact.teamId, ["PROGRESS_EVAL"]);
76	      await tx.runnerTask.create({
77	        data: {
78	          artifactId: artifact.id,
79	          raceId,
80	          submissionId: artifact.submissionId,
81	          taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL",

83	        },

205	export async function completeRunnerTask(input: RunnerResultInput) {
206	  const task = await prisma.runnerTask.findUnique({
207	    where: { id: input.taskId },
208	    include: {
209	      artifact: true,
210	      race: true,
211	      submission: true,
212	      team: true,
213	    },
214	  });
215	
216	  if (!task) {
217	    throw new Error("任务不存在");
218	  }
219	
220	  if (task.submissionId !== input.submissionId) {
221	    throw new Error("任务与提交不匹配");
222	  }
223	
224	  if (task.status === "STALE") {
225	    throw new Error("任务已失效，不能再回传结果");
226	  }
227	
228	  if (task.status !== "CLAIMED") {
229	    throw new Error("只能回传已拉取任务的结果");
230	  }
231	
232	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
233	    await tx.runnerTask.update({
234	      where: { id: task.id },
235	      data: {
236	        finishedAt: input.finishedAt ? new Date(input.finishedAt) : new Date(),
237	        resultHash: input.resultHash ?? null,
238	        runnerComment: input.runnerComment || null,
239	        score: input.score,
240	        status: input.status === "succeeded" ? "SUCCEEDED" : "FAILED",
241	      },
242	    });
243	
244	    if (input.status === "failed") {
245	      if (task.taskType === "SUBMISSION_TEST") {
246	        await tx.submission.update({
247	          where: { id: task.submissionId },
248	          data: {
249	            runnerComment: input.runnerComment || null,
250	            runnerStatus: "failed",
251	            scoredAt: new Date(),
252	            status: SubmissionStatus.FAILED,
253	          },
254	        });
255	      }
256	      return;
257	    }
258	
259	    switch (task.taskType) {
260	      case "SUBMISSION_TEST":
261	        await projectSubmissionTestSuccess(tx, task, input);
262	        break;
263	      case "PROGRESS_EVAL":
264	        await projectProgressEvalSuccess(tx, task, input);
265	        break;
266	      case "HARNESS_EVAL":
267	        await projectHarnessEvalSuccess(tx, task, input);
268	        break;
269	    }
270	  });
271	}

551	  keywordScore: number,

556	  const safeK = weightKeyword > 0 ? weightKeyword : 1;
557	  const total = safeR + safeK;
558	  return Math.round((reasoningScore * (safeR / total) + keywordScore * (safeK / total)) * 10) / 10;

59	export function normalizeWeights(weights: ScoreWeights): ScoreWeights {
60	  const task = normalizePair(weights.taskPassRate, weights.codeReview);
61	  const dialogue = normalizePair(weights.reasoning, weights.keywords);
62	  const total = normalizeTriple(
63	    weights.totalTask,
64	    weights.totalToken,
65	    weights.totalDialogue,
66	  );
67	
68	  return {
69	    taskPassRate: task[0],
70	    codeReview: task[1],
71	    reasoning: dialogue[0],
72	    keywords: dialogue[1],
73	    totalTask: total[0],
74	    totalToken: total[1],
75	    totalDialogue: total[2],
76	  };
77	}

79	export function buildScoreResult(input: {
80	  weights: ScoreWeights;
81	  tokenLimit: number;
82	  keywords: string[];
83	  artifact: SubmissionArtifactInput;
84	  runner: RunnerScoreInput;
85	}): ScoreResult {
86	  const weights = normalizeWeights(input.weights);
87	  const keywordScore = getKeywordScore(input.artifact.ridingRecord, input.keywords);
88	  const tokenScore = getTokenScore(input.artifact.tokenUsed, input.tokenLimit);
89	  const taskScore =
90	    input.runner.passRate * weights.taskPassRate +
91	    input.runner.codeReviewScore * weights.codeReview;
92	  const dialogueScore =
93	    input.runner.reasoningScore * weights.reasoning +
94	    keywordScore * weights.keywords;
95	  const antiCheatPenalty = getAntiCheatPenalty(input.artifact);
96	  const totalScore =
97	    taskScore * weights.totalTask +
98	    tokenScore * weights.totalToken +
99	    dialogueScore * weights.totalDialogue -
100	    antiCheatPenalty;
101	
102	  return {
103	    passRate: roundScore(input.runner.passRate),
104	    codeReviewScore: roundScore(input.runner.codeReviewScore),
105	    reasoningScore: roundScore(input.runner.reasoningScore),
106	    keywordScore: roundScore(keywordScore),
107	    tokenScore: roundScore(tokenScore),
108	    taskScore: roundScore(taskScore),
109	    dialogueScore: roundScore(dialogueScore),
110	    totalScore: roundScore(Math.max(0, totalScore)),
111	    antiCheatPenalty: roundScore(antiCheatPenalty),
112	    runnerComment: input.runner.runnerComment.trim(),
113	    runnerStatus: input.runner.status,
114	  };

133	function getKeywordScore(text: string, keywords: string[]): number {
134	  if (keywords.length === 0) {
135	    return 100;
136	  }
137	
138	  const matched = keywords.filter((keyword) => text.includes(keyword)).length;
139	  return (matched / keywords.length) * 100;
140	}
141	
142	function getTokenScore(tokenUsed: number, tokenLimit: number): number {
143	  if (tokenLimit <= 0) {
144	    return 100;
145	  }
146	
147	  return Math.max(0, 100 * (1 - tokenUsed / tokenLimit));
148	}
149	
150	function getAntiCheatPenalty(artifact: SubmissionArtifactInput): number {
151	  const combined = `${artifact.codeContent}\n${artifact.ridingRecord}`.toLowerCase();
152	
153	  return INDUCEMENT_TERMS.some((term) => combined.includes(term.toLowerCase()))
154	    ? 20
155	    : 0;
156	}
157	
158	function normalizePair(left: number, right: number): [number, number] {
159	  const safeLeft = left > 0 ? left : 1;
160	  const safeRight = right > 0 ? right : 1;
161	  const total = safeLeft + safeRight;
162	
163	  return [safeLeft / total, safeRight / total];
164	}
165	
166	function normalizeTriple(
167	  first: number,
168	  second: number,
169	  third: number,
170	): [number, number, number] {
171	  const safe = [first, second, third].map((value) => (value > 0 ? value : 1));
172	  const total = safe.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
173	
174	  return [safe[0] / total, safe[1] / total, safe[2] / total];
175	}
176	
177	function roundScore(value: number): number {
178	  return Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
179	}

`next-env.d.ts` 是 Next.js 自动生成的 TypeScript 环境声明文件。它的作用主要是两件事：

1. 给项目注入 Next 的类型定义，比如 `next`、`next/image`、路由类型这些。
2. 把 `.next` 里生成的路由类型接进来，所以编辑器和 `tsc` 才能识别 App Router 的页面路径。

这个文件一般**不应该手改**，Next 会自己维护它。

215	export function PublicRaceSections({ race }: { race: RaceListItem }) {
216	  const isRunningPhase = race.phase === "active" || race.phase === "frozen";
217	  const isFinishedPhase = race.phase === "finished";
218	
219	  return (
220	    <>
221	      <header className="race-panel__header">
222	        <div>
223	          <p className="eyebrow">{getRacePhaseLabel(race.phase)}</p>
224	          <h2>{race.title}</h2>
225	          <p>{race.summary}</p>
226	        </div>
227	        <div className="meta-pills">
228	          <span>{race.teams.length} 支队伍</span>
229	          <span>{race.submissionIntervalHours}h 提交冷却</span>
230	          <span>Top {race.displayHighlightCount} Highlight</span>
231	        </div>
232	      </header>
233	
234	      <section className="grid">
235	        <Panel title="公开规则" eyebrow="Public Projection">
236	          <dl className="detail-grid">
237	            <div>
238	              <dt>题目包</dt>
239	              <dd>
240	                {race.taskPackageLabel}
241	                {race.cloudStudioUrl ? (
242	                  <span> · <a href={race.cloudStudioUrl}>打开任务入口</a></span>
243	                ) : null}
244	              </dd>
245	            </div>
246	            <div>
247	              <dt>赛道</dt>
248	              <dd>{race.trackId}</dd>
249	            </div>
250	            <div>
251	              <dt>CloudStudio</dt>
252	              <dd>{race.cloudStudioUrl || "未设置"}</dd>
253	            </div>
254	            <div>
255	              <dt>报名时间</dt>
256	              <dd>
257	                {formatDateTime(race.signupStart)} -{" "}
258	                {formatDateTime(race.signupEnd)}
259	              </dd>
260	            </div>
261	            <div>
262	              <dt>比赛时间</dt>
263	              <dd>
264	                {formatDateTime(race.raceStart)} -{" "}
265	                {formatDateTime(race.raceEnd)}
266	              </dd>
267	            </div>
268	            <div>
269	              <dt>评测说明</dt>
270	              <dd>{race.evaluationNotes}</dd>
271	            </div>
272	            <div>
273	              <dt>关键词</dt>
274	              <dd>{race.keywords.join(" / ")}</dd>
275	            </div>
276	          </dl>
277	        </Panel>
278	
279	        {isRunningPhase ? (
280	          <Panel title="过程榜单" eyebrow="Leaderboard">
281	            {shouldHidePublicLeaderboard(race.phase) ? (
282	              <p className="muted">当前处于封榜阶段，公开榜单暂时隐藏。</p>
283	            ) : race.leaderboardEntries.length === 0 ? (
284	              <p className="muted">尚未同步榜单。</p>
285	            ) : (
286	              <table className="table">
287	                <thead>
288	                  <tr>
289	                    <th>排名</th>
290	                    <th>队伍</th>
291	                    <th>总分</th>
292	                    <th>任务</th>
293	                    <th>Token</th>
294	                    <th>对话</th>
295	                    <th>Agent</th>
296	                  </tr>
297	                </thead>
298	                <tbody>
299	                  {race.leaderboardEntries.map((entry) => (
300	                    <tr key={entry.id}>
301	                      <td>{entry.rank}</td>
302	                      <td>{entry.team.name}</td>
303	                      <td>{entry.totalScore}</td>
304	                      <td>{entry.taskScore ?? "-"}</td>
305	                      <td>{entry.tokenScore ?? "-"}</td>
306	                      <td>{entry.dialogueScore ?? "-"}</td>
307	                      <td>{getAgentLabel(entry.agentType)}</td>
308	                    </tr>
309	                  ))}
310	                </tbody>
311	              </table>
312	            )}
313	          </Panel>
314	        ) : isFinishedPhase ? (
315	          <Panel title="最终公开结果" eyebrow="Final Result">
316	            {race.harnessEntries.length > 0 ? (
317	              <table className="table">
318	                <thead>
319	                  <tr>
320	                    <th>队伍</th>
321	                    <th>Harness</th>
322	                    <th>Reasoning</th>
323	                    <th>Keyword</th>
324	                  </tr>
325	                </thead>
326	                <tbody>
327	                  {race.harnessEntries.map((entry) => (
328	                    <tr key={entry.id}>
329	                      <td>{entry.team.name}</td>
330	                      <td>{entry.harnessScore}</td>
331	                      <td>{entry.reasoningScore ?? "-"}</td>
332	                      <td>{entry.keywordScore ?? "-"}</td>
333	                    </tr>
334	                  ))}
335	                </tbody>
336	              </table>
337	            ) : race.leaderboardEntries.length > 0 ? (
338	              <table className="table">
339	                <thead>
340	                  <tr>
341	                    <th>排名</th>
342	                    <th>队伍</th>
343	                    <th>总分</th>
344	                    <th>Agent</th>
345	                  </tr>
346	                </thead>
347	                <tbody>
348	                  {race.leaderboardEntries.map((entry) => (
349	                    <tr key={entry.id}>
350	                      <td>{entry.rank}</td>
351	                      <td>{entry.team.name}</td>
352	                      <td>{entry.totalScore}</td>
353	                      <td>{getAgentLabel(entry.agentType)}</td>
354	                    </tr>
355	                  ))}
356	                </tbody>
357	              </table>
358	            ) : (
359	              <p className="muted">最终公开结果尚未发布。</p>
360	            )}
361	          </Panel>
362	        ) : (
363	          <Panel title="当前阶段说明" eyebrow="Stage">
364	            <div className="stack">
365	              <p className="muted">
366	                当前阶段主要展示赛事说明、报名时间和任务入口；过程榜单与赛马大屏将在比赛开始后开放。
367	              </p>
368	              <p>
369	                当前默认赛道模板：{race.trackId}。即使比赛尚未开始，也已经绑定了统一底图，不是缺少背景图。
370	              </p>
371	              <p>
372	                如果你是参赛者，请在比赛开始前完成组队、环境准备和题目理解。
373	              </p>
374	            </div>
375	          </Panel>
376	        )}
377	      </section>
378	
379	      <section className="grid">
380	        <Panel title="题目与披露边界" eyebrow="Boundary">
381	          <div className="stack">
382	            <p>{race.taskDescription}</p>
383	            <p>
384	              训练数据：
385	              {race.displayShowTrainingData
386	                ? ` ${race.trainingDataSummary || "未填写"}`
387	                : " Organizer 未公开"}
388	            </p>
389	            <ul className="bullet-list">
390	              <li>
391	                Organizer 评论：
392	                {race.displayShowOrganizerComment ? "公开" : "不公开"}
393	              </li>
394	              <li>
395	                Rider 代码：
396	                {race.displayShowRiderCode ? "公开" : "不公开"}
397	              </li>
398	              <li>
399	                Top Highlights：
400	                {race.displayShowTopHighlights
401	                  ? `公开前 ${race.displayHighlightCount} 条`
402	                  : "不公开"}
403	              </li>
404	            </ul>
405	          </div>
406	        </Panel>
407	
408	        {isFinishedPhase ? (
409	          <Panel title="赛后展示" eyebrow="Showcase">
410	            {race.highlights.length === 0 && race.harnessEntries.length === 0 ? (
411	              <p className="muted">尚未发布赛后展示。</p>
412	            ) : (
413	              <div className="stack">
414	                {race.highlights.map((highlight) => (
415	                  <div className="highlight-card" key={highlight.id}>
416	                    <div className="highlight-card__top">
417	                      <strong>{highlight.team.name}</strong>
418	                      <span>
419	                        {getAgentLabel(highlight.agentType)} / {highlight.score}
420	                      </span>
421	                    </div>
422	                    <p>{highlight.excerpt}</p>
423	                    {race.displayShowRiderCode ? (
424	                      <pre>{highlight.codeSnippet}</pre>
425	                    ) : null}
426	                  </div>
427	                ))}
428	
429	                {race.displayShowOrganizerComment && race.organizerComment ? (
430	                  <blockquote className="comment-card">
431	                    {race.organizerComment}
432	                  </blockquote>
433	                ) : null}
434	              </div>
435	            )}
436	          </Panel>
437	        ) : isRunningPhase ? (
438	          <Panel title="比赛进行提示" eyebrow="Live Race">
439	            <div className="stack">
440	              <p className="muted">
441	                当前比赛处于进行中阶段，首页会展示过程榜单与赛马大屏；赛后披露内容将在比赛结束后按 Organizer 配置公开。
442	              </p>
443	              <p>
444	                若处于封榜阶段，公开榜单会暂时隐藏，但比赛动态仍可通过大屏继续观看。
445	              </p>
446	            </div>
447	          </Panel>
448	        ) : (
449	          <Panel title="报名与准备提示" eyebrow="Preparation">
450	            <div className="stack">
451	              <p className="muted">
452	                当前仍在报名或准备阶段，首页不展示赛马大屏，避免把尚未开始的比赛误呈现为实时竞速。
453	              </p>
454	              <p>
455	                公开可见的内容以赛事说明、时间安排和任务入口为主。
456	              </p>
457	            </div>
458	          </Panel>
459	        )}
460	      </section>
461	    </>
462	  );
463	}

469	function AuthForm({
470	  action,
471	  description,
472	  includeRegisterFields = false,
473	  submitLabel,
474	  title,
475	}: {
476	  action: FormAction;
477	  description: string;
478	  includeRegisterFields?: boolean;
479	  submitLabel: string;
480	  title: string;
481	}) {
482	  return (
483	    <form action={action} className="form-grid">
484	      <div className="stack">
485	        <strong>{title}</strong>
486	        <p className="muted">{description}</p>
487	      </div>
488	      {includeRegisterFields ? (
489	        <>
490	          <label>
491	            角色
492	            <select defaultValue="RIDER" name="role">
493	              <option value="ORGANIZER">Organizer</option>
494	              <option value="RIDER">Rider</option>
495	            </select>
496	          </label>
497	        </>
498	      ) : null}
499	      <label>
500	        用户名
501	        <input name="username" placeholder="username" required />
502	      </label>
503	      <label>
504	        密码
505	        <input
506	          name="password"
507	          placeholder="password"
508	          required
509	          type="password"
510	        />
511	      </label>
512	      <button type="submit">{submitLabel}</button>
513	    </form>
514	  );
515	}

1	import {
2	  AgentType,
3	  SubmissionStatus,
4	} from "@/generated/prisma/enums";
5	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
6	import { getRacePhase } from "@/lib/race-phase";
7	import { enqueueSubmissionTestTask } from "@/lib/services/runner";
8	import { createSubmissionSchema } from "@/lib/validation";
9	
10	export async function createSubmission(riderId: string, formData: FormData) {
11	  const parsed = createSubmissionSchema.parse({
12	    raceId: formData.get("raceId"),
13	    codeLabel: formData.get("codeLabel"),
14	    codeContent: formData.get("codeContent"),
15	    tokenUsed: formData.get("tokenUsed"),
16	    agentType: formData.get("agentType"),
17	  });
18	
19	  const team = await prisma.team.findFirst({
20	    where: {
21	      captainId: riderId,
22	      raceId: parsed.raceId,
23	    },
24	  });
25	
26	  if (!team) {
27	    throw new Error("请先报名参赛");
28	  }
29	
30	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
31	    where: {
32	      id: parsed.raceId,
33	    },
34	  });
35	
36	  if (!race) {
37	    throw new Error("赛事不存在");
38	  }
39	
40	  const phase = getRacePhase(race);
41	  if (phase !== "active" && phase !== "frozen") {
42	    throw new Error("只有比赛中或封榜期才能提交");
43	  }
44	
45	  const lastSubmission = await prisma.submission.findFirst({
46	    where: {
47	      teamId: team.id,
48	    },
49	    orderBy: {
50	      createdAt: "desc",
51	    },
52	  });
53	
54	  if (lastSubmission) {
55	    const cooldownMs = race.submissionIntervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
56	    const elapsed = Date.now() - lastSubmission.createdAt.getTime();
57	    if (elapsed < cooldownMs) {
58	      const minutes = Math.ceil((cooldownMs - elapsed) / 60000);
59	      throw new Error(`提交过于频繁，请 ${minutes} 分钟后再试`);
60	    }
61	  }
62	
63	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
64	    const submission = await tx.submission.create({
65	      data: {
66	        agentType: parsed.agentType,
67	        codeContent: parsed.codeContent,
68	        codeLabel: parsed.codeLabel,
69	        raceId: parsed.raceId,
70	        recordLabel: null,
71	        ridingRecord: null,
72	        status: SubmissionStatus.QUEUED,
73	        teamId: team.id,
74	        tokenUsed: parsed.tokenUsed,
75	      },
76	    });
77	
78	    const artifact = await tx.submissionArtifact.create({
79	      data: {
80	        agentType: parsed.agentType,
81	        codeContent: parsed.codeContent,
82	        codeLabel: parsed.codeLabel,
83	        raceId: parsed.raceId,
84	        recordLabel: null,
85	        ridingRecord: null,
86	        submissionId: submission.id,
87	        teamId: team.id,
88	        tokenUsed: parsed.tokenUsed,
89	      },
90	    });
91	
92	    await enqueueSubmissionTestTask({
93	      artifactId: artifact.id,
94	      raceId: parsed.raceId,
95	      submissionId: submission.id,
96	      teamId: team.id,
97	      tx,
98	    });
99	
100	    return submission;
101	  });
102	}
103	
104	export function getAgentLabel(agent: AgentType): string {
105	  switch (agent) {
106	    case AgentType.CLAUDE:
107	      return "Claude";
108	    case AgentType.COPILOT:
109	      return "Copilot";
110	    case AgentType.DEEPSEEK:
111	      return "DeepSeek";
112	    case AgentType.ZHIPU:
113	      return "Zhipu";
114	    case AgentType.OPENAI:
115	      return "OpenAI";
116	    case AgentType.CUSTOM:
117	      return "Custom";
118	    default:
119	      return "Unknown";
120	  }
121	}
122

1	# ARY Runner 第一期重构说明
2	
3	日期：2026-06-06
4	
5	## 1. 这份文档的目的
6	
7	这份文档用于总结当前工作区里已经完成的 runner 第一期重构改动。
8	
9	它回答四个问题：
10	
11	1. 这轮改动想解决什么问题
12	2. 实际改了哪些代码和数据模型
13	3. 现在 runner 主链路变成了什么样
14	4. 哪些部分已经验证通过，哪些部分还留给下一阶段
15	
16	## 2. 这轮改动的核心目标
17	
18	这轮改动的核心目标是把当前项目里的 runner 流程，从“ARY 直接围绕 `Submission` 做评分”重构成“以独立任务为中心的 runner 主链路”，并且把分数计算边界改成：
19	
20	- 分数全部由 organizer 侧 runner 计算
21	- ARY 只接收最终分数和结果摘要
22	
23	同时保留以下约束：
24	
25	- 第一阶段先不实现 `register / heartbeat / renew / status / fail`
26	- 第一阶段继续复用当前按钮触发任务
27	- 第一阶段继续让 `pull` 返回内联内容，不先做 signed URL 下载链路
28	
29	## 3. 已完成的模型改动
30	
31	### 3.1 新增的 schema
32	
33	在 [prisma/schema.prisma](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/prisma/schema.prisma) 中新增了：
34	
35	- `RunnerTaskType`
36	  - `SUBMISSION_TEST`
37	  - `PROGRESS_EVAL`
38	  - `HARNESS_EVAL`
39	- `RunnerTaskStatus`
40	  - `QUEUED`
41	  - `CLAIMED`
42	  - `SUCCEEDED`
43	  - `FAILED`
44	  - `STALE`
45	- `SubmissionArtifact`
46	  - 保存某次提交对应的不可变评测输入
47	- `RunnerTask`
48	  - 保存独立 runner 任务
49	
50	### 3.2 现有 schema 的调整
51	
52	还做了这些兼容性调整：
53	
54	- `SubmissionStatus` 新增 `FAILED`
55	- `Submission.recordLabel` 改为可空
56	- `Submission.ridingRecord` 继续可空
57	- `TeamArchive.recordLabel` / `ridingRecord` 改为可空
58	- `TeamArchive.taskScore` / `dialogueScore` / `tokenScore` / `reasoningScore` / `keywordScore` 改为可空
59	- `LeaderboardEntry.taskScore` / `tokenScore` / `dialogueScore` 改为可空
60	- `HarnessEntry.reasoningScore` / `keywordScore` 改为可空
61	- `LeaderboardEntry` 增加 `raceId + teamId` 唯一约束
62	- `HarnessEntry` 增加 `raceId + teamId` 唯一约束
63	
64	### 3.3 migration
65	
66	新增 migration：
67	
68	- [20260606190000_runner_tasks](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/prisma/migrations/20260606190000_runner_tasks/migration.sql)
69	
70	这个 migration 做了两类事情：
71	
72	1. 重建旧表，使可空字段和唯一约束与新模型一致
73	2. 新建 `SubmissionArtifact` 与 `RunnerTask`
74	
75	## 4. 已完成的服务层改动
76	
77	### 4.1 `Submission` 的职责被收窄
78	
79	[src/lib/services/submissions.ts](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/services/submissions.ts) 现在只负责：
80	
81	- 处理用户提交
82	- 创建 `Submission`
83	- 创建 `SubmissionArtifact`
84	- 自动入队一个 `SUBMISSION_TEST` 任务
85	
86	它不再负责：
87	
88	- runner 拉取任务
89	- runner 回传结果
90	- ARY 自己计算分数
91	- 直接重算公开榜单或 Harness 展示
92	
93	### 4.2 新增独立 runner service
94	
95	新增文件：
96	
97	- [src/lib/services/runner.ts](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/services/runner.ts)
98	
99	当前它已经负责：
100	
101	- `enqueueSubmissionTestTask`
102	- `enqueueProgressEvalTasks`
103	- `enqueueHarnessEvalTasks`
104	- `pullRunnerTask`
105	- `completeRunnerTask`
106	
107	当前落地的行为是：
108	
109	- `submitEntryAction` 创建提交后自动生成一条 `SUBMISSION_TEST` 任务
110	- Organizer 点“发起进度评测”会按队伍最新 artifact 生成 `PROGRESS_EVAL`
111	- Organizer 点“发起 Harness 评测”会按有 `Riding Record` 的队伍最新 artifact 生成 `HARNESS_EVAL`
112	- 同一队伍同一类型的未完成旧任务会被标记为 `STALE`
113	- runner 从 `RunnerTask` 拉任务，不再直接从 `Submission` 拉
114	- runner 回传结果时，只以最终分数为主，不再要求分项评分输入
115	
116	### 4.3 结果投影规则
117	
118	当前代码里，任务完成后的投影规则是：
119	
120	- `SUBMISSION_TEST`
121	  - 回写 `Submission.totalScore`
122	  - 更新 `Submission.status`
123	  - 清空主提交流水中的原文
124	- `PROGRESS_EVAL`
125	  - 更新 `TeamArchive`
126	  - 更新 `LeaderboardEntry`
127	  - 更新 `Race.lastLeaderboardSyncAt`
128	- `HARNESS_EVAL`
129	  - 更新 `HarnessEntry`
130	  - 重建 `RidingHighlight`
131	  - 更新 `Race.lastShowcaseSyncAt`
132	
133	这里的重要变化是：
134	
135	- ARY 不再根据 `passRate / codeReviewScore / reasoningScore` 自己算总分
136	- runner 直接回最终 `score`
137	
138	## 5. 已完成的接口改动

141	
142	[src/app/api/runner/tasks/pull/route.ts](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/api/runner/tasks/pull/route.ts) 已改为走新的 `runner.ts`。

163	当前接收：
164	
165	- `taskId`
166	- `submissionId`

172	
173	它不再接收：
174	
175	- `passRate`
176	- `codeReviewScore`
177	- `reasoningScore`
178

1	import type { Race } from "@/generated/prisma/client";
2	
3	export type RacePhase =
4	  | "registration"
5	  | "preparation"
6	  | "active"
7	  | "frozen"
8	  | "finished";
9	
10	export function getRacePhase(race: Pick<Race, "signupStart" | "signupEnd" | "raceStart" | "raceEnd" | "enableFreeze" | "freezeMinutesBeforeEnd">, now: Date = new Date()): RacePhase {
11	  if (now >= race.raceEnd) {
12	    return "finished";
13	  }
14	
15	  if (now >= race.raceStart) {
16	    if (!race.enableFreeze) {
17	      return "active";
18	    }
19	
20	    const freezeTime = new Date(
21	      race.raceEnd.getTime() - race.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd * 60 * 1000,
22	    );
23	    return now >= freezeTime ? "frozen" : "active";
24	  }
25	
26	  if (now > race.signupEnd || now < race.signupStart) {
27	    return "preparation";
28	  }
29	
30	  return "registration";
31	}
32	
33	export function getRacePhaseLabel(phase: RacePhase): string {
34	  switch (phase) {
35	    case "registration":
36	      return "报名中";
37	    case "preparation":
38	      return "报名结束";
39	    case "active":
40	      return "比赛中";
41	    case "frozen":
42	      return "封榜中";
43	    case "finished":
44	      return "比赛结束";
45	  }
46	}
47	
48	export function shouldHidePublicLeaderboard(phase: RacePhase): boolean {
49	  return phase === "frozen";
50	}

大体上**已经实现了，但有一个边界我需要明确说清楚**：

### 已经实现的部分
1. **赛后提交的代码 + Riding Record 会进入企业 Runner 链路**
   - 赛后表单提交后会生成带 `codeContent + ridingRecord` 的 artifact
   - `src/lib/services/submissions.ts` 里的 `createFinalSubmission()` 已经这么做了

2. **企业 Runner 拉取 Harness 任务时，会拿到代码和 Riding Record**
   - `src/lib/services/runner.ts:174` 的 `buildRunnerTaskPayload(...)`
   - 对 `HARNESS_EVAL` 会带上：
     - `codeLabel`
     - `codeContent`
     - `recordLabel`
     - `ridingRecord`

3. **Runner 回传总分后，会进入最后榜单**
   - `completeRunnerTask()` 里 `HARNESS_EVAL` 会走 `projectHarnessEvalSuccess()`
   - 它会更新 `HarnessEntry`
   - 首页 `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx:315` 在比赛结束阶段优先展示 `harnessEntries`
   - 所以最终榜单显示的是企业 Runner 回传后的赛后总分

4. **企业没勾选的展示项不会展示**
   - `Organizer 评论`、`Rider 代码`、`Top Highlights` 都受展示开关控制
   - 这些控制在 `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx:389` 和 `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx:409` 之后那块已经生效

### 还差的一点
**赛后提交后不会自动创建 Harness 任务。**

现在的逻辑是：
- Rider 赛后提交代码 + Riding Record
- 然后 **Organizer 还要点一次**“发起 Harness 评测”
- 之后 Runner 才会去拉取这些赛后提交

也就是说：
- **“由 Runner 拉取到企业处并返回总分显示最终榜单”这条主链路是有的**

32	
33	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
34	    where: {
35	      id: parsed.raceId,
36	    },
37	  });
38	
39	  if (!race) {
40	    throw new Error("赛事不存在");
41	  }
42	
43	  const phase = getRacePhase(race);
44	  if (phase !== "active" && phase !== "frozen") {
45	    throw new Error("只有比赛中或封榜期才能提交");
46	  }
47	
48	  const lastSubmission = await prisma.submission.findFirst({
49	    where: {
50	      teamId: team.id,
51	    },
52	    orderBy: {
53	      createdAt: "desc",
54	    },
55	  });
56	
57	  if (lastSubmission) {
58	    const cooldownMs = race.submissionIntervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
59	    const elapsed = Date.now() - lastSubmission.createdAt.getTime();
60	    if (elapsed < cooldownMs) {
61	      const minutes = Math.ceil((cooldownMs - elapsed) / 60000);
62	      throw new Error(`提交过于频繁，请 ${minutes} 分钟后再试`);
63	    }
64	  }

我把赛后提交自动入队这条链路补上，先看当前 runner 入队逻辑在哪里最适合接。

我看到现状里赛后提交只落库，还没在提交时自动生成 `HARNESS_EVAL` 任务；我现在把这一步接上。

我再跑一遍类型和构建，确认自动入队没有把 runner 事务链路打坏。

已经补上了。

现在赛后链路变成：

- Rider 在**比赛结束后**提交 **最终代码 + Riding Record**
- `src/lib/services/submissions.ts:143` 在落库后会**自动创建对应的 `HARNESS_EVAL` 任务**
- Runner 不需要等 Organizer 再点按钮，就可以直接从 `/api/runner/tasks/pull` 拉到这条赛后评测任务
- Runner 回传总分后，最终榜单会显示 `HarnessEntry`
- 企业没有勾选的展示项，前端还是照旧不展示

我这次补的关键点是：
- `src/lib/services/runner.ts`：抽出 `enqueueHarnessEvalTaskForArtifact(...)`
- `src/lib/services/submissions.ts`：`createFinalSubmission()` 创建赛后 artifact 后，立即自动入队 `HARNESS_EVAL`

1	"use client";

3	import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
4	import type { RaceSnapshot, TrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
5	import { samplePath, sampleAt, tangentAngle, normal } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/path-sampler";
6	import { assignLane } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/lane-manager";
7	import { resolveMotionState } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state";
8	
9	interface Props {
10	  snapshot: RaceSnapshot;
11	  trackProfile: TrackProfile;
12	}
13	
14	const BASE_LERP = 0.03; // 基础插值速度
15	
16	export default function JumbotronClient({ snapshot, trackProfile }: Props) {
17	  const [debug, setDebug] = useState(false);
18	  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(snapshot.competition.elapsedTime);
19	  const [kpiDetail, setKpiDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);
20	  const [detailEntry, setDetailEntry] = useState<string | null>(null); // drill-down 面板
21	
22	  // -- s-axis 动画状态 --
23	  const [displayS, setDisplayS] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
24	  const rafRef = useRef<number>(0);
25	
26	  const sorted = useMemo(
27	    () => [...snapshot.entries].sort((a, b) => (a.rank ?? 999) - (b.rank ?? 999)),
28	    [snapshot.entries],
29	  );
30	
31	  // 目标 s 值
32	  const targetS = useMemo(() => {
33	    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
34	    for (const e of sorted) map[e.entryId] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, e.roundProgress));
35	    return map;
36	  }, [sorted]);
37	
38	  // 初始化 displayS
39	  const isLive = snapshot.competition.liveStatus === "live";
40	  useEffect(() => {
41	    setDisplayS((prev) => {
42	      if (Object.keys(prev).length > 0) return prev;
43	      const next: Record<string, number> = {};
44	      for (const e of sorted) {
45	        // 进行中的赛事：所有马从起跑线出发，营造起跑效果
46	        // 非 live 赛事（报名中/已结束）：直接跳到目标位置
47	        next[e.entryId] = isLive ? 0 : (targetS[e.entryId] ?? 0.5);
48	      }
49	      return next;
50	    });
51	  }, [sorted, isLive, targetS]);
52	
53	  // s-axis 补间动画循环 —— 每匹马速度略有差异
54	  const animateRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
55	  animateRef.current = useCallback(() => {
56	    setDisplayS((prev) => {
57	      let changed = false;
58	      const next: Record<string, number> = { ...prev };
59	      for (const id of Object.keys(targetS)) {
60	        const cur = prev[id] ?? 0;
61	        const tgt = targetS[id] ?? 0.5;
62	        const diff = tgt - cur;
63	        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.0005) { next[id] = tgt; continue; }
64	        changed = true;
65	        // 每匹马速度在 0.02~0.05 之间随机，模拟不同的追赶节奏
66	        const seed = id.charCodeAt(id.length - 1) || 0;
67	        const speed = BASE_LERP * (0.7 + (seed % 10) / 10);
68	        next[id] = cur + diff * speed;
69	      }
70	      return changed ? next : prev;
71	    });
72	    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animateRef.current);
73	    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
74	  }, [targetS]);
75	
76	  // 每 15 秒微扰所有马位置，制造"实时竞速"感
77	  useEffect(() => {
78	    const jitter = setInterval(() => {
79	      setDisplayS((prev) => {
80	        if (Object.keys(prev).length === 0) return prev;
81	        const next: Record<string, number> = {};
82	        for (const id of Object.keys(prev)) {
83	          next[id] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, prev[id] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006));
84	        }
85	        return next;
86	      });
87	    }, 15000);
88	    return () => clearInterval(jitter);
89	  }, []);
90	
91	  useEffect(() => {
92	    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animateRef.current);
93	    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
94	  }, []);
95	
96	  // key bindings
97	  useEffect(() => {
98	    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "d" || e.key === "D") setDebug((v) => !v); };
99	    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
100	    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
101	  }, []);
102	
103	  // timer
104	  useEffect(() => {
105	    if (snapshot.competition.liveStatus !== "live") return;
106	    const i = setInterval(() => setElapsed((t) => t + 1), 1000);
107	    return () => clearInterval(i);
108	  }, [snapshot.competition.liveStatus]);

110	  const { competition, entries, kpis, messages, attentionItems } = snapshot;
111	  const path = useMemo(

116	  // 用 displayS（插值后的 s）计算姿势

122	      const sampled = sampleAt(path, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s)));
123	      if (!sampled) return null;

132	        s, laneId: lane.id, state,

136	  }, [sorted, trackProfile, path, displayS]);

141	    .slice(0, 3);
142	
143	  return (
144	    <div className={debug ? "jt jt-debug" : "jt"}>

157	        </div>
158	      </header>
159	
160	      {/* ====== KPI ====== */}
161	      <div className="jt-kpis">
162	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "progress" ? null : "progress")}><b>{kpis.completionRate}%</b><small>完成度</small></div>
163	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "tokens" ? null : "tokens")}><b>{fmtNum(kpis.totalTokens)}</b><small>Tokens</small></div>
164	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "ca" ? null : "ca")}><b>{kpis.codexShare}%</b><small>Codex</small></div>
165	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "ca" ? null : "ca")}><b>{kpis.claudeShare}%</b><small>Claude</small></div>
166	        {kpis.riskCount > 0 && <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--warn jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "risk" ? null : "risk")}><b>{kpis.riskCount}</b><small>风险</small></div>}
167	      </div>
168	
169	      {/* ====== KPI Detail Panel ====== */}
170	      {kpiDetail && (
171	        <div className="jt-kpi-detail">
172	          {kpiDetail === "progress" && (
173	            <table><thead><tr><th>队伍</th><th>总分</th><th>进度</th><th>任务分</th><th>Token分</th><th>对话分</th></tr></thead><tbody>
174	              {sorted.map((e) => (
175	                <tr key={e.entryId}><td>{e.projectName}</td><td>{entries.find(x => x.entryId === e.entryId)?.costTokens ?? "-"}</td><td>{Math.round(e.roundProgress*100)}%</td><td>-</td><td>-</td><td>-</td></tr>

我先检查赛马位置计算链路和首页登录按钮样式，确认一个是数据映射问题还是渲染问题，另一个直接把 CTA 放大。

我先把这两个问题对应的组件和数据链路读出来，直接定位。

我已经定位到第一个大问题了：`src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx:45-48` 现在把 live 比赛所有马都强制从 0 起步初始化，所以哪怕 snapshot 里有真实进度，也会先全堆在起点，这就是你看到的现象。第二个问题就是首页登录 CTA 的样式确实没被做大。

我把两个点都改了，现在跑一遍编译确认没有引入回归。

编译过了，我把这两个任务状态收掉。

这两个问题我都改了。

1. 赛马进度位置问题  
根因在 `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx:40` 附近。之前 live 比赛初始化时把所有马的 `displayS` 强制设成了 `0`，所以即使 snapshot 里已经有 `roundProgress`，画面一开始也会全挤在起点。  
我现在改成了：
- 初始位置直接使用 snapshot 里的真实 `targetS`
- 后续如果 snapshot 更新，再沿用已有位置平滑补间
这样“排序算法挑战赛”这种已经有进度数据的 demo，会按真实进度落在赛道对应位置上，而不是从起点集体出发。

2. 首页登录按钮太小  
我把首页未登录卡片里的登录 CTA 放大了：
- `src/app/page.tsx:120` 给登录按钮加了更显眼的大 CTA 样式
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx` 新增了 `.button-cta-large`
- 同时把上面的提示文案字号也抬高了一点

检查结果：
- `npx tsc --noEmit` 通过
- `npm run build` 通过

所以现在这两项都已经落代码里了。

54	export async function enqueueProgressEvalTasks(raceId: string) {
55	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
56	    where: { id: raceId },
57	  });
58	
59	  if (!race) {
60	    throw new Error("赛事不存在");
61	  }
62	
63	  const phase = getRacePhase(race);
64	  if (phase !== "active" && phase !== "frozen") {
65	    throw new Error("只有比赛中或封榜期才能发起进度评测");
66	  }
67	
68	  const latestArtifacts = await getLatestArtifactsForRace(raceId);
69	  if (latestArtifacts.length === 0) {
70	    throw new Error("当前还没有可评测提交");
71	  }
72	
73	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
74	    for (const artifact of latestArtifacts) {
75	      await staleActiveRunnerTasks(tx, artifact.teamId, ["PROGRESS_EVAL"]);
76	      await tx.runnerTask.create({
77	        data: {
78	          artifactId: artifact.id,
79	          raceId,
80	          submissionId: artifact.submissionId,
81	          taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL",
82	          teamId: artifact.teamId,
83	        },
84	      });
85	    }
86	  });
87	}

212	export async function completeRunnerTask(input: RunnerResultInput) {
213	  const task = await prisma.runnerTask.findUnique({
214	    where: { id: input.taskId },
215	    include: {
216	      artifact: true,
217	      race: true,
218	      submission: true,
219	      team: true,
220	    },
221	  });
222	
223	  if (!task) {
224	    throw new Error("任务不存在");
225	  }
226	
227	  if (task.submissionId !== input.submissionId) {
228	    throw new Error("任务与提交不匹配");
229	  }
230	
231	  if (task.status === "STALE") {
232	    throw new Error("任务已失效，不能再回传结果");
233	  }
234	
235	  if (task.status !== "CLAIMED") {
236	    throw new Error("只能回传已拉取任务的结果");
237	  }
238	
239	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
240	    await tx.runnerTask.update({
241	      where: { id: task.id },
242	      data: {
243	        finishedAt: input.finishedAt ? new Date(input.finishedAt) : new Date(),
244	        resultHash: input.resultHash ?? null,
245	        runnerComment: input.runnerComment || null,
246	        score: input.score,
247	        status: input.status === "succeeded" ? "SUCCEEDED" : "FAILED",
248	      },
249	    });
250	
251	    if (input.status === "failed") {
252	      if (task.taskType === "SUBMISSION_TEST") {
253	        await tx.submission.update({
254	          where: { id: task.submissionId },
255	          data: {
256	            runnerComment: input.runnerComment || null,
257	            runnerStatus: "failed",
258	            scoredAt: new Date(),
259	            status: SubmissionStatus.FAILED,
260	          },
261	        });
262	      }
263	      return;
264	    }
265	
266	    switch (task.taskType) {
267	      case "SUBMISSION_TEST":
268	        await projectSubmissionTestSuccess(tx, task, input);
269	        break;
270	      case "PROGRESS_EVAL":
271	        await projectProgressEvalSuccess(tx, task, input);
272	        break;
273	      case "HARNESS_EVAL":
274	        await projectHarnessEvalSuccess(tx, task, input);
275	        break;
276	    }
277	  });
278	}

389	    where: { id: task.raceId },
390	    data: {
391	      lastLeaderboardSyncAt: new Date(),
392	    },
393	  });
394	}

396	async function projectHarnessEvalSuccess(
397	  tx: Parameters<Parameters<typeof prisma.$transaction>[0]>[0],
398	  task: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof prisma.runnerTask.findUnique>> & {
399	    artifact: LatestArtifactRecord;
400	    race: { id: string; displayHighlightCount: number; displayShowRiderCode: boolean; harnessWeightReasoning: number; harnessWeightKeyword: number };
401	    submission: { id: string; agentType: AgentType };
402	    team: { id: string };
403	  },
404	  input: RunnerResultInput,
405	) {
406	  const { reasoningScore, keywordScore } = input;
407	  const harnessScore =
408	    reasoningScore != null && keywordScore != null
409	      ? computeHarnessScore(
410	          reasoningScore,
411	          keywordScore,
412	          task.race.harnessWeightReasoning,
413	          task.race.harnessWeightKeyword,
414	        )
415	      : input.score;
416	
417	  await tx.harnessEntry.upsert({
418	    where: {
419	      raceId_teamId: {
420	        raceId: task.raceId,
421	        teamId: task.teamId,
422	      },
423	    },
424	    update: {
425	      harnessScore,
426	      reasoningScore: reasoningScore ?? null,
427	      keywordScore: keywordScore ?? null,
428	    },
429	    create: {
430	      harnessScore,
431	      reasoningScore: reasoningScore ?? null,
432	      keywordScore: keywordScore ?? null,
433	      raceId: task.raceId,
434	      teamId: task.teamId,
435	    },
436	  });
437	
438	  const successfulHarnessTasks = await tx.runnerTask.findMany({
439	    where: {
440	      raceId: task.raceId,
441	      status: "SUCCEEDED",
442	      taskType: "HARNESS_EVAL",
443	    },
444	    include: {
445	      artifact: true,
446	      team: true,
447	    },
448	    orderBy: [
449	      { score: "desc" },
450	      { createdAt: "asc" },
451	    ],
452	  });
453	
454	  await tx.ridingHighlight.deleteMany({
455	    where: { raceId: task.raceId },
456	  });
457	
458	  if (successfulHarnessTasks.length > 0) {
459	    await tx.ridingHighlight.createMany({
460	      data: successfulHarnessTasks
461	        .slice(0, task.race.displayHighlightCount)
462	        .map((runnerTask) => ({
463	          agentType: runnerTask.artifact.agentType,
464	          codeSnippet: task.race.displayShowRiderCode
465	            ? extractCodeSnippetSafe(runnerTask.artifact.codeContent)
466	            : "Organizer 未公开 Rider 代码。",
467	          excerpt: extractHighlightSafe(runnerTask.artifact.ridingRecord),
468	          raceId: task.raceId,
469	          score: runnerTask.score ?? 0,
470	          teamId: runnerTask.teamId,
471	        })),
472	    });
473	  }
474	
475	  await tx.race.update({
476	    where: { id: task.raceId },
477	    data: {
478	      lastShowcaseSyncAt: new Date(),
479	    },
480	  });
481	}
482	
483	async function staleActiveRunnerTasks(
484	  tx: Parameters<Parameters<typeof prisma.$transaction>[0]>[0],
485	  teamId: string,
486	  taskTypes: RunnerTaskTypeValue[],
487	) {
488	  await tx.runnerTask.updateMany({
489	    where: {
490	      status: {
491	        in: ACTIVE_RUNNER_TASK_STATUSES,
492	      },
493	      taskType: {
494	        in: taskTypes,
495	      },
496	      teamId,
497	    },
498	    data: {
499	      status: "STALE",
500	    },
501	  });
502	}
503	
504	async function getLatestArtifactsForRace(
505	  raceId: string,
506	): Promise<LatestArtifactRecord[]> {
507	  const artifacts = await prisma.submissionArtifact.findMany({
508	    where: { raceId },
509	    orderBy: [
510	      { teamId: "asc" },
511	      { createdAt: "desc" },
512	    ],
513	  });
514	
515	  const latestByTeam = new Map<string, LatestArtifactRecord>();
516	  for (const artifact of artifacts) {
517	    if (!latestByTeam.has(artifact.teamId)) {
518	      latestByTeam.set(artifact.teamId, artifact);
519	    }
520	  }
521	
522	  return [...latestByTeam.values()];
523	}
524	
525	function toRunnerWireTaskType(taskType: RunnerTaskTypeValue) {
526	  switch (taskType) {
527	    case "SUBMISSION_TEST":
528	      return "submission_test";
529	    case "PROGRESS_EVAL":
530	      return "progress_eval";
531	    case "HARNESS_EVAL":
532	      return "harness_eval";
533	  }
534	}
535	
536	function extractHighlightSafe(record: null | string): string {
537	  if (!record) {
538	    return "未提供 Riding Record。";
539	  }
540	
541	  const lines = record
542	    .split(/\r?\n/)
543	    .map((line) => line.trim())
544	    .filter(Boolean);
545	
546	  return (lines[0] ?? record.trim()).slice(0, 140);
547	}
548	
549	function extractCodeSnippetSafe(code: string): string {
550	  return code
551	    .split(/\r?\n/)
552	    .slice(0, 8)
553	    .join("\n");
554	}
555	
556	function computeHarnessScore(
557	  reasoningScore: number,
558	  keywordScore: number,
559	  weightReasoning: number,
560	  weightKeyword: number,
561	): number {
562	  const safeR = weightReasoning > 0 ? weightReasoning : 1;
563	  const safeK = weightKeyword > 0 ? weightKeyword : 1;
564	  const total = safeR + safeK;
565	  return Math.round((reasoningScore * (safeR / total) + keywordScore * (safeK / total)) * 10) / 10;
566	}

1	import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
2	import { DEFAULT_RUNNER_SECRET } from "@/lib/constants";
3	import { completeRunnerTask } from "@/lib/services/runner";
4	
5	function isAuthorized(request: Request): boolean {
6	  const token = request.headers.get("authorization")?.replace("Bearer ", "");
7	  return token === (process.env.RUNNER_TOKEN ?? DEFAULT_RUNNER_SECRET);
8	}
9	
10	export async function POST(request: Request) {
11	  if (!isAuthorized(request)) {
12	    return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
13	  }
14	
15	  const body = await request.json();
16	  await completeRunnerTask({
17	    taskId: String(body.taskId ?? ""),
18	    submissionId: String(body.submissionId ?? ""),
19	    status: String(body.status ?? "") as "failed" | "succeeded",
20	    score: Number(body.score ?? 0),
21	    reasoningScore: typeof body.reasoningScore === "number" ? body.reasoningScore : undefined,
22	    keywordScore: typeof body.keywordScore === "number" ? body.keywordScore : undefined,
23	    runnerComment: String(body.runnerComment ?? ""),
24	    resultHash:
25	      typeof body.resultHash === "string" && body.resultHash.length > 0
26	        ? body.resultHash
27	        : undefined,
28	    finishedAt:
29	      typeof body.finishedAt === "string" && body.finishedAt.length > 0
30	        ? body.finishedAt
31	        : undefined,
32	  });
33	
34	  return NextResponse.json({
35	    ok: true,
36	  });
37	}
38

1	# Context
2	
3	这次不是继续泛化 Jumbotron，而是修正用户实测时暴露出来的 5 个明确问题：
4	- `/login` 页的登录入口不够显眼
5	- 每场比赛都必须有可用默认底图/赛道，`API 设计大赛` 当前表现为没有默认底图
6	- 既然 `/` 已经是公开主页，就不再保留 `/login` 里的旧 Audience 入口，也不再保留一套重复的 `/audience` 入口语义
7	- 企业发布题目、提供底图、用户提交代码这三处都需要真实的本地选择按钮，而不是只填文本
8	- Organizer 创建比赛时，应该能配置当前 Jumbotron 真正在消费的赛道参数，至少包括起终点、检查点等 Calibrator 里已有的参数
9	
10	当前代码已经具备这些能力的“半成品”：
11	- `/` 已经是公开主页，公开浏览能力已存在；`/login` 仍保留 `AudienceEntryPanel`，造成重复入口
12	- `Race.trackId` 已存在，但 create-race / seed / runtime 缺少统一的 fallback 兜底

1	# ARY GRS 001 ROADMAP
2	
3	## 任务背景
4	
5	目标是把 `PRD.md` 中的 ARY 产品方案做成一个可运行演示，并且从“前端假状态 PoC”升级到“真实账号与真实数据库”的全栈版本。
6	
7	## 当前实现方向
8	
9	最终实现采用：
10	
11	- Next.js 16 App Router
12	- Prisma 7
13	- SQLite
14	- Server Actions + API Routes
15	
16	原因：
17	
18	- 能快速落地真实注册登录和共享数据
19	- 仍然能严格控制 ARY 的数据边界
20	- 后续若需要改成 Postgres，只需要切 Prisma datasource 和部署方式
21	
22	## 数据边界决策
23	
24	ARY 持久化：
25	
26	- 用户、赛事、队伍
27	- 反馈、通知
28	- 提交状态
29	- 公开榜单投影
30	- 最佳归档与赛后展示
31	
32	ARY 不持久化：
33	
34	- Organizer 私有评测代码
35	- Organizer 私有 Runner 逻辑
36	- 私有完整评测过程
37	
38	折中实现：
39	
40	- Rider 提交进入 ARY 数据库中的临时字段
41	- Runner 评分后，提交正文被清空
42	- 仅保留最佳归档用于赛后公开展示
43	
44	## 当前能力
45

105	
106	修复目标如下：
107	
108	1. **首页改为 Audience 公开首页**
109	   - `/` 不再强制跳转 `/login`
110	   - Audience 无需登录即可浏览赛事与 Jumbotron 入口
111	   - `/login` 保持为独立登录页
112	   - 首页按比赛阶段分层展示：
113	     - 报名/准备阶段：展示赛事说明、报名信息、任务入口，不展示大屏
114	     - 进行中/封榜阶段：展示赛事说明、过程榜单与 Jumbotron 大屏
115	     - 已结束阶段：展示最终公开结果与 Organizer 允许披露的赛后内容

120	
121	3. **把纯文本命名改成真实按钮/链接**
122	   - 题目发布：提供真实链接或上传入口，而不是仅 `taskPackageLabel`
123	   - 参赛者提交：保留当前文本式提交，但增加清晰跳转/提交按钮
124	   - 大屏底图：提供真实选择/上传控件
125

1	# ARY GRS 001 ROADMAP
2	
3	## 任务背景
4	
5	目标是把 `PRD.md` 中的 ARY 产品方案做成一个可运行演示，并且从“前端假状态 PoC”升级到“真实账号与真实数据库”的全栈版本。
6	
7	## 当前实现方向
8	
9	最终实现采用：
10	
11	- Next.js 16 App Router
12	- Prisma 7
13	- SQLite
14	- Server Actions + API Routes
15	
16	原因：
17	
18	- 能快速落地真实注册登录和共享数据
19	- 仍然能严格控制 ARY 的数据边界
20	- 后续若需要改成 Postgres，只需要切 Prisma datasource 和部署方式
21	
22	## 数据边界决策
23	
24	ARY 持久化：
25	
26	- 用户、赛事、队伍
27	- 反馈、通知
28	- 提交状态
29	- 公开榜单投影
30	- 最佳归档与赛后展示
31	
32	ARY 不持久化：
33	
34	- Organizer 私有评测代码
35	- Organizer 私有 Runner 逻辑
36	- 私有完整评测过程
37	
38	折中实现：
39	
40	- Rider 提交进入 ARY 数据库中的临时字段
41	- Runner 评分后，提交正文被清空
42	- 仅保留最佳归档用于赛后公开展示
43	
44	## 当前能力
45	
46	- 真实注册 / 登录
47	- Organizer 创建赛事
48	- Rider 报名参赛
49	- Rider 比赛中提交代码，赛后提交最终代码与 Riding Record
50	- Rider 与 Organizer 的反馈线程
51	- Runner 拉取任务并回传包含评分分项的 JSON，由 ARY 按比赛权重计算总分
52	- Organizer 发起进度评测 / Harness 评测
53	- Audience 无登录浏览公开页面
54	
55	## 临时部署策略
56	
57	为了让临时域名也能真实写库：
58	
59	- 构建阶段生成并填充 `prisma/dev.db`
60	- 运行时在生产环境把该数据库复制到 `/tmp/ary-runtime/runtime.db`
61	- 预览实例上的写入是真实 SQLite 写入，但不保证长期持久
62	
63	## 已知限制
64	
65	- 临时域名上的 SQLite 数据会随实例重建丢失
66	- 还没有接入 Postgres 等持久数据库
67	- 还没有接入真实外部 Agent API
68	- 目前 Runner 鉴权仍是简单 bearer token
69	
70	## 迭代记录
71	
72	### Iteration 0
73	
74	- 阅读 PRD
75	- 产出实现计划与路线
76	
77	### Iteration 1
78	
79	- 接入 GitHub 组织仓库 `SysuGroup9/ARY-for-ARY`
80	- 完成前端 localStorage PoC
81	- 部署首个临时预览
82	
83	### Iteration 2
84	
85	- 用户指出注册登录是假的，只是 localStorage
86	- 决定整体重构为 Next.js + Prisma + SQLite
87	
88	### Iteration 3
89	
90	- 新建 Prisma schema 与鉴权基础能力
91	- 重写服务层：users / races / teams / submissions / feedback
92	- 新建首页、Server Actions、Runner API
93	- 加入 seed 数据与临时部署 SQLite 方案
94	- 完成 `tsc`、`lint`、`build` 验证
95	
96	## 第二周修复计划（Jumbotron / Audience / Snapshot Truthfulness）
97	
98	本轮不切换实现路线，继续沿用当前仓库中同学已落地的 snapshot-based Jumbotron：
99	
100	- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/page.tsx`
101	- `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
102	- `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`
103	- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx`
104	
105	修复目标如下：
106	
107	1. **首页改为 Audience 公开首页**
108	   - `/` 不再强制跳转 `/login`
109	   - Audience 无需登录即可浏览赛事与 Jumbotron 入口
110	   - `/login` 保持为独立登录页
111	   - 首页按比赛阶段分层展示：
112	     - 报名/准备阶段：展示赛事说明、报名信息、任务入口，不展示大屏
113	     - 进行中/封榜阶段：展示赛事说明、过程榜单与 Jumbotron 大屏
114	     - 已结束阶段：展示最终公开结果与 Organizer 允许披露的赛后内容
115	
116	2. **Organizer 创建比赛补齐 Jumbotron / 展示选项**
117	   - 继续沿用当前 `CreateRaceForm` 风格
118	   - 补齐 Jumbotron 展示配置、底图/赛道资源选择、公开可见性等选项
119	
120	3. **把纯文本命名改成真实按钮/链接**
121	   - 题目发布：提供真实链接或上传入口，而不是仅 `taskPackageLabel`
122	   - 参赛者提交：保留当前文本式提交，但增加清晰跳转/提交按钮
123	   - 大屏底图：提供真实选择/上传控件
124	
125	4. **Jumbotron 位置改为真实进度值驱动**
126	   - 删除 adapter 中按 rank/time 伪造 `roundProgress` 的逻辑
127	   - 改为消费企业 Runner 返回的真实 progress 值
128	   - live 赛事首帧直接使用 snapshot 中的真实进度，不再把所有马重置到起点
129	
130	5. **活跃骑手排名按主动提交次数计算**
131	   - 基于 `Submission` 表统计每队主动提交次数
132	   - 在 Jumbotron 中独立展示，不与比赛总排名混淆
133	
134	6. **修改比赛内容后清掉进度榜单 / snapshot**
135	   - 修改题目/训练数据后，清空 `LeaderboardEntry`
136	   - 删除 `public/assets/snapshots/<raceId>.json`
137	   - 防止大屏残留旧进度状态
138	
139	7. **比赛结束后切换到最终评分榜单**
140	   - 比赛中展示 progress leaderboard
141	   - 比赛结束后展示 final scoring leaderboard
142	   - 不再延续 progress-only 的赛道语义
143	
144	8. **清理当前 Jumbotron mock 痕迹**
145	   - 去掉 fake `rankDelta`
146	   - 去掉强制最后一名 stale
147	   - 去掉 fake/random messages
148	   - 去掉硬编码风险说明和 `currentPhase: "DEV"`
149	
150	## 错误复盘
151	
152	- 早期从旧 PoC 迁移时有编码损坏的中文文本混入新实现。
153	- 改进措施：不再从旧损坏文件复制中文字面量，所有中文文案重新手写并在最终构建前做人工检查。
154	
```

1	# ARY Runner 第一期重构说明
2	
3	日期：2026-06-06
4	
5	## 1. 这份文档的目的
6	
7	这份文档用于总结当前工作区里已经完成的 runner 第一期重构改动。
8	
9	它回答四个问题：
10	
11	1. 这轮改动想解决什么问题
12	2. 实际改了哪些代码和数据模型
13	3. 现在 runner 主链路变成了什么样
14	4. 哪些部分已经验证通过，哪些部分还留给下一阶段
15	
16	## 2. 这轮改动的核心目标
17	
18	这轮改动的核心目标是把当前项目里的 runner 流程，从“ARY 直接围绕 `Submission` 做评分”重构成“以独立任务为中心的 runner 主链路”，并且把分数计算边界改成：
19	
20	- 分数全部由 organizer 侧 runner 计算
21	- ARY 只接收最终分数和结果摘要
22	
23	同时保留以下约束：
24	
25	- 第一阶段先不实现 `register / heartbeat / renew / status / fail`
26	- 第一阶段继续复用当前按钮触发任务
27	- 第一阶段继续让 `pull` 返回内联内容，不先做 signed URL 下载链路
28	
29	## 3. 已完成的模型改动
30	
31	### 3.1 新增的 schema
32	
33	在 [prisma/schema.prisma](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/prisma/schema.prisma) 中新增了：
34	
35	- `RunnerTaskType`
36	  - `SUBMISSION_TEST`
37	  - `PROGRESS_EVAL`
38	  - `HARNESS_EVAL`
39	- `RunnerTaskStatus`
40	  - `QUEUED`
41	  - `CLAIMED`
42	  - `SUCCEEDED`
43	  - `FAILED`
44	  - `STALE`
45	- `SubmissionArtifact`
46	  - 保存某次提交对应的不可变评测输入
47	- `RunnerTask`
48	  - 保存独立 runner 任务
49	
50	### 3.2 现有 schema 的调整
51	
52	还做了这些兼容性调整：
53	
54	- `SubmissionStatus` 新增 `FAILED`
55	- `Submission.recordLabel` 改为可空
56	- `Submission.ridingRecord` 继续可空
57	- `TeamArchive.recordLabel` / `ridingRecord` 改为可空
58	- `TeamArchive.taskScore` / `dialogueScore` / `tokenScore` / `reasoningScore` / `keywordScore` 改为可空
59	- `LeaderboardEntry.taskScore` / `tokenScore` / `dialogueScore` 改为可空
60	- `HarnessEntry.reasoningScore` / `keywordScore` 改为可空
61	- `LeaderboardEntry` 增加 `raceId + teamId` 唯一约束
62	- `HarnessEntry` 增加 `raceId + teamId` 唯一约束
63	
64	### 3.3 migration
65	
66	新增 migration：
67	
68	- [20260606190000_runner_tasks](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/prisma/migrations/20260606190000_runner_tasks/migration.sql)
69	
70	这个 migration 做了两类事情：
71	
72	1. 重建旧表，使可空字段和唯一约束与新模型一致
73	2. 新建 `SubmissionArtifact` 与 `RunnerTask`
74	
75	## 4. 已完成的服务层改动
76	
77	### 4.1 `Submission` 的职责被收窄
78	
79	[src/lib/services/submissions.ts](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/services/submissions.ts) 现在只负责：
80	
81	- 处理用户提交
82	- 创建 `Submission`
83	- 创建 `SubmissionArtifact`
84	- 自动入队一个 `SUBMISSION_TEST` 任务
85	
86	它不再负责：
87	
88	- runner 拉取任务
89	- runner 回传结果
90	- ARY 自己计算分数
91	- 直接重算公开榜单或 Harness 展示
92	
93	### 4.2 新增独立 runner service
94	
95	新增文件：
96	
97	- [src/lib/services/runner.ts](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/services/runner.ts)
98	
99	当前它已经负责：
100	
101	- `enqueueSubmissionTestTask`
102	- `enqueueProgressEvalTasks`
103	- `enqueueHarnessEvalTasks`
104	- `pullRunnerTask`
105	- `completeRunnerTask`
106	
107	当前落地的行为是：
108	
109	- 比赛中 `submitEntryAction` 只允许提交代码，并自动生成一条 `SUBMISSION_TEST` 任务
110	- 比赛结束后 `submitFinalEntryAction` 要求同时提交最终代码与 `Riding Record`
111	- 赛后提交会自动生成对应的 `HARNESS_EVAL` 任务，Organizer 仍可按需手动再次发起
112	- Organizer 点“发起进度评测”会按队伍最新代码 artifact 生成 `PROGRESS_EVAL`
113	- Organizer 点“发起 Harness 评测”会按有 `Riding Record` 的赛后 artifact 生成 `HARNESS_EVAL`
114	- 同一队伍同一类型的未完成旧任务会被标记为 `STALE`
115	- runner 从 `RunnerTask` 拉任务，不再直接从 `Submission` 拉
116	- runner 回传结果时，只以最终分数为主，不再要求分项评分输入
117	
118	### 4.3 结果投影规则
119	
120	当前代码里，任务完成后的投影规则是：
121	
122	- `SUBMISSION_TEST`
123	  - 回写 `Submission.totalScore`
124	  - 更新 `Submission.status`
125	  - 清空主提交流水中的原文
126	- `PROGRESS_EVAL`
127	  - 更新 `TeamArchive`
128	  - 更新 `LeaderboardEntry`
129	  - 更新 `Race.lastLeaderboardSyncAt`
130	- `HARNESS_EVAL`
131	  - 更新 `HarnessEntry`
132	  - 重建 `RidingHighlight`
133	  - 更新 `Race.lastShowcaseSyncAt`
134	
135	这里的重要变化是：
136	
137	- ARY 不再根据 `passRate / codeReviewScore / reasoningScore` 自己算总分
138	- runner 直接回最终 `score`
139	
140	## 5. 已完成的接口改动
141	
142	### 5.1 `pull`
143	
144	[src/app/api/runner/tasks/pull/route.ts](D:/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/api/runner/tasks/pull/route.ts) 已改为走新的 `runner.ts`。
145

165	当前接收：

175	它不再接收：

178	- `codeReviewScore`
179	- `reasoningScore`

    ```ts
    export function computeHarnessScore(
      reasoningScore: number,
      keywordScore: number,
      weightReasoning: number,
      weightKeyword: number,
    ): number {
      const safeR = weightReasoning > 0 ? weightReasoning : 1;
      const safeK = weightKeyword > 0 ? weightKeyword : 1;
      const total = safeR + safeK;
      return roundScore(reasoningScore * (safeR / total) + keywordScore * (safeK / total));
    }
    ```

1	// RaceSnapshot 生成服务
2	// 从 ARY 数据库读取赛事数据 → 通过 Adapter 映射 → 写入 JSON 快照文件
3	
4	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
5	import {
6	  AryDerivedDataProvider,
7	  mapToCompetition,
8	  type AryRaceData,
9	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/adapter";
10	import { normalizeTrackId, parseRaceTrackConfigJson } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-config";
11	import type { RaceSnapshot } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
12	import fs from "node:fs";
13	import path from "node:path";
14	
15	const SNAPSHOT_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "assets", "snapshots");
16	
17	/**
18	 * 生成赛事快照 JSON
19	 *
20	 * 数据流：
21	 *   1. 从 Prisma 查询赛事全量数据
22	 *   2. 通过 AryDerivedDataProvider 映射为 Jumbotron 格式
23	 *   3. 写入 public/assets/snapshots/<raceId>.json
24	 *   4. 返回生成的快照对象
25	 */
26	export async function generateRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): Promise<RaceSnapshot> {
27	  // 1. 查询赛事全量数据
28	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
29	    where: { id: raceId },
30	    include: {
31	      organizer: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
32	      teams: {
33	        include: {
34	          captain: { select: { id: true, username: true } },
35	        },
36	      },
37	      leaderboardEntries: {
38	        orderBy: [{ totalScore: "desc" }, { createdAt: "asc" }],
39	      },
40	      submissions: {
41	        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
42	      },
43	      teamArchives: {
44	        orderBy: { totalScore: "desc" },
45	      },
46	      feedbackThreads: {
47	        include: {
48	          messages: {
49	            orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
50	          },
51	        },
52	      },
53	    },
54	  });
55	
56	  if (!race) {
57	    throw new Error(`赛事 ${raceId} 不存在`);
58	  }
59	
60	  // 2. 构造 AryRaceData
61	  const raceData: AryRaceData = {
62	    id: race.id,
63	    title: race.title,
64	    summary: race.summary,
65	    signupStart: race.signupStart,
66	    signupEnd: race.signupEnd,
67	    raceStart: race.raceStart,
68	    raceEnd: race.raceEnd,
69	    organizer: race.organizer,
70	    teams: race.teams.map((t) => ({
71	      id: t.id,
72	      name: t.name,
73	      captain: t.captain,
74	    })),
75	    leaderboardEntries: race.leaderboardEntries.map((e) => ({
76	      id: e.id,
77	      teamId: e.teamId,
78	      totalScore: e.totalScore,
79	      progress: e.progress,
80	      taskScore: e.taskScore,
81	      tokenScore: e.tokenScore,
82	      dialogueScore: e.dialogueScore,
83	      agentType: e.agentType,
84	      createdAt: e.createdAt,
85	    })),
86	    submissions: race.submissions.map((s) => ({
87	      id: s.id,
88	      teamId: s.teamId,
89	      createdAt: s.createdAt,
90	    })),
91	    teamArchives: race.teamArchives.map((a) => ({
92	      teamId: a.teamId,
93	      agentType: a.agentType,
94	      tokenUsed: a.tokenUsed,
95	      totalScore: a.totalScore,
96	      antiCheatPenalty: a.antiCheatPenalty,
97	    })),
98	    feedbackThreads: race.feedbackThreads.map((f) => ({
99	      teamId: f.teamId,
100	      messages: f.messages.map((m) => ({
101	        content: m.content,
102	        createdAt: m.createdAt,
103	      })),
104	    })),
105	  };
106	
107	  // 3. 通过 Adapter 映射
108	  const provider = new AryDerivedDataProvider(raceData);
109	  const now = new Date();
110	
111	  const [entries, messages, attentionItems, kpis] = await Promise.all([
112	    provider.getRaceEntries(raceId),
113	    provider.getRidingMessages(raceId),
114	    provider.getAttentionItems(raceId),
115	    provider.getCompetitionKPI(raceId),
116	  ]);
117	
118	  const competition = mapToCompetition(raceData, now);
119	
120	  // 4. 修正 KPIs：在线数 = 总数 - stale 数
121	  const staleCount = entries.filter((e) => e.status === "stale").length;
122	  kpis.onlineRiders = entries.length - staleCount;
123	  kpis.activeRiders = entries.filter((e) => e.status !== "stale" && e.status !== "idle").length;
124	
125	  // 5. 组装快照
126	  const trackConfig = parseRaceTrackConfigJson(race.trackConfigJson);
127	
128	  const snapshot: RaceSnapshot = {
129	    generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
130	    raceId,
131	    trackId: normalizeTrackId(race.trackId),
132	    trackConfig: trackConfig ?? undefined,
133	    competition,
134	    entries,
135	    kpis,
136	    messages,
137	    attentionItems,
138	  };
139	
140	  // 5. 写入文件
141	  ensureSnapshotDir();
142	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
143	  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2), "utf-8");
144	
145	  return snapshot;
146	}
147	
148	/**
149	 * 读取已生成的快照（供 Jumbotron 页面静态消费）
150	 */
151	export function loadRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): RaceSnapshot | null {
152	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
153	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
154	
155	  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
156	  return JSON.parse(raw) as RaceSnapshot;
157	}
158	
159	/**
160	 * 列出所有已生成的快照 ID
161	 */
162	export function listSnapshotIds(): string[] {
163	  ensureSnapshotDir();
164	  return fs
165	    .readdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)
166	    .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"))
167	    .map((f) => f.replace(".json", ""));
168	}
169	
170	export function deleteRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): void {
171	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
172	  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
173	    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
174	  }
175	}
176	
177	function ensureSnapshotDir(): void {
178	  if (!fs.existsSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)) {
179	    fs.mkdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR, { recursive: true });
180	  }
181	}
182	
```

18	export default function JumbotronBanner({ items }: Props) {
19	  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
20	
21	  const next = useCallback(() => {
22	    setCurrent((c) => (c + 1) % items.length);
23	  }, [items.length]);
24	
25	  const prev = useCallback(() => {
26	    setCurrent((c) => (c - 1 + items.length) % items.length);
27	  }, [items.length]);
28	
29	  // 自动轮播
30	  useEffect(() => {
31	    if (items.length <= 1) return;
32	    const timer = setInterval(next, 8000);
33	    return () => clearInterval(timer);
34	  }, [items.length, next]);
35	
36	  if (items.length === 0) return null;
37	
38	  const item = items[current];
39	
40	  return (

60	          <a href={`/jumbotron/${item.raceId}`} target="_blank" style={{color:"#c34e36",fontSize:12,textDecoration:"none",marginLeft:8,fontWeight:600}}>🔲 全屏</a>
61	        </div>
62	      </div>
63	
64	      {/* Jumbotron 画面 */}

69	      <style>{bannerStyles}</style>
70	    </div>
71	  );
72	}
