    ```ts
    export async function getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug: string): Promise<{
      race: RaceListItem;
      slug: string;
    } | null> {
      const races = await listRaces();
      const exactMatch = races.find(
        (item) => buildRaceSlug(item.id, item.title) === raceSlug,
      );
      const race = exactMatch ?? races.find((item) => item.id === getRaceIdFromSlug(raceSlug));

      if (!race) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        race,
        slug: buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title),
      };
    }
    ```

## Central access helper

  - no session → `/login`

## 1) Why the Live Hall preview currently requires a click-to-expand button

The click-to-expand behavior is not in `LiveHallView` itself; it comes from the embedded preview component it uses.

### Where it lives
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/_components/public/live-hall.tsx`
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/JumbotronInline.tsx`

### Code path
In `LiveHallView`, the preview is rendered like this:

- `LiveHallView` receives `jumbotronPreview`
- if present, it renders `<JumbotronInline ... />`

Inside `JumbotronInline`:
- local state `open` starts as `false`
- it renders a button labeled:
  - `查看赛马大屏 ▼`
- only when `open === true` does it render the actual `JumbotronClient`

So the preview is intentionally collapsed by default and must be expanded by click.

### Relevant function/component
- `LiveHallView(...)` in `src/app/_components/public/live-hall.tsx`
- `JumbotronInline(...)` in `src/app/JumbotronInline.tsx`

### Why this seems designed that way
The component is an inline, opt-in preview inside a dense informational page. It avoids mounting the full Jumbotron canvas/track UI immediately, which is consistent with the docs saying Live Hall should show a compact web-friendly summary and offer a screen entry, not embed the full big-screen experience by default.

---

## 2) Where the component lives

The Live Hall page itself is here:

- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/races/[raceSlug]/live/page.tsx`

That route:
- loads the race by slug
- builds a race snapshot
- computes a track profile from the snapshot
- passes both into `LiveHallView` as `jumbotronPreview`

So the preview shown in Live Hall is powered by:
- `buildRaceSnapshot(...)` from `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
- `getEffectiveTrackProfileFromSnapshot(...)` from `src/lib/jumbotron/track-config`

## 4) How the Jumbotron decides to show horse activity vs `zzz` / idle state

This is split between:
- snapshot derivation
- motion-state resolution
- rendering in `JumbotronClient`

### A) Snapshot derivation: where rider/horse activity comes from
Primary file:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`

#### `mapToRacingEntries(race)`
This function builds each `RacingEntrySnapshot`.

Important parts:
- finds leaderboard entries
- looks up registration and CA connection data
- derives:
  - `overallProgress`
  - `roundProgress`
  - `status`
  - `lastMessage`
  - `submissionCount`
  - `costTokens`
  - etc.

#### Status derivation
The final status is produced by:

- `deriveStatus(entry, race, roundProgress)`

Behavior:
- if race is finished → `finished`
- if there is no leaderboard entry → `idle`
- if `roundProgress >= 0.95` → `sprinting`
- if `roundProgress > 0` → `running`
- otherwise → `idle`

Also, within `mapToRacingEntries`, if the registration has:
- `registration.raceProject.aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"`

then the returned snapshot status is forced to:
- `running`

So the “active rider” signal comes from a combination of:
- leaderboard entry presence
- progress values
- CA connection / ingestion status
- race phase timing

### B) Motion-state resolution: when the renderer turns activity into `zzz`
Primary file:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state.ts`

#### `resolveMotionState(status, updatedAt)`
Rules:
- if status is `running` or `sprinting` and `updatedAt` is too old, return `stale`
- otherwise, preserve the status
- unknown statuses fall back to `idle`

Important threshold:
- `STALE_THRESHOLD_MS = 300_000` (5 minutes)

So a rider can be logically “running” in snapshot terms but still be displayed as `stale` if not updated recently.

### C) Visual rendering: where `zzz` is drawn
Primary file:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx`

In the horses/SVG loop:
- `const state = resolveMotionState(entry.status, entry.updatedAt);`
- `const stale = p.state === "stale";`

Rendering rule:
- if `stale`, the emoji becomes `💤`
- the ring becomes dimmer
- `OFFLINE` label is shown
- opacity drops

So:
- “horse activity” = status resolves to `running` or `sprinting`
- “zzz / idle” = status is `idle`, or it becomes `stale` due to old `updatedAt`

---

## 5) Where online / active rider state is derived for the snapshot

There are two layers here.

### Layer 1: per-rider status in the snapshot
In:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`

`mapToRacingEntries(...)` derives each rider’s `status` from:
- leaderboard presence
- `roundProgress`
- `race.raceStart / race.raceEnd`
- `aggregateIngestionStatus`

This is the main source of rider state for the Jumbotron snapshot.

### Layer 2: aggregate KPI counts on the snapshot
In:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`

After building entries:
- `kpis.onlineRiders = entries.length - staleCount`
- `kpis.activeRiders = entries.filter((entry) => entry.status !== "stale" && entry.status !== "idle").length`

So:
- `onlineRiders` is “not stale”
- `activeRiders` is “not stale and not idle”

That is the final snapshot-level aggregate used by Jumbotron UI.

### How Jumbotron uses it
In `JumbotronClient.tsx`:
- header shows `在线 {kpis.onlineRiders}/{entries.length}`
- active rider cards are built from `entries`
- horse rendering uses `entry.status` via `resolveMotionState(...)`

## Central access helper
`C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/viewer-access.ts`

This is the main policy file. It centralizes the decisions for:

- `getConsoleEntryTarget(hasSession)`  
  - session yes → `/console`
  - session no → `/login`
- `getConsoleHomeSections(roles)`  
  - `RIDER | JUDGE | ORGANIZER` → `races`
  - `ADMIN` → `admin`
  - `ADMIN | ORGANIZER` → `screen`
- `getConsoleDefaultHref(roles)`  
  - `ADMIN` → `/console/admin/users`
  - `ORGANIZER | RIDER | JUDGE` → `/console/races`
  - otherwise → `/login`
- `getConsoleRaceViewAccess(...)`
  - no session (`roles === null`) → `/login`
  - organizer view requires `ORGANIZER` plus `isRaceOrganizer`
  - rider view requires `RIDER` plus `isRaceRider`
  - judge view requires `JUDGE` plus `isRaceJudge`
  - failures redirect to `/console/races`
- `getConsoleAdminAccess(roles)`
  - no session → `/login`
  - non-admin → `/console`
- `getConsoleScreenAccess(roles)`
  - no session → `/login`
  - non-admin/non-organizer → `/console`
- `getCreateRacePageAccess(roles)`
  - no session → `/login`
  - non-organizer → `/console`

This is the best place to tighten policy because the route pages already consume it.

- Live Hall may link to or preview the Jumbotron, but it should not replace the dedicated display surface

That matches the current implementation:
- a button to open the full Jumbotron view
- a collapsible inline preview, not an always-expanded embedded screen

---

## 4) How the Jumbotron decides to show horse activity vs `zzz` / idle state

This is split between:
- snapshot derivation
- motion-state resolution
- rendering in `JumbotronClient`

### A) Snapshot derivation: where rider/horse activity comes from
Primary file:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`

#### `mapToRacingEntries(race)`
This function builds each `RacingEntrySnapshot`.

Important parts:
- finds leaderboard entries
- looks up registration and CA connection data
- derives:
  - `overallProgress`
  - `roundProgress`
  - `status`
  - `lastMessage`
  - `submissionCount`
  - `costTokens`
  - etc.

#### Status derivation
The final status is produced by:

- `deriveStatus(entry, race, roundProgress)`

Behavior:
- if race is finished → `finished`
- if there is no leaderboard entry → `idle`
- if `roundProgress >= 0.95` → `sprinting`
- if `roundProgress > 0` → `running`
- otherwise → `idle`

Also, within `mapToRacingEntries`, if the registration has:
- `registration.raceProject.aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"`

then the returned snapshot status is forced to:
- `running`

So the “active rider” signal comes from a combination of:
- leaderboard entry presence
- progress values
- CA connection / ingestion status
- race phase timing

### B) Motion-state resolution: when the renderer turns activity into `zzz`
Primary file:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state.ts`

#### `resolveMotionState(status, updatedAt)`
Rules:
- if status is `running` or `sprinting` and `updatedAt` is too old, return `stale`
- otherwise, preserve the status
- unknown statuses fall back to `idle`

Important threshold:
- `STALE_THRESHOLD_MS = 300_000` (5 minutes)

So a rider can be logically “running” in snapshot terms but still be displayed as `stale` if not updated recently.

### C) Visual rendering: where `zzz` is drawn
Primary file:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx`

In the horses/SVG loop:
- `const state = resolveMotionState(entry.status, entry.updatedAt);`
- `const stale = p.state === "stale";`

Rendering rule:
- if `stale`, the emoji becomes `💤`
- the ring becomes dimmer
- `OFFLINE` label is shown
- opacity drops

So:
- “horse activity” = status resolves to `running` or `sprinting`
- “zzz / idle” = status is `idle`, or it becomes `stale` due to old `updatedAt`

## 5) Where online / active rider state is derived for the snapshot

There are two layers here.

### Layer 1: per-rider status in the snapshot
In:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`

`mapToRacingEntries(...)` derives each rider’s `status` from:
- leaderboard presence
- `roundProgress`
- `race.raceStart / race.raceEnd`
- `aggregateIngestionStatus`

This is the main source of rider state for the Jumbotron snapshot.

### Layer 2: aggregate KPI counts on the snapshot
In:
- `C:/Users/ruanyicheng/Desktop/ARY-for-ARY/src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`

After building entries:
- `kpis.onlineRiders = entries.length - staleCount`
- `kpis.activeRiders = entries.filter((entry) => entry.status !== "stale" && entry.status !== "idle").length`

So:
- `onlineRiders` is “not stale”
- `activeRiders` is “not stale and not idle”

That is the final snapshot-level aggregate used by Jumbotron UI.

### How Jumbotron uses it
In `JumbotronClient.tsx`:
- header shows `在线 {kpis.onlineRiders}/{entries.length}`
- active rider cards are built from `entries`
- horse rendering uses `entry.status` via `resolveMotionState(...)`

Here is a concise implementation plan aligned with `docs/grs003`, without changing code yet.

## Recommended implementation plan

### 1. Fix public header/login entry so the public site stays public
Goal: logged-in users should remain in the public IA by default, while authorized users still have a clear but secondary way into Console.

#### What to change
- In `public-header.tsx`, stop using session existence alone to decide the primary action label and href.
- In `viewer-access.ts`, replace the current binary `getConsoleEntryTarget(hasSession)` behavior with role-aware public-entry behavior.

#### Recommended approach
- Keep the header’s main auth action public-facing:
  - Anonymous user: show `登录` linking to `/login`
  - Logged-in user: show something like `账户` or `我的入口`, linking to a neutral public-safe destination such as `/` or a future profile/account page
- Add a separate secondary Console entry that only appears for users with actual console-capable roles/sections:
  - Use existing `getConsoleHomeSections(roles)` as the reuse point
  - If `getConsoleHomeSections(roles).length > 0`, render a smaller secondary `进入控制台` link
  - If no accessible sections, do not render Console entry at all

#### Why this fits grs003
- `ary-mvp.ia.md` says public header should be `Races / Works / Riders / Cooperation / Login / Console Entry`, with Console Entry secondary and non-disruptive.
- This keeps public viewers from being invited into `/console` just because they have a session.
- It still allows authorized users to reach Console quickly, but only as an explicit secondary action.

#### Suggested refactor shape
- In `viewer-access.ts`, split responsibilities:
  - `getPublicHeaderAuthAction(...)` or similar: primary public-safe CTA
  - `canShowConsoleEntry(roles)` or `getConsoleEntryHref(roles)` using `getConsoleHomeSections`
- Avoid reusing `hasSession` as the decision boundary for console access. Roles/capabilities are the correct boundary.

---

### 2. Remove seed/demo accounts from the login page
Goal: the login page should stop advertising seed/demo credentials.

#### What to change
- `src/app/login/page.tsx` currently renders `SeedAccountsPanel`.
- `SeedAccountsPanel` in `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx` depends on `getDemoCredentials()` from `src/lib/demo-credentials.ts`.

#### Recommended approach
- Remove `SeedAccountsPanel` from the login page render tree.
- Keep the shared component and helper only if they are still used elsewhere for internal/demo flows; otherwise they become cleanup candidates later.
- Do not change login flow semantics in this pass beyond removing public exposure of demo credentials.

#### Why this fits grs003
- Public auth entry should be an identity entry, not a seeded demo showcase.
- It reduces the mismatch between public product behavior and internal/demo scaffolding.

---

### 3. Make Live Hall show the Jumbotron inline at the top by default
Goal: the big-screen experience should be visible immediately in Live Hall, not hidden behind a click-to-expand button.

#### What to change
- `src/app/_components/public/live-hall.tsx` already embeds `JumbotronInline`.
- `src/app/JumbotronInline.tsx` currently defaults closed and requires button interaction.

#### Recommended approach
- Convert `JumbotronInline` into a presentational embedded preview by default:
  - render the framed `JumbotronClient` immediately when snapshot and track profile exist
  - remove the local `open` state and the toggle button for this public Live Hall use case
- Keep the existing “打开大屏” and “打开大屏控制台” links in `LiveHallView`; those remain valid secondary actions.

#### Reuse recommendation
- Reuse `JumbotronClient` exactly as-is for rendering.
- Only change the wrapper behavior in `JumbotronInline`, unless this component is also used somewhere else that still needs collapsible behavior.
- If collapsible behavior is needed in other places, introduce a prop like `defaultOpen` or `collapsible`, with Live Hall passing the non-collapsible mode.

#### Why this fits grs003 and the user request
- Docs position Live Hall as the public process page and Jumbotron as Screen Display, but the user explicitly wants the big screen at the top of Live Hall.
- This is still IA-consistent if treated as an embedded display section inside the public Live Hall, while full-screen display remains its own output surface.

---

### 4. Fix “all horses show zzz” when riders are actually online
Goal: entering Live Hall should not immediately make active riders appear stale/offline.

#### Root cause from current code path
The problem is likely a combination of two issues:

1. `mapToRacingEntries()` in `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts` sets `updatedAt` from leaderboard entry creation time:
   - `updatedAt: entry?.createdAt.toISOString() ?? new Date().toISOString()`
2. `resolveMotionState()` in `src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state.ts` marks `running`/`sprinting` entries as `stale` if `updatedAt` is older than 5 minutes.

So even when:
- a registration’s `aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"`
- sessions exist
- `latestActivity` is recent

the horse can still go stale because its `updatedAt` comes from an old leaderboard row instead of current session activity.

#### Recommended fix
Make `updatedAt` reflect the freshest runtime signal available, not historical leaderboard creation time.

Priority order for `updatedAt` in `mapToRacingEntries()`:
1. latest session activity timestamp, if available
2. most recent projection-derived recency, if available in future
3. leaderboard entry timestamp as fallback
4. current time as final fallback

Concretely, derive the latest session by recency, not by highest progress:
- current code sorts sessions by `progressPercent`
- that is a poor freshness proxy
- use the most recent session activity timestamp instead

Also revisit how status is derived:
- current override:
  - if `aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"`, force status to `"running"`
- that is acceptable, but only if `updatedAt` is also tied to session freshness
- otherwise the UI says “running” and then motion resolver immediately downgrades to `stale`

#### Optional hardening
- Consider lowering stale threshold later toward the comment’s intended production value (`30s`), but only after `updatedAt` becomes trustworthy.
- If a rider is active via `ACTIVE` connection but no timestamp exists, consider mapping to `idle` rather than `running`, to avoid false “online but stale” contradictions.
- If there is a reliable session-level `latestActivity` string but it is not ISO time in some cases, confirm schema/seed shape before relying on it universally.

---

## Sequencing

### Phase A: IA-safe public entry fixes
1. Refactor header auth/console decision logic in `viewer-access.ts`
2. Update `public-header.tsx` to render:
   - primary public-safe auth/account link
   - secondary role-gated Console entry
3. Update/add tests in `viewer-access.test.ts`

### Phase B: Remove demo account exposure
4. Remove `SeedAccountsPanel` from `login/page.tsx`
5. Check whether `SeedAccountsPanel` and `getDemoCredentials()` are now unused and either leave for later cleanup or remove in the same pass if safe

### Phase C: Live Hall display behavior
6. Change `JumbotronInline` to render open by default, preferably via a prop-based reusable pattern if other callers may still need collapse behavior
7. Verify Live Hall still preserves explicit links to full-screen Jumbotron and Screen Console

### Phase D: Jumbotron activity freshness

## Recommended implementation plan

### 1. Fix public header/login entry so the public site stays public
Goal: logged-in users should remain in the public IA by default, while authorized users still have a clear but secondary way into Console.

#### What to change
- In `public-header.tsx`, stop using session existence alone to decide the primary action label and href.
- In `viewer-access.ts`, replace the current binary `getConsoleEntryTarget(hasSession)` behavior with role-aware public-entry behavior.

#### Recommended approach
- Keep the header’s main auth action public-facing:
  - Anonymous user: show `登录` linking to `/login`
  - Logged-in user: show something like `账户` or `我的入口`, linking to a neutral public-safe destination such as `/` or a future profile/account page
- Add a separate secondary Console entry that only appears for users with actual console-capable roles/sections:
  - Use existing `getConsoleHomeSections(roles)` as the reuse point
  - If `getConsoleHomeSections(roles).length > 0`, render a smaller secondary `进入控制台` link
  - If no accessible sections, do not render Console entry at all

#### Why this fits grs003
- `ary-mvp.ia.md` says public header should be `Races / Works / Riders / Cooperation / Login / Console Entry`, with Console Entry secondary and non-disruptive.
- This keeps public viewers from being invited into `/console` just because they have a session.

#### Suggested refactor shape

  - `getPublicHeaderAuthAction(...)` or similar: primary public-safe CTA

### 3. Make Live Hall show the Jumbotron inline at the top by default
Goal: the big-screen experience should be visible immediately in Live Hall, not hidden behind a click-to-expand button.

#### What to change
- `src/app/_components/public/live-hall.tsx` already embeds `JumbotronInline`.
- `src/app/JumbotronInline.tsx` currently defaults closed and requires button interaction.

#### Recommended approach
- Convert `JumbotronInline` into a presentational embedded preview by default:
  - render the framed `JumbotronClient` immediately when snapshot and track profile exist
  - remove the local `open` state and the toggle button for this public Live Hall use case
- Keep the existing “打开大屏” and “打开大屏控制台” links in `LiveHallView`; those remain valid secondary actions.

#### Reuse recommendation
- Reuse `JumbotronClient` exactly as-is for rendering.
- Only change the wrapper behavior in `JumbotronInline`, unless this component is also used somewhere else that still needs collapsible behavior.
- If collapsible behavior is needed in other places, introduce a prop like `defaultOpen` or `collapsible`, with Live Hall passing the non-collapsible mode.

#### Why this fits grs003 and the user request

- This is still IA-consistent if treated as an embedded display section inside the public Live Hall, while full-screen display remains its own output surface.

---

### 4. Fix “all horses show zzz” when riders are actually online
Goal: entering Live Hall should not immediately make active riders appear stale/offline.

#### Root cause from current code path
The problem is likely a combination of two issues:

1. `mapToRacingEntries()` in `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts` sets `updatedAt` from leaderboard entry creation time:
   - `updatedAt: entry?.createdAt.toISOString() ?? new Date().toISOString()`
2. `resolveMotionState()` in `src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state.ts` marks `running`/`sprinting` entries as `stale` if `updatedAt` is older than 5 minutes.

So even when:
- a registration’s `aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"`
- sessions exist
- `latestActivity` is recent

the horse can still go stale because its `updatedAt` comes from an old leaderboard row instead of current session activity.

#### Recommended fix
Make `updatedAt` reflect the freshest runtime signal available, not historical leaderboard creation time.

Priority order for `updatedAt` in `mapToRacingEntries()`:
1. latest session activity timestamp, if available
2. most recent projection-derived recency, if available in future
3. leaderboard entry timestamp as fallback
4. current time as final fallback

Concretely, derive the latest session by recency, not by highest progress:
- current code sorts sessions by `progressPercent`
- that is a poor freshness proxy
- use the most recent session activity timestamp instead

Also revisit how status is derived:
- current override:
  - if `aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"`, force status to `"running"`
- that is acceptable, but only if `updatedAt` is also tied to session freshness
- otherwise the UI says “running” and then motion resolver immediately downgrades to `stale`

#### Optional hardening
- Consider lowering stale threshold later toward the comment’s intended production value (`30s`), but only after `updatedAt` becomes trustworthy.
- If a rider is active via `ACTIVE` connection but no timestamp exists, consider mapping to `idle` rather than `running`, to avoid false “online but stale” contradictions.
- If there is a reliable session-level `latestActivity` string but it is not ISO time in some cases, confirm schema/seed shape before relying on it universally.

String: # Context

当前还剩 4 个直接影响 demo 观感和验收节奏的问题需要一起修：
- 首页未登录态的登录入口虽然已经放大过，但仍然不够醒目
- Jumbotron 虽然已经改成和进度榜单同源，但计时器展示逻辑不对：三个比赛现在都像在用同一套时钟；赛前/赛后本不该显示时钟，同时 banner 的暂停/锁定按钮也缺失
- 参赛者在比赛中当然可以主动提交代码，赛后只是额外要求补交最终代码与 Riding Record；现在部分公开说明把“赛后提交”写成了泛化规则，容易让 Rider 误以为比赛中不能交
- demo 的种子赛事时间窗口太短，按当前 seed 很快就会跨阶段，不利于把验收稳定维持到下周 28 号

这轮改动不需要重做数据模型，重点是复用现有相位判断、Jumbotron 数据构建和提交表单组件，把显示逻辑、文案和 seed 时间统一纠正。

# Recommended Approach

## 1. 继续放大首页未登录态 CTA

### 改动目标
让 `/` 页未登录态的“立即前往登录”在视觉上更明显，不只是有按钮，而是足够大、足够显眼。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 保留现有 `button button-cta-large` 入口，不新增新类名
- 直接在 `aryStyles` 里的 `.button-cta-large` 上继续提高尺寸：`min-height`、横向 padding、字号、字重、圆角和阴影
- 如有必要同步提高未登录态提示文案的字号和按钮所在块的留白，避免“按钮变大但视觉上还是挤”

## 2. 让 Jumbotron 的时钟与比赛阶段一致，并恢复暂停锁定

### 改动目标
- 大屏继续和进度榜单同源
- 时钟只在比赛真正进行中（`active` / `frozen`）展示
- 赛前（`registration` / `preparation`）和赛后（`finished`）不展示时钟
- Banner 恢复暂停按钮，暂停后锁定当前比赛，不再自动轮播

### 关键文件
- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx`
- `src/app/JumbotronBanner.tsx`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`
- `src/lib/race-phase.ts`

### 实施方式
- 复用现有 phase 概念，不另造一套 Jumbotron 状态名
- 在 `JumbotronClient` 中基于 `competition.currentPhase` 或等价判断得到 `showClock` / `isRunningPhase`
- 只有在 `active` / `frozen` 时才推进 `elapsed` / `systemTime` 的本地 tick；其他阶段直接隐藏 header/footer 的时钟位
- 检查 `adapter.ts` 的 `getRaceLivePhase()` 与 `src/lib/race-phase.ts` 的 `getRacePhase()` 是否有语义漂移，必要时收敛到同一判断口径，避免首页 phase 和大屏 phase 不一致
- 在 `JumbotronBanner.tsx` 增加 `isPaused` 状态与暂停/继续按钮；自动轮播 effect 在 `isPaused` 时停掉
- 用户手动切 tab、点上一场/下一场后都保持当前锁定，直到主动恢复自动轮播

## 3. 修正 Rider 提交相关文案，避免把“赛后补交”误写成“只能赛后交”

### 改动目标
把“比赛中可主动交代码，赛后再补交最终代码 + Riding Record”说清楚，并且不同阶段看到的提示要匹配当前阶段。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/_components/submission-form-client.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/final-submission-form-client.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 保留比赛中表单本身的代码-only 行为不变
- 检查并改掉所有把“赛后提交代码与 Riding Record”写成普遍规则的公共说明，尤其是 `PublicRaceSections` 里 pre-race 阶段说明和首页分支文案
- 文案统一为：
  - 比赛前：说明比赛开始后可主动提交代码
  - 比赛中 / 封榜中：明确当前就可以主动提交代码
  - 比赛后：明确需要补交最终代码与 Riding Record
- 尽量抽成一致措辞，避免 `page.tsx` 和 `ary-shared.tsx` 再次漂移

## 4. 拉长 demo 种子赛事时间窗口到下周 28 号前仍然稳定

### 改动目标
让 demo 在验收周期内持续保留“报名中 / 比赛中 / 已结束”三种代表场景，而不是几天后自动跳相位。

### 关键文件
- `prisma/seed.ts`
- `src/lib/race-phase.ts`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`

### 实施方式
- 直接调整 seed 里的三场演示赛的 `signupStart` / `signupEnd` / `raceStart` / `raceEnd`
- 保持三种展示态：
  - 一场仍处于报名中
  - 一场仍处于比赛中（必要时可带封榜，也可继续不封榜）
  - 一场仍处于已结束
- 时间要相对当前日期拉长到 2026-06-28 附近仍然稳态，不要让“报名中”或“比赛中”场景在几天内自然消失
- 调整后确认首页 phase 和 Jumbotron phase 仍然一致，尤其不要因为 `adapter.ts` 的相位推导简化而让大屏时钟与首页阶段冲突

# Critical Files

- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\page.tsx`
- `C:\Users\ruanyicheng\Desktop\ARY-for-ARY\src\app\_components\ary-shared.tsx`

# Reuse

- 首页未登录态 CTA 与共享样式：`src/app/page.tsx`, `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
- 比赛中代码提交表单：`src/app/_components/submission-form-client.tsx`

## 首页 CTA

- 确认账户中心里的“立即前往登录”明显比当前更大、更醒目

## Jumbotron 计时与暂停
- 在报名中比赛上确认大屏不显示时钟
- 在比赛中比赛上确认大屏显示并推进时钟
- 在已结束比赛上确认大屏不显示时钟

1	# Context
2	
3	当前还剩 4 个直接影响 demo 观感和验收节奏的问题需要一起修：
4	- 首页未登录态的登录入口虽然已经放大过，但仍然不够醒目
5	- Jumbotron 虽然已经改成和进度榜单同源，但计时器展示逻辑不对：三个比赛现在都像在用同一套时钟；赛前/赛后本不该显示时钟，同时 banner 的暂停/锁定按钮也缺失
6	- 参赛者在比赛中当然可以主动提交代码，赛后只是额外要求补交最终代码与 Riding Record；现在部分公开说明把“赛后提交”写成了泛化规则，容易让 Rider 误以为比赛中不能交
7	- demo 的种子赛事时间窗口太短，按当前 seed 很快就会跨阶段，不利于把验收稳定维持到下周 28 号

## Approved Plan:
# Context

当前这轮要一起修的是 7 个彼此相关的体验问题，核心目标是让公开站、登录入口、控制台入口和 Live Hall / Jumbotron 都重新符合 `docs/grs003` 的公开信息架构，同时保留你已经强调过的 GRS003 现有接口：
- 首页未登录态的登录入口还不够醒目
- 登录后首页顶部现在直接变成“进入控制台”，这会把公开观众和已登录但无后台职责的用户都往 Console 心智上带；Console 入口需要保留，但必须是受权限限制且次级的入口
- 登录页当前还公开展示 seed/demo 账号，这一块需要移除
- Live Hall 里的大屏现在藏在点击展开按钮后面，但你要求它应直接出现在 Live Hall 顶部
- 进入赛事大厅后，即使选手在线，马匹也经常显示 `zzz`，说明当前大屏活跃态和在线态的时间戳来源不对
- Jumbotron 的时钟逻辑仍要修正：只在真正比赛进行中显示，赛前/赛后不显示
- demo 种子赛事时间窗口太短，按当前 seed 很快就会跨阶段，不利于把验收稳定维持到 2026-06-28

这轮改动不重做数据模型，重点是复用现有的：
- 权限与入口判断：`src/lib/viewer-access.ts`
- 赛事阶段判断：`src/lib/race-phase.ts`
- Jumbotron 数据构建：`src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`, `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
- Live Hall 路由与当前大屏预览接线：`src/app/races/[raceSlug]/live/page.tsx`, `src/app/_components/public/live-hall.tsx`
- 提交表单组件：`src/app/_components/submission-form-client.tsx`, `src/app/_components/final-submission-form-client.tsx`

文档收口约束：这轮相关说明性更新统一写入 `docs/superpowers/status.md`，不再额外分散到别的说明文档；代码仍按实际受影响文件修改。

# Recommended Approach

## 1. 继续放大首页未登录态 CTA

### 改动目标
让 `/` 页未登录态的“立即前往登录”在视觉上更明显，不只是有按钮，而是足够大、足够显眼。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 保留现有 `button button-cta-large` 入口，不新增新类名
- 直接在 `aryStyles` 里的 `.button-cta-large` 上继续提高尺寸：`min-height`、横向 padding、字号、字重、圆角和阴影
- 如有必要同步提高未登录态提示文案的字号和按钮所在块的留白，避免“按钮变大但视觉上还是挤”

## 2. 把首页顶部入口改回“公开站优先，控制台次级且按权限显示”

### 改动目标
- 登录后不再让公开站主入口直接变成泛化的“进入控制台”
- 只有确实有 Console 可用分区的用户，才看到次级 Console 入口
- 无论是否登录，公开站导航都保持 gallery-first，不把普通观众往 `/console` 心智引导

### 关键文件
- `src/app/_components/public/public-header.tsx`
- `src/lib/viewer-access.ts`
- `src/app/page.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 停止用单纯 `hasSession` 决定 header 主按钮的文案和目标；当前 `getConsoleEntryTarget(hasSession)` 语义过粗，需要改成按角色/能力判断
- 在 `viewer-access.ts` 中复用现有 `getConsoleHomeSections(roles)` / `getRoleCapabilities(roles)`，新增公开站 header 所需的两个判断口径：
  - 主 auth/account 入口：匿名用户仍去 `/login`；已登录用户保持公开站语义，不直接把主入口变成 Console
  - 次级 Console 入口：只有 `getConsoleHomeSections(roles).length > 0` 的用户才展示
- `public-header.tsx` 改成双入口结构：
  - 主按钮继续承担登录/账户入口
  - 次按钮只对有后台可访问分区的用户显示“进入控制台”
- 保持现有 Console 路由守卫不变，因为 `src/app/console/**` 和 `viewer-access.ts` 已经在做权限拦截；这一步主要修公开页上的错误引导

## 3. 登录页去掉 seed/demo 账号展示

### 改动目标
让 `/login` 只保留真实登录/注册入口和必要说明，不再公开展示 seed/demo 账号。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/login/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`
- `src/lib/demo-credentials.ts`

### 实施方式
- 先从 `login/page.tsx` 中移除 `SeedAccountsPanel`，不改动登录/注册动作和登录态跳转
- 再检查 `SeedAccountsPanel` 与 `getDemoCredentials()` 是否还有其他调用；若无其它用途，同轮直接删除，避免遗留公开 demo 凭据组件
- 保持 `getLoginRedirectTarget()` 现有行为：已登录用户仍不应停留在 `/login`

## 4. 把大屏直接放到 Live Hall 顶部，并避免公开观众被引向 Screen Console

### 改动目标
- Live Hall 顶部直接出现大屏，而不是先点“查看赛马大屏”按钮
- 公开用户仍能打开真正的大屏输出，但不应在公开页里被直接邀请进入 Screen Console

### 关键文件
- `src/app/_components/public/live-hall.tsx`
- `src/app/JumbotronInline.tsx`
- `src/app/races/[raceSlug]/live/page.tsx`
- `src/lib/viewer-access.ts`

### 实施方式
- 保留当前 `race live page -> buildRaceSnapshot -> getEffectiveTrackProfileFromSnapshot -> LiveHallView` 的 GRS003 接线不变
- 将 `JumbotronInline` 从默认折叠的可展开组件改为可配置组件：
  - Live Hall 顶部使用“直接展开且不可折叠”模式
  - 如果别处仍需要折叠预览，再通过 prop 保留该能力，不强行全局删掉
- 在 `live-hall.tsx` 中调整布局：
  - 页面顶部先放 Jumbotron 区块
  - 再放赛事状态、过程指标、Rider 活动、事件流等 web summary 内容
- 公开页上的“打开大屏控制台”链接要删除或按权限显式 gate，避免匿名观众或普通用户被引去 `/console/screen/...`
- 保留“打开大屏”这种公开可访问的大屏链接，因为它属于公开展示面，不是后台入口

## 5. 修正 Jumbotron 在线骑手仍显示 `zzz` 的活跃态来源

### 改动目标
让“选手在线时有马在跑”重新成立，不再因为旧时间戳或错误 freshness 代理导致刚进入大厅就一片 `zzz`。

### 关键文件
- `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`
- `src/lib/services/race-snapshot.ts`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state.ts`
- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 不从 UI 端硬改 `resolveMotionState()` 逻辑；根因更可能在 `adapter.ts` 里给每个 entry 的 `updatedAt` 取值不对
- 重点检查并改造 `mapToRacingEntries()`：
  - 现在如果 `updatedAt` 主要来自旧 leaderboard 时间，而不是最近 session 活动时间，就会在 `resolveMotionState()` 的 5 分钟 stale 阈值下被打成 `stale`
  - 要把 `updatedAt` 收敛为“最近一次真实活跃时间”优先，例如最近 session 活动 / 最近连接活动，而不是 progress 排序结果或历史 leaderboard 创建时间
- 保留当前 `aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE"` 可推动 `running` 的思路，但必须让它和新的 freshness 时间戳一致，否则会出现“逻辑上 running，视觉上 stale/zzz” 的冲突
- 如有必要，顺带校正 `race-snapshot.ts` 里 `onlineRiders` / `activeRiders` 与 entry freshness 的一致性，避免头部 KPI 和赛道动画互相打架

## 6. 让 Jumbotron 的时钟与比赛阶段一致，并恢复暂停锁定

### 改动目标
- 大屏继续和进度榜单同源
- 时钟只在比赛真正进行中（`active` / `frozen`）展示
- 赛前（`registration` / `preparation`）和赛后（`finished`）不展示时钟
- Banner 恢复暂停按钮，暂停后锁定当前比赛，不再自动轮播

### 关键文件
- `src/app/jumbotron/[raceId]/JumbotronClient.tsx`
- `src/app/JumbotronBanner.tsx`
- `src/lib/jumbotron/adapter.ts`
- `src/lib/race-phase.ts`

### 实施方式
- 复用现有 phase 概念，不另造一套 Jumbotron 状态名
- 在 `JumbotronClient` 中基于 `competition.currentPhase` 或等价判断得到 `showClock` / `isRunningPhase`
- 只有在 `active` / `frozen` 时才推进 `elapsed` / `systemTime` 的本地 tick；其他阶段直接隐藏 header/footer 的时钟位
- 检查 `adapter.ts` 的相位推导与 `src/lib/race-phase.ts` 是否有语义漂移，必要时收敛到同一判断口径，避免首页 phase 和大屏 phase 不一致
- 在 `JumbotronBanner.tsx` 增加 `isPaused` 状态与暂停/继续按钮；自动轮播 effect 在 `isPaused` 时停掉
- 用户手动切 tab、点上一场/下一场后都保持当前锁定，直到主动恢复自动轮播

## 7. 修正 Rider 提交相关文案，避免把“赛后补交”误写成“只能赛后交”

### 改动目标
把“比赛中可主动交代码，赛后再补交最终代码 + Riding Record”说清楚，并且不同阶段看到的提示要匹配当前阶段。

### 关键文件
- `src/app/_components/submission-form-client.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/final-submission-form-client.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/app/_components/ary-shared.tsx`

### 实施方式
- 保留比赛中表单本身的 code-only 行为不变
- 检查并改掉所有把“赛后提交代码与 Riding Record”写成普遍规则的公共说明，尤其是 `PublicRaceSections` 里 pre-race 阶段说明和首页分支文案
- 文案统一为：
  - 比赛前：说明比赛开始后可主动提交代码
  - 比赛中 / 封榜中：明确当前就可以主动提交代码
  - 比赛后：明确需要补交最终代码与 Riding Record
- 尽量抽成一致措辞，避免 `page.tsx` 和 `ary-shared.tsx` 再次漂移

## 8. 拉长 demo 种子赛事时间窗口到 2026-06-28 前仍然稳定

### 改动目标
让 demo 在验收周期内持续保留“报名中 / 比赛中 / 已结束”三种代表场景，而不是几天后自动跳相位。

## 9. 文档更新统一收口到 `docs/superpowers/status.md`

130	/**
131	 * ARY 数据 → Competition
132	 */
133	export function mapToCompetition(race: AryRaceData, now: Date = new Date()): Competition {
134	  const phase = getRaceLivePhase(race, now);
135	  const liveStatus: Competition["liveStatus"] =
136	    phase === "finished" ? "finished" : phase === "active" || phase === "frozen" ? "live" : "not_started";
137	
138	  return {
139	    competitionId: race.id,
140	    title: race.title,
141	    subtitle: race.summary,
142	    theme: "ARY GRS 001",
143	    organizer: race.organizer.username,
144	    liveStatus,
145	    currentPhase: phase,
146	    currentRound: 1,
147	    nextPhase:
148	      phase === "registration"
149	        ? "比赛中"
150	        : phase === "preparation"
151	          ? "比赛中"
152	          : phase === "active"
153	            ? "封榜中"
154	            : phase === "frozen"
155	              ? "比赛结束"
156	              : "已结束",
157	    elapsedTime:
158	      phase === "active" || phase === "frozen"
159	        ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((now.getTime() - race.raceStart.getTime()) / 1000))
160	        : 0,
161	    systemTime: now.toISOString(),
162	  };
163	}
164	
165	/**
166	 * ARY 数据 → RacingEntrySnapshot[]
167	 */
168	export function mapToRacingEntries(race: AryRaceData): RacingEntrySnapshot[] {
169	  const { teams, leaderboardEntries, submissions, teamArchives, feedbackThreads } = race;
170	
171	  const ranked = [...leaderboardEntries].sort((a, b) => b.totalScore - a.totalScore);
172	  const maxScore = ranked[0]?.totalScore ?? 100;
173	  const archiveMap = new Map(teamArchives.map((a) => [a.teamId, a]));
174	  const feedbackMap = new Map(feedbackThreads.map((f) => [f.teamId, f]));
175	  const submissionCountMap = submissions.reduce((map, submission) => {
176	    map.set(submission.teamId, (map.get(submission.teamId) ?? 0) + 1);
177	    return map;
178	  }, new Map<string, number>());
179	  const now = new Date();
180	  const allRankedProgressZero =
181	    ranked.length > 0 &&
182	    ranked.every((entry) => typeof entry.progress === "number" && entry.progress === 0);
183	
184	  const registrationsByUserId = new Map(
185	    (race.registrations ?? []).map((registration) => [registration.userId, registration]),
186	  );
187	  const projectedLeaderboard = race.projections?.find(
188	    (projection) => projection.type === "CURRENT_LEADERBOARD",
189	  );
190	  let projectedEntries = new Map<
191	    string,
192	    {
193	      entryId: string;
194	      progressPercent: number;
195	      rank: number;
196	      tokenCost: number;
197	      username: string;
198	    }
199	  >();
200	  let projectedRows: Array<{
201	    entryId: string;
202	    progressPercent: number;
203	    rank: number;
204	    tokenCost: number;
205	    username: string;
206	  }> = [];
207	  if (projectedLeaderboard) {
208	    try {
209	      const parsed = JSON.parse(projectedLeaderboard.payloadJson) as Array<{
210	        entryId: string;
211	        progressPercent: number;
212	        rank: number;
213	        tokenCost: number;
214	        username: string;
215	      }>;
216	      projectedRows = parsed;
217	      projectedEntries = new Map(parsed.map((item) => [item.entryId, item]));
218	    } catch {
219	      projectedEntries = new Map();
220	      projectedRows = [];
221	    }
222	  }
223	
224	  const rosterTeams =
225	    (race.registrations?.length ?? 0) > 0
226	      ? (race.registrations ?? []).map((registration) => ({
227	          id: registration.id,
228	          name: registration.work?.title ?? registration.user.username,
229	          captain: registration.user,
230	        }))
231	      : teams;
232	
233	  return rosterTeams.map((team) => {
234	    const projected =
235	      projectedEntries.get(team.id) ??
236	      projectedRows.find((item) => item.username === team.captain.username);
237	    const rank = projected?.rank ? projected.rank - 1 : ranked.findIndex((e) => e.teamId === team.id);
238	    const entry = ranked[rank];
239	    const archive = archiveMap.get(team.id);
240	    const compatibilityTeam = teams.find((candidate) => candidate.captain.id === team.captain.id);
241	    const feedback = feedbackMap.get(compatibilityTeam?.id ?? team.id);
242	    const submissionCount = submissionCountMap.get(compatibilityTeam?.id ?? team.id) ?? 0;
243	    const registration = registrationsByUserId.get(team.captain.id);
244	    const sessionTokenCost =
245	      registration?.raceProject?.caConnections?.reduce(
246	        (sum, connection) =>
247	          sum +
248	          (connection.sessions?.reduce(
249	            (inner, session) => inner + (session.tokenCost ?? 0),
250	            0,
251	          ) ?? 0),
252	        0,
253	      ) ?? 0;
254	    const primaryConnection = registration?.raceProject?.caConnections?.[0];
255	    const latestSession =
256	      registration?.raceProject?.caConnections
257	        ?.flatMap((connection) => connection.sessions ?? [])
258	        .sort(
259	          (left, right) =>
260	            (right.progressPercent ?? 0) - (left.progressPercent ?? 0),
261	        )[0] ?? null;
262	    const effectiveTokenCost =
263	      sessionTokenCost > 0 ? sessionTokenCost : (archive?.tokenUsed ?? 0);
264	
265	    // overallProgress：分数相对最高分的比例
266	    const overallProgress =
267	      projected?.progressPercent != null
268	        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(projected.progressPercent / 100, 1))
269	        : entry && maxScore > 0
270	          ? Math.min(entry.totalScore / maxScore, 1)
271	          : 0.5;
272	
273	    const rawProgress = entry?.progress ?? null;
274	    let roundProgress: number;
275	    const shouldIgnoreZeroProgressPlaceholder =
276	      !!entry &&
277	      allRankedProgressZero &&
278	      overallProgress > 0 &&
279	      ranked.length > 1;
280	
281	    if (typeof rawProgress === "number" && !shouldIgnoreZeroProgressPlaceholder) {
282	      roundProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(rawProgress, 1));
283	    } else if (shouldIgnoreZeroProgressPlaceholder) {
284	      // 当排行榜已有明显分布，但整批 progress 都被写成占位 0 时，
285	      // 退回到 overallProgress，避免所有马被压到同一个起点/终点位置。
286	      roundProgress = overallProgress;
287	    } else if (now >= race.raceEnd) {
288	      roundProgress = 1;
289	    } else if (now < race.raceStart) {
290	      roundProgress = 0;
291	    } else if (projected) {
292	      roundProgress = overallProgress;
293	    } else if (entry) {
294	      // Jumbotron 子系统要求在缺失 roundProgress 时显式退回到 overallProgress，
295	      // 而不是把所有正在比赛的队伍压回起点。
296	      roundProgress = overallProgress;
297	    } else {
298	      roundProgress = 0;
299	    }
300	
301	    const status = deriveStatus(entry, race, roundProgress);
302	
303	    // lastMessage — 优先真实反馈，否则不显示
304	    const lastMsg = feedback?.messages?.slice(-1)[0];
305	    const lastMessage: RidingMessageSnapshot | undefined = lastMsg
306	      ? {
307	          messageId: `msg-${team.id}`,
308	          entryId: team.id,
309	          source: "feedback",
310	          type: "progress_update",
311	          severity: "info",
312	          summary: lastMsg.content.slice(0, 50),
313	          createdAt: lastMsg.createdAt.toISOString(),
314	          displayMode: "ticker",
315	        }
316	      : latestSession?.latestActivity
317	        ? {
318	            messageId: `msg-${team.id}-session`,
319	            entryId: team.id,
320	            source: "session",
```

3	import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
4	import type { RaceSnapshot, TrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
5	import { samplePath, sampleAt, tangentAngle, normal } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/path-sampler";
6	import { assignLane } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/lane-manager";
7	import { resolveMotionState } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/animation-state";
8	
9	interface Props {
10	  snapshot: RaceSnapshot;
11	  trackProfile: TrackProfile;
12	}
13	
14	const BASE_LERP = 0.03; // 基础插值速度
15	
16	export default function JumbotronClient({ snapshot, trackProfile }: Props) {
17	  const [debug, setDebug] = useState(false);
18	  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(snapshot.competition.elapsedTime);
19	  const [kpiDetail, setKpiDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);
20	  const [detailEntry, setDetailEntry] = useState<string | null>(null); // drill-down 面板
21	  const [systemTime, setSystemTime] = useState(snapshot.competition.systemTime);
22	  const isRunningPhase =
23	    snapshot.competition.currentPhase === "active" ||
24	    snapshot.competition.currentPhase === "frozen";
25	  const showClock = isRunningPhase;
26	
27	  // -- s-axis 动画状态 --
28	  const [displayS, setDisplayS] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
29	  const rafRef = useRef<number>(0);
30	
31	  const sorted = useMemo(
32	    () => [...snapshot.entries].sort((a, b) => (a.rank ?? 999) - (b.rank ?? 999)),
33	    [snapshot.entries],
34	  );
35	
36	  // 目标 s 值
37	  const targetS = useMemo(() => {
38	    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
39	    for (const e of sorted) map[e.entryId] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, e.roundProgress));
40	    return map;
41	  }, [sorted]);
42	
43	  // 初始化 displayS
44	  useEffect(() => {
45	    setDisplayS((prev) => {
46	      const next: Record<string, number> = {};
47	      for (const e of sorted) {
48	        const previous = prev[e.entryId];
49	        next[e.entryId] = previous ?? (targetS[e.entryId] ?? 0.5);
50	      }
51	      return next;
52	    });
53	  }, [sorted, targetS]);
54	
55	  // s-axis 补间动画循环 —— 每匹马速度略有差异
56	  const animateRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
57	  animateRef.current = useCallback(() => {
58	    setDisplayS((prev) => {
59	      let changed = false;
60	      const next: Record<string, number> = { ...prev };
61	      for (const id of Object.keys(targetS)) {
62	        const cur = prev[id] ?? 0;
63	        const tgt = targetS[id] ?? 0.5;
64	        const diff = tgt - cur;
65	        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.0005) { next[id] = tgt; continue; }
66	        changed = true;
67	        // 每匹马速度在 0.02~0.05 之间随机，模拟不同的追赶节奏
68	        const seed = id.charCodeAt(id.length - 1) || 0;
69	        const speed = BASE_LERP * (0.7 + (seed % 10) / 10);
70	        next[id] = cur + diff * speed;
71	      }
72	      return changed ? next : prev;
73	    });
74	    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animateRef.current);
75	    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
76	  }, [targetS]);
77	
78	  // 每 15 秒微扰所有马位置，制造"实时竞速"感
79	  useEffect(() => {
80	    const jitter = setInterval(() => {
81	      setDisplayS((prev) => {
82	        if (Object.keys(prev).length === 0) return prev;
83	        const next: Record<string, number> = {};
84	        for (const id of Object.keys(prev)) {
85	          next[id] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, prev[id] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006));
86	        }
87	        return next;
88	      });
89	    }, 15000);
90	    return () => clearInterval(jitter);
91	  }, []);
92	
93	  useEffect(() => {
94	    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animateRef.current);
95	    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
96	  }, []);
97	
98	  // key bindings
99	  useEffect(() => {
100	    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "d" || e.key === "D") setDebug((v) => !v); };
101	    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
102	    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
103	  }, []);
104	
105	  // timer
106	  useEffect(() => {
107	    setElapsed(snapshot.competition.elapsedTime);
108	  }, [snapshot.competition.elapsedTime, snapshot.competition.currentPhase]);
109	
110	  useEffect(() => {
111	    setSystemTime(snapshot.competition.systemTime);
112	  }, [snapshot.competition.systemTime, snapshot.competition.currentPhase]);
113	
114	  useEffect(() => {
115	    if (!isRunningPhase) return;
116	    const i = setInterval(() => setElapsed((t) => t + 1), 1000);
117	    return () => clearInterval(i);
118	  }, [isRunningPhase]);
119	
120	  useEffect(() => {
121	    if (!isRunningPhase) return;
122	    const i = setInterval(() => setSystemTime(new Date().toISOString()), 1000);
123	    return () => clearInterval(i);
124	  }, [isRunningPhase]);
125	
126	  const { competition, entries, kpis, messages, attentionItems } = snapshot;
127	  const path = useMemo(
128	    () => samplePath(trackProfile.centerline.points, trackProfile.centerline.closed, 20),
129	    [trackProfile],
130	  );
131	
132	  // 用 displayS（插值后的 s）计算姿势
133	  const poses = useMemo(() => {
134	    return sorted.map((entry) => {
135	      const rank = entry.rank ?? sorted.indexOf(entry) + 1;
136	      const lane = assignLane(rank, trackProfile.lanes.length);
137	      const s = displayS[entry.entryId] ?? entry.roundProgress;
138	      const sampled = sampleAt(path, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s)));
139	      if (!sampled) return null;
140	      const n = normal(sampled.tangent);
141	      const offset = trackProfile.lanes[lane.index]?.offset ?? 0;
142	      const state = resolveMotionState(entry.status, entry.updatedAt);

147	        rotation: (tangentAngle(sampled.tangent) * 180) / Math.PI,
148	        s, laneId: lane.id, state,

150	      };

152	  }, [sorted, trackProfile, path, displayS]);
153	
154	  const top3 = entries.filter((e) => e.rank && e.rank <= 3).sort((a, b) => (a.rank ?? 99) - (b.rank ?? 99));
155	  const activeRiders = [...entries]
156	    .sort((a, b) => (b.submissionCount ?? 0) - (a.submissionCount ?? 0) || (a.rank ?? 999) - (b.rank ?? 999))
157	    .slice(0, 3);
158	
159	  return (
160	    <div className={debug ? "jt jt-debug" : "jt"}>
161	      {/* ====== Header ====== */}

169	        </div>
170	        <div className="jt-hdr__right">
171	          {showClock ? <span>⏱ {formatTime(elapsed)}</span> : null}
172	          <span className="jt-hdr__online">在线 {kpis.onlineRiders}/{entries.length}</span>
173	        </div>
174	      </header>
175	
176	      {/* ====== KPI ====== */}
177	      <div className="jt-kpis">
178	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "progress" ? null : "progress")}><b>{kpis.completionRate}%</b><small>完成度</small></div>
179	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "tokens" ? null : "tokens")}><b>{fmtNum(kpis.totalTokens)}</b><small>Tokens</small></div>
180	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "ca" ? null : "ca")}><b>{kpis.codexShare}%</b><small>Codex</small></div>
181	        <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "ca" ? null : "ca")}><b>{kpis.claudeShare}%</b><small>Claude</small></div>
182	        {kpis.riskCount > 0 && <div className="jt-kpi jt-kpi--warn jt-kpi--click" onClick={() => setKpiDetail(kpiDetail === "risk" ? null : "risk")}><b>{kpis.riskCount}</b><small>风险</small></div>}
183	      </div>
184	
185	      {/* ====== KPI Detail Panel ====== */}
186	      {kpiDetail && (
187	        <div className="jt-kpi-detail">
188	          {kpiDetail === "progress" && (
189	            <table><thead><tr><th>队伍</th><th>总分</th><th>进度</th><th>任务分</th><th>Token分</th><th>对话分</th></tr></thead><tbody>
190	              {sorted.map((e) => (

199	              ))}
200	            </tbody></table>

204	              {sorted.map((e) => (

344	    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
345	    .replace(/-+/g, "-");

359	/**
360	 * 生成 Mock Riding Messages
361	 */
362	export function generateMessages(race: AryRaceData): RidingMessageSnapshot[] {
363	  const projected = race.projections?.find((projection) => projection.type === "SCREEN_FEED");
364	  if (projected) {
365	    try {
366	      const parsed = JSON.parse(projected.payloadJson) as {
367	        items?: Array<{ summary: string; type: string }>;
368	      };
369	      if (parsed.items?.length) {
370	        return parsed.items.map((item, index) => ({
371	          messageId: `screen-feed-${index}`,
372	          entryId: race.teams[index]?.id ?? race.id,
373	          source: "projection",
374	          type:
375	            item.type === "current_leaderboard_projection"
376	              ? "milestone"
377	              : "progress_update",
378	          severity: "info",
379	          summary: item.summary,
380	          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
381	          displayMode: "ticker",
382	        }));
383	      }
384	    } catch {
385	      // fall back to legacy/mock generation
386	    }
387	  }
388	
389	  const messages: RidingMessageSnapshot[] = [];
390	  const now = new Date();
391	  const sessionMessages = (race.registrations ?? []).flatMap((registration) =>
392	    registration.raceProject?.caConnections?.flatMap((connection) =>
393	      (connection.sessions ?? [])
394	        .filter((session) => session.latestActivity)
395	        .map((session, index) => ({
396	          messageId: `session-${registration.id}-${index}`,
397	          entryId:
398	            race.teams.find((team) => team.captain.id === registration.userId)?.id ??
399	            registration.id,
400	          source: "session",
401	          type: "progress_update" as const,
402	          severity: "info" as const,
403	          summary: session.latestActivity!,
404	          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
405	          displayMode: "ticker" as const,
406	        })),
407	    ) ?? [],
408	  );
409	
410	  if (sessionMessages.length > 0) {
411	    return sessionMessages;
412	  }
413	
414	  // 从 feedback 生成消息
415	  for (const fb of race.feedbackThreads) {
416	    for (const msg of fb.messages.slice(-2)) {
417	      messages.push({
418	        messageId: `msg-${fb.teamId}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
419	        entryId: fb.teamId,
420	        source: "feedback",
421	        type: "progress_update",
422	        severity: "info",
423	        summary: msg.content.slice(0, 80),
424	        createdAt: msg.createdAt.toISOString(),
425	        displayMode: "ticker",
426	      });
427	    }
428	  }
429	
430	  return messages;
431	}

433	/**
434	 * 生成 Attention Items（风险/阻碍/违规）
435	 */
436	export function generateAttentionItems(race: AryRaceData): AttentionItem[] {
437	  const items: AttentionItem[] = [];
438	
439	  for (const registration of race.registrations ?? []) {
440	    if (registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus === "FAILED") {
441	      items.push({
442	        itemId: `risk-ca-${registration.id}`,
443	        entryId:
444	          race.teams.find((team) => team.captain.id === registration.userId)?.id ??
445	          registration.userId,
446	        category: "risk",
447	        severity: "medium",
448	        summary: `${registration.user.username}: CA ingestion failed`,
449	        status: "active",
450	        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
451	      });
452	    }
453	  }
454	
455	  for (const archive of race.teamArchives) {
456	    if ((archive.antiCheatPenalty ?? 0) > 0) {
457	      const team = race.teams.find((t) => t.id === archive.teamId);
458	      items.push({
459	        itemId: `risk-${archive.teamId}`,
460	        entryId: archive.teamId,
461	        category: "violation",
462	        severity: "medium",
463	        summary: `${team?.name ?? archive.teamId}: 检测到诱导词，扣 ${archive.antiCheatPenalty} 分`,
464	        status: "active",
465	        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
466	      });
467	    }
468	  }
469	
470	  return items;
471	}

473	/**
474	 * 计算 Competition KPI
475	 */
476	export function calculateKPIs(race: AryRaceData): CompetitionKPI {
477	  const registrationCount = race.registrations?.length ?? 0;
478	  const totalTeams = registrationCount > 0 ? registrationCount : race.teams.length;
479	  const scoredTeams = race.leaderboardEntries.length;
480	  const activeRaceProjects =
481	    registrationCount > 0
482	      ? (race.registrations ?? []).filter((registration) => registration.raceProject).length
483	      : scoredTeams;
484	  const activeRegistrations =
485	    registrationCount > 0
486	      ? (race.registrations ?? []).filter(
487	          (registration) =>
488	            registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus === "ACTIVE",
489	        ).length
490	      : scoredTeams;
491	  const sessionTokenCosts = (race.registrations ?? []).flatMap((registration) =>
492	    registration.raceProject?.caConnections?.flatMap((connection) =>
493	      connection.sessions?.map((session) => session.tokenCost ?? 0) ?? [],
494	    ) ?? [],
495	  );
496	  const totalTokens = sessionTokenCosts.length
497	    ? sessionTokenCosts.reduce((sum, tokenCost) => sum + tokenCost, 0)
498	    : race.teamArchives.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.tokenUsed, 0);
499	  const codexTokens = sessionTokenCosts.length
500	    ? sessionTokenCosts.reduce((sum, tokenCost) => sum + tokenCost, 0)
501	    : race.teamArchives
502	        .filter((a) => a.agentType === "COPILOT")
503	        .reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.tokenUsed, 0);
504	  const claudeTokens = sessionTokenCosts.length
505	    ? 0
506	    : race.teamArchives
507	        .filter((a) => a.agentType === "CLAUDE")
508	        .reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.tokenUsed, 0);
509	  const totalTokensWithCA = codexTokens + claudeTokens || 1;
510	  const riskCount =
511	    (race.registrations ?? []).filter(
512	      (registration) =>
513	        registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus === "FAILED",
514	    ).length ||
515	    race.teamArchives.filter((a) => (a.antiCheatPenalty ?? 0) > 0).length;
516	
517	  return {
518	    completionRate: totalTeams > 0 ? Math.round((activeRaceProjects / totalTeams) * 100) : 0,
519	    totalTokens,
520	    activeRiders: activeRegistrations,
521	    onlineRiders: totalTeams,
522	    activeCockpits: activeRaceProjects,
523	    codexTokens,
524	    claudeTokens,
525	    codexShare: Math.round((codexTokens / totalTokensWithCA) * 100),
526	    claudeShare: Math.round((claudeTokens / totalTokensWithCA) * 100),
527	    riskCount,
528	    obstacleCount: 0,
529	    violationCount: riskCount,
530	  };
531	}
532	
533	// ---- 辅助函数 ----
534	
535	function mapAgentType(agentType?: string): "codex" | "claude" | "other" {
536	  switch (agentType) {
537	    case "CLAUDE":
538	      return "claude";
539	    case "COPILOT":
540	      return "codex";
541	    default:
542	      return "other";
543	  }

28	export function isFailureSignalPayload(signal: RidingSignalInput): boolean {

32	export function getNextConnectionStatusFromSignal(input: {
33	  currentStatus: IngestionStatus;
34	  signal: RidingSignalInput;
35	}): IngestionStatus {
36	  if (isFailureSignalPayload(input.signal)) {
37	    return "FAILED";
38	  }
39	
40	  if (
41	    input.signal.type === "session_started" ||
42	    input.signal.type === "task_progress" ||
43	    input.signal.type === "session_completed"
44	  ) {
45	    return "ACTIVE";
46	  }
47	
48	  return input.currentStatus;
49	}

1	// 动画状态机：RacingEntrySnapshot.status → 视觉表现映射
2	import type { HorseMotionState } from "./types";
3	
4	const STALE_THRESHOLD_MS = 300_000; // 5 分钟无更新视为 stale（demo 用，生产改为 30s）
5	
6	export function resolveMotionState(
7	  status: string,
8	  updatedAt?: string,
9	  now: Date = new Date(),
10	): HorseMotionState {
11	  // 只对 running/sprinting 检查时间 staleness
12	  if ((status === "running" || status === "sprinting") && updatedAt) {
13	    const elapsed = now.getTime() - new Date(updatedAt).getTime();
14	    if (elapsed > STALE_THRESHOLD_MS) return "stale";
15	  }
16	
17	  switch (status) {
18	    case "idle":
19	    case "running":
20	    case "sprinting":
21	    case "slowed":
22	    case "blocked":
23	    case "pit_stop":
24	    case "takeover":
25	    case "finished":
26	    case "stale":
27	      return status;
28	    default:
29	      return "idle";
30	  }
31	}
32	
33	/**
34	 * 获取状态的视觉属性
35	 *
36	 * 用于 CSS/SVG 渲染时决定动画类型、透明度、颜色等
37	 */
38	export function getMotionVisuals(state: HorseMotionState): {
39	  opacity: number;
40	  speed: string;       // CSS animation-duration
41	  highlight: boolean;
42	  pulse: boolean;
43	  cssClass: string;
44	} {
45	  switch (state) {
46	    case "idle":
47	      return { opacity: 0.8, speed: "2s", highlight: false, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-idle" };
48	    case "running":
49	      return { opacity: 1, speed: "0.8s", highlight: false, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-running" };
50	    case "sprinting":
51	      return { opacity: 1, speed: "0.4s", highlight: true, pulse: true, cssClass: "horse-sprinting" };
52	    case "slowed":
53	      return { opacity: 0.7, speed: "1.5s", highlight: false, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-slowed" };
54	    case "blocked":
55	      return { opacity: 0.6, speed: "0s", highlight: false, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-blocked" };
56	    case "pit_stop":
57	      return { opacity: 0.7, speed: "0s", highlight: false, pulse: true, cssClass: "horse-pitstop" };
58	    case "takeover":
59	      return { opacity: 1, speed: "0s", highlight: true, pulse: true, cssClass: "horse-takeover" };
60	    case "finished":
61	      return { opacity: 0.9, speed: "0s", highlight: true, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-finished" };
62	    case "stale":
63	      return { opacity: 0.3, speed: "0s", highlight: false, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-stale" };
64	    default:
65	      return { opacity: 0.8, speed: "1s", highlight: false, pulse: false, cssClass: "horse-idle" };
66	  }
67	}
68	
```

- 你这次 `npm run dev` 想退到 `3001`
- 但 Next 检测到“这个目录已经有一个 dev server 在跑”，于是主动退出了  
  所以才看到：

- `Port 3000 is in use by process 11064`
- `Another next dev server is already running`

也就是说：

- 现有可用服务应该在：`http://localhost:3000`
- 你这次新开的进程没有真正启动成功

你可以这样处理：

   `! taskkill /PID 11064 /F`

3. 然后再重新启动：
   `! npm run dev`

1	import type { Checkpoint, RaceSnapshot, TrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
2	import fs from "node:fs";

4	
5	export const DEFAULT_TRACK_ID = "oval-track";
6	const VALID_TRACK_IDS = new Set([DEFAULT_TRACK_ID, "circuit-track"]);
7	
8	export interface RaceTrackConfig {
9	  startFinish: { s: number };
10	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
11	}
12	
13	export function normalizeTrackId(trackId: string | null | undefined): string {
14	  if (!trackId || !VALID_TRACK_IDS.has(trackId)) {
15	    return DEFAULT_TRACK_ID;
16	  }
17	  return hasTrackProfileAsset(trackId) ? trackId : DEFAULT_TRACK_ID;
18	}
19	
20	export function parseRaceTrackConfigJson(value: string | null | undefined): RaceTrackConfig | null {
21	  if (!value) return null;
22	  const raw = value.trim();
23	  if (!raw) return null;
24	
25	  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
26	    startFinish?: { s?: number };
27	    checkpoints?: Array<{ id?: string; name?: string; s?: number }>;
28	  };
29	
30	  const startFinishS = parsed.startFinish?.s;
31	  if (typeof startFinishS !== "number" || startFinishS < 0 || startFinishS > 1) {
32	    throw new Error("起终点位置必须在 0~1 之间");
33	  }
34	
35	  const checkpoints = Array.isArray(parsed.checkpoints)
36	    ? parsed.checkpoints.map((checkpoint, index) => {
37	        const id = checkpoint.id?.trim() || `checkpoint-${index + 1}`;
38	        const name = checkpoint.name?.trim() || `检查点 ${index + 1}`;
39	        const s = checkpoint.s;
40	        if (typeof s !== "number" || s < 0 || s > 1) {
41	          throw new Error(`检查点 ${index + 1} 的位置必须在 0~1 之间`);
42	        }
43	        return { id, name, s } satisfies Checkpoint;
44	      })
45	    : [];
46	
47	  return {
48	    startFinish: { s: startFinishS },
49	    checkpoints,
50	  };
51	}
52	
53	export function serializeRaceTrackConfig(config: RaceTrackConfig | null): string {
54	  return config ? JSON.stringify(config) : "";
55	}

57	export function loadTrackProfile(trackId: string): TrackProfile | null {
58	  const filePath = path.join(
59	    process.cwd(),
60	    "public",
61	    "assets",
62	    "tracks",
63	    trackId,
64	    "track.profile.json",
65	  );
66	
67	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
68	  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8")) as TrackProfile;
69	}

71	export function getEffectiveTrackProfile(
72	  trackId: string | null | undefined,
73	  trackConfig: RaceTrackConfig | null | undefined,
74	): TrackProfile | null {
75	  const normalizedTrackId = normalizeTrackId(trackId);
76	  const baseProfile = loadTrackProfile(normalizedTrackId);
77	  if (!baseProfile) return null;
78	
79	  return {
80	    ...baseProfile,
81	    trackId: normalizedTrackId,
82	    startFinish: trackConfig?.startFinish ?? baseProfile.startFinish,
83	    checkpoints: trackConfig?.checkpoints?.length
84	      ? trackConfig.checkpoints
85	      : baseProfile.checkpoints,
86	  };
87	}

61	function getCurrentProgressPercent(
62	  race: Pick<RaceSummaryLike, "leaderboardEntries" | "projections">,
63	): number {
64	  const currentLeaderboard = parseCurrentLeaderboardProjection(race.projections);
65	  if (currentLeaderboard.length > 0) {
66	    const total = currentLeaderboard.reduce(
67	      (sum, entry) => sum + clampPercent(entry.progressPercent ?? 0),
68	      0,
69	    );
70	    return Math.round(total / currentLeaderboard.length);
71	  }
72	
73	  if (race.leaderboardEntries.length === 0) return 0;
74	  const top = race.leaderboardEntries[0]?.totalScore ?? 0;
75	  if (top <= 0) return 0;
76	  const total = race.leaderboardEntries.reduce(
77	    (sum, entry) => sum + Math.min(entry.totalScore / top, 1),
78	    0,
79	  );
80	  return Math.round((total / race.leaderboardEntries.length) * 100);
81	}
82	
83	function parseCurrentLeaderboardProjection(
84	  projections: RaceSummaryLike["projections"],
85	): Array<{ progressPercent?: number }> {
86	  const payloadJson = projections?.find(

88	  )?.payloadJson;
89	
90	  if (!payloadJson) {
91	    return [];
92	  }
93	
94	  try {
95	    const parsed = JSON.parse(payloadJson) as Array<{ progressPercent?: number }>;
96	    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
97	  } catch {
98	    return [];
99	  }
100	}

Here are the docs I’d treat as authoritative for this question, with the specific requirements they state.

## 1) Which identities enter from login

### `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
- MVP uses **GitHub Account login**.
- After profile completion, the person becomes an **ARY User**.
- Identity is expressed through `User.roles`, and one user can hold multiple roles:
  - `rider`
  - `judge`
  - `organizer`
  - `admin`
- The doc explicitly says there is **no separate `RoleAssignment` entity** in MVP.

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.prd.md`
- Confirms the same model:
  - **GitHub 登录 + 个人资料补全**
  - user identities are represented by `User.roles`
- Public visitors can browse without login, but **后台访问必须登录** and then pass `User.roles` checks.

## 2) What the login page is for

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
- The public header includes **`Login / Console Entry`**.
- Login is part of the **public site entry flow**, not a separate product area.
- Once logged in, the user may additionally see **Console Entry** depending on roles.

In short: login is the entry point to become an authenticated ARY user and, if authorized, to enter console areas.

## 3) How rider signup / registration should work

### `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
- `Registration.submit` is allowed for **Rider → own registration** only.
- Key rule: **one User can have at most one Registration per Race**.
- After `Registration` is approved, the system **automatically creates `RaceProject`**.
- The rider does **not manually create** their own `RaceProject`.

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
- In the Rider View, the user can:
  - see registration status
  - see CA setup
  - in the participation flow, configure **one or more CAConnection**
- Important IA rule:
  - **Work Submission is not blocked by CA setup**
  - if CA is missing or broken, the system shows **evidence gap / risk prompts**, not auto-withdrawal

### `docs/grs003/ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`
- Defines `Registration` as the fact connecting a **User with rider role** to a **Race**.
- The rider signup flow is:
  - user with `rider` role registers for a race
  - registration can be approved / rejected / withdrawn
  - approved registration drives downstream participation objects

## 4) Is console restricted to specific roles?

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
Yes.
- **Race Console**
  - `organizer` → Organizer View
  - `rider` → Rider View
  - `judge` → Judge View
- **Admin Console**
  - only for `admin` role
- **Screen Console**
  - typically used by `organizer` or `admin`
- The doc says console subroutes must be access-controlled by:
  - `User.roles`
  - current Race relationship
  - authorization scope

### `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
- `Admin Console` only manages:
  - account basics
  - profile completion status
  - `User.roles`
- It explicitly says Admin Console does **not** handle:
  - race execution
  - CA connection maintenance
  - data operations
- `Screen`-related actions are also limited to `Organizer` / `Admin` scope.

## Most relevant files to read first
1. `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
2. `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
3. `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.prd.md`
4. `docs/grs003/ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`

## One-line summary
- **Login** is GitHub-based auth + profile completion into an ARY user.
- **Rider signup** is race registration, not account creation; approved registration auto-creates `RaceProject`.
- **Console access** is role-restricted, with Rider/Judge/Organizer views split and Admin Console limited to admin.

Here are the docs I’d treat as authoritative for this question, with the specific requirements they state.

## 1) Which identities enter from login

### `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
- MVP uses **GitHub Account login**.
- After profile completion, the person becomes an **ARY User**.
- Identity is expressed through `User.roles`, and one user can hold multiple roles:
  - `rider`
  - `judge`
  - `organizer`
  - `admin`
- The doc explicitly says there is **no separate `RoleAssignment` entity** in MVP.

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.prd.md`
- Confirms the same model:
  - **GitHub 登录 + 个人资料补全**
  - user identities are represented by `User.roles`
- Public visitors can browse without login, but **后台访问必须登录** and then pass `User.roles` checks.

## 2) What the login page is for

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
- The public header includes **`Login / Console Entry`**.
- Login is part of the **public site entry flow**, not a separate product area.
- Once logged in, the user may additionally see **Console Entry** depending on roles.

In short: login is the entry point to become an authenticated ARY user and, if authorized, to enter console areas.

## 3) How rider signup / registration should work

### `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
- `Registration.submit` is allowed for **Rider → own registration** only.
- Key rule: **one User can have at most one Registration per Race**.
- After `Registration` is approved, the system **automatically creates `RaceProject`**.
- The rider does **not manually create** their own `RaceProject`.

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
- In the Rider View, the user can:
  - see registration status
  - see CA setup
  - in the participation flow, configure **one or more CAConnection**
- Important IA rule:
  - **Work Submission is not blocked by CA setup**
  - if CA is missing or broken, the system shows **evidence gap / risk prompts**, not auto-withdrawal

### `docs/grs003/ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`
- Defines `Registration` as the fact connecting a **User with rider role** to a **Race**.
- The rider signup flow is:
  - user with `rider` role registers for a race
  - registration can be approved / rejected / withdrawn
  - approved registration drives downstream participation objects

## 4) Is console restricted to specific roles?

### `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
Yes.
- **Race Console**
  - `organizer` → Organizer View
  - `rider` → Rider View
  - `judge` → Judge View
- **Admin Console**
  - only for `admin` role
- **Screen Console**
  - typically used by `organizer` or `admin`
- The doc says console subroutes must be access-controlled by:
  - `User.roles`
  - current Race relationship
  - authorization scope

### `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
- `Admin Console` only manages:
  - account basics
  - profile completion status
  - `User.roles`
- It explicitly says Admin Console does **not** handle:
  - race execution
  - CA connection maintenance
  - data operations
- `Screen`-related actions are also limited to `Organizer` / `Admin` scope.

## Most relevant files to read first
1. `docs/grs003/ary-permission-matrix.md`
2. `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.ia.md`
3. `docs/grs003/ary-mvp.prd.md`
4. `docs/grs003/ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`

## One-line summary
- **Login** is GitHub-based auth + profile completion into an ARY user.
- **Rider signup** is race registration, not account creation; approved registration auto-creates `RaceProject`.
- **Console access** is role-restricted, with Rider/Judge/Organizer views split and Admin Console limited to admin.

247	- 有活跃连接和最近 session 的比赛里，进入大屏后不应立刻看到一片 `zzz`
248	- 真正离线或超时的选手仍应正确显示 stale / idle
249	- 报名中比赛不显示时钟
250	- 比赛中比赛显示并推进时钟
251	- 已结束比赛不显示时钟
252	- Banner 点击暂停后不再自动切换比赛
253	- 手动切到某个比赛后保持锁定，恢复自动轮播后才继续切换
254	
255	## Rider 提交文案
256	- 比赛中 / 封榜中页面明确写“现在可以提交代码”
257	- 比赛前说明写“比赛开始后可提交代码”
258	- 比赛结束后说明写“需要提交最终代码与 Riding Record”
259	- 检查首页公共说明和具体提交表单文案不互相打架
260	
```

```
1	# ARY MVP Permission Matrix
2	
3	版本：v0.3
4	文档类型：Permission Matrix
5	上游入口：`ary-mvp.prd.md`
6	领域基线：`ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`
7	
8	---
9	
10	# 1. 文档目的
11	
12	本文是 ARY MVP 的权限矩阵附件，定义资源动作级访问规则。PRD 只保留角色原则；实际架构设计、接口鉴权、页面入口和测试用例应以本文为权限输入。
13	
14	MVP 使用 GitHub Account 登录；用户补充个人资料后成为 ARY User。用户身份通过 `User.roles` 集合表达，可同时拥有 `rider`、`judge`、`organizer`、`admin` 多重身份；MVP 不建立独立 `RoleAssignment` 实体。
15	
16	---
17	
18	# 2. 角色与范围规则
19	
20	| 角色 | 权限范围 |
21	|---|---|
22	| Public | 未登录或未授权公众，只能访问已公开、已发布资源 |
23	| Rider | 拥有 `rider` role 的用户，只能管理自己的报名、RaceProject、Work、报告和可见骑行摘要 |
24	| Judge | 拥有 `judge` role 的用户，只能访问分配给自己的评审任务和相关作品 / Evidence 摘要 |
25	| Organizer | 拥有 `organizer` role 的用户，只能管理自己负责的 Race 及其报名、提交、评审、榜单、报告和展示 |
26	| Admin | 拥有 `admin` role 的用户，可以维护用户角色，并可进行必要系统管理和异常处理 |
27	
28	范围说明：
29	
30	* `own` 表示仅限当前用户自己的资源。
31	* `assigned` 表示仅限分配给当前评委的资源。
32	* `managed race` 表示仅限当前主办方负责的赛事。
33	* `public` 表示仅限公开且已发布的资源。
34	* `system` 表示系统管理范围，MVP 中主要由 Admin 承担。
35	
36	`managed race` 判定规则：
37	
38	* MVP 不引入 Organization。
39	* Organizer 可管理的 Race 由 Race 上的 organizer 用户集合或创建者关系判定。
40	* 若后续数据模型保存 `organizerUserIds`、`createdByUserId` 或类似字段，接口鉴权必须以这些关系判断 `managed race` 范围。
41	
42	---
43	
44	# 3. 权限矩阵
45	
46	## 3.1 Race
47	
48	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
49	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
50	| view_public | public | public | public | public | public |
51	| view_private | - | own registered race | assigned race | managed race | system |
52	| create | - | - | - | yes | system |
53	| edit | - | - | - | managed race | system |
54	| publish | - | - | - | managed race | system |
55	| archive | - | - | - | managed race | system |
56	
57	## 3.2 Registration
58	
59	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
60	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
61	| submit | - | own | - | - | - |
62	| view | - | own | assigned work context | managed race | system |
63	| approve | - | - | - | managed race | system |
64	| reject | - | - | - | managed race | system |
65	| withdraw | - | own before locked | - | managed race exception | system exception |
66	
67	规则：
68	
69	* 一个 User 对同一 Race 最多一个 Registration。
70	* CA 接入状态不驱动 Registration 进入 `withdrawn`；RaceProject 聚合接入 failed / not_configured 只表达证据缺口或接入异常，并进入评审前风险提示。
71	
72	## 3.3 RaceProject
73	
74	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
75	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
76	| create | - | - | - | managed race assistance | system |
77	| view_status | - | own | assigned work summary | managed race | system |
78	| register_ca_connection | - | own approved registration during race participation | - | managed race assistance | system exception |
79	| manage_ca_connection | - | own connection metadata | - | managed race exception | system exception |
80	| view_session_summary | - | own | assigned work summary | managed race | system |
81	| view_raw_session | - | - | - | managed race internal exception | system |
82	| sync_status | - | own status | - | managed race | system |
83	
84	规则：
85	
86	* Registration approved 后由系统幂等创建 RaceProject；Rider 不手动创建自己的 RaceProject。
87	* 同一 RaceProject 可配置多个 CAConnection；CAConnection 可在参赛过程中新增。
88	* 只有已登记、已握手、归属正确且未禁用的 CAConnection 后续数据可以进入 Projection、Evidence 或 Report 输入。
89	* 单个 CAConnection failed 或 RaceProject 聚合接入 failed 不触发 Registration 自动退赛，只形成连接异常、证据缺口和评审前风险提示。
90	* GitHub Repo 只能作为作品代码入口或 Evidence 外部材料引用，不能替代任何实时 CAConnection。
91	* 原始 CA Session 默认不公开，公开端永不读取原始 CA Session。
92	* Rider、Judge 默认读取 Session Summary 或 Evidence 摘要，不直接读取原始 CA Session。
93	
94	## 3.4 Work
95	
96	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
97	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
98	| view_public | public | public | public | public | public |
99	| view_private | - | own | assigned | managed race | system |
100	| create | - | own registration | - | - | system exception |
101	| submit | - | own registration | - | - | system exception |
102	| lock | - | - | - | managed race | system |
103	| publish | - | - | - | managed race | system |
104	| hide | - | own if draft | - | managed race | system |
105	| review | - | - | assigned | - | - |
106	
107	规则：
108	
109	* Work 是作品资产，不是提交记录本身。
110	* MVP 阶段一个 Registration 最多一个主 Work。
111	
112	## 3.5 Evidence
113	
114	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
115	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
116	| view_public | public | public | public | public | public |
117	| view_private_summary | - | own | assigned work context | managed race | system |
118	| view_raw_source | - | - | - | managed race internal exception | system |
119	| set_visibility | - | own limited | - | managed race | system |
120	| cite_in_report | - | - | - | managed race | system |
121	
122	规则：
123	
124	* Evidence 通过 `sourceRef` 引用来源。
125	* 公开端只展示可公开 Evidence 摘要，不暴露敏感原始 Session。
126	* Rider 默认管理 Evidence 可见性和摘要，不直接读取敏感原始来源。
127	
128	## 3.6 JudgeAssignment
129	
130	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
131	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
132	| view | - | - | assigned | managed race | system |
133	| create | - | - | - | managed race | system |
134	| update | - | - | - | managed race | system |
135	| remove | - | - | - | managed race | system |
136	
137	规则：
138	
139	* JudgeAssignment 应记录 `assignedByUserId`。
140	* 分配人应拥有 `organizer` 或 `admin` role。
141	
142	## 3.7 JudgingRecord
143	
144	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
145	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
146	| view_published_summary | public | own work result | assigned | managed race | system |
147	| view_private | - | own result after release | assigned own record | managed race | system |
148	| create | - | - | assigned | - | - |
149	| submit | - | - | assigned | - | - |
150	| update_before_submit | - | - | assigned own record | - | - |
151	
152	规则：
153	
154	* JudgingRecord 应来源于 JudgeAssignment。
155	* MVP 暂不处理奖项推荐。
156	
157	## 3.8 Award / Leaderboard
158	
159	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
160	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
161	| view_published | public | public | public | public | public |
162	| view_draft | - | - | - | managed race | system |
163	| create_draft | - | - | - | managed race | system |
164	| edit_draft | - | - | - | managed race | system |
165	| publish | - | - | - | managed race | system |
166	| withdraw_publication | - | - | - | managed race | system |
167	
168	规则：
169	
170	* Award 授予 Registration，可选关联获奖 Work。
171	* Leaderboard 是按 Award.rank 排列的读取模型。
172	* Award / Leaderboard draft 在发布前只允许 managed race Organizer 和 Admin 查看，避免提前泄露赛果。
173	
174	## 3.9 Projection
175	
176	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
177	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
178	| view_public | public via Live Hall | public via Live Hall | public via Live Hall | public via Live Hall | public via Live Hall |
179	| view_internal | - | own summary | assigned context | managed race | system |
180	| rebuild | - | - | - | managed race | system |
181	| inspect_status | - | - | - | managed race | system |
182	
183	规则：
184	
185	* Projection 是过程展示数据，可以重建，不作为最终事实源。
186	* Projection 失败不影响核心事实数据。
187	
188	## 3.10 Report
189	
190	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
191	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
192	| view_public_published | public report | public report | public report | public report | public report |
193	| view_private | - | own rider_report | assigned context summary | managed race | system |
194	| generate | - | - | - | managed race | system |
195	| edit | - | - | - | managed race | system |
196	| publish | - | - | - | managed race | system |
197	| regenerate | - | - | - | managed race | system |
198	
199	规则：
200	
201	* `rider_report` 必须关联 `subjectRegistrationId`。
202	* `race_report` / `review_summary` 的 `subjectRegistrationId` 必须为空。
203	* Public 只能查看已发布且公开可见的 `race_report` / `review_summary`；`rider_report` 默认只允许对应 Rider、managed race Organizer 和 Admin 查看，除非后续单独增加公开发布规则。
204	
205	## 3.11 User
206	
207	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
208	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
209	| sign_in_github | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
210	| update_profile | - | own | own | own | own |
211	| view_public_profile | public | public | public | public | public |
212	| view_private_profile | - | own | own | managed race user summary | system |
213	| update_roles | - | - | - | - | system |
214	
215	规则：
216	
217	* Admin Console 只承载基础账号、个人资料状态和 `User.roles` 管理。
218	* MVP 不建立独立 `RoleAssignment` 实体。
219	
220	## 3.12 Announcement
221	
222	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
223	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
224	| view_public | public | public | public | public | public |
225	| view_private | - | - | - | managed race | system |
226	| create | - | - | - | managed race | system |
227	| edit | - | - | - | managed race | system |
228	| publish | - | - | - | managed race | system |
229	| hide | - | - | - | managed race | system |
230	
231	## 3.13 ScreenDisplay
232	
233	| Action | Public | Rider | Judge | Organizer | Admin |
234	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
235	| view_public_display | public | public | public | public | public |
236	| configure | - | - | - | managed race | system |
237	| switch_mode | - | - | - | managed race | system |
238	| fallback_to_stable_projection | - | - | - | managed race | system |
239	| fallback_to_static_notice | - | - | - | managed race | system |
240	
241	规则：
242	
243	* Screen Console 是独立控制台，不混入 Race Console。
244	* 大屏展示失败时，可切换到最近一次稳定 Projection 或静态榜单 / 公告。
245	
246	---
247	
248	# 4. 测试要求
249	
250	权限测试至少覆盖：
251	
252	* Public 不可访问后台、原始 CA Session、未发布 Work、未发布 JudgingRecord 和未发布 Report。
253	* Rider 只能操作自己的 Registration、RaceProject、Work、rider_report 和私有摘要。
254	* Judge 只能访问分配给自己的 Work、Evidence 摘要和 JudgingRecord。
255	* Organizer 只能管理自己负责的 Race 及其相关资源。
256	* Admin 可以维护 `User.roles`，但 Admin Console 不承担赛事执行、CA 接入维护或数据运营职责。
257	* Projection 重建、Report 生成、大屏 fallback 等内部维护动作只能由 Organizer 管理赛事范围或 Admin 系统范围执行。
258	
```
