49	export async function completeCAConnectionHandshake(input: {
50	  authToken: string;
51	  body: unknown;
52	}) {
53	  const parsed = handshakeSchema.parse(input.body);
54	  const connection = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
55	    where: { id: parsed.caConnectionId },
56	  });
57	
58	  if (!connection) {
59	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "connection_not_found" };
60	  }
61	
62	  if (connection.connectorSecret !== input.authToken) {
63	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "unauthorized" };
64	  }
65	
66	  if (
67	    connection.connectorId !== parsed.connectorId ||
68	    connection.caProjectId !== parsed.caProjectId ||
69	    connection.disabledAt
70	  ) {
71	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "scope_mismatch" };
72	  }
73	
74	  const timestamp = parsed.timestamp ? new Date(parsed.timestamp) : new Date();
75	  const nextStatus =
76	    connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE"
77	      ? "ACTIVE"
78	      : getNextConnectionStatusFromSignal({
79	          currentStatus: connection.ingestionStatus,
80	          signal: {
81	            counters: {},
82	            ingestion: null,
83	            timestamp,
84	            type: "session_started",
85	          },
86	        }) === "ACTIVE"
87	      ? "CONNECTED"
88	      : "CONNECTED";
89	
90	  const updated = await prisma.cAConnection.update({
91	    where: { id: connection.id },
92	    data: {
93	      connectorVersion: parsed.connectorVersion ?? connection.connectorVersion,
94	      handshakeCompletedAt: connection.handshakeCompletedAt ?? timestamp,
95	      ingestionStatus: nextStatus,
96	      lastSyncedAt: timestamp,
97	    },
98	  });
99	
100	  return {
101	    accepted: true as const,
102	    connectionId: updated.id,
103	    ingestionStatus: updated.ingestionStatus,
104	  };
105	}

107	export async function fetchCASessionSnapshotForConnection(input: {
108	  caConnectionId: string;
109	  caSessionId: string;
110	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
111	}) {
112	  const fetchImpl = input.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
113	  const connection = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
114	    where: { id: input.caConnectionId },
115	    include: {
116	      raceProject: {
117	        include: {
118	          registration: true,
119	        },
120	      },
121	    },
122	  });
123	
124	  if (!connection) {
125	    throw new Error("CAConnection not found");
126	  }
127	
128	  if (!connection.handshakeCompletedAt || connection.disabledAt) {
129	    throw new Error("CAConnection is not eligible for snapshot fetch");
130	  }
131	
132	  if (!connection.connectorBaseUrl) {
133	    throw new Error("CAConnection has no connectorBaseUrl");
134	  }
135	
136	  const url = `${connection.connectorBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/ary/ca/connections/${connection.id}/sessions/${input.caSessionId}/snapshot`;
137	  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
138	    headers: {
139	      Authorization: `Bearer ${connection.connectorSecret}`,
140	    },
141	  });
142	
143	  if (!response.ok) {
144	    throw new Error(`Snapshot fetch failed with status ${response.status}`);
145	  }
146	
147	  const parsed = snapshotSchema.parse(await response.json());
148	
149	  if (
150	    parsed.ca.caConnectionId !== connection.id ||
151	    parsed.ca.caProjectId !== connection.caProjectId ||
152	    parsed.ca.caSessionId !== input.caSessionId
153	  ) {
154	    throw new Error("Snapshot payload scope mismatch");
155	  }
156	
157	  const fetchedAt = new Date(parsed.fetchedAt);
158	  const existing = await prisma.session.findUnique({
159	    where: {
160	      caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
161	        caConnectionId: connection.id,
162	        caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
163	      },
164	    },
165	  });
166	
167	  if (
168	    !shouldApplyFetchedSnapshot({
169	      fetchedAt,
170	      snapshotFetchedAt: existing?.snapshotFetchedAt ?? null,
171	    })
172	  ) {
173	    return { applied: false as const, reason: "stale_snapshot" };
174	  }
175	
176	  const patch = buildSessionPatchFromSnapshot({
177	    snapshot: {

180	      task: parsed.task,

183	        endedAt: parsed.session.endedAt ? new Date(parsed.session.endedAt) : null,
184	        lastActiveAt: parsed.session.lastActiveAt

186	          : null,

188	        startedAt: new Date(parsed.session.startedAt),
189	        tokenCost: parsed.session.tokenCost,
190	        toolCallCount: parsed.session.toolCallCount,
191	      },
192	    },
193	  });
194	
195	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
196	    await tx.session.upsert({
197	      where: {
198	        caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
199	          caConnectionId: connection.id,
200	          caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
201	        },
202	      },
203	      update: patch,
204	      create: {
205	        ...patch,
206	        caConnectionId: connection.id,
207	        caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
208	      },
209	    });
210	
211	    await tx.cAConnection.update({
212	      where: { id: connection.id },
213	      data: {
214	        ingestionStatus: patch.endedAt ? "ACTIVE" : "ACTIVE",
215	        lastSyncedAt: fetchedAt,
216	      },
217	    });
218

222	      },

225	      },
226	    });

234	      },
235	    });
236

194	export async function generateRaceSnapshot(
195	  raceId: string,
196	): Promise<RaceSnapshot> {
197	  const snapshot = await buildRaceSnapshot(raceId);
198	
199	  ensureSnapshotDir();
200	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
201	  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2), "utf-8");
202	
203	  return snapshot;
204	}

206	export function loadRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): RaceSnapshot | null {
207	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
208	  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null;
209	
210	  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
211	  return JSON.parse(raw) as RaceSnapshot;
212	}

216	  return fs
217	    .readdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)
218	    .filter((fileName) => fileName.endsWith(".json"))
219	    .map((fileName) => fileName.replace(".json", ""));
220	}
221	
222	export function deleteRaceSnapshot(raceId: string): void {
223	  const filePath = path.join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `${raceId}.json`);
224	  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
225	    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
226	  }
227	}
228	
229	function ensureSnapshotDir(): void {
230	  if (!fs.existsSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR)) {
231	    fs.mkdirSync(SNAPSHOT_DIR, { recursive: true });
232	  }

47	  const registrationItems = race.registrations.map((registration) => {

52	      caConnectionCount: connections.length,
53	      raceProjectId: registration.raceProject?.id ?? null,
54	      registrationId: registration.id,
55	      registrationStatus: registration.status,
56	      sessionCount: connections.reduce(

64	  const leaderboardItems = buildCurrentLeaderboardProjectionPayload(
65	    race.registrations.map((registration) => {
66	      const sessions = registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap(
67	        (connection) => connection.sessions,
68	      ) ?? [];
69	      const latestSession = [...sessions].sort(
70	        (left, right) =>
71	          (right.lastActiveAt ?? right.startedAt).getTime() -
72	          (left.lastActiveAt ?? left.startedAt).getTime(),
73	      )[0];
74	
75	      return {
76	        entryId: registration.id,
77	        progressPercent: latestSession?.progressPercent ?? 0,
78	        tokenCost: sessions.reduce((sum, session) => sum + session.tokenCost, 0),
79	        username: registration.user.username,
80	      };
81	    }),
82	  );

84	  const raceProgress = buildRaceProgressProjectionPayload({
85	    activeConnections: race.registrations.reduce(

89	          (connection) => connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE",
90	        ).length ?? 0),
91	      0,
92	    ),
93	    activeRegistrations: race.registrations.filter(

101	            inner +
102	            connection.sessions.filter((session) => session.endedAt === null).length,
103	          0,
104	        ) ?? 0),
105	      0,
106	    ),
107	    raceId,
108	    totalRegistrations: race.registrations.length,

116	      })),

1	import { EvidenceType, Visibility } from "@/generated/prisma/enums";
2	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
3	import { buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord } from "@/lib/evidence-projection-helpers";
4	
5	export async function rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace(raceId: string) {
6	  const registrations = await prisma.registration.findMany({
7	    where: { raceId },
8	    include: {
9	      raceProject: {
10	        include: {
11	          caConnections: {
12	            include: {
13	              sessions: true,
14	            },
15	          },
16	        },
17	      },
18	    },
19	  });
20	
21	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
22	    await tx.evidence.deleteMany({
23	      where: {
24	        registration: {
25	          raceId,
26	        },
27	        type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
28	      },
29	    });
30	
31	    for (const registration of registrations) {
32	      for (const connection of registration.raceProject?.caConnections ?? []) {
33	        for (const session of connection.sessions) {
34	          const evidence = buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord({
35	            caConnectionId: connection.id,
36	            caProjectId: connection.caProjectId,
37	            caSessionId: session.caSessionId,
38	            caType: connection.caType,
39	            messageCount: session.messageCount,
40	            registrationId: registration.id,
41	            startedAt: session.startedAt,
42	            tokenCost: session.tokenCost,
43	            toolCallCount: session.toolCallCount,
44	          });
45	
46	          await tx.evidence.create({
47	            data: {
48	              registrationId: evidence.registrationId,
49	              sourceRefJson: evidence.sourceRefJson,
50	              summary: evidence.summary,
51	              title: evidence.title,
52	              type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
53	              visibility: Visibility.INTERNAL,
54	            },
55	          });
56	        }
57	      }
58	    }
59	  });
60	}

1	import { ProjectionType } from "@/generated/prisma/enums";
2	import {
3	  buildCurrentLeaderboardProjectionPayload,
4	  buildEventStreamProjectionPayload,
5	  buildRaceProgressProjectionPayload,
6	  buildRegistrationStatusProjectionPayload,
7	  buildScreenFeedProjectionPayload,
8	} from "@/lib/evidence-projection-helpers";
9	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
10	
11	export async function rebuildRaceProcessProjections(raceId: string) {
12	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
13	    where: { id: raceId },
14	    include: {
15	      registrations: {
16	        include: {
17	          raceProject: {
18	            include: {
19	              caConnections: {
20	                include: {
21	                  sessions: true,
22	                },
23	              },
24	            },
25	          },
26	          user: true,
27	        },
28	      },
29	      leaderboardEntries: {
30	        include: {
31	          team: true,
32	        },
33	      },
34	      notifications: {
35	        orderBy: {
36	          createdAt: "desc",
37	        },
38	        take: 5,
39	      },
40	    },
41	  });
42	
43	  if (!race) {
44	    throw new Error("Race not found");
45	  }
46	
47	  const registrationItems = race.registrations.map((registration) => {
48	    const connections = registration.raceProject?.caConnections ?? [];
49	    return buildRegistrationStatusProjectionPayload({
50	      aggregateIngestionStatus:
51	        registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus ?? "NOT_CONFIGURED",
52	      caConnectionCount: connections.length,
53	      raceProjectId: registration.raceProject?.id ?? null,
54	      registrationId: registration.id,
55	      registrationStatus: registration.status,
56	      sessionCount: connections.reduce(
57	        (sum, connection) => sum + connection.sessions.length,
58	        0,
59	      ),
60	      username: registration.user.username,
61	    });
62	  });
63	
64	  const leaderboardItems = buildCurrentLeaderboardProjectionPayload(
65	    race.registrations.map((registration) => {
66	      const sessions = registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap(
67	        (connection) => connection.sessions,
68	      ) ?? [];
69	      const latestSession = [...sessions].sort(
70	        (left, right) =>
71	          (right.lastActiveAt ?? right.startedAt).getTime() -
72	          (left.lastActiveAt ?? left.startedAt).getTime(),
73	      )[0];
74	
75	      return {
76	        entryId: registration.id,
77	        progressPercent: latestSession?.progressPercent ?? 0,
78	        tokenCost: sessions.reduce((sum, session) => sum + session.tokenCost, 0),
79	        username: registration.user.username,
80	      };
81	    }),
82	  );
83	
84	  const raceProgress = buildRaceProgressProjectionPayload({
85	    activeConnections: race.registrations.reduce(
86	      (sum, registration) =>
87	        sum +
88	        (registration.raceProject?.caConnections.filter(
89	          (connection) => connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE",
90	        ).length ?? 0),
91	      0,
92	    ),
93	    activeRegistrations: race.registrations.filter(
94	      (registration) => registration.status === "APPROVED",
95	    ).length,
96	    activeSessions: race.registrations.reduce(
97	      (sum, registration) =>
98	        sum +
99	        (registration.raceProject?.caConnections.reduce(
100	          (inner, connection) =>
101	            inner +
102	            connection.sessions.filter((session) => session.endedAt === null).length,
103	          0,
104	        ) ?? 0),
105	      0,
106	    ),
107	    raceId,
108	    totalRegistrations: race.registrations.length,
109	  });
110	
111	  const screenFeed = buildScreenFeedProjectionPayload({
112	    items: [
113	      ...race.notifications.slice(0, 3).map((item) => ({
114	        summary: item.content,
115	        type: "announcement" as const,
116	      })),
117	      ...race.registrations.flatMap((registration) =>
118	        registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap((connection) =>
119	          connection.sessions.slice(0, 1).map((session) => ({
120	            summary:
121	              session.latestActivity ??
122	              `${registration.user.username} session ${session.caSessionId} has ${session.messageCount} messages.`,
123	            type: "session_summary" as const,
124	          })),
125	        ) ?? [],
126	      ),
127	      ...(leaderboardItems.length > 0
128	        ? [
129	            {
130	              summary: "Current process leaderboard is available.",
131	              type: "current_leaderboard_projection" as const,
132	            },
133	          ]
134	        : []),
135	    ].slice(0, 8),
136	    raceId,
137	  });
138	
139	  const eventStream = buildEventStreamProjectionPayload({
140	    items: [
141	      ...race.notifications.slice(0, 5).map((item) => ({
142	        createdAt: item.createdAt.toISOString(),
143	        severity: "info" as const,
144	        summary: item.content,
145	        type: "announcement" as const,
146	      })),
147	      ...race.registrations.flatMap((registration) =>
148	        registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap((connection) =>
149	          connection.sessions
150	            .filter((session) => session.latestActivity || session.messageCount > 0)
151	            .map((session) => ({
152	              createdAt:
153	                (session.lastActiveAt ?? session.startedAt).toISOString(),
154	              registrationId: registration.id,
155	              severity: "info" as const,
156	              summary:
157	                session.latestActivity ??
158	                `${registration.user.username} session ${session.caSessionId} has ${session.messageCount} messages.`,
159	              type: "session_activity" as const,
160	              username: registration.user.username,
161	            })),
162	        ) ?? [],
163	      ),
164	      ...race.registrations
165	        .filter(
166	          (registration) =>
167	            registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus === "FAILED",
168	        )
169	        .map((registration) => ({
170	          createdAt:
171	            registration.raceProject?.updatedAt.toISOString() ??
172	            race.updatedAt.toISOString(),
173	          registrationId: registration.id,
174	          severity: "warning" as const,
175	          summary: `${registration.user.username} reported a CA ingestion failure.`,
176	          type: "risk" as const,
177	          username: registration.user.username,
178	        })),
179	    ].slice(0, 12),
180	    raceId,
181	  });
182	
183	  const projectionPayloads = [
184	    {
185	      payload: raceProgress,
186	      type: ProjectionType.RACE_PROGRESS,
187	    },
188	    {
189	      payload: registrationItems,
190	      type: ProjectionType.REGISTRATION_STATUS,
191	    },
192	    {
193	      payload: race.registrations.map((registration) => ({
194	        registrationId: registration.id,
195	        tokenCost:
196	          registration.raceProject?.caConnections.reduce(
197	            (sum, connection) =>
198	              sum +
199	              connection.sessions.reduce(
200	                (inner, session) => inner + session.tokenCost,
201	                0,
202	              ),
203	            0,
204	          ) ?? 0,
205	      })),
206	      type: ProjectionType.COST,
207	    },
208	    {
209	      payload: race.registrations.map((registration) => ({
210	        aggregateIngestionStatus:
211	          registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus ?? "NOT_CONFIGURED",
212	        registrationId: registration.id,
213	      })),
214	      type: ProjectionType.RISK,
215	    },
216	    {
217	      payload: leaderboardItems,
218	      type: ProjectionType.CURRENT_LEADERBOARD,
219	    },
220	    {
221	      payload: eventStream,
222	      type: ProjectionType.EVENT_STREAM_READ_MODEL,
223	    },
224	    {
225	      payload: screenFeed,
226	      type: ProjectionType.SCREEN_FEED,
227	    },
228	  ] as const;
229	
230	  await prisma.$transaction(
231	    projectionPayloads.map((item) =>
232	      prisma.projection.upsert({
233	        where: {
234	          raceId_type: {
235	            raceId,
236	            type: item.type,
237	          },
238	        },
239	        update: {
240	          asOfAt: new Date(),
241	          payloadJson: JSON.stringify(item.payload),
242	        },
243	        create: {
244	          asOfAt: new Date(),
245	          payloadJson: JSON.stringify(item.payload),
246	          raceId,
247	          type: item.type,
248	        },
249	      }),
250	    ),
251	  );
252	}
253

15	          },

24	        registration: {
25	          raceId,
26	        },
27	        type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
28	      },

34	          const evidence = buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord({
35	            caConnectionId: connection.id,

39	            messageCount: session.messageCount,

42	            tokenCost: session.tokenCost,

46	          await tx.evidence.create({

48	              registrationId: evidence.registrationId,

11	export async function rebuildRaceProcessProjections(raceId: string) {

18	            include: {

20	                include: {

22	                },
23	              },
24	            },
25	          },
26	          user: true,
27	        },
28	      },
29	      leaderboardEntries: {
30	        include: {
31	          team: true,
32	        },
33	      },
34	      notifications: {
35	        orderBy: {
36	          createdAt: "desc",
37	        },
38	        take: 5,
39	      },
40	    },
41	  });
42	
43	  if (!race) {
44	    throw new Error("Race not found");
45	  }
46	
47	  const registrationItems = race.registrations.map((registration) => {
48	    const connections = registration.raceProject?.caConnections ?? [];
49	    return buildRegistrationStatusProjectionPayload({
50	      aggregateIngestionStatus:
51	        registration.raceProject?.aggregateIngestionStatus ?? "NOT_CONFIGURED",
52	      caConnectionCount: connections.length,
53	      raceProjectId: registration.raceProject?.id ?? null,
54	      registrationId: registration.id,
55	      registrationStatus: registration.status,
56	      sessionCount: connections.reduce(
57	        (sum, connection) => sum + connection.sessions.length,
58	        0,
59	      ),
60	      username: registration.user.username,
61	    });
62	  });
63	
64	  const leaderboardItems = buildCurrentLeaderboardProjectionPayload(
65	    race.registrations.map((registration) => {
66	      const sessions = registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap(
67	        (connection) => connection.sessions,
68	      ) ?? [];
69	      const latestSession = [...sessions].sort(
70	        (left, right) =>
71	          (right.lastActiveAt ?? right.startedAt).getTime() -
72	          (left.lastActiveAt ?? left.startedAt).getTime(),
73	      )[0];
74	
75	      return {
76	        entryId: registration.id,
77	        progressPercent: latestSession?.progressPercent ?? 0,
78	        tokenCost: sessions.reduce((sum, session) => sum + session.tokenCost, 0),
79	        username: registration.user.username,
80	      };
81	    }),
82	  );
83	
84	  const raceProgress = buildRaceProgressProjectionPayload({
85	    activeConnections: race.registrations.reduce(
86	      (sum, registration) =>
87	        sum +
88	        (registration.raceProject?.caConnections.filter(
89	          (connection) => connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE",
90	        ).length ?? 0),
91	      0,
92	    ),
93	    activeRegistrations: race.registrations.filter(
94	      (registration) => registration.status === "APPROVED",

97	      (sum, registration) =>
98	        sum +
99	        (registration.raceProject?.caConnections.reduce(
100	          (inner, connection) =>
101	            inner +
102	            connection.sessions.filter((session) => session.endedAt === null).length,
103	          0,
104	        ) ?? 0),
105	      0,
106	    ),
107	    raceId,
108	    totalRegistrations: race.registrations.length,
109	  });
110	
111	  const screenFeed = buildScreenFeedProjectionPayload({
112	    items: [
113	      ...race.notifications.slice(0, 3).map((item) => ({
114	        summary: item.content,
115	        type: "announcement" as const,
116	      })),
117	      ...race.registrations.flatMap((registration) =>
118	        registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap((connection) =>
119	          connection.sessions.slice(0, 1).map((session) => ({
120	            summary:
121	              session.latestActivity ??

123	            type: "session_summary" as const,

133	          ]

138

148	        registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap((connection) =>

154	              registrationId: registration.id,

159	              type: "session_activity" as const,

161	            })),
162	        ) ?? [],

200	                (inner, session) => inner + session.tokenCost,
201	                0,
202	              ),
203	            0,
204	          ) ?? 0,
205	      })),

207	    },
208	    {

210	        aggregateIngestionStatus:

212	        registrationId: registration.id,

1	import { EvidenceType, Visibility } from "@/generated/prisma/enums";
2	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
3	import { buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord } from "@/lib/evidence-projection-helpers";
4	
5	export async function rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace(raceId: string) {
6	  const registrations = await prisma.registration.findMany({
7	    where: { raceId },
8	    include: {
9	      raceProject: {
10	        include: {
11	          caConnections: {
12	            include: {
13	              sessions: true,
14	            },
15	          },
16	        },
17	      },
18	    },
19	  });
20	
21	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
22	    await tx.evidence.deleteMany({
23	      where: {
24	        registration: {
25	          raceId,
26	        },
27	        type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
28	      },
29	    });
30	
31	    for (const registration of registrations) {
32	      for (const connection of registration.raceProject?.caConnections ?? []) {
33	        for (const session of connection.sessions) {
34	          const evidence = buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord({
35	            caConnectionId: connection.id,
36	            caProjectId: connection.caProjectId,
37	            caSessionId: session.caSessionId,
38	            caType: connection.caType,
39	            messageCount: session.messageCount,
40	            registrationId: registration.id,
41	            startedAt: session.startedAt,
42	            tokenCost: session.tokenCost,
43	            toolCallCount: session.toolCallCount,
44	          });
45	
46	          await tx.evidence.create({
47	            data: {
48	              registrationId: evidence.registrationId,
49	              sourceRefJson: evidence.sourceRefJson,
50	              summary: evidence.summary,
51	              title: evidence.title,
52	              type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
53	              visibility: Visibility.INTERNAL,
54	            },
55	          });
56	        }
57	      }
58	    }
59	  });
60	}

28	      },

37	        },
38	        take: 5,

54	      registrationId: registration.id,

66	      const sessions = registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap(
67	        (connection) => connection.sessions,
68	      ) ?? [];
69	      const latestSession = [...sessions].sort(
70	        (left, right) =>
71	          (right.lastActiveAt ?? right.startedAt).getTime() -
72	          (left.lastActiveAt ?? left.startedAt).getTime(),
73	      )[0];
74	
75	      return {
76	        entryId: registration.id,

101	            inner +
102	            connection.sessions.filter((session) => session.endedAt === null).length,
103	          0,
104	        ) ?? 0),

118	        registration.raceProject?.caConnections.flatMap((connection) =>
119	          connection.sessions.slice(0, 1).map((session) => ({

```
1	# ARY GRS 003 增补：防伪与防篡改安全计划 3.0
2	
3	版本：v0.3  
4	文档类型：Security Plan  
5	上游入口：`ary-mvp.prd.md`  
6	领域基线：`ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`  
7	相关契约：`ary-ca-integration-spec.md`、`ary-permission-matrix.md`
8	
9	---
10	
11	# 1. 文档定位
12	
13	本文定义 ARY MVP 在 GRS003 语义下的防伪与防篡改方案，目标不是把安全子系统做成独立产品，而是为以下链路建立可信边界：
14	
15	- 用户身份与角色边界
16	- RaceProject / CAConnection / Session 的实时接入边界
17	- Work 与外部代码材料的完整性边界
18	- Projection、Evidence、Report 的可追溯边界
19	- Organizer / Judge 在评审前看到的风险提示边界
20	- Runner 在材料校验、摘要生成与结构化预处理链路中的完整性边界
21	
22	本文明确保留 Runner，但 Runner 只作为内部辅助处理组件，不再作为领域中心、评审主体或裁决来源。正式评审与结果裁决仍留在受权限控制的 Organizer / Judge 工作流中。
23	
24	---
25	
26	# 2. 背景与目标
27	
28	GRS003 的安全重点不是“把所有异常自动打成 DQ”，而是：
29	
30	1. 防止未登记、未握手、归属错误或被篡改的数据进入有效证据链。
31	2. 防止 Work、代码材料、题目材料、评审辅助输入在传输或存储过程中被静默篡改。
32	3. 让实时 CA 接入、作品材料、Runner 辅助处理结果都具备可追溯性。
33	4. 在正式评审前向 Organizer / Judge 暴露风险、证据缺口和可信度问题。
34	5. 让大屏、Live Hall、Race Console 读取 Projection 或已发布结果，而不是直接读取未经校验的原始输入。
35	
36	安全目标与 GRS003 产品约束保持一致：
37	
38	- 实时 CA 数据是骑行过程证据、Projection 输入和评审参考，不是参赛资格硬门禁。
39	- CA 接入失败、无 CA 数据、证据缺口或高风险不自动取消 Registration 的提交、评审或 Award 资格。
40	- 系统需要产生 Review Flag / Review Readiness，而不是直接用安全检测替代人工评审。
41	
42	---
43	
44	# 3. 保护对象
45	
46	| 对象 | 为什么要保护 |
47	|---|---|
48	| User / GitHub 登录态 | 防止身份伪造、越权访问后台 |
49	| Registration | 防止参赛身份被冒用或错误绑定 |
50	| RaceProject | 防止把错误来源的数据混入某个选手的比赛事实 |
51	| CAConnection | 防止未登记 CA、错误 connector、错误外部项目伪装成有效接入 |
52	| Session / Riding Signal | 防止消息伪造、重放、串线和篡改 |
53	| Work / GitHub Repo / 外部材料 | 防止作品材料被替换、篡改或错误归属 |
54	| Race challenge materials | 防止赛题、数据包、评测输入被未授权修改 |
55	| Evidence | 防止失去来源引用与可信度标记 |
56	| Projection | 防止将异常输入直接传播到公开展示 |
57	| Report | 防止不可信摘要进入评审总结或选手报告 |
58	| Runner 输入输出 | 防止 Runner 拿到被篡改材料，或输出无法追溯 |
59	
60	---
61	
62	# 4. 威胁模型
63	
64	| 威胁 | 描述 | 主要影响 |
65	|---|---|---|
66	| 身份伪造 | 冒充其他 Rider、Organizer、Judge 或 CA connector | 越权、错误归属 |
67	| CA 伪接入 | 未登记或未握手的 CAConnection 推送数据 | 污染比赛事实 |
68	| 消息篡改 | Riding signal 在链路中被修改 | Projection / Evidence 失真 |
69	| 消息重放 | 重复发送旧消息或旧快照 | 制造假活跃度、假进度 |
70	| 归属串线 | 某个外部 CA Project / Session 被错误绑定到其他 Registration | 证据归属错误 |
71	| 作品篡改 | Work、Repo、压缩包、Demo 材料被静默替换 | 评审对象失真 |
72	| 题目篡改 | 赛题或评测输入被未授权修改 | 比赛公平性受损 |
73	| Runner 输入污染 | Runner 拉取到的代码、材料或摘要输入已被篡改 | 评测和摘要失真 |
74	| Runner 输出伪造 | Runner 产出的摘要、校验结果、指标来源不清 | 无法信任报告链路 |
75	| 公开泄露 | 原始 Session、私有 Evidence、未发布结果被公开读取 | 隐私和比赛秩序受损 |
76	
77	---
78	
79	# 5. 安全原则
80	
81	## 5.1 先校验归属，再接收数据
82	
83	任何进入有效链路的实时 CA 数据，都必须先满足：
84	
85	- 对应 Rider 已拥有该 Race 的 approved Registration。
86	- 该 Registration 已幂等生成唯一 RaceProject。
87	- `caConnectionId` 已登记并完成握手。
88	- `caConnectionId` 归属当前 `raceProjectId`。
89	- connector 未被禁用，来源未被吊销。
90	
91	未满足以上条件的数据，不得进入有效 Projection、Evidence 或 Report 输入，只能拒收或写入隔离审计区。
92	
93	## 5.2 Projection 不是事实源
94	
95	大屏、Live Hall、过程榜单和 Race Console 的过程展示优先读取 Projection。Projection 可以重算，也必须允许丢弃异常输入后重建。
96	
97	## 5.3 风险提示优先于自动处罚
98	
99	安全检测的默认输出应是：
100	
101	- review flags
102	- readiness 状态
103	- evidence completeness
104	- integrity 状态
105	- 审计记录
106	
107	只有当主办方另有赛事规则明确授权时，才可在人工作业流中执行取消资格、移除榜单或隐藏作品等动作；本文不把自动 DQ 作为默认系统行为。
108	
109	## 5.4 原始数据最小暴露
110	
111	Public Site、Live Hall、Screen Console 不读取原始 Session。公开端只读取：
112	
113	- Projection
114	- Evidence 摘要
115	- 已公开 Work
116	- 已发布 Award
117	- 已发布且公开可见的 Report
118	
119	## 5.5 Runner 服从同一可信链
120	
121	Runner 不是独立真相源，而是消费 ARY 已校验材料、执行辅助校验、摘要生成或结构化预处理的内部组件。Runner 的输入、输出、版本和校验结果都需要可追溯；Judge / Organizer 才是正式评审意见与结果裁决的主体。
122	
123	---
124	
125	# 6. 可信链设计
126	
127	## 6.1 身份与访问层
128	
129	- 账号入口使用 GitHub 登录。
130	- 后台访问必须经过登录和 `User.roles` 权限校验。
131	- Race Console、Admin Console、Screen Console 的访问边界隔离。
132	- Organizer、Judge、Rider 只读取各自范围内的数据与摘要。
133	
134	这部分主要解决“人是谁、是否有权限看到或操作该资源”的问题。
135	
136	## 6.2 CAConnection 登记与握手层
137	
138	每个参赛 CA 必须先形成 CAConnection，再进入实时接入。
139	
140	登记记录至少需要包含：
141	
142	- `registrationId`
143	- `raceProjectId`
144	- `caConnectionId`
145	- `caType`
146	- `connectorId`
147	- `connectorVersion`
148	- `caProjectId`
149	- `registeredAt`
150	- `ingestionStatus`
151	- `credentialFingerprint` 或等价来源标识
152	
153	握手完成后，ARY 才接受该 CAConnection 的实时消息或快照抓取请求。
154	
155	## 6.3 实时消息接入层
156	
157	对于 push 到 ARY 的 RidingSignalMessage 或等价消息：
158	
159	- 校验 `caConnectionId` 是否已登记且归属正确。
160	- 校验消息 schemaVersion、messageId、idempotencyKey。
161	- 对签名或来源令牌进行校验。
162	- 对时间戳窗口进行合理性检查。
163	- 对同一 `caConnectionId + caSessionId + sequence` 做幂等去重。
164	- 对异常来源、重复消息、乱序严重消息做隔离审计。
165	
166	说明：
167	
168	- “时间戳超时”默认是接入风险，不直接等价为作弊。
169	- 反馈类说明消息、网络抖动或 connector 重试需要与恶意重放区别处理。
170	
171	## 6.4 Session 快照抓取层
172	
173	ARY 需要完整 Session 时，从已登记 connector 提供的 HTTP fetch 接口抓取。
174	
175	要求：
176	
177	- fetch 目标必须绑定到已登记 CAConnection。
178	- 响应应带来源标识、抓取时间、外部 session 标识和摘要校验信息。
179	- 抓取失败只形成接入异常或证据缺口，不自动改变 Registration 资格状态。
180	
181	## 6.5 Work / 代码材料完整性层
182	
183	Work、GitHub Repo、压缩包、Demo 附件等材料进入系统时，需要建立完整性元数据：
184	
185	- sourceRef
186	- 内容哈希
187	- 上传或抓取时间
188	- 提交人 / 触发人
189	- 所属 Registration / Work
190	- 可见性
191	
192	这确保后续评审、Evidence 引用和 Runner 拉取时使用的是同一份可追溯材料。
193	
194	## 6.6 题目与评测输入完整性层
195	
196	主办方维护的 challenge materials、数据包、评测配置和输入样例，应记录：
197	
198	- 版本号
199	- 内容哈希
200	- 修改人
201	- 修改时间
202	- 修改原因
203	
204	任何对题目或评测输入的更新，都必须留下审计记录，避免赛中无痕改题或无痕替换评测输入。
205	
206	## 6.7 Runner 辅助处理层
207	
208	Runner 可保留并承担以下职责：
209	
210	- 拉取已锁定或已提交的 Work / 代码材料
211	- 校验 ARY 提供的内容哈希
212	- 执行静态检查、摘要提取、结构化分析或其他评审辅助处理
213	- 输出可回写到 Evidence / Projection / Report 的辅助处理结果
214	
215	Runner 必须遵守以下边界：
216	
217	- 不直接接收未登记 CA 的原始消息作为真相源。
218	- 不直接充当 Judge，也不直接决定 Registration 是否取消资格、是否得奖或最终评分。
219	- 不绕过 ARY 的权限和归属规则。
220	- 输出结果必须包含 `runnerVersion`、输入材料引用、输入哈希、处理时间和处理状态。
221	- Runner 输出默认只作为 Organizer / Judge 的辅助输入，而不是正式裁决本身。
222	
223	---
224	
225	# 7. 检测与处置模型
226	
227	## 7.1 事件分级
228	
229	安全相关事件建议分为四类：
230	
231	| 级别 | 含义 | 默认系统行为 |
232	|---|---|---|
233	| reject | 本次输入不接受 | 拒收，不进入有效链路，写审计 |
234	| risk | 可疑或异常，但不确定是作弊 | 生成 Review Flag / 风险提示 |
235	| integrity_gap | 证据缺口或可信度不足 | 标记 Evidence / Projection / Report 可信度 |
236	| confirmed_violation | 经规则或人工确认的违规 | 记录违规结果，交由 Organizer 流程处理 |
237	
238	## 7.2 典型检测规则
239	
240	### A. 必须拒收的情况
241	
242	- `caConnectionId` 未登记
243	- `caConnectionId` 归属错误 RaceProject
244	- 握手未完成却发送有效比赛消息
245	- 签名或来源令牌验证失败
246	- 幂等键与消息体关键字段冲突
247	
248	默认处置：
249	
250	- 拒收本次输入
```

```
1	# ARY GRS 003 增补：防伪与防篡改安全计划 3.0
2	
3	版本：v0.3  
4	文档类型：Security Plan  
5	上游入口：`ary-mvp.prd.md`  
6	领域基线：`ary-domain-analysis.v0.3.md`  
7	相关契约：`ary-ca-integration-spec.md`、`ary-permission-matrix.md`
8	
9	---
10	
11	# 1. 文档定位
12	
13	本文定义 ARY MVP 在 GRS003 语义下的防伪与防篡改方案，目标不是把安全子系统做成独立产品，而是为以下链路建立可信边界：
14	
15	- 用户身份与角色边界
16	- RaceProject / CAConnection / Session 的实时接入边界
17	- Work 与外部代码材料的完整性边界
18	- Projection、Evidence、Report 的可追溯边界
19	- Organizer / Judge 在评审前看到的风险提示边界
20	- Runner 在材料校验、摘要生成与结构化预处理链路中的完整性边界
21	
22	本文明确保留 Runner，但 Runner 只作为内部辅助处理组件，不再作为领域中心、评审主体或裁决来源。正式评审与结果裁决仍留在受权限控制的 Organizer / Judge 工作流中。
23	
24	---
25	
26	# 2. 背景与目标
27	
28	GRS003 的安全重点不是“把所有异常自动打成 DQ”，而是：
29	
30	1. 防止未登记、未握手、归属错误或被篡改的数据进入有效证据链。
31	2. 防止 Work、代码材料、题目材料、评审辅助输入在传输或存储过程中被静默篡改。
32	3. 让实时 CA 接入、作品材料、Runner 辅助处理结果都具备可追溯性。
33	4. 在正式评审前向 Organizer / Judge 暴露风险、证据缺口和可信度问题。
34	5. 让大屏、Live Hall、Race Console 读取 Projection 或已发布结果，而不是直接读取未经校验的原始输入。
35	
36	安全目标与 GRS003 产品约束保持一致：
37	
38	- 实时 CA 数据是骑行过程证据、Projection 输入和评审参考，不是参赛资格硬门禁。
39	- CA 接入失败、无 CA 数据、证据缺口或高风险不自动取消 Registration 的提交、评审或 Award 资格。
40	- 系统需要产生 Review Flag / Review Readiness，而不是直接用安全检测替代人工评审。
41	
42	---
43	
44	# 3. 保护对象
45	
46	| 对象 | 为什么要保护 |
47	|---|---|
48	| User / GitHub 登录态 | 防止身份伪造、越权访问后台 |
49	| Registration | 防止参赛身份被冒用或错误绑定 |
50	| RaceProject | 防止把错误来源的数据混入某个选手的比赛事实 |
51	| CAConnection | 防止未登记 CA、错误 connector、错误外部项目伪装成有效接入 |
52	| Session / Riding Signal | 防止消息伪造、重放、串线和篡改 |
53	| Work / GitHub Repo / 外部材料 | 防止作品材料被替换、篡改或错误归属 |
54	| Race challenge materials | 防止赛题、数据包、评测输入被未授权修改 |
55	| Evidence | 防止失去来源引用与可信度标记 |
56	| Projection | 防止将异常输入直接传播到公开展示 |
57	| Report | 防止不可信摘要进入评审总结或选手报告 |
58	| Runner 输入输出 | 防止 Runner 拿到被篡改材料，或输出无法追溯 |
59	
60	---
61	
62	# 4. 威胁模型
63	
64	| 威胁 | 描述 | 主要影响 |
65	|---|---|---|
66	| 身份伪造 | 冒充其他 Rider、Organizer、Judge 或 CA connector | 越权、错误归属 |
67	| CA 伪接入 | 未登记或未握手的 CAConnection 推送数据 | 污染比赛事实 |
68	| 消息篡改 | Riding signal 在链路中被修改 | Projection / Evidence 失真 |
69	| 消息重放 | 重复发送旧消息或旧快照 | 制造假活跃度、假进度 |
70	| 归属串线 | 某个外部 CA Project / Session 被错误绑定到其他 Registration | 证据归属错误 |
71	| 作品篡改 | Work、Repo、压缩包、Demo 材料被静默替换 | 评审对象失真 |
72	| 题目篡改 | 赛题或评测输入被未授权修改 | 比赛公平性受损 |
73	| Runner 输入污染 | Runner 拉取到的代码、材料或摘要输入已被篡改 | 评测和摘要失真 |
74	| Runner 输出伪造 | Runner 产出的摘要、校验结果、指标来源不清 | 无法信任报告链路 |
75	| 公开泄露 | 原始 Session、私有 Evidence、未发布结果被公开读取 | 隐私和比赛秩序受损 |
76	
77	---
78	
79	# 5. 安全原则
80	
81	## 5.1 先校验归属，再接收数据
82	
83	任何进入有效链路的实时 CA 数据，都必须先满足：
84	
85	- 对应 Rider 已拥有该 Race 的 approved Registration。
86	- 该 Registration 已幂等生成唯一 RaceProject。
87	- `caConnectionId` 已登记并完成握手。
88	- `caConnectionId` 归属当前 `raceProjectId`。
89	- connector 未被禁用，来源未被吊销。
90	
91	未满足以上条件的数据，不得进入有效 Projection、Evidence 或 Report 输入，只能拒收或写入隔离审计区。
92	
93	## 5.2 Projection 不是事实源
94	
95	大屏、Live Hall、过程榜单和 Race Console 的过程展示优先读取 Projection。Projection 可以重算，也必须允许丢弃异常输入后重建。
96	
97	## 5.3 风险提示优先于自动处罚
98	
99	安全检测的默认输出应是：
100	
101	- review flags
102	- readiness 状态
103	- evidence completeness
104	- integrity 状态
105	- 审计记录
106	
107	只有当主办方另有赛事规则明确授权时，才可在人工作业流中执行取消资格、移除榜单或隐藏作品等动作；本文不把自动 DQ 作为默认系统行为。
108	
109	## 5.4 原始数据最小暴露
110	
111	Public Site、Live Hall、Screen Console 不读取原始 Session。公开端只读取：
112	
113	- Projection
114	- Evidence 摘要
115	- 已公开 Work
116	- 已发布 Award
117	- 已发布且公开可见的 Report
118	
119	## 5.5 Runner 服从同一可信链
120	
121	Runner 不是独立真相源，而是消费 ARY 已校验材料、执行辅助校验、摘要生成或结构化预处理的内部组件。Runner 的输入、输出、版本和校验结果都需要可追溯；Judge / Organizer 才是正式评审意见与结果裁决的主体。
122	
123	---
124	
125	# 6. 可信链设计
126	
127	## 6.1 身份与访问层
128	
129	- 账号入口使用 GitHub 登录。
130	- 后台访问必须经过登录和 `User.roles` 权限校验。
131	- Race Console、Admin Console、Screen Console 的访问边界隔离。
132	- Organizer、Judge、Rider 只读取各自范围内的数据与摘要。
133	
134	这部分主要解决“人是谁、是否有权限看到或操作该资源”的问题。
135	
136	## 6.2 CAConnection 登记与握手层
137	
138	每个参赛 CA 必须先形成 CAConnection，再进入实时接入。
139	
140	登记记录至少需要包含：
141	
142	- `registrationId`
143	- `raceProjectId`
144	- `caConnectionId`
145	- `caType`
146	- `connectorId`
147	- `connectorVersion`
148	- `caProjectId`
149	- `registeredAt`
150	- `ingestionStatus`
151	- `credentialFingerprint` 或等价来源标识
152	
153	握手完成后，ARY 才接受该 CAConnection 的实时消息或快照抓取请求。
154	
155	## 6.3 实时消息接入层
156	
157	对于 push 到 ARY 的 RidingSignalMessage 或等价消息：
158	
159	- 校验 `caConnectionId` 是否已登记且归属正确。
160	- 校验消息 schemaVersion、messageId、idempotencyKey。
161	- 对签名或来源令牌进行校验。
162	- 对时间戳窗口进行合理性检查。
163	- 对同一 `caConnectionId + caSessionId + sequence` 做幂等去重。
164	- 对异常来源、重复消息、乱序严重消息做隔离审计。
165	
166	说明：
167	
168	- “时间戳超时”默认是接入风险，不直接等价为作弊。
169	- 反馈类说明消息、网络抖动或 connector 重试需要与恶意重放区别处理。
170	
171	## 6.4 Session 快照抓取层
172	
173	ARY 需要完整 Session 时，从已登记 connector 提供的 HTTP fetch 接口抓取。
174	
175	要求：
176	
177	- fetch 目标必须绑定到已登记 CAConnection。
178	- 响应应带来源标识、抓取时间、外部 session 标识和摘要校验信息。
179	- 抓取失败只形成接入异常或证据缺口，不自动改变 Registration 资格状态。
180	
181	## 6.5 Work / 代码材料完整性层
182	
183	Work、GitHub Repo、压缩包、Demo 附件等材料进入系统时，需要建立完整性元数据：
184	
185	- sourceRef
186	- 内容哈希
187	- 上传或抓取时间
188	- 提交人 / 触发人
189	- 所属 Registration / Work
190	- 可见性
191	
192	这确保后续评审、Evidence 引用和 Runner 拉取时使用的是同一份可追溯材料。
193	
194	## 6.6 题目与评测输入完整性层
195	
196	主办方维护的 challenge materials、数据包、评测配置和输入样例，应记录：
197	
198	- 版本号
199	- 内容哈希
200	- 修改人
201	- 修改时间
202	- 修改原因
203	
204	任何对题目或评测输入的更新，都必须留下审计记录，避免赛中无痕改题或无痕替换评测输入。
205	
206	## 6.7 Runner 辅助处理层
207	
208	Runner 可保留并承担以下职责：
209	
210	- 拉取已锁定或已提交的 Work / 代码材料
211	- 校验 ARY 提供的内容哈希
212	- 执行静态检查、摘要提取、结构化分析或其他评审辅助处理
213	- 输出可回写到 Evidence / Projection / Report 的辅助处理结果
214	
215	Runner 必须遵守以下边界：
216	
217	- 不直接接收未登记 CA 的原始消息作为真相源。
218	- 不直接充当 Judge，也不直接决定 Registration 是否取消资格、是否得奖或最终评分。
219	- 不绕过 ARY 的权限和归属规则。
220	- 输出结果必须包含 `runnerVersion`、输入材料引用、输入哈希、处理时间和处理状态。
221	- Runner 输出默认只作为 Organizer / Judge 的辅助输入，而不是正式裁决本身。
222	
223	---
224	
225	# 7. 检测与处置模型
226	
227	## 7.1 事件分级
228	
229	安全相关事件建议分为四类：
230	
231	| 级别 | 含义 | 默认系统行为 |
232	|---|---|---|
233	| reject | 本次输入不接受 | 拒收，不进入有效链路，写审计 |
234	| risk | 可疑或异常，但不确定是作弊 | 生成 Review Flag / 风险提示 |
235	| integrity_gap | 证据缺口或可信度不足 | 标记 Evidence / Projection / Report 可信度 |
236	| confirmed_violation | 经规则或人工确认的违规 | 记录违规结果，交由 Organizer 流程处理 |
237	
238	## 7.2 典型检测规则
239	
240	### A. 必须拒收的情况
241	
242	- `caConnectionId` 未登记
243	- `caConnectionId` 归属错误 RaceProject
244	- 握手未完成却发送有效比赛消息
245	- 签名或来源令牌验证失败
246	- 幂等键与消息体关键字段冲突
247	
248	默认处置：
249	
250	- 拒收本次输入
251	- 写入审计日志
252	- 如持续出现，升级为 risk
253	
254	### B. 形成风险提示的情况
255	
256	- 同一 CAConnection 高频时间戳异常
257	- 同一外部 session 在短时间内跨多个 Registration 出现
258	- Session 活跃但长期无可解释进展
259	- Work 材料与历史引用差异异常
260	- Runner 多次拉取哈希不一致
261	- Runner 辅助摘要与人工评审观察长期明显冲突
262	
263	默认处置：
264	
265	- 生成 Review Flag
266	- 在 Organizer / Judge 视图提示
267	- 允许人工查看证据摘要与处理历史
268	
269	### C. 形成证据缺口的情况
270	
271	- 没有任何 CAConnection
272	- CAConnection 已登记但始终无有效 Session
273	- Session 摘要抓取失败
274	- Work 缺少必要材料
275	- Runner 处理失败，未能产出可用摘要或验证结果
276	
277	默认处置：
278	
279	- 标记 `reviewReadiness` 降级
280	- 标记 `evidenceCompleteness` 不完整
281	- 允许继续提交和评审，但明确提醒可信度边界
282	
283	### D. 可能进入确认违规流程的情况
284	
285	- 经核实存在身份冒用
286	- 经核实存在故意篡改提交内容
287	- 经核实存在恶意串线接入他人 RaceProject
288	- 经核实存在伪造来源材料或伪造报告输入
289	
290	默认处置：
291	
292	- 记录 confirmed violation
293	- 由 Organizer / Admin 按赛事规则决定是否隐藏展示、撤销结果、取消资格或补充公示
294	
295	---
296	
297	# 8. 与 Projection、Live Hall、Jumbotron 的关系
298	
299	## 8.1 公开展示使用什么数据
300	
301	Live Hall、Jumbotron、Billboard 读取的是 Projection，不直接读取原始安全事件流。
302	
303	Projection 中可以包含有限安全态字段，例如：
304	
305	- `integrityStatus`: ok / warning / blocked
306	- `evidenceCompleteness`: complete / partial / missing
307	- `reviewFlagsCount`
308	- `connectionHealth`: ok / partial_failed / all_failed
309	
310	## 8.2 默认展示语义
311	
312	大屏和实况页默认展示“风险 / 异常 / 接入状态”，而不是直接展示“DQ”。
313	
314	例如：
315	
316	- “接入异常”
317	- “证据缺口”
318	- “待人工确认”
319	- “高风险，请评审关注”
320	
321	只有在 Organizer 明确发布处罚结论后，Projection 才可以同步已发布的处罚状态。
322	
323	## 8.3 为什么不默认自动 DQ
324	
325	原因：
326	
327	- GRS003 明确要求 CA 接入失败和无 CA 数据不自动取消资格。
328	- Projection 是展示数据，不是最终裁决源。
329	- 安全检测会产生误报，必须保留人工复核空间。
330	
331	---
332	
333	# 9. 数据模型建议
334	
335	以下是面向 GRS003 的最小安全数据对象建议，不要求与数据库表名完全一致。
336	
337	## 9.1 CAConnectionTrust
338	
339	| 字段 | 说明 |
340	|---|---|
341	| caConnectionId | 对应 CAConnection |
342	| credentialFingerprint | 凭证或公钥指纹 |
343	| credentialType | 签名、公钥、token、connector secret 等类型 |
344	| registeredAt | 登记时间 |
345	| verifiedAt | 首次通过握手校验时间 |
346	| revokedAt | 吊销时间，可空 |
347	| trustStatus | pending / verified / revoked / blocked |
348	
349	## 9.2 IngestionAuditEvent
350	
351	| 字段 | 说明 |
352	|---|---|
353	| id | 审计事件 ID |
354	| raceId | 赛事 |
355	| registrationId | 报名记录 |
356	| raceProjectId | 骑行工作区 |
357	| caConnectionId | CA 接入 |
358	| externalSessionId | 外部 session 标识，可空 |
359	| eventType | handshake_failed / signature_failed / replay_rejected / fetch_failed 等 |
360	| severity | reject / risk / integrity_gap / confirmed_violation |
361	| summary | 简述 |
362	| evidenceRef | 对应证据引用或摘要 |
363	| createdAt | 发生时间 |
364	
365	## 9.3 MaterialIntegrityRecord
366	
367	| 字段 | 说明 |
368	|---|---|
369	| id | 记录 ID |
370	| ownerType | challenge_material / work_asset / repo_snapshot / runner_input |
371	| ownerId | 对应对象 ID |
372	| hashAlgorithm | 哈希算法 |
373	| contentHash | 内容哈希 |
374	| sourceRef | 来源引用 |
375	| capturedAt | 采集时间 |
376	| capturedBy | 触发人或系统 |
377	
378	## 9.4 ReviewFlag
379	
380	| 字段 | 说明 |
381	|---|---|
382	| id | 风险标记 ID |
383	| subjectType | registration / race_project / work / report |
384	| subjectId | 对应对象 |
385	| flagType | no_ca_data / integrity_mismatch / suspicious_replay / missing_material 等 |
386	| severity | info / warning / high |
387	| status | open / acknowledged / resolved |
388	| createdAt | 创建时间 |
389	| resolvedAt | 关闭时间，可空 |
390	
391	## 9.5 RunnerExecutionRecord
392	
393	| 字段 | 说明 |
394	|---|---|
395	| id | 执行记录 ID |
396	| runnerVersion | Runner 版本 |
397	| subjectType | work / report / projection_rebuild |
398	| subjectId | 处理对象 |
399	| inputRefs | 输入材料引用列表 |
400	| inputHashes | 输入材料哈希列表 |
401	| outputRef | 输出引用 |
402	| outputHash | 输出摘要哈希 |
403	| status | queued / running / succeeded / failed / rejected |
404	| startedAt | 开始时间 |
405	| finishedAt | 结束时间 |
406	
407	---
408	
409	# 10. 接口与流程要求
410	
411	## 10.1 CAConnection 登记
412	
413	登记接口至少应写入：
414	
415	- Registration / RaceProject 归属
416	- connector 与 CA 类型信息
417	- 外部 CA Project 标识
418	- 凭证指纹或来源标识
419	- 当前状态
420	
421	## 10.2 握手与实时消息接收
422	
423	接收消息前必须完成：
424	
425	1. 连接归属校验
426	2. 凭证校验
427	3. 幂等校验
428	4. 基本时间有效性检查
429	5. 审计记录
430	
431	## 10.3 Work / 材料提交
432	
433	提交或抓取作品材料时必须：
434	
435	1. 固定 owner（Registration / Work）
436	2. 记录 sourceRef
437	3. 计算内容哈希
438	4. 记录可见性
439	5. 允许后续 Runner 和 Evidence 引用同一哈希记录
440	
441	## 10.4 Runner 拉取与回写
442	
443	Runner 处理前：
444	
445	1. 拉取已锁定输入
446	2. 校验输入哈希
447	3. 记录本次执行上下文
448	
449	Runner 回写后：
450	
451	1. 回写结构化结果、摘要或其他评审辅助结果
452	2. 记录输出哈希
453	3. 记录版本与状态
454	4. 如失败，标记为 integrity gap 或 processing failure，而不是直接改写比赛资格
455	5. 回写结果默认进入 Organizer / Judge 可见的辅助信息层，不直接替代正式评审意见或最终裁决
456	
457	---
458	
459	# 11. 非功能要求
460	
461	## 11.1 传输安全
462	
463	- 所有外部通信使用 TLS。
464	- connector 与 ARY、Runner 与 ARY 的内部通信也应使用受控安全链路。
465	
466	## 11.2 可观测性
467	
468	至少可追踪：
469	
470	- CAConnection 握手状态
471	- 消息拒收数量与原因
472	- Session fetch 成功率
473	- 完整性校验失败次数
474	- Runner 输入校验失败次数
475	- Review Flag 产生、确认、关闭流程
476	
477	## 11.3 可恢复性
478	
479	- Projection 可重建。
480	- 安全审计事件保留独立记录，不依赖 Projection 存活。
481	- Runner 执行失败后允许重跑。
482	- 单个 RaceProject 的接入异常不应导致整个赛事公开展示不可用。
483	
484	## 11.4 隐私与最小披露
485	
486	- 原始 Session 默认不公开。
487	- 审计事件默认只对 Organizer / Admin 可见。
488	- Judge 默认只看到评审所需的摘要与风险提示。
489	- Public 不可见未发布处罚结论、原始证据和私有审计细节。
490	
491	---
492	
493	# 12. 实施优先级
494	
495	## P0
496	
497	- GitHub 登录与后台角色校验收口
498	- CAConnection 登记、握手、归属校验
499	- 实时消息幂等与拒收审计
500	- Work / 材料哈希记录
501	- Runner 输入哈希校验
502	- Review Flag 基础模型
503	- Organizer / Judge 对 Runner 辅助结果的查看与引用边界
504	
505	## P1
506	
507	- Session fetch 校验与失败归因
508	- Projection 可信度字段
509	- Race Console 中的风险提示与 readiness 展示
510	- Screen Console / Live Hall 的有限风险态透出
511	- 题目材料审计与版本追踪
512	
513	## P2
514	
515	- 凭证轮换与吊销
516	- 更细的 connector 风险画像
517	- Runner 输出签名或更强输出校验
518	- Organizer 处罚发布工作流与公开公示联动
519	
520	---
521	
522	# 13. 验收标准
523	
524	满足以下条件时，可认为本计划达到 MVP 可用基线：
525	
526	- 未登记、未握手、归属错误的 CAConnection 数据无法进入有效 Projection、Evidence 或 Report 输入。
527	- 实时消息支持幂等去重，并保留拒收审计。
528	- Work / 外部代码材料 / Runner 输入具备可追溯哈希记录。
529	- Runner 在处理前校验输入完整性，处理后记录版本、状态与输出引用。
530	- Runner 输出只作为 Organizer / Judge 的辅助输入，不直接替代正式评审意见或最终裁决。
531	- 系统能够生成 review flags、integrity status、evidence completeness 等评审前风险提示。
532	- CA 接入失败、无 CA 数据、Runner 失败不会自动取消 Registration 的提交、评审或 Award 资格。
533	- Live Hall 与 Jumbotron 只读取 Projection 或已发布结果，不直接读取未经校验的原始输入。
534	- Organizer / Judge 可以看到与评审相关的风险提示，但 Public 无法读取私有审计细节。
535	
536	---
537	
538	# 14. 一句话总结
539	
540	在 GRS003 里，防伪与防篡改的目标不是把 Runner 或安全规则做成“自动裁判”，而是让 Registration、RaceProject、CAConnection、Work、Evidence、Projection、Report 这条链路中的每一步都可验证、可追溯、可提示风险，并把最终裁决留在受权限控制的 Organizer / Judge 工作流中。
541	
```

14	const ridingSignalSchema = z.object({
15	  ca: z.object({
16	    caConnectionId: z.string().min(1),
17	    caProjectId: z.string().min(1),
18	    caSessionId: z.string().min(1),
19	    caType: z.enum(["CLAUDE_CODE", "CODEX", "OTHER"]),
20	    connectorId: z.string().min(1),
21	    connectorVersion: z.string().optional(),

23	  counters: z
24	    .object({
25	      allRidingMessageLength: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
26	      messageCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
27	      sessionCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
28	      tokens: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
29	      toolCallCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
30	    })
31	    .default({}),
32	  idempotencyKey: z.string().min(1),
33	  ingestion: z

36	      status: z.nativeEnum(IngestionStatus),
37	      statusReason: z.string().default(""),

39	    .nullable()
40	    .optional(),

42	    .object({
43	      currentGoal: z.string().optional(),
44	      latestActivity: z.string().optional(),
45	      riskLevel: z.string().optional(),
46	      riskReason: z.string().optional(),
47	    })
48	    .optional(),
49	  messageId: z.string().min(1),
50	  race: z.object({
51	    raceId: z.string().min(1),
52	    taskId: z.string().optional(),
53	  }),
54	  rider: z.object({
55	    raceProjectId: z.string().min(1),
56	    registrationId: z.string().min(1),
57	  }),
58	  signal: z.object({
59	    kind: z.enum(["event", "note"]),
60	    phase: z.string().optional(),
61	    progressPercent: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(),
62	    taskStatus: z.string().optional(),
63	    type: z.enum([
64	      "risk_detected",
65	      "session_completed",
66	      "session_started",
67	      "task_progress",
68	    ]),
69	  }),

71	});

73	export async function ingestRidingSignalMessage(input: {
74	  authToken: string;
75	  body: unknown;
76	}) {
77	  const parsed = ridingSignalSchema.parse(input.body);
78	  const observedAt = new Date(parsed.timestamp);
79	
80	  const event = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
81	    where: {
82	      id: parsed.ca.caConnectionId,
83	    },
84	    include: {
85	      raceProject: {
86	        include: {
87	          registration: true,
88	        },
89	      },
90	    },
91	  });
92	
93	  if (!event) {
94	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "connection_not_found" };
95	  }
96	
97	  if (event.connectorSecret !== input.authToken) {
98	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "unauthorized" };
99	  }
100	
101	  if (event.disabledAt || !event.handshakeCompletedAt) {
102	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "connection_not_ready" };
103	  }
104	
105	  if (
106	    event.raceProject.id !== parsed.rider.raceProjectId ||
107	    event.raceProject.registrationId !== parsed.rider.registrationId ||
108	    event.raceProject.registration.raceId !== parsed.race.raceId ||
109	    event.caProjectId !== parsed.ca.caProjectId ||
110	    event.connectorId !== parsed.ca.connectorId
111	  ) {
112	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "scope_mismatch" };
113	  }
114	
115	  const existingEvent = await prisma.cAIngestionEvent.findUnique({
116	    where: {
117	      idempotencyKey: parsed.idempotencyKey,
118	    },
119	  });
120	
121	  if (existingEvent) {
122	    return { accepted: true as const, deduped: true as const };
123	  }
124	
125	  const signalForHelpers: RidingSignalInput = {
126	    counters: parsed.counters,
127	    currentGoal: parsed.summary?.currentGoal ?? null,
128	    ingestion: parsed.ingestion
129	      ? {
130	          status: parsed.ingestion.status,
131	          statusReason: parsed.ingestion.statusReason,
132	        }
133	      : null,
134	    latestActivity: parsed.summary?.latestActivity ?? null,
135	    progressPercent: parsed.signal.progressPercent ?? null,
136	    riskLevel: parsed.summary?.riskLevel ?? null,
137	    riskReason: parsed.summary?.riskReason ?? null,
138	    taskStatus: parsed.signal.taskStatus ?? null,
139	    timestamp: observedAt,
140	    type: parsed.signal.type,
141	  };
142	
143	  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
144	    await tx.cAIngestionEvent.create({
145	      data: {
146	        caConnectionId: event.id,
147	        idempotencyKey: parsed.idempotencyKey,
148	        messageId: parsed.messageId,
149	        observedAt,
150	        payloadJson: JSON.stringify(parsed),
151	        signalKind: parsed.signal.kind,
152	        signalType: parsed.signal.type,
153	      },
154	    });
155	
156	    const existingSession = await tx.session.findUnique({
157	      where: {
158	        caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
159	          caConnectionId: event.id,
160	          caSessionId: parsed.ca.caSessionId,
161	        },
162	      },
163	    });
164	
165	    const sessionPatch = buildSessionPatchFromSignal({
166	      existingSession: existingSession
167	        ? {
168	            caSessionId: existingSession.caSessionId,
169	            currentGoal: existingSession.currentGoal,
170	            endedAt: existingSession.endedAt,
171	            lastActiveAt: existingSession.lastActiveAt,
172	            latestActivity: existingSession.latestActivity,
173	            messageCount: existingSession.messageCount,
174	            progressPercent: existingSession.progressPercent,
175	            riskLevel: existingSession.riskLevel,
176	            riskReason: existingSession.riskReason,
177	            startedAt: existingSession.startedAt,
178	            taskStatus: existingSession.taskStatus,
179	            tokenCost: existingSession.tokenCost,
180	            toolCallCount: existingSession.toolCallCount,
181	          }
182	        : null,
183	      signal: signalForHelpers,
184	    });
185	
186	    await tx.session.upsert({
187	      where: {
188	        caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
189	          caConnectionId: event.id,
190	          caSessionId: parsed.ca.caSessionId,
191	        },
192	      },
193	      update: {
194	        endedAt: sessionPatch.endedAt,
195	        currentGoal: sessionPatch.currentGoal,
196	        lastActiveAt: sessionPatch.lastActiveAt,
197	        latestActivity: sessionPatch.latestActivity,
198	        messageCount: sessionPatch.messageCount,
199	        progressPercent: sessionPatch.progressPercent,
200	        riskLevel: sessionPatch.riskLevel,
201	        riskReason: sessionPatch.riskReason,
202	        tokenCost: sessionPatch.tokenCost,
203	        taskStatus: sessionPatch.taskStatus,
204	        toolCallCount: sessionPatch.toolCallCount,
205	      },
206	      create: {
207	        caConnectionId: event.id,
208	        caSessionId: parsed.ca.caSessionId,
209	        currentGoal: sessionPatch.currentGoal,
210	        endedAt: sessionPatch.endedAt,
211	        lastActiveAt: sessionPatch.lastActiveAt,
212	        latestActivity: sessionPatch.latestActivity,
213	        messageCount: sessionPatch.messageCount,
214	        progressPercent: sessionPatch.progressPercent,
215	        riskLevel: sessionPatch.riskLevel,
216	        riskReason: sessionPatch.riskReason,
217	        startedAt: sessionPatch.startedAt,
218	        taskStatus: sessionPatch.taskStatus,
219	        tokenCost: sessionPatch.tokenCost,
220	        toolCallCount: sessionPatch.toolCallCount,
221	      },
222	    });
223	
224	    const nextStatus = getNextConnectionStatusFromSignal({
225	      currentStatus: event.ingestionStatus,
226	      signal: signalForHelpers,
227	    });
228	
229	    await tx.cAConnection.update({
230	      where: {
231	        id: event.id,
232	      },
233	      data: {
234	        connectorVersion: parsed.ca.connectorVersion ?? event.connectorVersion,
235	        ingestionStatus: nextStatus,
236	        lastSyncedAt: observedAt,
237	      },
238	    });
239	
240	    const allConnections = await tx.cAConnection.findMany({
241	      where: {
242	        raceProjectId: event.raceProjectId,
243	      },
244	      select: {
245	        ingestionStatus: true,
246	      },
247	    });
248	
249	    const aggregateStatus = getAggregateIngestionStatus(
250	      allConnections.map((item) => item.ingestionStatus),
251	    );
252	
253	    await tx.raceProject.update({
254	      where: {
255	        id: event.raceProjectId,
256	      },
257	      data: {
258	        aggregateIngestionStatus: aggregateStatus,
259	      },
260	    });
261	
262	    return {
263	      aggregateStatus,
264	      connectionStatus: nextStatus,
265	      failedSignal: isFailureSignalPayload(signalForHelpers),
266	      raceId: event.raceProject.registration.raceId,
267	      sessionId: parsed.ca.caSessionId,
268	    };
269	  });
270	
271	  await rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace(updated.raceId);
272	  await rebuildRaceProcessProjections(updated.raceId);
273	
274	  return {
275	    accepted: true as const,
276	    deduped: false as const,
277	    failedSignal: updated.failedSignal,
278	    aggregateStatus: updated.aggregateStatus,
279	    connectionStatus: updated.connectionStatus,
280	    sessionId: updated.sessionId,
281	  };
282	}

1	import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
2	import { completeCAConnectionHandshake } from "@/lib/services/ca-fetch";
3	
4	export async function POST(request: Request) {
5	  const token = request.headers.get("authorization")?.replace("Bearer ", "") ?? "";
6	  const body = await request.json();
7	  const result = await completeCAConnectionHandshake({
8	    authToken: token,
9	    body,
10	  });
11	
12	  if (!result.accepted) {
13	    return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 401 });
14	  }
15	
16	  return NextResponse.json(result);
17	}

7	} from "@/lib/ca-runtime-helpers";
8	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
9	import { rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace } from "@/lib/services/evidence";
10	import { rebuildRaceProcessProjections } from "@/lib/services/projections";
11	
12	const handshakeSchema = z.object({
13	  caConnectionId: z.string().min(1),
14	  caProjectId: z.string().min(1),
15	  connectorId: z.string().min(1),
16	  connectorVersion: z.string().optional(),
17	  timestamp: z.string().datetime().optional(),
18	});
19	
20	const snapshotSchema = z.object({
21	  ca: z.object({
22	    caConnectionId: z.string().min(1),
23	    caProjectId: z.string().min(1),
24	    caSessionId: z.string().min(1),
25	  }),
26	  fetchedAt: z.string().datetime(),
27	  schemaVersion: z.string().min(1),
28	  summary: z.object({
29	    currentGoal: z.string(),
30	    latestActivity: z.string(),
31	    riskLevel: z.string(),
32	    riskReason: z.string(),
33	  }),
34	  task: z.object({
35	    progressPercent: z.number().min(0).max(100),
36	    taskStatus: z.string(),
37	  }),
38	  session: z.object({
39	    allRidingMessageLength: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
40	    endedAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
41	    lastActiveAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
42	    messageCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
43	    startedAt: z.string().datetime(),
44	    tokenCost: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
45	    toolCallCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
46	  }),
47	});
48	
49	export async function completeCAConnectionHandshake(input: {
50	  authToken: string;
51	  body: unknown;
52	}) {
53	  const parsed = handshakeSchema.parse(input.body);
54	  const connection = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
55	    where: { id: parsed.caConnectionId },
56	  });
57	
58	  if (!connection) {
59	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "connection_not_found" };
60	  }
61	
62	  if (connection.connectorSecret !== input.authToken) {
63	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "unauthorized" };
64	  }
65	
66	  if (
67	    connection.connectorId !== parsed.connectorId ||
68	    connection.caProjectId !== parsed.caProjectId ||
69	    connection.disabledAt
70	  ) {
71	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "scope_mismatch" };
72	  }
73	
74	  const timestamp = parsed.timestamp ? new Date(parsed.timestamp) : new Date();
75	  const nextStatus =
76	    connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE"
77	      ? "ACTIVE"
78	      : getNextConnectionStatusFromSignal({
79	          currentStatus: connection.ingestionStatus,
80	          signal: {
81	            counters: {},
82	            ingestion: null,
83	            timestamp,
84	            type: "session_started",
85	          },
86	        }) === "ACTIVE"
87	      ? "CONNECTED"
88	      : "CONNECTED";
89	
90	  const updated = await prisma.cAConnection.update({
91	    where: { id: connection.id },
92	    data: {
93	      connectorVersion: parsed.connectorVersion ?? connection.connectorVersion,
94	      handshakeCompletedAt: connection.handshakeCompletedAt ?? timestamp,
95	      ingestionStatus: nextStatus,
96	      lastSyncedAt: timestamp,
97	    },
98	  });
99	
100	  return {
101	    accepted: true as const,
102	    connectionId: updated.id,
103	    ingestionStatus: updated.ingestionStatus,
104	  };
105	}
106	
107	export async function fetchCASessionSnapshotForConnection(input: {
108	  caConnectionId: string;
109	  caSessionId: string;
110	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
111	}) {
112	  const fetchImpl = input.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
113	  const connection = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
114	    where: { id: input.caConnectionId },
115	    include: {
116	      raceProject: {
117	        include: {
118	          registration: true,
119	        },
120	      },
121	    },
122	  });
123	
124	  if (!connection) {
125	    throw new Error("CAConnection not found");
126	  }
127	
128	  if (!connection.handshakeCompletedAt || connection.disabledAt) {
129	    throw new Error("CAConnection is not eligible for snapshot fetch");
130	  }
131	
132	  if (!connection.connectorBaseUrl) {
133	    throw new Error("CAConnection has no connectorBaseUrl");
134	  }
135	
136	  const url = `${connection.connectorBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/ary/ca/connections/${connection.id}/sessions/${input.caSessionId}/snapshot`;
137	  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
138	    headers: {
139	      Authorization: `Bearer ${connection.connectorSecret}`,
140	    },
141	  });
142	
143	  if (!response.ok) {
144	    throw new Error(`Snapshot fetch failed with status ${response.status}`);
145	  }
146	
147	  const parsed = snapshotSchema.parse(await response.json());
148	
149	  if (
150	    parsed.ca.caConnectionId !== connection.id ||
151	    parsed.ca.caProjectId !== connection.caProjectId ||
152	    parsed.ca.caSessionId !== input.caSessionId
153	  ) {
154	    throw new Error("Snapshot payload scope mismatch");
155	  }
156	
157	  const fetchedAt = new Date(parsed.fetchedAt);
158	  const existing = await prisma.session.findUnique({
159	    where: {
160	      caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
161	        caConnectionId: connection.id,
162	        caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
163	      },
164	    },
165	  });
166	
167	  if (
168	    !shouldApplyFetchedSnapshot({
169	      fetchedAt,
170	      snapshotFetchedAt: existing?.snapshotFetchedAt ?? null,
171	    })
172	  ) {
173	    return { applied: false as const, reason: "stale_snapshot" };
174	  }
175	
176	  const patch = buildSessionPatchFromSnapshot({
177	    snapshot: {
178	      fetchedAt,
179	      summary: parsed.summary,
180	      task: parsed.task,
181	      session: {
182	        allRidingMessageLength: parsed.session.allRidingMessageLength,
183	        endedAt: parsed.session.endedAt ? new Date(parsed.session.endedAt) : null,
184	        lastActiveAt: parsed.session.lastActiveAt
185	          ? new Date(parsed.session.lastActiveAt)
186	          : null,
187	        messageCount: parsed.session.messageCount,
188	        startedAt: new Date(parsed.session.startedAt),
189	        tokenCost: parsed.session.tokenCost,
190	        toolCallCount: parsed.session.toolCallCount,
191	      },
192	    },
193	  });
194	
195	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
196	    await tx.session.upsert({
197	      where: {
198	        caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
199	          caConnectionId: connection.id,
200	          caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
201	        },
202	      },
203	      update: patch,
204	      create: {
205	        ...patch,
206	        caConnectionId: connection.id,
207	        caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
208	      },
209	    });
210	
211	    await tx.cAConnection.update({
212	      where: { id: connection.id },
213	      data: {
214	        ingestionStatus: patch.endedAt ? "ACTIVE" : "ACTIVE",
215	        lastSyncedAt: fetchedAt,
216	      },
217	    });
218	
219	    const allConnections = await tx.cAConnection.findMany({
220	      where: {
221	        raceProjectId: connection.raceProjectId,
222	      },
223	      select: {
224	        ingestionStatus: true,
225	      },
226	    });
227	
228	    await tx.raceProject.update({
229	      where: { id: connection.raceProjectId },
230	      data: {
231	        aggregateIngestionStatus: getAggregateIngestionStatus(
232	          allConnections.map((item) => item.ingestionStatus),
233	        ),
234	      },
235	    });
236	
237	    await tx.cAIngestionEvent.create({
238	      data: {
239	        caConnectionId: connection.id,
240	        idempotencyKey: `fetch:${connection.id}:${input.caSessionId}:${parsed.fetchedAt}`,
241	        messageId: `fetch:${connection.id}:${input.caSessionId}:${parsed.fetchedAt}`,
242	        observedAt: fetchedAt,
243	        payloadJson: JSON.stringify(parsed),
244	        signalKind: "snapshot",
245	        signalType: "snapshot_fetch",
246	      },
247	    });
248	  });
249	
250	  await rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace(connection.raceProject.registration.raceId);
251	  await rebuildRaceProcessProjections(connection.raceProject.registration.raceId);
252	
253	  return {
254	    applied: true as const,
255	    caConnectionId: connection.id,
256	    fetchedAt: parsed.fetchedAt,
257	    sessionId: input.caSessionId,
258	  };
259	}
260	
```

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {

181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,

111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;

119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,

164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,

166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

1	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}
16
