106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}
178	
179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

11	# 1. 文档定位
12	
13	本文定义 ARY MVP 在 GRS003 语义下的防伪与防篡改方案，目标不是把安全子系统做成独立产品，而是为以下链路建立可信边界：
14	
15	- 用户身份与角色边界
16	- RaceProject / CAConnection / Session 的实时接入边界
17	- Work 与外部代码材料的完整性边界
18	- Projection、Evidence、Report 的可追溯边界
19	- Organizer / Judge 在评审前看到的风险提示边界
20	- Runner 在材料校验、摘要生成与结构化预处理链路中的完整性边界
21	
22	本文明确保留 Runner，但 Runner 只作为内部辅助处理组件，不再作为领域中心、评审主体或裁决来源。正式评审与结果裁决仍留在受权限控制的 Organizer / Judge 工作流中。
23	
24	---
25	
26	# 2. 背景与目标
27	
28	GRS003 的安全重点不是“把所有异常自动打成 DQ”，而是：
29	
30	1. 防止未登记、未握手、归属错误或被篡改的数据进入有效证据链。
31	2. 防止 Work、代码材料、题目材料、评审辅助输入在传输或存储过程中被静默篡改。
32	3. 让实时 CA 接入、作品材料、Runner 辅助处理结果都具备可追溯性。
33	4. 在正式评审前向 Organizer / Judge 暴露风险、证据缺口和可信度问题。
34	5. 让大屏、Live Hall、Race Console 读取 Projection 或已发布结果，而不是直接读取未经校验的原始输入。
35	
36	安全目标与 GRS003 产品约束保持一致：
37	
38	- 实时 CA 数据是骑行过程证据、Projection 输入和评审参考，不是参赛资格硬门禁。
39	- CA 接入失败、无 CA 数据、证据缺口或高风险不自动取消 Registration 的提交、评审或 Award 资格。
40	- 系统需要产生 Review Flag / Review Readiness，而不是直接用安全检测替代人工评审。
41	
42	---
43	
44	# 3. 保护对象
45	
46	| 对象 | 为什么要保护 |
47	|---|---|
48	| User / GitHub 登录态 | 防止身份伪造、越权访问后台 |
49	| Registration | 防止参赛身份被冒用或错误绑定 |
50	| RaceProject | 防止把错误来源的数据混入某个选手的比赛事实 |
51	| CAConnection | 防止未登记 CA、错误 connector、错误外部项目伪装成有效接入 |
52	| Session / Riding Signal | 防止消息伪造、重放、串线和篡改 |
53	| Work / GitHub Repo / 外部材料 | 防止作品材料被替换、篡改或错误归属 |
54	| Race challenge materials | 防止赛题、数据包、评测输入被未授权修改 |
55	| Evidence | 防止失去来源引用与可信度标记 |
56	| Projection | 防止将异常输入直接传播到公开展示 |
57	| Report | 防止不可信摘要进入评审总结或选手报告 |
58	| Runner 输入输出 | 防止 Runner 拿到被篡改材料，或输出无法追溯 |
59	
60	---
61	
62	# 4. 威胁模型
63	
64	| 威胁 | 描述 | 主要影响 |
65	|---|---|---|
66	| 身份伪造 | 冒充其他 Rider、Organizer、Judge 或 CA connector | 越权、错误归属 |
67	| CA 伪接入 | 未登记或未握手的 CAConnection 推送数据 | 污染比赛事实 |
68	| 消息篡改 | Riding signal 在链路中被修改 | Projection / Evidence 失真 |
69	| 消息重放 | 重复发送旧消息或旧快照 | 制造假活跃度、假进度 |
70	| 归属串线 | 某个外部 CA Project / Session 被错误绑定到其他 Registration | 证据归属错误 |
71	| 作品篡改 | Work、Repo、压缩包、Demo 材料被静默替换 | 评审对象失真 |
72	| 题目篡改 | 赛题或评测输入被未授权修改 | 比赛公平性受损 |
73	| Runner 输入污染 | Runner 拉取到的代码、材料或摘要输入已被篡改 | 评测和摘要失真 |
74	| Runner 输出伪造 | Runner 产出的摘要、校验结果、指标来源不清 | 无法信任报告链路 |
75	| 公开泄露 | 原始 Session、私有 Evidence、未发布结果被公开读取 | 隐私和比赛秩序受损 |
76	
77	---
78	
79	# 5. 安全原则
80	
81	## 5.1 先校验归属，再接收数据
82	
83	任何进入有效链路的实时 CA 数据，都必须先满足：
84	
85	- 对应 Rider 已拥有该 Race 的 approved Registration。
86	- 该 Registration 已幂等生成唯一 RaceProject。
87	- `caConnectionId` 已登记并完成握手。
88	- `caConnectionId` 归属当前 `raceProjectId`。
89	- connector 未被禁用，来源未被吊销。
90	
91	未满足以上条件的数据，不得进入有效 Projection、Evidence 或 Report 输入，只能拒收或写入隔离审计区。
92	
93	## 5.2 Projection 不是事实源
94	
95	大屏、Live Hall、过程榜单和 Race Console 的过程展示优先读取 Projection。Projection 可以重算，也必须允许丢弃异常输入后重建。
96	
97	## 5.3 风险提示优先于自动处罚
98	
99	安全检测的默认输出应是：
100	
101	- review flags
102	- readiness 状态
103	- evidence completeness
104	- integrity 状态
105	- 审计记录
106	
107	只有当主办方另有赛事规则明确授权时，才可在人工作业流中执行取消资格、移除榜单或隐藏作品等动作；本文不把自动 DQ 作为默认系统行为。
108	
109	## 5.4 原始数据最小暴露
110	
111	Public Site、Live Hall、Screen Console 不读取原始 Session。公开端只读取：
112	
113	- Projection
114	- Evidence 摘要
115	- 已公开 Work
116	- 已发布 Award
117	- 已发布且公开可见的 Report
118	
119	## 5.5 Runner 服从同一可信链
120	
121	Runner 不是独立真相源，而是消费 ARY 已校验材料、执行辅助校验、摘要生成或结构化预处理的内部组件。Runner 的输入、输出、版本和校验结果都需要可追溯；Judge / Organizer 才是正式评审意见与结果裁决的主体。
122	
123	---
124	
125	# 6. 可信链设计
126	
127	## 6.1 身份与访问层
128	
129	- 账号入口使用 GitHub 登录。
130	- 后台访问必须经过登录和 `User.roles` 权限校验。
131	- Race Console、Admin Console、Screen Console 的访问边界隔离。
132	- Organizer、Judge、Rider 只读取各自范围内的数据与摘要。
133	
134	这部分主要解决“人是谁、是否有权限看到或操作该资源”的问题。
135	
136	## 6.2 CAConnection 登记与握手层
137	
138	每个参赛 CA 必须先形成 CAConnection，再进入实时接入。
139	
140	登记记录至少需要包含：
141	
142	- `registrationId`
143	- `raceProjectId`
144	- `caConnectionId`
145	- `caType`
146	- `connectorId`
147	- `connectorVersion`
148	- `caProjectId`
149	- `registeredAt`
150	- `ingestionStatus`
151	- `credentialFingerprint` 或等价来源标识
152	
153	握手完成后，ARY 才接受该 CAConnection 的实时消息或快照抓取请求。
154	
155	## 6.3 实时消息接入层
156	
157	对于 push 到 ARY 的 RidingSignalMessage 或等价消息：
158	
159	- 校验 `caConnectionId` 是否已登记且归属正确。
160	- 校验消息 schemaVersion、messageId、idempotencyKey。
161	- 对签名或来源令牌进行校验。
162	- 对时间戳窗口进行合理性检查。
163	- 对同一 `caConnectionId + caSessionId + sequence` 做幂等去重。
164	- 对异常来源、重复消息、乱序严重消息做隔离审计。
165	
166	说明：
167	
168	- “时间戳超时”默认是接入风险，不直接等价为作弊。
169	- 反馈类说明消息、网络抖动或 connector 重试需要与恶意重放区别处理。
170	
171	## 6.4 Session 快照抓取层
172	
173	ARY 需要完整 Session 时，从已登记 connector 提供的 HTTP fetch 接口抓取。
174	
175	要求：
176	
177	- fetch 目标必须绑定到已登记 CAConnection。
178	- 响应应带来源标识、抓取时间、外部 session 标识和摘要校验信息。
179	- 抓取失败只形成接入异常或证据缺口，不自动改变 Registration 资格状态。
180	
181	## 6.5 Work / 代码材料完整性层
182	
183	Work、GitHub Repo、压缩包、Demo 附件等材料进入系统时，需要建立完整性元数据：
184	
185	- sourceRef
186	- 内容哈希
187	- 上传或抓取时间
188	- 提交人 / 触发人
189	- 所属 Registration / Work
190	- 可见性
191	
192	这确保后续评审、Evidence 引用和 Runner 拉取时使用的是同一份可追溯材料。
193	
194	## 6.6 题目与评测输入完整性层
195	
196	主办方维护的 challenge materials、数据包、评测配置和输入样例，应记录：
197	
198	- 版本号
199	- 内容哈希
200	- 修改人
201	- 修改时间
202	- 修改原因
203	
204	任何对题目或评测输入的更新，都必须留下审计记录，避免赛中无痕改题或无痕替换评测输入。
205	
206	## 6.7 Runner 辅助处理层
207	
208	Runner 可保留并承担以下职责：
209	
210	- 拉取已锁定或已提交的 Work / 代码材料
211	- 校验 ARY 提供的内容哈希
212	- 执行静态检查、摘要提取、结构化分析或其他评审辅助处理
213	- 输出可回写到 Evidence / Projection / Report 的辅助处理结果
214	
215	Runner 必须遵守以下边界：
216	
217	- 不直接接收未登记 CA 的原始消息作为真相源。
218	- 不直接充当 Judge，也不直接决定 Registration 是否取消资格、是否得奖或最终评分。
219	- 不绕过 ARY 的权限和归属规则。
220	- 输出结果必须包含 `runnerVersion`、输入材料引用、输入哈希、处理时间和处理状态。
221	- Runner 输出默认只作为 Organizer / Judge 的辅助输入，而不是正式裁决本身。
222	
223	---
224	
225	# 7. 检测与处置模型
226	
227	## 7.1 事件分级
228	
229	安全相关事件建议分为四类：
230	
231	| 级别 | 含义 | 默认系统行为 |
232	|---|---|---|
233	| reject | 本次输入不接受 | 拒收，不进入有效链路，写审计 |
234	| risk | 可疑或异常，但不确定是作弊 | 生成 Review Flag / 风险提示 |
235	| integrity_gap | 证据缺口或可信度不足 | 标记 Evidence / Projection / Report 可信度 |
236	| confirmed_violation | 经规则或人工确认的违规 | 记录违规结果，交由 Organizer 流程处理 |
237	
238	## 7.2 典型检测规则
239	
240	### A. 必须拒收的情况
241	
242	- `caConnectionId` 未登记
243	- `caConnectionId` 归属错误 RaceProject
244	- 握手未完成却发送有效比赛消息
245	- 签名或来源令牌验证失败
246	- 幂等键与消息体关键字段冲突
247	
248	默认处置：
249	
250	- 拒收本次输入
251	- 写入审计日志
252	- 如持续出现，升级为 risk
253	
254	### B. 形成风险提示的情况
255	
256	- 同一 CAConnection 高频时间戳异常
257	- 同一外部 session 在短时间内跨多个 Registration 出现
258	- Session 活跃但长期无可解释进展
259	- Work 材料与历史引用差异异常
260	- Runner 多次拉取哈希不一致
```

1	import { EvidenceType, Visibility } from "@/generated/prisma/enums";
2	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
3	import { buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord } from "@/lib/evidence-projection-helpers";
4	
5	export async function rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace(raceId: string) {
6	  const registrations = await prisma.registration.findMany({
7	    where: { raceId },
8	    include: {
9	      raceProject: {
10	        include: {
11	          caConnections: {
12	            include: {
13	              sessions: true,
14	            },
15	          },
16	        },
17	      },
18	    },
19	  });
20	
21	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
22	    await tx.evidence.deleteMany({
23	      where: {
24	        registration: {
25	          raceId,
26	        },
27	        type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
28	      },
29	    });
30	
31	    for (const registration of registrations) {
32	      for (const connection of registration.raceProject?.caConnections ?? []) {
33	        for (const session of connection.sessions) {
34	          const evidence = buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord({
35	            caConnectionId: connection.id,
36	            caProjectId: connection.caProjectId,
37	            caSessionId: session.caSessionId,
38	            caType: connection.caType,
39	            messageCount: session.messageCount,
40	            registrationId: registration.id,
41	            startedAt: session.startedAt,
42	            tokenCost: session.tokenCost,
43	            toolCallCount: session.toolCallCount,
44	          });
45	
46	          await tx.evidence.create({
47	            data: {
48	              registrationId: evidence.registrationId,
49	              sourceRefJson: evidence.sourceRefJson,
50	              summary: evidence.summary,
51	              title: evidence.title,
52	              type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
53	              visibility: Visibility.INTERNAL,
54	            },
55	          });
56	        }
57	      }
58	    }
59	  });
60	}
61

13	  caConnectionId: z.string().min(1),

15	  connectorId: z.string().min(1),
16	  connectorVersion: z.string().optional(),

20	const snapshotSchema = z.object({
21	  ca: z.object({
22	    caConnectionId: z.string().min(1),
23	    caProjectId: z.string().min(1),
24	    caSessionId: z.string().min(1),
25	  }),
26	  fetchedAt: z.string().datetime(),

36	    taskStatus: z.string(),
37	  }),
38	  session: z.object({
39	    allRidingMessageLength: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
40	    endedAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
41	    lastActiveAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
42	    messageCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),

49	export async function completeCAConnectionHandshake(input: {
50	  authToken: string;
51	  body: unknown;
52	}) {
53	  const parsed = handshakeSchema.parse(input.body);
54	  const connection = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
55	    where: { id: parsed.caConnectionId },
56	  });
57	
58	  if (!connection) {
59	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "connection_not_found" };
60	  }
61	
62	  if (connection.connectorSecret !== input.authToken) {
63	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "unauthorized" };
64	  }
65	
66	  if (
67	    connection.connectorId !== parsed.connectorId ||
68	    connection.caProjectId !== parsed.caProjectId ||
69	    connection.disabledAt
70	  ) {
71	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "scope_mismatch" };
72	  }
73	
74	  const timestamp = parsed.timestamp ? new Date(parsed.timestamp) : new Date();
75	  const nextStatus =
76	    connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE"
77	      ? "ACTIVE"
78	      : getNextConnectionStatusFromSignal({
79	          currentStatus: connection.ingestionStatus,
80	          signal: {
81	            counters: {},
82	            ingestion: null,
83	            timestamp,
84	            type: "session_started",
85	          },
86	        }) === "ACTIVE"
87	      ? "CONNECTED"
88	      : "CONNECTED";
89	
90	  const updated = await prisma.cAConnection.update({
91	    where: { id: connection.id },
92	    data: {
93	      connectorVersion: parsed.connectorVersion ?? connection.connectorVersion,
94	      handshakeCompletedAt: connection.handshakeCompletedAt ?? timestamp,
95	      ingestionStatus: nextStatus,
96	      lastSyncedAt: timestamp,
97	    },
98	  });
99	
100	  return {
101	    accepted: true as const,
102	    connectionId: updated.id,
103	    ingestionStatus: updated.ingestionStatus,
104	  };
105	}

107	export async function fetchCASessionSnapshotForConnection(input: {
108	  caConnectionId: string;
109	  caSessionId: string;
110	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
111	}) {
112	  const fetchImpl = input.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
113	  const connection = await prisma.cAConnection.findUnique({
114	    where: { id: input.caConnectionId },
115	    include: {
116	      raceProject: {
117	        include: {
118	          registration: true,
119	        },
120	      },
121	    },
122	  });
123	
124	  if (!connection) {
125	    throw new Error("CAConnection not found");
126	  }
127	
128	  if (!connection.handshakeCompletedAt || connection.disabledAt) {
129	    throw new Error("CAConnection is not eligible for snapshot fetch");
130	  }
131	
132	  if (!connection.connectorBaseUrl) {
133	    throw new Error("CAConnection has no connectorBaseUrl");
134	  }
135	
136	  const url = `${connection.connectorBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/ary/ca/connections/${connection.id}/sessions/${input.caSessionId}/snapshot`;
137	  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
138	    headers: {
139	      Authorization: `Bearer ${connection.connectorSecret}`,
140	    },
141	  });
142	
143	  if (!response.ok) {
144	    throw new Error(`Snapshot fetch failed with status ${response.status}`);
145	  }
146	
147	  const parsed = snapshotSchema.parse(await response.json());
148	
149	  if (
150	    parsed.ca.caConnectionId !== connection.id ||
151	    parsed.ca.caProjectId !== connection.caProjectId ||
152	    parsed.ca.caSessionId !== input.caSessionId
153	  ) {
154	    throw new Error("Snapshot payload scope mismatch");
155	  }
156	
157	  const fetchedAt = new Date(parsed.fetchedAt);
158	  const existing = await prisma.session.findUnique({
159	    where: {
160	      caConnectionId_caSessionId: {
161	        caConnectionId: connection.id,
162	        caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
163	      },
164	    },
165	  });
166	
167	  if (
168	    !shouldApplyFetchedSnapshot({
169	      fetchedAt,
170	      snapshotFetchedAt: existing?.snapshotFetchedAt ?? null,
171	    })
172	  ) {
173	    return { applied: false as const, reason: "stale_snapshot" };
174	  }
175	
176	  const patch = buildSessionPatchFromSnapshot({
177	    snapshot: {

179	      summary: parsed.summary,
180	      task: parsed.task,
181	      session: {
182	        allRidingMessageLength: parsed.session.allRidingMessageLength,
183	        endedAt: parsed.session.endedAt ? new Date(parsed.session.endedAt) : null,
184	        lastActiveAt: parsed.session.lastActiveAt

55	    where: { id: parsed.caConnectionId },
56	  });
57	
58	  if (!connection) {
59	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "connection_not_found" };
60	  }

63	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "unauthorized" };
64	  }
65	
66	  if (
67	    connection.connectorId !== parsed.connectorId ||
68	    connection.caProjectId !== parsed.caProjectId ||
69	    connection.disabledAt

71	    return { accepted: false as const, reason: "scope_mismatch" };
72	  }
73	
74	  const timestamp = parsed.timestamp ? new Date(parsed.timestamp) : new Date();
75	  const nextStatus =
76	    connection.ingestionStatus === "ACTIVE"
77	      ? "ACTIVE"
78	      : getNextConnectionStatusFromSignal({
79	          currentStatus: connection.ingestionStatus,
80	          signal: {
81	            counters: {},
82	            ingestion: null,
83	            timestamp,
84	            type: "session_started",

95	      ingestionStatus: nextStatus,
96	      lastSyncedAt: timestamp,
97	    },
98	  });
99	
100	  return {
101	    accepted: true as const,
102	    connectionId: updated.id,
103	    ingestionStatus: updated.ingestionStatus,
104	  };

78	export function buildEventStreamProjectionPayload(input: {
79	  items: Array<{
80	    createdAt: string;
81	    registrationId?: null | string;
82	    severity: "critical" | "info" | "warning";
83	    summary: string;
84	    type: "announcement" | "risk" | "session_activity";
85	    username?: null | string;
86	  }>;
87	  raceId: string;
88	}) {
89	  return {
90	    items: [...input.items].sort(
91	      (left, right) =>
92	        new Date(right.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(left.createdAt).getTime(),
93	    ),
94	    raceId: input.raceId,
95	  };
96	}

98	export function buildCurrentLeaderboardProjectionPayload(
99	  items: Array<{
100	    entryId: string;
101	    progressPercent: number;
102	    tokenCost: number;
103	    username: string;
104	  }>,
105	) {
106	  return [...items]
107	    .sort((left, right) => {
108	      if (right.progressPercent !== left.progressPercent) {
109	        return right.progressPercent - left.progressPercent;
110	      }
111	      if (left.tokenCost !== right.tokenCost) {
112	        return left.tokenCost - right.tokenCost;
113	      }
114	      return left.username.localeCompare(right.username, "en");
115	    })
116	    .map((item, index) => ({
117	      ...item,
118	      rank: index + 1,
119	    }));
120	}

10	        include: {

12	            include: {

24	        registration: {
25	          raceId,
26	        },
27	        type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
28	      },

35	            caConnectionId: connection.id,
36	            caProjectId: connection.caProjectId,

39	            messageCount: session.messageCount,

42	            tokenCost: session.tokenCost,
43	            toolCallCount: session.toolCallCount,
44	          });
45	
46	          await tx.evidence.create({
47	            data: {
48	              registrationId: evidence.registrationId,
49	              sourceRefJson: evidence.sourceRefJson,
50	              summary: evidence.summary,
51	              title: evidence.title,
52	              type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
53	              visibility: Visibility.INTERNAL,

5	export async function rebuildSessionSummaryEvidenceForRace(raceId: string) {
6	  const registrations = await prisma.registration.findMany({
7	    where: { raceId },
8	    include: {
9	      raceProject: {
10	        include: {
11	          caConnections: {
12	            include: {
13	              sessions: true,
14	            },
15	          },
16	        },
17	      },
18	    },
19	  });
20	
21	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
22	    await tx.evidence.deleteMany({
23	      where: {
24	        registration: {
25	          raceId,
26	        },
27	        type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
28	      },
29	    });
30	
31	    for (const registration of registrations) {
32	      for (const connection of registration.raceProject?.caConnections ?? []) {
33	        for (const session of connection.sessions) {
34	          const evidence = buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord({
35	            caConnectionId: connection.id,
36	            caProjectId: connection.caProjectId,
37	            caSessionId: session.caSessionId,
38	            caType: connection.caType,
39	            messageCount: session.messageCount,
40	            registrationId: registration.id,
41	            startedAt: session.startedAt,
42	            tokenCost: session.tokenCost,
43	            toolCallCount: session.toolCallCount,
44	          });
45	
46	          await tx.evidence.create({
47	            data: {
48	              registrationId: evidence.registrationId,
49	              sourceRefJson: evidence.sourceRefJson,
50	              summary: evidence.summary,
51	              title: evidence.title,
52	              type: EvidenceType.SESSION_SUMMARY,
53	              visibility: Visibility.INTERNAL,
54	            },
55	          });
56	        }
57	      }
58	    }
59	  });
60	}

1	export function buildSessionSummaryEvidenceRecord(input: {
2	  caConnectionId: string;
3	  caProjectId: string;
4	  caSessionId: string;
5	  caType: "CLAUDE_CODE" | "CODEX" | "OTHER";
6	  messageCount: number;
7	  registrationId: string;
8	  startedAt: Date;
9	  tokenCost: number;
10	  toolCallCount: number;
11	}) {
12	  return {
13	    registrationId: input.registrationId,
14	    sourceRefJson: JSON.stringify({
15	      caConnectionId: input.caConnectionId,
16	      caProjectId: input.caProjectId,
17	      caSessionId: input.caSessionId,
18	    }),
19	    summary: `${input.caType} session ${input.caSessionId} produced ${input.messageCount} messages, ${input.toolCallCount} tool calls, and ${input.tokenCost} tokens.`,
20	    title: `Session ${input.caSessionId}`,
21	    type: "SESSION_SUMMARY" as const,
22	    visibility: "INTERNAL" as const,
23	  };
24	}
25	
26	export function buildRegistrationStatusProjectionPayload(input: {
27	  aggregateIngestionStatus: "ACTIVE" | "CONNECTED" | "FAILED" | "NOT_CONFIGURED";
28	  caConnectionCount: number;
29	  raceProjectId: null | string;
30	  registrationId: string;
31	  registrationStatus: "APPROVED" | "REJECTED" | "SUBMITTED" | "WITHDRAWN";
32	  sessionCount: number;
33	  username: string;
34	}) {
35	  return {
36	    aggregateIngestionStatus: input.aggregateIngestionStatus,
37	    caConnectionCount: input.caConnectionCount,
38	    raceProjectId: input.raceProjectId,
39	    registrationId: input.registrationId,
40	    registrationStatus: input.registrationStatus,
41	    sessionCount: input.sessionCount,
42	    username: input.username,
43	  };
44	}
45	
46	export function buildRaceProgressProjectionPayload(input: {
47	  activeConnections: number;
48	  activeRegistrations: number;
49	  activeSessions: number;
50	  raceId: string;
51	  totalRegistrations: number;
52	}) {
53	  return {
54	    activeConnections: input.activeConnections,
55	    activeRegistrations: input.activeRegistrations,
56	    activeSessions: input.activeSessions,
57	    raceId: input.raceId,
58	    totalRegistrations: input.totalRegistrations,
59	  };
60	}
61	
62	export function buildScreenFeedProjectionPayload(input: {
63	  items: Array<{
64	    summary: string;
65	    type:
66	      | "announcement"
67	      | "current_leaderboard_projection"
68	      | "session_summary";
69	  }>;
70	  raceId: string;
71	}) {
72	  return {
73	    items: input.items,
74	    raceId: input.raceId,
75	  };
76	}
77	
78	export function buildEventStreamProjectionPayload(input: {
79	  items: Array<{
80	    createdAt: string;
81	    registrationId?: null | string;
82	    severity: "critical" | "info" | "warning";
83	    summary: string;
84	    type: "announcement" | "risk" | "session_activity";
85	    username?: null | string;
86	  }>;
87	  raceId: string;
88	}) {
89	  return {
90	    items: [...input.items].sort(
91	      (left, right) =>
92	        new Date(right.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(left.createdAt).getTime(),
93	    ),
94	    raceId: input.raceId,
95	  };
96	}
97	
98	export function buildCurrentLeaderboardProjectionPayload(
99	  items: Array<{
100	    entryId: string;
101	    progressPercent: number;
102	    tokenCost: number;
103	    username: string;
104	  }>,
105	) {
106	  return [...items]
107	    .sort((left, right) => {
108	      if (right.progressPercent !== left.progressPercent) {
109	        return right.progressPercent - left.progressPercent;
110	      }
111	      if (left.tokenCost !== right.tokenCost) {
112	        return left.tokenCost - right.tokenCost;
113	      }
114	      return left.username.localeCompare(right.username, "en");
115	    })
116	    .map((item, index) => ({
117	      ...item,
118	      rank: index + 1,
119	    }));
120	}

96	export async function registerForRace(userId: string, raceId: string) {
97	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
98	    where: { id: raceId },
99	  });
100	
101	  if (!race) {
102	    throw new Error("Race not found");
103	  }
104	
105	  if (getRacePhase(race) !== "registration") {
106	    throw new Error("Registration is only open during the registration phase");
107	  }
108	
109	  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
110	    where: { id: userId },
111	  });
112	
113	  if (!user) {
114	    throw new Error("User not found");
115	  }
116	
117	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
118	    const existingRegistration = await tx.registration.findUnique({
119	      where: {
120	        raceId_userId: {
121	          raceId,
122	          userId,
123	        },
124	      },
125	      include: {
126	        raceProject: true,
127	      },
128	    });
129	
130	    const existingTeam = await tx.team.findFirst({
131	      where: {
132	        captainId: userId,
133	        raceId,
134	      },
135	      include: {
136	        members: true,
137	      },
138	    });
139	
140	    const flow = planRegistrationBridgeFlow({
141	      hasCompatibilityTeam: !!existingTeam,
142	      hasRaceProject: !!existingRegistration?.raceProject,
143	      registrationStatus: existingRegistration?.status ?? null,
144	    });
145	
146	    let registration = existingRegistration;
147	
148	    if (!registration && flow.shouldCreateRegistration) {
149	      registration = await tx.registration.create({
150	        data: {
151	          approvedAt: flow.nextRegistrationStatus === "APPROVED" ? new Date() : null,
152	          raceId,
153	          status: flow.nextRegistrationStatus as RegistrationStatus,
154	          userId,
155	        },
156	        include: {
157	          raceProject: true,
158	          user: true,
159	        },
160	      });
161	    } else if (
162	      registration &&
163	      registration.status !== flow.nextRegistrationStatus
164	    ) {
165	      registration = await tx.registration.update({
166	        where: { id: registration.id },
167	        data: {
168	          approvedAt:
169	            flow.nextRegistrationStatus === "APPROVED"
170	              ? registration.approvedAt ?? new Date()
171	              : registration.approvedAt,
172	          rejectedAt:
173	            flow.nextRegistrationStatus === "REJECTED"
174	              ? registration.rejectedAt ?? new Date()
175	              : registration.rejectedAt,
176	          status: flow.nextRegistrationStatus as RegistrationStatus,
177	          withdrawnAt:
178	            flow.nextRegistrationStatus === "WITHDRAWN"
179	              ? registration.withdrawnAt ?? new Date()
180	              : registration.withdrawnAt,
181	        },
182	        include: {
183	          raceProject: true,
184	          user: true,
185	        },
186	      });
187	    }
188	
189	    if (!registration) {
190	      throw new Error("Registration could not be created");
191	    }
192	
193	    if (flow.ensureRaceProject) {
194	      await tx.raceProject.upsert({
195	        where: {
196	          registrationId: registration.id,
197	        },
198	        update: {},
199	        create: {
200	          aggregateIngestionStatus: getRaceProjectInitialStatus(),
201	          registrationId: registration.id,
202	        },
203	      });
204	    }
205	
206	    if (flow.ensureCompatibilityTeam) {
207	      await tx.team.create({
208	        data: {
209	          captainId: userId,
210	          members: {
211	            create: [
212	              {
213	                displayName: user.username,
214	                userId,
215	              },
216	            ],
217	          },
218	          name: `${user.username} solo`,
219	          raceId,
220	        },
221	      });
222	    }
223	
224	    return tx.registration.findUnique({
225	      where: { id: registration.id },
226	      include: {
227	        raceProject: true,
228	        user: true,
229	      },
230	    });
231	  });
232	}

1	export type RegistrationStatusLike =
2	  | "APPROVED"
3	  | "REJECTED"
4	  | "SUBMITTED"
5	  | "WITHDRAWN";
6	
7	export function shouldEnsureRaceProject(
8	  status: RegistrationStatusLike | null,
9	): boolean {
10	  return status === "APPROVED";
11	}
12	
13	export function getRaceProjectInitialStatus():
14	  | "ACTIVE"
15	  | "CONNECTED"
16	  | "FAILED"
17	  | "NOT_CONFIGURED" {
18	  return "NOT_CONFIGURED";
19	}
20	
21	export function getCompatibilityTeamMode(): "secondary" {
22	  return "secondary";
23	}
24	
25	export function planRegistrationBridgeFlow(input: {
26	  hasCompatibilityTeam: boolean;
27	  hasRaceProject: boolean;
28	  registrationStatus: RegistrationStatusLike | null;
29	}): {
30	  ensureCompatibilityTeam: boolean;
31	  ensureRaceProject: boolean;
32	  nextRegistrationStatus: RegistrationStatusLike;
33	  shouldCreateRegistration: boolean;
34	} {
35	  const nextRegistrationStatus: RegistrationStatusLike =
36	    input.registrationStatus ?? "APPROVED";
37	
38	  return {
39	    ensureCompatibilityTeam:
40	      getCompatibilityTeamMode() === "secondary" && !input.hasCompatibilityTeam,
41	    ensureRaceProject:
42	      shouldEnsureRaceProject(nextRegistrationStatus) && !input.hasRaceProject,
43	    nextRegistrationStatus,
44	    shouldCreateRegistration: input.registrationStatus === null,
45	  };
46	}

7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}

99	export async function listCooperationRequests(status?: string) {
100	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.findMany({

103	  });

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}
178	
179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

18	export async function listConsoleRacesForUser(input: {
19	  roles: readonly AppRole[];
20	  userId: string;
21	}): Promise<ConsoleRaceListItem[]> {
22	  const roles = normalizeRoles(input.roles);
23	  const races = await listRaces();
24	  const items: ConsoleRaceListItem[] = [];
25	
26	  if (hasRole(roles, "ORGANIZER")) {
27	    items.push(
28	      ...races
29	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => race.organizerId === input.userId)
30	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
31	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
32	          return {
33	            access: "organizer" as const,
34	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/organizer/overview`,
35	            race,
36	            slug,
37	          };
38	        }),
39	    );
40	  }
41	
42	  if (hasRole(roles, "RIDER")) {
43	    items.push(
44	      ...races
45	        .filter(
46	          (race: RaceListItem) =>
47	            race.registrations.some(
48	              (registration: RaceListItem["registrations"][number]) =>
49	                registration.userId === input.userId,
50	            ),
51	        )
52	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
53	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
54	          return {
55	            access: "rider" as const,
56	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/rider/registration`,
57	            race,
58	            slug,
59	          };
60	        }),
61	    );
62	  }
63	
64	  if (hasRole(roles, "JUDGE")) {
65	    const assignments = await prisma.judgeAssignment.findMany({
66	      where: {
67	        judgeId: input.userId,
68	      },
69	      select: {
70	        work: {
71	          select: {
72	            registration: {
73	              select: {
74	                raceId: true,
75	              },
76	            },
77	          },
78	        },
79	      },
80	    });
81	    const assignedRaceIds = new Set(
82	      assignments.map(
83	        (assignment: { work: { registration: { raceId: string } } }) =>
84	          assignment.work.registration.raceId,
85	      ),
86	    );
87	
88	    items.push(
89	      ...races
90	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => assignedRaceIds.has(race.id))
91	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
92	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
93	          return {
94	            access: "judge" as const,
95	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/judge/assigned`,
96	            race,
97	            slug,
98	          };
99	        }),
100	    );
101	  }
102	
103	  const seen = new Set<string>();
104	  return items.filter((item) => {
105	    const key = `${item.access}-${item.race.id}`;
106	    if (seen.has(key)) {
107	      return false;
108	    }
109	    seen.add(key);
110	    return true;
111	  });
112	}
113	
114	export async function listScreenConsoleRacesForUser(input: {
115	  roles: readonly AppRole[];
116	  userId: string;
117	}): Promise<Array<{ defaultHref: string; race: RaceListItem; slug: string }>> {
118	  const roles = normalizeRoles(input.roles);
119	  const races = await listRaces();
120	
121	  if (hasRole(roles, "ADMIN")) {
122	    // 企业能力尚未独立建模，当前由 Admin 代理大屏控制台可见范围。
123	    return races.map((race: RaceListItem) => {

125	      return {

127	        race,
128	        slug,
129	      };
130	    });
131	  }
132	
133	  return [];
134	}

136	export async function getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug: string): Promise<{
137	  race: RaceListItem;
138	  slug: string;
139	} | null> {
140	  const races = await listRaces();
141	  const exactMatch = races.find(
142	    (item: RaceListItem) => buildRaceSlug(item.id, item.title) === raceSlug,
143	  );
144	  const race =
145	    exactMatch ??
146	    races.find((item: RaceListItem) => item.id === getRaceIdFromSlug(raceSlug));
147	
148	  if (!race) {
149	    return null;
150	  }
151	
152	  return {
153	    race,
154	    slug: buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title),
155	  };
156	}

274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
294	}

262	function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
263	  if (!value) return null;

269	      </span>
270	    </div>
271	  );
272	}

274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
294	}

1	"use client";
2	
3	import { useReducer, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useState } from "react";
4	import {
5	  calibratorReducer,
6	  createInitialState,
7	  toTrackProfile,
8	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/calibrator/CalibratorState";
9	import { samplePath, sampleAt, tangentAngle, normal } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/path-sampler";
10	import { validateTrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/validator";
11	import type { Point } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
12	
13	export default function CalibratorClient() {
14	  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(calibratorReducer, null, createInitialState);
15	  const [bgImage, setBgImage] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
16	  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
17	  const profileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
18	  const dragRef = useRef<{ index: number; ox: number; oy: number; px: number; py: number } | null>(null);
19	
20	  // 自动播放
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    if (!state.isPlaying) return;
23	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
24	      dispatch({ type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS", payload: (state.previewProgress + 0.002 * state.previewSpeed) % 1 });
25	    }, 16);
26	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
27	  }, [state.isPlaying, state.previewProgress, state.previewSpeed]);
28	
29	  // ---- 拖拽处理（SVG 原生事件，viewBox 坐标） ----
30	  const onPointMouseDown = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
31	    e.stopPropagation();
32	    dragRef.current = { index, ox: e.clientX, oy: e.clientY, px: state.centerline.points[index].x, py: state.centerline.points[index].y };
33	    dispatch({ type: "SELECT_POINT", payload: index });
34	  }, [state.centerline.points]);
35	
36	  const onPointContextMenu = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
37	    e.preventDefault();
38	    e.stopPropagation();
39	    dispatch({ type: "DELETE_POINT", payload: { index } });
40	  }, []);
41	
42	  const onSvgMouseMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
43	    if (!dragRef.current) return;
44	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
45	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
46	    pt.x = e.clientX;
47	    pt.y = e.clientY;
48	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
49	    if (!ctm) return;
50	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
51	    const dx = svgPt.x - dragRef.current.px;
52	    const dy = svgPt.y - dragRef.current.py;
53	    dispatch({ type: "MOVE_POINT", payload: { index: dragRef.current.index, point: { x: dragRef.current.px + dx, y: dragRef.current.py + dy } } });
54	  }, []);
55	
56	  const onSvgMouseUp = useCallback(() => { dragRef.current = null; }, []);
57	
58	  const onSvgDoubleClick = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
59	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
60	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
61	    pt.x = e.clientX;
62	    pt.y = e.clientY;
63	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
64	    if (!ctm) return;
65	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
66	    dispatch({ type: "ADD_POINT", payload: { x: svgPt.x, y: svgPt.y } });
67	  }, []);
68	
69	  // ---- 导入/导出 ----
70	  const handleImportBg = useCallback(() => fileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
71	  const handleBgFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
72	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
73	    const reader = new FileReader();
74	    reader.onload = () => {
75	      const img = new Image();
76	      img.onload = () => { setBgImage(img); dispatch({ type: "SET_BACKGROUND", payload: { src: reader.result as string, naturalWidth: img.naturalWidth, naturalHeight: img.naturalHeight } }); };
77	      img.src = reader.result as string;
78	    };
79	    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
80	  }, []);
81	
82	  const handleImportProfile = useCallback(() => profileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
83	  const handleProfileFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
84	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
85	    const reader = new FileReader();
86	    reader.onload = () => {
87	      try { const profile = JSON.parse(reader.result as string); dispatch({ type: "LOAD_PROFILE", payload: profile }); } catch { alert("JSON 解析失败"); }
88	    };
89	    reader.readAsText(file);
90	  }, []);
91	
92	  const handleValidate = useCallback(() => {
93	    const result = validateTrackProfile(toTrackProfile(state));
94	    dispatch({ type: "SET_VALIDATION", payload: { errors: result.errors.map(e => `${e.field}: ${e.message}`), warnings: result.warnings.map(w => `${w.field}: ${w.message}`) } });
95	  }, [state]);
96	
97	  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
98	    const json = JSON.stringify(toTrackProfile(state), null, 2);
99	    const blob = new Blob([json], { type: "application/json" });
100	    const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = `${state.trackId}.profile.json`; a.click();
101	  }, [state]);
102	
103	  // ---- 路径计算 ----
104	  const path = state.centerline.points.length >= 2
105	    ? samplePath(state.centerline.points, state.centerline.closed, 20)
106	    : null;
107	
108	  // ---- 马匹预览 ----
109	  const horsePreviews = path ? Array.from({ length: state.previewHorseCount }, (_, i) => {
110	    const s = (state.previewProgress + i * 0.03) % 1;
111	    const sampled = sampleAt(path, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s)));
112	    if (!sampled) return null;
113	    const lane = state.lanes[i % state.lanes.length];
114	    const n = normal(sampled.tangent);
115	    const offset = lane?.offset ?? 0;
116	    return { x: sampled.point.x + n.x * offset, y: sampled.point.y + n.y * offset, angle: (tangentAngle(sampled.tangent) * 180) / Math.PI, idx: i };
117	  }).filter(Boolean) : [];
118	
119	  const vb = state.viewBox;
120	  const selectedIdx = state.selectedPointIndex;
121	
122	  return (
123	    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "calc(100vh - 40px)", gap: 8 }}>
124	      {/* Toolbar */}
125	      <div className="cal-bar">
126	        <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" style={{ display: "none" }} onChange={handleBgFile} />
127	        <input ref={profileInputRef} type="file" accept=".json" style={{ display: "none" }} onChange={handleProfileFile} />
128	        <button onClick={handleImportBg}>📷 导入底图</button>
129	        <button onClick={handleImportProfile}>📂 导入 Profile</button>
130	        <button onClick={handleValidate}>✓ 校验</button>
131	        <button onClick={handleExport} className="cal-btn1">⬇ 导出</button>
132	        <span className="cal-inf">点数: {state.centerline.points.length}{path ? ` | 路径: ${Math.round(path.totalLength)}px` : ""}</span>
133	      </div>
134	
135	      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
136	        {/* Main SVG Area */}
137	        <div style={{ flex: 1, background: "#1a1a1a", border: "1px solid #ccc", position: "relative", overflow: "hidden" }}>
138	          {!state.background && (
139	            <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#888", zIndex: 1, pointerEvents: "none", gap: 8 }}>
140	              <div style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>📷</div>
141	              <div>点击上方「导入底图」加载赛道图片</div>
142	              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#555" }}>加载后双击添加控制点，拖拽移动，右键删除</div>
143	            </div>
144	          )}
145	          {state.background && (
146	            <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, left: 8, zIndex: 2, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)", color: "#4f4", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 12, pointerEvents: "none" }}>
147	              ✓ 底图已加载 ({state.background.naturalWidth}×{state.background.naturalHeight}) | 双击添加点 | 拖拽移动 | 右键删除
148	            </div>
149	          )}
150	
151	          <svg
152	            viewBox={`0 0 ${vb.w} ${vb.h}`}
153	            style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", position: "absolute", inset: 0, cursor: dragRef.current ? "grabbing" : "crosshair" }}
154	            onMouseMove={onSvgMouseMove}
155	            onMouseUp={onSvgMouseUp}
156	            onMouseLeave={onSvgMouseUp}
157	            onDoubleClick={onSvgDoubleClick}
158	          >
159	            {/* 背景 */}
160	            {bgImage && <image href={state.background?.src ?? ""} width={vb.w} height={vb.h} />}
161	
162	            {/* 采样路径 */}
163	            {path && path.points.length > 1 && (
164	              <>
165	                <polyline points={path.points.map(p => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(" ")} fill="none" stroke="rgba(60,140,200,0.5)" strokeWidth={6} />
166	                {/* 方向箭头 */}
167	                {path.points.filter((_, i) => i % 50 === 0).map((p, i) => {
168	                  const j = Math.min(i * 50 + 1, path.points.length - 1);
169	                  const q = path.points[j];

171	                  return <polygon key={i} points="-8,-4 8,0 -8,4" fill="rgba(60,140,200,0.4)" transform={`translate(${p.x},${p.y}) rotate(${a})`} />;
172	                })}

202	              return <g key={cp.id}><rect x={r.point.x + n.x * 40 - 8} y={r.point.y + n.y * 40 - 8} width={16} height={16} fill="#fa0" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth={1} transform={`rotate(45, ${r.point.x + n.x * 40}, ${r.point.y + n.y * 40})`} /></g>;

13	export default function CalibratorClient() {

20	  // 自动播放

22	    if (!state.isPlaying) return;
23	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
24	      dispatch({ type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS", payload: (state.previewProgress + 0.002 * state.previewSpeed) % 1 });
25	    }, 16);
26	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
27	  }, [state.isPlaying, state.previewProgress, state.previewSpeed]);
28	
29	  // ---- 拖拽处理（SVG 原生事件，viewBox 坐标） ----
30	  const onPointMouseDown = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
31	    e.stopPropagation();
32	    dragRef.current = { index, ox: e.clientX, oy: e.clientY, px: state.centerline.points[index].x, py: state.centerline.points[index].y };
33	    dispatch({ type: "SELECT_POINT", payload: index });
34	  }, [state.centerline.points]);
35	
36	  const onPointContextMenu = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
37	    e.preventDefault();
38	    e.stopPropagation();
39	    dispatch({ type: "DELETE_POINT", payload: { index } });
40	  }, []);
41	
42	  const onSvgMouseMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
43	    if (!dragRef.current) return;
44	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
45	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
46	    pt.x = e.clientX;
47	    pt.y = e.clientY;
48	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
49	    if (!ctm) return;
50	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
51	    const dx = svgPt.x - dragRef.current.px;
52	    const dy = svgPt.y - dragRef.current.py;
53	    dispatch({ type: "MOVE_POINT", payload: { index: dragRef.current.index, point: { x: dragRef.current.px + dx, y: dragRef.current.py + dy } } });
54	  }, []);
55	
56	  const onSvgMouseUp = useCallback(() => { dragRef.current = null; }, []);
57

60	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
61	    pt.x = e.clientX;
62	    pt.y = e.clientY;
63	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
64	    if (!ctm) return;
65	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
66	    dispatch({ type: "ADD_POINT", payload: { x: svgPt.x, y: svgPt.y } });
67	  }, []);
68	
69	  // ---- 导入/导出 ----

72	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
73	    const reader = new FileReader();
74	    reader.onload = () => {
75	      const img = new Image();
76	      img.onload = () => { setBgImage(img); dispatch({ type: "SET_BACKGROUND", payload: { src: reader.result as string, naturalWidth: img.naturalWidth, naturalHeight: img.naturalHeight } }); };
77	      img.src = reader.result as string;
78	    };
79	    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
80	  }, []);
81	
82	  const handleImportProfile = useCallback(() => profileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
83	  const handleProfileFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
84	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
85	    const reader = new FileReader();
86	    reader.onload = () => {
87	      try { const profile = JSON.parse(reader.result as string); dispatch({ type: "LOAD_PROFILE", payload: profile }); } catch { alert("JSON 解析失败"); }
88	    };
89	    reader.readAsText(file);
90	  }, []);
91	
92	  const handleValidate = useCallback(() => {
93	    const result = validateTrackProfile(toTrackProfile(state));

1	"use client";
2	
3	import { useReducer, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useState } from "react";
4	import {
5	  calibratorReducer,
6	  createInitialState,
7	  toTrackProfile,
8	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/calibrator/CalibratorState";
9	import { samplePath, sampleAt, tangentAngle, normal } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/path-sampler";
10	import { validateTrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/validator";
11	import type { Point } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
12	
13	export default function CalibratorClient() {
14	  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(calibratorReducer, null, createInitialState);
15	  const [bgImage, setBgImage] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
16	  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
17	  const profileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
18	  const dragRef = useRef<{ index: number; ox: number; oy: number; px: number; py: number } | null>(null);
19	
20	  // 自动播放
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    if (!state.isPlaying) return;
23	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
24	      dispatch({ type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS", payload: (state.previewProgress + 0.002 * state.previewSpeed) % 1 });
25	    }, 16);
26	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
27	  }, [state.isPlaying, state.previewProgress, state.previewSpeed]);
28	
29	  // ---- 拖拽处理（SVG 原生事件，viewBox 坐标） ----
30	  const onPointMouseDown = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
31	    e.stopPropagation();

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

31	    e.stopPropagation();

46	    pt.x = e.clientX;
47	    pt.y = e.clientY;

52	    const dy = svgPt.y - dragRef.current.py;
53	    dispatch({ type: "MOVE_POINT", payload: { index: dragRef.current.index, point: { x: dragRef.current.px + dx, y: dragRef.current.py + dy } } });

62	    pt.y = e.clientY;

65	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());

67	  }, []);

152	      return {

162	      const points = [...state.centerline.points];

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}
16

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}
178	
179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

1	import {
2	  ConsoleShell,
3	  buildConsoleSectionNavItems,
4	  screenConsoleModes,
5	} from "@/app/_components/console/console-shell";
6	import { ScreenConsolePageView } from "@/app/_components/console/screen-console-page";
7	import { loadDatabaseUser } from "@/lib/auth";
8	import { getEffectiveTrackProfileFromSnapshot } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-config";
9	import { getConsoleRaceBySlug } from "@/lib/services/console-routes";
10	import { buildRaceSnapshot } from "@/lib/services/race-snapshot";
11	import { getConsoleScreenAccess } from "@/lib/viewer-access";
12	import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
13	
14	const screenModeLabels: Record<string, string> = {
15	  jumbotron: "大屏",
16	  billboard: "看板",
17	  live: "实况",
18	  leaderboard: "榜单",
19	  works: "作品",
20	  announcement: "公告",
21	  calibration: "校准",
22	};
23	
24	export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
25	
26	interface Props {
27	  params: Promise<{ mode: string; raceSlug: string }>;
28	}
29	
30	export default async function ScreenConsoleModePage({ params }: Props) {
31	  const sessionUser = await loadDatabaseUser();
32	  const access = getConsoleScreenAccess(sessionUser?.roles ?? null);
33	
34	  if (!access.allowed) {
35	    redirect(access.redirectTo ?? "/console");
36	  }
37	
38	  const { mode, raceSlug } = await params;
39	  if (!screenConsoleModes.includes(mode as (typeof screenConsoleModes)[number])) {
40	    notFound();
41	  }
42	
43	  const context = await getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug);
44	  if (!context) {
45	    notFound();
46	  }
47	
48	  const jumbotronPreview =
49	    mode === "jumbotron"
50	      ? await buildJumbotronPreview(context.race.id)
51	      : undefined;
52	
53	  return (
54	    <ConsoleShell
55	      breadcrumbs={[
56	        { href: "/console", label: "控制台" },
57	        { href: "/console/screen", label: "大屏控制台" },
58	        { href: `/console/screen/${raceSlug}/jumbotron`, label: context.race.title },
59	        { label: screenModeLabels[mode] ?? mode },
60	      ]}
61	      description="按 `grs003` 模式分支组织的大屏控制路由。"
62	      navItems={buildConsoleSectionNavItems({
63	        baseHref: `/console/screen/${raceSlug}`,
64	        items: screenConsoleModes,
65	        labels: screenModeLabels,
66	      })}
67	      title={`${context.race.title} / 大屏`}
68	      user={{ username: sessionUser.username, roles: sessionUser.roles }}
69	    >
70	      <ScreenConsolePageView
71	        mode={mode as (typeof screenConsoleModes)[number]}
72	        race={context.race}
73	        raceSlug={raceSlug}
74	        jumbotronPreview={jumbotronPreview}
75	      />
76	    </ConsoleShell>
77	  );
78	}
79	
80	async function buildJumbotronPreview(raceId: string) {
81	  const snapshot = await buildRaceSnapshot(raceId);
82	  const trackProfile = getEffectiveTrackProfileFromSnapshot(snapshot);
83	  return { snapshot, trackProfile };
84	}

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}
16

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");

14	const adminSectionLabels: Record<string, string> = {
15	  users: "用户列表",
16	  "profile-completion": "资料补全",
17	  roles: "角色维护",
18	  "race-requests": "办赛申请审核",

21	export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

24	  params: Promise<{ section: string }>;
25	}

27	export default async function AdminConsoleSectionPage({ params }: Props) {
28	  const sessionUser = await loadDatabaseUser();
29	  const access = getConsoleAdminAccess(sessionUser?.roles ?? null);
30	
31	  if (!access.allowed) {
32	    redirect(access.redirectTo ?? "/console");
33	  }
34	
35	  const { section } = await params;
36	  if (
37	    !adminConsoleSections.includes(
38	      section as (typeof adminConsoleSections)[number],

40	  ) {
41	    notFound();
42	  }
43	
44	  const users = await listUsers();
45	  const cooperationRequests = await listCooperationRequests();
46

50	        { href: "/console", label: "控制台" },
51	        { href: "/console/admin/users", label: "管理控制台" },
52	        { label: adminSectionLabels[section] ?? section },
53	      ]}
54	      description="最小账号治理视图，用于查看用户、资料补全状态与角色维护。"
55	      navItems={buildConsoleSectionNavItems({
56	        baseHref: "/console/admin",
57	        items: adminConsoleSections,
58	        labels: adminSectionLabels,
59	      })}
60	      title="管理控制台"
61	      user={{ username: sessionUser.username, roles: sessionUser.roles }}
62	    >
63	      {section === "race-requests" ? (
64	        <RaceRequestsPageView requests={cooperationRequests} />
65	      ) : (
66	        <AdminConsolePageView
67	          section={section as (typeof adminConsoleSections)[number]}
68	          users={users}
69	        />
70	      )}
71	    </ConsoleShell>
72	  );
73	}

360	export async function clearRace(input: {
361	  organizerId: string;
362	  raceId: string;
363	}) {
364	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
365	    where: {
366	      id: input.raceId,
367	    },
368	  });
369	
370	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
371	    throw new Error("无权清空这场比赛");
372	  }
373	
374	  await prisma.race.delete({
375	    where: {
376	      id: input.raceId,
377	    },
378	  });
379	}

381	export async function updateRaceDisplayOptions(input: {
382	  organizerId: string;
383	  raceId: string;
384	  displayShowTrainingData: boolean;
385	  displayShowOrganizerComment: boolean;
386	  displayShowTopHighlights: boolean;
387	  displayHighlightCount: number;
388	  displayShowRiderCode: boolean;
389	}) {
390	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
391	    where: { id: input.raceId },
392	  });
393	
394	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
395	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
396	  }
397	
398	  const shouldClearTrainingData =
399	    race.displayShowTrainingData && !input.displayShowTrainingData;
400	  const shouldClearOrganizerComment =
401	    race.displayShowOrganizerComment && !input.displayShowOrganizerComment;
402	  const shouldClearHighlights =
403	    race.displayShowTopHighlights && !input.displayShowTopHighlights;
404	  const shouldClearRiderCode =
405	    race.displayShowRiderCode && !input.displayShowRiderCode;
406	
407	  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
408	    await tx.race.update({
409	      where: { id: input.raceId },
410	      data: {
411	        displayShowTrainingData: input.displayShowTrainingData,
412	        displayShowOrganizerComment: input.displayShowOrganizerComment,
413	        displayShowTopHighlights: input.displayShowTopHighlights,
414	        displayHighlightCount: input.displayHighlightCount,
415	        displayShowRiderCode: input.displayShowRiderCode,
416	      },
417	    });
418	
419	    if (shouldClearTrainingData) {
420	      await tx.race.update({
421	        where: { id: input.raceId },
422	        data: { trainingDataSummary: "" },
423	      });
424	    }
425	
426	    if (shouldClearOrganizerComment) {
427	      await tx.race.update({
428	        where: { id: input.raceId },
429	        data: { organizerComment: "" },
430	      });
431	    }
432	
433	    if (shouldClearHighlights) {
434	      await tx.ridingHighlight.deleteMany({
435	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
436	      });
437	    }
438	
439	    if (shouldClearRiderCode) {
440	      await tx.ridingHighlight.updateMany({
441	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
442	        data: { codeSnippet: "Organizer 未公开 Rider 代码。" },
443	      });
444	
445	      await tx.teamArchive.updateMany({
446	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
447	        data: { codeContent: "" },
448	      });
449	    }
450	  });
451	}

453	export function groupRacesByPhase<T extends { phase: string }>(races: T[]) {
454	  return {
455	    registration: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "registration"),
456	    preparation: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "preparation"),
457	    active: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "active"),
458	    frozen: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "frozen"),
459	    finished: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "finished"),
460	  };
461	}

274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
294	}

278	export async function updateRaceContent(input: {
279	  organizerId: string;
280	  raceId: string;
281	  taskDescription: string;
282	  trainingDataSummary: string;
283	}) {
284	  const race = await prisma.race.findUnique({
285	    where: {
286	      id: input.raceId,
287	    },
288	  });
289	
290	  if (!race || race.organizerId !== input.organizerId) {
291	    throw new Error("无权修改这场比赛");
292	  }
293	
294	  if (getRacePhase(race) === "finished") {
295	    throw new Error("比赛结束后不能再修改题目与训练数据");
296	  }
297	
298	  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
299	    const updatedRace = await tx.race.update({
300	      where: {
301	        id: input.raceId,
302	      },
303	      data: {
304	        taskDescription: input.taskDescription.trim(),
305	        trainingDataSummary: input.trainingDataSummary.trim(),
306	        lastLeaderboardSyncAt: null,
307	        lastShowcaseSyncAt: null,
308	      },
309	    });
310	
311	    await tx.leaderboardEntry.deleteMany({
312	      where: { raceId: input.raceId },
313	    });
314	
315	    await tx.runnerTask.deleteMany({
316	      where: { raceId: input.raceId, taskType: "PROGRESS_EVAL" },
317	    });
318	
319	    await tx.notification.create({
320	      data: {
321	        raceId: input.raceId,
322	        title: "题目已更新",
323	        content: `Organizer 更新了 ${updatedRace.title} 的题目描述或训练数据说明，原进度投影已清空`,
324	        target: "ALL",
325	      },
326	    });
327	
328	    return updatedRace;
329	  });
330	
331	  deleteRaceSnapshot(input.raceId);
332	  return updated;
333	}

433	    if (shouldClearHighlights) {

435	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
436	      });
437	    }
438

440	      await tx.ridingHighlight.updateMany({

442	        data: { codeSnippet: "Organizer 未公开 Rider 代码。" },
443	      });
444	
445	      await tx.teamArchive.updateMany({
446	        where: { raceId: input.raceId },
447	        data: { codeContent: "" },
448	      });
449	    }
450	  });
451	}
452	
453	export function groupRacesByPhase<T extends { phase: string }>(races: T[]) {
454	  return {
455	    registration: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "registration"),
456	    preparation: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "preparation"),
457	    active: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "active"),
458	    frozen: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "frozen"),
459	    finished: races.filter((race) => race.phase === "finished"),
460	  };
461	}
462	
463	export type RaceListItem = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listRaces>>[number];
464	
465	function normalizeDateTimeInput(value: FormDataEntryValue | null): string {
466	  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) {
467	    return "";
468	  }
469	
470	  return new Date(value).toISOString();
471	}

278	  } catch {

280	  }

283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}

274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");

262	function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
263	  if (!value) return null;
264	  return (
265	    <div style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
266	      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.8125rem" }}>{label}：</span>
267	      <span style={{ fontSize: "0.8125rem", color: "var(--muted-foreground)" }}>
268	        {value}
269	      </span>
270	    </div>
271	  );
272	}
273	
274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
294	}
