1	import { buildRaceSlug, getRaceIdFromSlug } from "@/lib/public-site";
2	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
3	import type { RaceListItem } from "@/lib/services/races";
4	import { listRaces } from "@/lib/services/races";
5	import { getCompatibilityContainerForRegistration } from "@/lib/services/rider-bridge";
6	import type { AppRole } from "@/lib/user-roles";
7	import { hasRole, normalizeRoles } from "@/lib/user-roles";
8	
9	export type ConsoleRaceAccess = "judge" | "organizer" | "rider";
10	
11	export type ConsoleRaceListItem = {
12	  access: ConsoleRaceAccess;
13	  defaultHref: string;
14	  race: RaceListItem;
15	  slug: string;
16	};
17	
18	export async function listConsoleRacesForUser(input: {
19	  roles: readonly AppRole[];
20	  userId: string;
21	}): Promise<ConsoleRaceListItem[]> {
22	  const roles = normalizeRoles(input.roles);
23	  const races = await listRaces();
24	  const items: ConsoleRaceListItem[] = [];
25	
26	  if (hasRole(roles, "ORGANIZER")) {
27	    items.push(
28	      ...races
29	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => race.organizerId === input.userId)
30	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
31	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
32	          return {
33	            access: "organizer" as const,
34	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/organizer/overview`,
35	            race,
36	            slug,
37	          };
38	        }),
39	    );
40	  }
41	
42	  if (hasRole(roles, "RIDER")) {
43	    items.push(
44	      ...races
45	        .filter(
46	          (race: RaceListItem) =>
47	            race.registrations.some(
48	              (registration: RaceListItem["registrations"][number]) =>
49	                registration.userId === input.userId,
50	            ),
51	        )
52	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
53	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
54	          return {
55	            access: "rider" as const,
56	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/rider/registration`,
57	            race,
58	            slug,
59	          };
60	        }),
61	    );
62	  }
63	
64	  if (hasRole(roles, "JUDGE")) {
65	    const assignments = await prisma.judgeAssignment.findMany({
66	      where: {
67	        judgeId: input.userId,
68	      },
69	      select: {
70	        work: {
71	          select: {
72	            registration: {
73	              select: {
74	                raceId: true,
75	              },
76	            },
77	          },
78	        },
79	      },
80	    });
81	    const assignedRaceIds = new Set(
82	      assignments.map(
83	        (assignment: { work: { registration: { raceId: string } } }) =>
84	          assignment.work.registration.raceId,
85	      ),
86	    );
87	
88	    items.push(
89	      ...races
90	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => assignedRaceIds.has(race.id))
91	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
92	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
93	          return {
94	            access: "judge" as const,
95	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/judge/assigned`,
96	            race,
97	            slug,
98	          };
99	        }),
100	    );
101	  }
102	
103	  const seen = new Set<string>();
104	  return items.filter((item) => {
105	    const key = `${item.access}-${item.race.id}`;
106	    if (seen.has(key)) {
107	      return false;
108	    }
109	    seen.add(key);
110	    return true;
111	  });
112	}
113	
114	export async function listScreenConsoleRacesForUser(input: {
115	  roles: readonly AppRole[];
116	  userId: string;
117	}): Promise<Array<{ defaultHref: string; race: RaceListItem; slug: string }>> {
118	  const roles = normalizeRoles(input.roles);
119	  const races = await listRaces();
120	
121	  if (hasRole(roles, "ADMIN")) {
122	    // 企业能力尚未独立建模，当前由 Admin 代理大屏控制台可见范围。
123	    return races.map((race: RaceListItem) => {
124	      const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
125	      return {
126	        defaultHref: `/console/screen/${slug}/jumbotron`,
127	        race,
128	        slug,
129	      };
130	    });
131	  }
132	
133	  return [];
134	}
135	
136	export async function getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug: string): Promise<{
137	  race: RaceListItem;
138	  slug: string;
139	} | null> {
140	  const races = await listRaces();
141	  const exactMatch = races.find(
142	    (item: RaceListItem) => buildRaceSlug(item.id, item.title) === raceSlug,
143	  );
144	  const race =
145	    exactMatch ??
146	    races.find((item: RaceListItem) => item.id === getRaceIdFromSlug(raceSlug));
147	
148	  if (!race) {
149	    return null;
150	  }
151	
152	  return {
153	    race,
154	    slug: buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title),
155	  };
156	}
157	
158	export async function getConsoleRiderTeamContext(input: {
159	  raceId: string;
160	  userId: string;
161	}) {
162	  return getCompatibilityContainerForRegistration({
163	    raceId: input.raceId,
164	    userId: input.userId,
165	  });
166	}

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}
16

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}
178	
179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

1	import { ConsoleShell, buildConsoleSectionNavItems, organizerConsoleSections } from "@/app/_components/console/console-shell";
2	import { OrganizerConsolePageView } from "@/app/_components/console/organizer-console-page";
3	import { loadDatabaseUser } from "@/lib/auth";
4	import { getConsoleRaceBySlug } from "@/lib/services/console-routes";
5	import { listJudgeAssignmentsForRace } from "@/lib/services/judging";
6	import { listUsersByRole } from "@/lib/services/users";
7	import { getConsoleRaceViewAccess } from "@/lib/viewer-access";
8	import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
9	
10	const organizerSectionLabels: Record<string, string> = {
11	  overview: "总览",
12	  settings: "设置",
13	  registrations: "报名",
14	  riders: "骑手",
15	  "ca-status": "CA 状态",
16	  works: "作品",
17	  judges: "评委分配",
18	  judging: "评审进度",
19	  awards: "奖项",
20	  reports: "报告",
21	  maintenance: "维护",
22	};
23	
24	export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
25	
26	interface Props {
27	  params: Promise<{ raceSlug: string; section: string }>;
28	}
29	
30	export default async function OrganizerConsoleSectionPage({ params }: Props) {
31	  const sessionUser = await loadDatabaseUser();
32	
33	  if (!sessionUser) {
34	    redirect("/login");
35	  }
36	
37	  const { raceSlug, section } = await params;
38	  if (!organizerConsoleSections.includes(section as (typeof organizerConsoleSections)[number])) {
39	    notFound();
40	  }
41	
42	  const context = await getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug);
43	  if (!context) {
44	    notFound();
45	  }
46	
47	  const access = getConsoleRaceViewAccess({
48	    roles: sessionUser.roles,
49	    view: "organizer",
50	    isRaceOrganizer: context.race.organizerId === sessionUser.id,
51	    isRaceRider: false,
52	  });
53	
54	  if (!access.allowed) {
55	    redirect(access.redirectTo ?? "/console/races");
56	  }
57	
58	  const [judgeAssignments, judges] = await Promise.all([
59	    listJudgeAssignmentsForRace(context.race.id),
60	    listUsersByRole("JUDGE"),
61	  ]);
62	
63	  return (
64	    <ConsoleShell
65	      breadcrumbs={[
66	        { href: "/console", label: "控制台" },
67	        { href: "/console/races", label: "赛事控制台" },
68	        { href: `/console/races/${raceSlug}`, label: context.race.title },
69	        { label: organizerSectionLabels[section] ?? section },
70	      ]}
71	      description="主办方在单场赛事上下文中的工作台。"
72	      navItems={buildConsoleSectionNavItems({
73	        baseHref: `/console/races/${raceSlug}/organizer`,
74	        items: organizerConsoleSections,
75	        labels: organizerSectionLabels,
76	      })}
77	      title={`${context.race.title} / 主办方`}
78	      user={{ username: sessionUser.username, roles: sessionUser.roles }}
79	    >
80	      <OrganizerConsolePageView
81	        judgeAssignments={judgeAssignments}
82	        judges={judges.map((judge) => ({ id: judge.id, username: judge.username }))}
83	        race={context.race}
84	        raceSlug={raceSlug}
85	        section={section as (typeof organizerConsoleSections)[number]}
86	      />
87	    </ConsoleShell>
88	  );
89	}

62	    >

67	          section={section as (typeof adminConsoleSections)[number]}

3	import type { Point, TrackProfile, Lane, Checkpoint } from "../track-runtime/types";

5	export interface CalibratorState {
6	  // 赛道元信息
7	  trackId: string;
8	  name: string;

11	  // 画布 & 背景

25	  };
26

53	export type CalibratorAction =

57	  | { type: "ADD_POINT"; payload: Point }
58	  | { type: "MOVE_POINT"; payload: { index: number; point: Point } }
59	  | { type: "DELETE_POINT"; payload: { index: number } }
60	  | { type: "SELECT_POINT"; payload: number | null }

62	  | { type: "END_DRAG" }
63	  | { type: "SET_CLOSED"; payload: boolean }
64	  | { type: "REVERSE_DIRECTION" }
65	  | { type: "SET_START_FINISH"; payload: number }
66	  | { type: "ADD_LANE"; payload: Lane }
67	  | { type: "UPDATE_LANE"; payload: { index: number; lane: Lane } }
68	  | { type: "REMOVE_LANE"; payload: { index: number } }

111	      { id: "lane-2", name: "外侧车道", offset: 60 },

126	export function calibratorReducer(
127	  state: CalibratorState,
128	  action: CalibratorAction,
129	): CalibratorState {
130	  switch (action.type) {
131	    case "SET_BACKGROUND":
132	      return {
133	        ...state,
134	        background: action.payload,
135	        viewBox: { w: action.payload.naturalWidth, h: action.payload.naturalHeight },
136	      };
137	
138	    case "SET_VIEWBOX":
139	      return { ...state, viewBox: action.payload };
140	
141	    case "SET_NAME":
142	      return { ...state, name: action.payload };
143	
144	    case "ADD_POINT": {
145	      const points = state.selectedPointIndex !== null
146	        ? [
147	            ...state.centerline.points.slice(0, state.selectedPointIndex + 1),
148	            action.payload,
149	            ...state.centerline.points.slice(state.selectedPointIndex + 1),
150	          ]
151	        : [...state.centerline.points, action.payload];
152	      return {
153	        ...state,
154	        centerline: { ...state.centerline, points },
155	        selectedPointIndex: state.selectedPointIndex !== null
156	          ? state.selectedPointIndex + 1
157	          : points.length - 1,
158	      };
159	    }
160	
161	    case "MOVE_POINT": {
162	      const points = [...state.centerline.points];
163	      if (points[action.payload.index]) {
164	        points[action.payload.index] = action.payload.point;
165	      }
166	      return { ...state, centerline: { ...state.centerline, points } };
167	    }
168	
169	    case "DELETE_POINT": {
170	      const points = state.centerline.points.filter(
171	        (_, i) => i !== action.payload.index,
172	      );
173	      return {
174	        ...state,
175	        centerline: { ...state.centerline, points },
176	        selectedPointIndex: null,
177	      };
178	    }
179	
180	    case "SELECT_POINT":
181	      return { ...state, selectedPointIndex: action.payload };
182	
183	    case "START_DRAG":
184	      return { ...state, isDragging: true };
185	
186	    case "END_DRAG":
187	      return { ...state, isDragging: false };
188	
189	    case "SET_CLOSED":
190	      return { ...state, centerline: { ...state.centerline, closed: action.payload } };
191	
192	    case "REVERSE_DIRECTION":
193	      return {
194	        ...state,
195	        centerline: {
196	          ...state.centerline,
197	          points: [...state.centerline.points].reverse(),
198	        },
199	        direction: state.direction === "clockwise" ? "counterclockwise" : "clockwise",
200	      };
201	
202	    case "SET_START_FINISH":
203	      return { ...state, startFinish: { s: action.payload } };
204	
205	    case "ADD_LANE":
206	      return { ...state, lanes: [...state.lanes, action.payload] };
207	
208	    case "UPDATE_LANE": {
209	      const lanes = [...state.lanes];
210	      lanes[action.payload.index] = action.payload.lane;
211	      return { ...state, lanes };
212	    }
213	
214	    case "REMOVE_LANE": {
215	      const lanes = state.lanes.filter((_, i) => i !== action.payload.index);
216	      return { ...state, lanes };
217	    }
218	
219	    case "ADD_CHECKPOINT":
220	      return { ...state, checkpoints: [...state.checkpoints, action.payload] };
221	
222	    case "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT": {
223	      const checkpoints = [...state.checkpoints];
224	      checkpoints[action.payload.index] = action.payload.checkpoint;
225	      return { ...state, checkpoints };
226	    }
227	
228	    case "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT": {
229	      const checkpoints = state.checkpoints.filter(
230	        (_, i) => i !== action.payload.index,
231	      );
232	      return { ...state, checkpoints };
233	    }
234	
235	    case "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS":
236	      return { ...state, previewProgress: action.payload };
237	
238	    case "SET_PREVIEW_HORSE_COUNT":
239	      return { ...state, previewHorseCount: action.payload };
240	
241	    case "SET_PREVIEW_SPEED":
242	      return { ...state, previewSpeed: action.payload };
243	
244	    case "TOGGLE_PLAY":
245	      return { ...state, isPlaying: !state.isPlaying };
246	
247	    case "SET_VALIDATION":
248	      return {
249	        ...state,
250	        validationErrors: action.payload.errors,
251	        validationWarnings: action.payload.warnings,
252	      };
253	
254	    case "LOAD_PROFILE": {
255	      const p = action.payload;
256	      return {
257	        ...state,
258	        trackId: p.trackId,
259	        name: p.name,
260	        schemaVersion: p.schemaVersion,

3	import type { Point, TrackProfile, Lane, Checkpoint } from "../track-runtime/types";

5	export interface CalibratorState {
6	  // 赛道元信息
7	  trackId: string;
8	  name: string;
9	  schemaVersion: string;
10	
11	  // 画布 & 背景
12	  viewBox: { w: number; h: number };
13	  background: {
14	    src: string;
15	    naturalWidth: number;
16	    naturalHeight: number;
17	  } | null;
18	
19	  // 中心线
20	  centerline: {
21	    type: "polyline";
22	    closed: boolean;
23	    points: Point[];
24	    smoothing: "catmull-rom" | "linear";
25	  };
26	
27	  // 方向 & 起终点
28	  direction: "clockwise" | "counterclockwise";
29	  startFinish: { s: number };
30	
31	  // 车道
32	  lanes: Lane[];
33	
34	  // 检查点
35	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
36	
37	  // 交互状态
38	  selectedPointIndex: number | null;
39	  isDragging: boolean;
40	  canvasScale: number;
41	
42	  // 预览
43	  previewProgress: number;
44	  previewHorseCount: number;
45	  previewSpeed: number;
46	  isPlaying: boolean;
47	
48	  // 校验
49	  validationErrors: string[];
50	  validationWarnings: string[];
51	}

53	export type CalibratorAction =
54	  | { type: "SET_BACKGROUND"; payload: { src: string; naturalWidth: number; naturalHeight: number } }
55	  | { type: "SET_VIEWBOX"; payload: { w: number; h: number } }
56	  | { type: "SET_NAME"; payload: string }
57	  | { type: "ADD_POINT"; payload: Point }
58	  | { type: "MOVE_POINT"; payload: { index: number; point: Point } }
59	  | { type: "DELETE_POINT"; payload: { index: number } }
60	  | { type: "SELECT_POINT"; payload: number | null }
61	  | { type: "START_DRAG" }
62	  | { type: "END_DRAG" }
63	  | { type: "SET_CLOSED"; payload: boolean }
64	  | { type: "REVERSE_DIRECTION" }
65	  | { type: "SET_START_FINISH"; payload: number }
66	  | { type: "ADD_LANE"; payload: Lane }
67	  | { type: "UPDATE_LANE"; payload: { index: number; lane: Lane } }
68	  | { type: "REMOVE_LANE"; payload: { index: number } }
69	  | { type: "ADD_CHECKPOINT"; payload: Checkpoint }
70	  | { type: "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT"; payload: { index: number; checkpoint: Checkpoint } }
71	  | { type: "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT"; payload: { index: number } }
72	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS"; payload: number }
73	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_HORSE_COUNT"; payload: number }
74	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_SPEED"; payload: number }
75	  | { type: "TOGGLE_PLAY" }
76	  | { type: "SET_VALIDATION"; payload: { errors: string[]; warnings: string[] } }
77	  | { type: "LOAD_PROFILE"; payload: TrackProfile }
78	  | { type: "SET_SCALE"; payload: number };

93	        { x: 2172, y: 376 },
94	        { x: 2310, y: 631 },
95	        { x: 2172, y: 886 },
96	        { x: 1795, y: 1073 },
97	        { x: 1280, y: 1141 },
98	        { x: 765, y: 1073 },
99	        { x: 388, y: 886 },
100	        { x: 250, y: 631 },

111	      { id: "lane-2", name: "外侧车道", offset: 60 },
112	    ],

116	    canvasScale: 1,

126	export function calibratorReducer(
127	  state: CalibratorState,
128	  action: CalibratorAction,
129	): CalibratorState {
130	  switch (action.type) {
131	    case "SET_BACKGROUND":
132	      return {
133	        ...state,
134	        background: action.payload,
135	        viewBox: { w: action.payload.naturalWidth, h: action.payload.naturalHeight },
136	      };
137	
138	    case "SET_VIEWBOX":
139	      return { ...state, viewBox: action.payload };
140	
141	    case "SET_NAME":
142	      return { ...state, name: action.payload };
143	
144	    case "ADD_POINT": {
145	      const points = state.selectedPointIndex !== null
146	        ? [
147	            ...state.centerline.points.slice(0, state.selectedPointIndex + 1),
148	            action.payload,
149	            ...state.centerline.points.slice(state.selectedPointIndex + 1),
150	          ]
151	        : [...state.centerline.points, action.payload];
152	      return {
153	        ...state,
154	        centerline: { ...state.centerline, points },
155	        selectedPointIndex: state.selectedPointIndex !== null
156	          ? state.selectedPointIndex + 1
157	          : points.length - 1,
158	      };
159	    }
160	
161	    case "MOVE_POINT": {
162	      const points = [...state.centerline.points];
163	      if (points[action.payload.index]) {
164	        points[action.payload.index] = action.payload.point;
165	      }
166	      return { ...state, centerline: { ...state.centerline, points } };
167	    }
168	
169	    case "DELETE_POINT": {
170	      const points = state.centerline.points.filter(
171	        (_, i) => i !== action.payload.index,
172	      );
173	      return {
174	        ...state,
175	        centerline: { ...state.centerline, points },
176	        selectedPointIndex: null,
177	      };
178	    }
179	
180	    case "SELECT_POINT":
181	      return { ...state, selectedPointIndex: action.payload };
182	
183	    case "START_DRAG":
184	      return { ...state, isDragging: true };
185	
186	    case "END_DRAG":
187	      return { ...state, isDragging: false };
188	
189	    case "SET_CLOSED":
190	      return { ...state, centerline: { ...state.centerline, closed: action.payload } };
191	
192	    case "REVERSE_DIRECTION":
193	      return {
194	        ...state,
195	        centerline: {
196	          ...state.centerline,
197	          points: [...state.centerline.points].reverse(),
198	        },
199	        direction: state.direction === "clockwise" ? "counterclockwise" : "clockwise",
200	      };
201	
202	    case "SET_START_FINISH":
203	      return { ...state, startFinish: { s: action.payload } };
204	
205	    case "ADD_LANE":
206	      return { ...state, lanes: [...state.lanes, action.payload] };
207	
208	    case "UPDATE_LANE": {
209	      const lanes = [...state.lanes];
210	      lanes[action.payload.index] = action.payload.lane;
211	      return { ...state, lanes };
212	    }
213	
214	    case "REMOVE_LANE": {
215	      const lanes = state.lanes.filter((_, i) => i !== action.payload.index);
216	      return { ...state, lanes };
217	    }
218	
219	    case "ADD_CHECKPOINT":
220	      return { ...state, checkpoints: [...state.checkpoints, action.payload] };
221	
222	    case "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT": {
223	      const checkpoints = [...state.checkpoints];
224	      checkpoints[action.payload.index] = action.payload.checkpoint;
225	      return { ...state, checkpoints };
226	    }
227	
228	    case "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT": {
229	      const checkpoints = state.checkpoints.filter(
230	        (_, i) => i !== action.payload.index,
231	      );
232	      return { ...state, checkpoints };
233	    }
234	
235	    case "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS":
236	      return { ...state, previewProgress: action.payload };
237	
238	    case "SET_PREVIEW_HORSE_COUNT":
239	      return { ...state, previewHorseCount: action.payload };
240	
241	    case "SET_PREVIEW_SPEED":
242	      return { ...state, previewSpeed: action.payload };
243	
244	    case "TOGGLE_PLAY":
245	      return { ...state, isPlaying: !state.isPlaying };
246	
247	    case "SET_VALIDATION":
248	      return {
249	        ...state,
250	        validationErrors: action.payload.errors,
251	        validationWarnings: action.payload.warnings,
252	      };
253	
254	    case "LOAD_PROFILE": {
255	      const p = action.payload;
256	      return {
257	        ...state,
258	        trackId: p.trackId,
259	        name: p.name,
260	        schemaVersion: p.schemaVersion,
261	        viewBox: p.viewBox,
262	        background: p.background,
263	        centerline: p.centerline,
264	        direction: p.direction,
265	        startFinish: p.startFinish,
266	        lanes: p.lanes,
267	        checkpoints: p.checkpoints,
268	      };
269	    }
270	
271	    case "SET_SCALE":
272	      return { ...state, canvasScale: action.payload };
273	
274	    default:
275	      return state;
276	  }
277	}

282	export function toTrackProfile(state: CalibratorState): TrackProfile {
283	  return {
284	    schemaVersion: state.schemaVersion,
285	    trackId: state.trackId,
286	    name: state.name,
287	    viewBox: state.viewBox,
288	    background: state.background ?? {
289	      src: "",
290	      naturalWidth: state.viewBox.w,
291	      naturalHeight: state.viewBox.h,
292	    },
293	    centerline: state.centerline,
294	    direction: state.direction,
295	    startFinish: state.startFinish,
296	    lanes: state.lanes,
297	    checkpoints: state.checkpoints,
298	  };
299	}

3	import { useReducer, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useState } from "react";
4	import {
5	  calibratorReducer,
6	  createInitialState,
7	  toTrackProfile,
8	} from "@/lib/jumbotron/calibrator/CalibratorState";
9	import { samplePath, sampleAt, tangentAngle, normal } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/path-sampler";
10	import { validateTrackProfile } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/validator";
11	import type { Point } from "@/lib/jumbotron/track-runtime/types";
12	
13	export default function CalibratorClient() {
14	  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(calibratorReducer, null, createInitialState);
15	  const [bgImage, setBgImage] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
16	  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
17	  const profileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
18	  const dragRef = useRef<{ index: number; ox: number; oy: number; px: number; py: number } | null>(null);
19	
20	  // 自动播放
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    if (!state.isPlaying) return;
23	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
24	      dispatch({ type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS", payload: (state.previewProgress + 0.002 * state.previewSpeed) % 1 });
25	    }, 16);
26	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
27	  }, [state.isPlaying, state.previewProgress, state.previewSpeed]);
28	
29	  // ---- 拖拽处理（SVG 原生事件，viewBox 坐标） ----
30	  const onPointMouseDown = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
31	    e.stopPropagation();
32	    dragRef.current = { index, ox: e.clientX, oy: e.clientY, px: state.centerline.points[index].x, py: state.centerline.points[index].y };
33	    dispatch({ type: "SELECT_POINT", payload: index });
34	  }, [state.centerline.points]);
35	
36	  const onPointContextMenu = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
37	    e.preventDefault();
38	    e.stopPropagation();
39	    dispatch({ type: "DELETE_POINT", payload: { index } });
40	  }, []);
41	
42	  const onSvgMouseMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
43	    if (!dragRef.current) return;
44	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
45	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
46	    pt.x = e.clientX;
47	    pt.y = e.clientY;
48	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
49	    if (!ctm) return;
50	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
51	    const dx = svgPt.x - dragRef.current.px;
52	    const dy = svgPt.y - dragRef.current.py;
53	    dispatch({ type: "MOVE_POINT", payload: { index: dragRef.current.index, point: { x: dragRef.current.px + dx, y: dragRef.current.py + dy } } });
54	  }, []);
55	
56	  const onSvgMouseUp = useCallback(() => { dragRef.current = null; }, []);
57	
58	  const onSvgDoubleClick = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
59	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
60	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
61	    pt.x = e.clientX;
62	    pt.y = e.clientY;
63	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
64	    if (!ctm) return;
65	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
66	    dispatch({ type: "ADD_POINT", payload: { x: svgPt.x, y: svgPt.y } });
67	  }, []);
68	
69	  // ---- 导入/导出 ----
70	  const handleImportBg = useCallback(() => fileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
71	  const handleBgFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
72	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
73	    const reader = new FileReader();
74	    reader.onload = () => {
75	      const img = new Image();
76	      img.onload = () => { setBgImage(img); dispatch({ type: "SET_BACKGROUND", payload: { src: reader.result as string, naturalWidth: img.naturalWidth, naturalHeight: img.naturalHeight } }); };
77	      img.src = reader.result as string;
78	    };
79	    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
80	  }, []);
81	
82	  const handleImportProfile = useCallback(() => profileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
83	  const handleProfileFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
84	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
85	    const reader = new FileReader();
86	    reader.onload = () => {
87	      try { const profile = JSON.parse(reader.result as string); dispatch({ type: "LOAD_PROFILE", payload: profile }); } catch { alert("JSON 解析失败"); }
88	    };
89	    reader.readAsText(file);
90	  }, []);
91	
92	  const handleValidate = useCallback(() => {
93	    const result = validateTrackProfile(toTrackProfile(state));
94	    dispatch({ type: "SET_VALIDATION", payload: { errors: result.errors.map(e => `${e.field}: ${e.message}`), warnings: result.warnings.map(w => `${w.field}: ${w.message}`) } });
95	  }, [state]);
96	
97	  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
98	    const json = JSON.stringify(toTrackProfile(state), null, 2);
99	    const blob = new Blob([json], { type: "application/json" });
100	    const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = `${state.trackId}.profile.json`; a.click();
101	  }, [state]);
102	
103	  // ---- 路径计算 ----
104	  const path = state.centerline.points.length >= 2
105	    ? samplePath(state.centerline.points, state.centerline.closed, 20)
106	    : null;
107	
108	  // ---- 马匹预览 ----
109	  const horsePreviews = path ? Array.from({ length: state.previewHorseCount }, (_, i) => {
110	    const s = (state.previewProgress + i * 0.03) % 1;
111	    const sampled = sampleAt(path, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s)));
112	    if (!sampled) return null;
113	    const lane = state.lanes[i % state.lanes.length];
114	    const n = normal(sampled.tangent);
115	    const offset = lane?.offset ?? 0;
116	    return { x: sampled.point.x + n.x * offset, y: sampled.point.y + n.y * offset, angle: (tangentAngle(sampled.tangent) * 180) / Math.PI, idx: i };
117	  }).filter(Boolean) : [];
118	
119	  const vb = state.viewBox;
120	  const selectedIdx = state.selectedPointIndex;
121	
122	  return (
123	    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "calc(100vh - 40px)", gap: 8 }}>
124	      {/* Toolbar */}
125	      <div className="cal-bar">
126	        <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" style={{ display: "none" }} onChange={handleBgFile} />
127	        <input ref={profileInputRef} type="file" accept=".json" style={{ display: "none" }} onChange={handleProfileFile} />
128	        <button onClick={handleImportBg}>📷 导入底图</button>
129	        <button onClick={handleImportProfile}>📂 导入 Profile</button>
130	        <button onClick={handleValidate}>✓ 校验</button>
131	        <button onClick={handleExport} className="cal-btn1">⬇ 导出</button>
132	        <span className="cal-inf">点数: {state.centerline.points.length}{path ? ` | 路径: ${Math.round(path.totalLength)}px` : ""}</span>
133	      </div>
134	
135	      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
136	        {/* Main SVG Area */}
137	        <div style={{ flex: 1, background: "#1a1a1a", border: "1px solid #ccc", position: "relative", overflow: "hidden" }}>
138	          {!state.background && (
139	            <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#888", zIndex: 1, pointerEvents: "none", gap: 8 }}>
140	              <div style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>📷</div>
141	              <div>点击上方「导入底图」加载赛道图片</div>
142	              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#555" }}>加载后双击添加控制点，拖拽移动，右键删除</div>
143	            </div>
144	          )}
145	          {state.background && (
146	            <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, left: 8, zIndex: 2, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)", color: "#4f4", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 12, pointerEvents: "none" }}>
147	              ✓ 底图已加载 ({state.background.naturalWidth}×{state.background.naturalHeight}) | 双击添加点 | 拖拽移动 | 右键删除
148	            </div>
149	          )}
150	
151	          <svg
152	            viewBox={`0 0 ${vb.w} ${vb.h}`}
153	            style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", position: "absolute", inset: 0, cursor: dragRef.current ? "grabbing" : "crosshair" }}
154	            onMouseMove={onSvgMouseMove}
155	            onMouseUp={onSvgMouseUp}
156	            onMouseLeave={onSvgMouseUp}
157	            onDoubleClick={onSvgDoubleClick}
158	          >
159	            {/* 背景 */}
160	            {bgImage && <image href={state.background?.src ?? ""} width={vb.w} height={vb.h} />}
161	
162	            {/* 采样路径 */}
163	            {path && path.points.length > 1 && (
164	              <>
165	                <polyline points={path.points.map(p => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(" ")} fill="none" stroke="rgba(60,140,200,0.5)" strokeWidth={6} />
166	                {/* 方向箭头 */}
167	                {path.points.filter((_, i) => i % 50 === 0).map((p, i) => {
168	                  const j = Math.min(i * 50 + 1, path.points.length - 1);
169	                  const q = path.points[j];
170	                  const a = Math.atan2(q.y - p.y, q.x - p.x) * 180 / Math.PI;
171	                  return <polygon key={i} points="-8,-4 8,0 -8,4" fill="rgba(60,140,200,0.4)" transform={`translate(${p.x},${p.y}) rotate(${a})`} />;
172	                })}
173	              </>
174	            )}
175	
176	            {/* 控制点连线 */}
177	            {state.centerline.points.length > 1 && (

179	            )}
180	
181	            {/* 车道预览 */}
182	            {path && state.lanes.map(lane => (
183	              <polyline
184	                key={lane.id}
185	                points={path.points.map((_, i) => {
186	                  const s = i / (path.points.length - 1 || 1);
187	                  const smp = sampleAt(path, s);

191	                }).join(" ")}
192	                fill="none" stroke="rgba(150,150,150,0.3)" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeDasharray="10,10"
193	              />
194	            ))}

203	            })}

211	                <text x={0} y={-12} textAnchor="middle" fill="#fff" fontSize={10} fontWeight="bold">{hp.idx + 1}</text>
212	              </g>
213	            ))}
214

216	            {state.centerline.points.map((p, i) => (

218	                <circle cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r={i === selectedIdx ? 14 : 10} fill="#fff" stroke={i === selectedIdx ? "#ff6600" : "#4a90d9"} strokeWidth={3}
219	                  style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}

1	import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";

3	import { cookies } from "next/headers";
4	import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
5	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
6	import type { AppRole } from "@/lib/user-roles";
7	import {
8	  getDefaultActiveRole,
9	  hasRole,
10	  normalizeRoles,
11	  parseRolesJson,
12	} from "@/lib/user-roles";
13	
14	const SESSION_COOKIE = "ary_session";
15	const SESSION_SECRET = process.env.SESSION_SECRET ?? "ary-dev-secret-change-me";
16	const encoder = new TextEncoder();
17	
18	export interface SessionUser {
19	  id: string;
20	  role: AppRole;
21	  roles: AppRole[];
22	  username: string;
23	}
24	
25	interface SessionPayload {
26	  roles: AppRole[];
27	  sub: string;
28	  username: string;
29	}
30	
31	export async function hashPassword(password: string): Promise<string> {
32	  return bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
33	}
34	
35	export async function verifyPassword(
36	  password: string,
37	  hash: string,
38	): Promise<boolean> {
39	  return bcrypt.compare(password, hash);
40	}
41	
42	export async function createSession(user: SessionUser): Promise<void> {
43	  const normalizedRoles = normalizeRoles(user.roles);
44	  const token = await new SignJWT({
45	    roles: normalizedRoles,
46	    username: user.username,
47	  } satisfies Omit<SessionPayload, "sub">)
48	    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
49	    .setSubject(user.id)
50	    .setIssuedAt()
51	    .setExpirationTime("7d")
52	    .sign(encoder.encode(SESSION_SECRET));
53	
54	  const store = await cookies();
55	  store.set(SESSION_COOKIE, token, {
56	    httpOnly: true,
57	    sameSite: "lax",
58	    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
59	    path: "/",
60	    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7,
61	  });
62	}
63	
64	export async function clearSession(): Promise<void> {
65	  const store = await cookies();
66	  store.delete(SESSION_COOKIE);
67	}
68	
69	export async function getSessionUser(): Promise<SessionUser | null> {
70	  const store = await cookies();
71	  const token = store.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
72	  if (!token) {
73	    return null;
74	  }
75	
76	  try {
77	    const verified = await jwtVerify(token, encoder.encode(SESSION_SECRET));
78	    const payload = verified.payload as unknown as SessionPayload;
79	    const roles = normalizeRoles(payload.roles);
80	    return {
81	      id: payload.sub,
82	      role: getDefaultActiveRole(roles),
83	      roles,
84	      username: payload.username,
85	    };
86	  } catch {
87	    return null;
88	  }
89	}
90	
91	export async function requireSession(): Promise<SessionUser> {
92	  const user = await getSessionUser();
93	  if (!user) {
94	    redirect("/login");
95	  }
96	  return user;
97	}
98	
99	export async function requireRole(role: AppRole): Promise<SessionUser> {
100	  const user = await requireSession();
101	  if (!hasRole(user.roles, role)) {
102	    redirect("/");
103	  }
104	  return user;
105	}
106	
107	export async function loadDatabaseUser(): Promise<SessionUser | null> {
108	  const session = await getSessionUser();
109	  if (!session) {
110	    return null;
111	  }
112	
113	  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
114	    where: {
115	      id: session.id,
116	    },
117	  });
118	
119	  if (!user) {
120	    return null;
121	  }
122

124	
125	  return {
126	    id: user.id,
127	    role: getDefaultActiveRole(roles),
128	    roles,
129	    username: user.username,
130	  };
131	}

262	function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
263	  if (!value) return null;
264	  return (
265	    <div style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
266	      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.8125rem" }}>{label}：</span>
267	      <span style={{ fontSize: "0.8125rem", color: "var(--muted-foreground)" }}>
268	        {value}
269	      </span>
270	    </div>
271	  );
272	}

274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
294	}

1	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}
16

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",
156	        displayShowTrainingData: request.displayShowTrainingData,
157	        displayShowOrganizerComment: request.displayShowOrganizerComment,
158	        displayShowTopHighlights: request.displayShowTopHighlights,
159	        displayShowRiderCode: request.displayShowRiderCode,
160	        weightTaskPassRate: weights.taskPassRate,
161	        weightCodeReview: weights.codeReview,
162	        weightReasoning: weights.reasoning,
163	        weightKeywords: weights.keywords,
164	        weightTotalTask: weights.totalTask,
165	        weightTotalToken: weights.totalToken,
166	        weightTotalDialogue: weights.totalDialogue,
167	      },
168	    });
169	
170	    await tx.cooperationRequest.update({
171	      where: { id: requestId },
172	      data: { status: "APPROVED" },
173	    });
174	
175	    return race;
176	  });
177	}
178	
179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

1	import { buildRaceSlug, getRaceIdFromSlug } from "@/lib/public-site";
2	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
3	import type { RaceListItem } from "@/lib/services/races";
4	import { listRaces } from "@/lib/services/races";
5	import { getCompatibilityContainerForRegistration } from "@/lib/services/rider-bridge";
6	import type { AppRole } from "@/lib/user-roles";
7	import { hasRole, normalizeRoles } from "@/lib/user-roles";
8	
9	export type ConsoleRaceAccess = "judge" | "organizer" | "rider";
10	
11	export type ConsoleRaceListItem = {
12	  access: ConsoleRaceAccess;
13	  defaultHref: string;
14	  race: RaceListItem;
15	  slug: string;
16	};
17	
18	export async function listConsoleRacesForUser(input: {
19	  roles: readonly AppRole[];
20	  userId: string;
21	}): Promise<ConsoleRaceListItem[]> {
22	  const roles = normalizeRoles(input.roles);
23	  const races = await listRaces();
24	  const items: ConsoleRaceListItem[] = [];
25	
26	  if (hasRole(roles, "ORGANIZER")) {
27	    items.push(
28	      ...races
29	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => race.organizerId === input.userId)
30	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
31	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
32	          return {
33	            access: "organizer" as const,
34	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/organizer/overview`,
35	            race,
36	            slug,
37	          };
38	        }),
39	    );
40	  }
41	
42	  if (hasRole(roles, "RIDER")) {
43	    items.push(
44	      ...races
45	        .filter(
46	          (race: RaceListItem) =>
47	            race.registrations.some(
48	              (registration: RaceListItem["registrations"][number]) =>
49	                registration.userId === input.userId,
50	            ),
51	        )
52	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
53	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
54	          return {
55	            access: "rider" as const,
56	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/rider/registration`,
57	            race,
58	            slug,
59	          };
60	        }),
61	    );
62	  }
63	
64	  if (hasRole(roles, "JUDGE")) {
65	    const assignments = await prisma.judgeAssignment.findMany({
66	      where: {
67	        judgeId: input.userId,
68	      },
69	      select: {
70	        work: {
71	          select: {
72	            registration: {
73	              select: {
74	                raceId: true,
75	              },
76	            },
77	          },
78	        },
79	      },
80	    });
81	    const assignedRaceIds = new Set(
82	      assignments.map(
83	        (assignment: { work: { registration: { raceId: string } } }) =>
84	          assignment.work.registration.raceId,
85	      ),
86	    );
87	
88	    items.push(
89	      ...races
90	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => assignedRaceIds.has(race.id))
91	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
92	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
93	          return {
94	            access: "judge" as const,
95	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/judge/assigned`,
96	            race,
97	            slug,
98	          };
99	        }),
100	    );
101	  }
102	
103	  const seen = new Set<string>();
104	  return items.filter((item) => {
105	    const key = `${item.access}-${item.race.id}`;
106	    if (seen.has(key)) {
107	      return false;
108	    }
109	    seen.add(key);
110	    return true;
111	  });
112	}

136	export async function getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug: string): Promise<{
137	  race: RaceListItem;
138	  slug: string;
139	} | null> {
140	  const races = await listRaces();
141	  const exactMatch = races.find(
142	    (item: RaceListItem) => buildRaceSlug(item.id, item.title) === raceSlug,
143	  );
144	  const race =
145	    exactMatch ??
146	    races.find((item: RaceListItem) => item.id === getRaceIdFromSlug(raceSlug));
147	
148	  if (!race) {
149	    return null;
150	  }
151	
152	  return {
153	    race,
154	    slug: buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title),
155	  };
156	}

14	const screenModeLabels: Record<string, string> = {
15	  jumbotron: "大屏",

28	}

30	export default async function ScreenConsoleModePage({ params }: Props) {
31	  const sessionUser = await loadDatabaseUser();
32	  const access = getConsoleScreenAccess(sessionUser?.roles ?? null);
33	
34	  if (!access.allowed) {
35	    redirect(access.redirectTo ?? "/console");
36	  }
37	
38	  const { mode, raceSlug } = await params;
39	  if (!screenConsoleModes.includes(mode as (typeof screenConsoleModes)[number])) {
40	    notFound();

42

44	  if (!context) {
45	    notFound();
46	  }
47	
48	  const jumbotronPreview =
49	    mode === "jumbotron"
50	      ? await buildJumbotronPreview(context.race.id)
51	      : undefined;
52	
53	  return (
54	    <ConsoleShell
55	      breadcrumbs={[
56	        { href: "/console", label: "控制台" },
57	        { href: "/console/screen", label: "大屏控制台" },
58	        { href: `/console/screen/${raceSlug}/jumbotron`, label: context.race.title },
59	        { label: screenModeLabels[mode] ?? mode },
60	      ]}
61	      description="按 `grs003` 模式分支组织的大屏控制路由。"
62	      navItems={buildConsoleSectionNavItems({
63	        baseHref: `/console/screen/${raceSlug}`,
64	        items: screenConsoleModes,
65	        labels: screenModeLabels,
66	      })}
67	      title={`${context.race.title} / 大屏`}
68	      user={{ username: sessionUser.username, roles: sessionUser.roles }}
69	    >
70	      <ScreenConsolePageView
71	        mode={mode as (typeof screenConsoleModes)[number]}
72	        race={context.race}
73	        raceSlug={raceSlug}
74	        jumbotronPreview={jumbotronPreview}
75	      />
76	    </ConsoleShell>
77	  );
78	}
79	
80	async function buildJumbotronPreview(raceId: string) {
81	  const snapshot = await buildRaceSnapshot(raceId);
82	  const trackProfile = getEffectiveTrackProfileFromSnapshot(snapshot);
83	  return { snapshot, trackProfile };
84	}

3	import { useReducer, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useState } from "react";

13	export default function CalibratorClient() {
14	  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(calibratorReducer, null, createInitialState);
15	  const [bgImage, setBgImage] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);

19	
20	  // 自动播放
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    if (!state.isPlaying) return;
23	    const interval = setInterval(() => {
24	      dispatch({ type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS", payload: (state.previewProgress + 0.002 * state.previewSpeed) % 1 });
25	    }, 16);
26	    return () => clearInterval(interval);
27	  }, [state.isPlaying, state.previewProgress, state.previewSpeed]);
28	
29	  // ---- 拖拽处理（SVG 原生事件，viewBox 坐标） ----
30	  const onPointMouseDown = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
31	    e.stopPropagation();
32	    dragRef.current = { index, ox: e.clientX, oy: e.clientY, px: state.centerline.points[index].x, py: state.centerline.points[index].y };
33	    dispatch({ type: "SELECT_POINT", payload: index });
34	  }, [state.centerline.points]);
35	
36	  const onPointContextMenu = useCallback((index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
37	    e.preventDefault();

39	    dispatch({ type: "DELETE_POINT", payload: { index } });
40	  }, []);
41	
42	  const onSvgMouseMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
43	    if (!dragRef.current) return;
44	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
45	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
46	    pt.x = e.clientX;
47	    pt.y = e.clientY;
48	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
49	    if (!ctm) return;
50	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
51	    const dx = svgPt.x - dragRef.current.px;
52	    const dy = svgPt.y - dragRef.current.py;
53	    dispatch({ type: "MOVE_POINT", payload: { index: dragRef.current.index, point: { x: dragRef.current.px + dx, y: dragRef.current.py + dy } } });
54	  }, []);
55	
56	  const onSvgMouseUp = useCallback(() => { dragRef.current = null; }, []);
57	
58	  const onSvgDoubleClick = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
59	    const svg = e.currentTarget;
60	    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
61	    pt.x = e.clientX;
62	    pt.y = e.clientY;
63	    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
64	    if (!ctm) return;
65	    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
66	    dispatch({ type: "ADD_POINT", payload: { x: svgPt.x, y: svgPt.y } });
67	  }, []);
68	
69	  // ---- 导入/导出 ----
70	  const handleImportBg = useCallback(() => fileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
71	  const handleBgFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
72	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
73	    const reader = new FileReader();
74	    reader.onload = () => {
75	      const img = new Image();
76	      img.onload = () => { setBgImage(img); dispatch({ type: "SET_BACKGROUND", payload: { src: reader.result as string, naturalWidth: img.naturalWidth, naturalHeight: img.naturalHeight } }); };
77	      img.src = reader.result as string;
78	    };
79	    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
80	  }, []);
81	
82	  const handleImportProfile = useCallback(() => profileInputRef.current?.click(), []);
83	  const handleProfileFile = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
84	    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
85	    const reader = new FileReader();
86	    reader.onload = () => {
87	      try { const profile = JSON.parse(reader.result as string); dispatch({ type: "LOAD_PROFILE", payload: profile }); } catch { alert("JSON 解析失败"); }
88	    };
89	    reader.readAsText(file);
90	  }, []);
91	
92	  const handleValidate = useCallback(() => {
93	    const result = validateTrackProfile(toTrackProfile(state));
94	    dispatch({ type: "SET_VALIDATION", payload: { errors: result.errors.map(e => `${e.field}: ${e.message}`), warnings: result.warnings.map(w => `${w.field}: ${w.message}`) } });
95	  }, [state]);
96	
97	  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
98	    const json = JSON.stringify(toTrackProfile(state), null, 2);

100	    const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = `${state.trackId}.profile.json`; a.click();
101	  }, [state]);

108	  // ---- 马匹预览 ----

112	    if (!sampled) return null;

116	    return { x: sampled.point.x + n.x * offset, y: sampled.point.y + n.y * offset, angle: (tangentAngle(sampled.tangent) * 180) / Math.PI, idx: i };
117	  }).filter(Boolean) : [];

119	  const vb = state.viewBox;

122	  return (

127	        <input ref={profileInputRef} type="file" accept=".json" style={{ display: "none" }} onChange={handleProfileFile} />
128	        <button onClick={handleImportBg}>📷 导入底图</button>
129	        <button onClick={handleImportProfile}>📂 导入 Profile</button>

135	      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>

138	          {!state.background && (
139	            <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#888", zIndex: 1, pointerEvents: "none", gap: 8 }}>
140	              <div style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>📷</div>
141	              <div>点击上方「导入底图」加载赛道图片</div>
142	              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#555" }}>加载后双击添加控制点，拖拽移动，右键删除</div>
143	            </div>
144	          )}
145	          {state.background && (
146	            <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, left: 8, zIndex: 2, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)", color: "#4f4", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 12, pointerEvents: "none" }}>
147	              ✓ 底图已加载 ({state.background.naturalWidth}×{state.background.naturalHeight}) | 双击添加点 | 拖拽移动 | 右键删除
148	            </div>
149	          )}
150	
151	          <svg
152	            viewBox={`0 0 ${vb.w} ${vb.h}`}
153	            style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", position: "absolute", inset: 0, cursor: dragRef.current ? "grabbing" : "crosshair" }}
154	            onMouseMove={onSvgMouseMove}
155	            onMouseUp={onSvgMouseUp}
156	            onMouseLeave={onSvgMouseUp}

34	  if (!access.allowed) {

80	async function buildJumbotronPreview(raceId: string) {

62	      navItems={buildConsoleSectionNavItems({

65	        labels: screenModeLabels,

68	      user={{ username: sessionUser.username, roles: sessionUser.roles }}
69	    >

71	        mode={mode as (typeof screenConsoleModes)[number]}
72	        race={context.race}
73	        raceSlug={raceSlug}
74	        jumbotronPreview={jumbotronPreview}

175	
176	            {/* 控制点连线 */}
177	            {state.centerline.points.length > 1 && (
178	              <polyline points={state.centerline.points.map(p => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(" ")} fill="none" stroke="rgba(74,144,217,0.3)" strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="8,6" />
179	            )}
180	
181	            {/* 车道预览 */}
182	            {path && state.lanes.map(lane => (
183	              <polyline
184	                key={lane.id}
185	                points={path.points.map((_, i) => {
186	                  const s = i / (path.points.length - 1 || 1);
187	                  const smp = sampleAt(path, s);
188	                  if (!smp) return "";
189	                  const n = normal(smp.tangent);
190	                  return `${smp.point.x + n.x * lane.offset},${smp.point.y + n.y * lane.offset}`;
191	                }).join(" ")}
192	                fill="none" stroke="rgba(150,150,150,0.3)" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeDasharray="10,10"
193	              />
194	            ))}
195	
196	            {/* 起跑线 */}
197	            {path && (() => { const r = sampleAt(path, state.startFinish.s); if (!r) return null; const n = normal(r.tangent); const L = 80; return <line x1={r.point.x + n.x * L} y1={r.point.y + n.y * L} x2={r.point.x - n.x * L} y2={r.point.y - n.y * L} stroke="#ff4444" strokeWidth={5} />; })()}
198	
199	            {/* 检查点 */}
200	            {path && state.checkpoints.map(cp => {
201	              const r = sampleAt(path, cp.s); if (!r) return null; const n = normal(r.tangent);
202	              return <g key={cp.id}><rect x={r.point.x + n.x * 40 - 8} y={r.point.y + n.y * 40 - 8} width={16} height={16} fill="#fa0" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth={1} transform={`rotate(45, ${r.point.x + n.x * 40}, ${r.point.y + n.y * 40})`} /></g>;
203	            })}
204	
205	            {/* 马匹预览 */}
206	            {horsePreviews.map((hp: any) => hp && (
207	              <g key={hp.idx} transform={`translate(${hp.x}, ${hp.y}) rotate(${hp.angle})`}>
208	                <ellipse cx={0} cy={0} rx={16} ry={9} fill={`hsl(${(hp.idx * 50) % 360},60%,55%)`} stroke="#333" strokeWidth={1} />
209	                <circle cx={18} cy={-5} r={6} fill={`hsl(${(hp.idx * 50) % 360},60%,45%)`} stroke="#333" strokeWidth={1} />
210	                <circle cx={0} cy={-16} r={10} fill="#d96c5a" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth={2} />
211	                <text x={0} y={-12} textAnchor="middle" fill="#fff" fontSize={10} fontWeight="bold">{hp.idx + 1}</text>
212	              </g>
213	            ))}
214	
215	            {/* 控制点（最后画，在最上层） */}
216	            {state.centerline.points.map((p, i) => (
217	              <g key={i}>
218	                <circle cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r={i === selectedIdx ? 14 : 10} fill="#fff" stroke={i === selectedIdx ? "#ff6600" : "#4a90d9"} strokeWidth={3}
219	                  style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}
220	                  onMouseDown={(e) => onPointMouseDown(i, e)}
221	                  onContextMenu={(e) => onPointContextMenu(i, e)}
222	                />
223	                <text x={p.x} y={p.y + 1} textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="central" fill={i === selectedIdx ? "#ff6600" : "#4a90d9"} fontSize={10} fontWeight="bold" style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>{i}</text>
224	              </g>
225	            ))}
226	          </svg>
227	        </div>
228	
229	        {/* Inspector */}
230	        <div className="cal-inspector">
231	          <h3>赛道信息</h3>
232	          <label>名称</label><input value={state.name} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "SET_NAME", payload: e.target.value })} />
233	          <label>画布 (w×h)</label>
234	          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4 }}>
235	            <input type="number" value={vb.w} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "SET_VIEWBOX", payload: { w: Number(e.target.value), h: vb.h } })} />
236	            <input type="number" value={vb.h} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "SET_VIEWBOX", payload: { w: vb.w, h: Number(e.target.value) } })} />
237	          </div>
238	          <h3>几何</h3>
239	          <label className="cal-inspector__check"><input type="checkbox" checked={state.centerline.closed} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "SET_CLOSED", payload: e.target.checked })} />闭合赛道</label>
240	          <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "REVERSE_DIRECTION" })}>🔄 反转方向 ({state.direction === "clockwise" ? "顺" : "逆"})</button>
241	          <h3>起终点 s</h3>
242	          <input type="range" min={0} max={1} step={0.01} value={state.startFinish.s} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "SET_START_FINISH", payload: Number(e.target.value) })} />
243	          <span>{state.startFinish.s.toFixed(2)}</span>
244	          <h3>车道 ({state.lanes.length})</h3>
245	          {state.lanes.map((l, i) => (
246	            <div key={l.id} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, marginBottom: 4 }}>
247	              <input size={8} value={l.name} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "UPDATE_LANE", payload: { index: i, lane: { ...l, name: e.target.value } } })} />
248	              <input type="number" size={5} value={l.offset} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "UPDATE_LANE", payload: { index: i, lane: { ...l, offset: Number(e.target.value) } } })} />
249	              <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "REMOVE_LANE", payload: { index: i } })} disabled={state.lanes.length <= 1}>✕</button>
250	            </div>
251	          ))}
252	          <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "ADD_LANE", payload: { id: `lane-${state.lanes.length}`, name: `车道${state.lanes.length + 1}`, offset: state.lanes.length * 50 } })}>+ 车道</button>
253	          <h3>检查点</h3>

257	              <input type="number" size={5} min={0} max={1} step={0.01} value={cp.s} onChange={e => dispatch({ type: "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT", payload: { index: i, checkpoint: { ...cp, s: Number(e.target.value) } } })} />
258	              <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT", payload: { index: i } })}>✕</button>
259	            </div>

261	          <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "ADD_CHECKPOINT", payload: { id: `cp-${Date.now()}`, name: `CP${state.checkpoints.length + 1}`, s: 0.5 } })}>+ 检查点</button>
262	          {(state.validationErrors.length > 0 || state.validationWarnings.length > 0) && (
263	            <>

266	              {state.validationWarnings.map((w, i) => <div key={i} className="cal-inspector__warn">⚠️ {w}</div>)}
267	            </>
268	          )}

270	      </div>

284

286	    </div>
287	  );

168	  };

27	export default async function AdminConsoleSectionPage({ params }: Props) {

70	      )}

72	  );
73	}

1	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
2	import { parseKeywords, normalizeWeights } from "@/lib/services/scoring";
3	import { writeFile, mkdir } from "node:fs/promises";
4	import { join } from "node:path";
5	
6	async function saveFile(file: File, subDir: string): Promise<{ name: string; path: string }> {
7	  const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
8	  const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
9	  const safeName = `${Date.now()}-${file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/g, "_")}`;
10	  const uploadDir = join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", subDir);
11	  await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
12	  const filePath = join(uploadDir, safeName);
13	  await writeFile(filePath, buffer);
14	  return { name: file.name, path: `/uploads/${subDir}/${safeName}` };
15	}
16	
17	export async function submitCooperationRequest(data: {
18	  submitterId?: string | null;
19	  companyName: string;
20	  contactName: string;
21	  contactEmail: string;
22	  contactPhone: string;
23	  raceTitle: string;
24	  raceSummary: string;
25	  taskDescription: string;
26	  trainingDataSummary: string;
27	  evaluationNotes: string;
28	  keywordsText: string;
29	  signupStart: string;
30	  signupEnd: string;
31	  raceStart: string;
32	  raceEnd: string;
33	  tokenLimit: number;
34	  maxTeamSize: number;
35	  submissionIntervalHours: number;
36	  freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: number;
37	  hasTrainingData: boolean;
38	  enableFreeze: boolean;
39	  displayShowTrainingData: boolean;
40	  displayShowOrganizerComment: boolean;
41	  displayShowTopHighlights: boolean;
42	  displayShowRiderCode: boolean;
43	  notes: string;
44	  taskPackageFile?: File | null;
45	  proposalFile?: File | null;
46	}) {
47	  let taskPackageFileName = "";
48	  let taskPackageFilePath = "";
49	  let proposalFileName = "";
50	  let proposalFilePath = "";
51	
52	  if (data.taskPackageFile && data.taskPackageFile.size > 0) {
53	    const saved = await saveFile(data.taskPackageFile, "cooperation/taskpackages");
54	    taskPackageFileName = saved.name;
55	    taskPackageFilePath = saved.path;
56	  }
57	  if (data.proposalFile && data.proposalFile.size > 0) {
58	    const saved = await saveFile(data.proposalFile, "cooperation/proposals");
59	    proposalFileName = saved.name;
60	    proposalFilePath = saved.path;
61	  }
62	
63	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.create({
64	    data: {
65	      submitterId: data.submitterId ?? null,
66	      companyName: data.companyName,
67	      contactName: data.contactName,
68	      contactEmail: data.contactEmail,
69	      contactPhone: data.contactPhone,
70	      raceTitle: data.raceTitle,
71	      raceSummary: data.raceSummary,
72	      taskDescription: data.taskDescription,
73	      trainingDataSummary: data.trainingDataSummary,
74	      evaluationNotes: data.evaluationNotes,
75	      keywordsText: data.keywordsText,
76	      signupStart: data.signupStart,
77	      signupEnd: data.signupEnd,
78	      raceStart: data.raceStart,
79	      raceEnd: data.raceEnd,
80	      tokenLimit: data.tokenLimit,
81	      maxTeamSize: data.maxTeamSize,
82	      submissionIntervalHours: data.submissionIntervalHours,
83	      freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: data.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd,
84	      hasTrainingData: data.hasTrainingData,
85	      enableFreeze: data.enableFreeze,
86	      displayShowTrainingData: data.displayShowTrainingData,
87	      displayShowOrganizerComment: data.displayShowOrganizerComment,
88	      displayShowTopHighlights: data.displayShowTopHighlights,
89	      displayShowRiderCode: data.displayShowRiderCode,
90	      notes: data.notes,
91	      taskPackageFileName,
92	      taskPackageFilePath,
93	      proposalFileName,
94	      proposalFilePath,
95	    },
96	  });
97	}

106	export async function approveCooperationRequest(
107	  requestId: string,
108	  adminUserId: string,
109	) {
110	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
111	    where: { id: requestId },
112	  });
113	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
114	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
115	
116	  // 优先使用提交申请时记录的 submitterId，fallback 到审批 Admin
117	  const organizerId = request.submitterId ?? adminUserId;
118	
119	  const keywords = parseKeywords(request.keywordsText);
120	  const weights = normalizeWeights({
121	    taskPassRate: 1.0,
122	    codeReview: 0.0,
123	    reasoning: 1.0,
124	    keywords: 1.0,
125	    totalTask: 1.0,
126	    totalToken: 0.0,
127	    totalDialogue: 0.0,
128	  });
129	
130	  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
131	    const race = await tx.race.create({
132	      data: {
133	        organizerId,
134	        title: request.raceTitle,
135	        summary: request.raceSummary,
136	        taskPackageLabel: request.raceTitle,
137	        taskDescription: request.taskDescription,
138	        trainingDataSummary: request.trainingDataSummary,
139	        hasTrainingData: request.hasTrainingData,
140	        evaluationNotes: request.evaluationNotes,
141	        keywordsJson: JSON.stringify(keywords),
142	        tokenLimit: request.tokenLimit,
143	        signupStart: new Date(request.signupStart),
144	        signupEnd: new Date(request.signupEnd),
145	        raceStart: new Date(request.raceStart),
146	        raceEnd: new Date(request.raceEnd),
147	        enableFreeze: request.enableFreeze,
148	        freezeMinutesBeforeEnd: request.enableFreeze
149	          ? request.freezeMinutesBeforeEnd
150	          : 0,
151	        maxTeamSize: request.maxTeamSize,
152	        submissionIntervalHours: request.submissionIntervalHours,
153	        cloudStudioUrl: "",
154	        trackId: "oval-track",
155	        trackConfigJson: "",

175	    return race;

179	export async function rejectCooperationRequest(requestId: string) {
180	  const request = await prisma.cooperationRequest.findUnique({
181	    where: { id: requestId },
182	  });
183	  if (!request) throw new Error("办赛申请不存在");
184	  if (request.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("该申请已处理，无法重复审批");
185	
186	  return prisma.cooperationRequest.update({
187	    where: { id: requestId },
188	    data: { status: "REJECTED" },
189	  });
190	}

90	        >
91	          <div className="stack">

93	              <RequestCard key={req.id} request={req} showActions={false} />
94	            ))}
95	          </div>
96	        </Panel>
97	      )}
98	    </>

262	function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
263	  if (!value) return null;
264	  return (
265	    <div style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
266	      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.8125rem" }}>{label}：</span>
267	      <span style={{ fontSize: "0.8125rem", color: "var(--muted-foreground)" }}>
268	        {value}
269	      </span>
270	    </div>
271	  );
272	}
273	
274	function formatDate(iso: string) {
275	  try {
276	    const d = new Date(iso);
277	    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
278	  } catch {
279	    return iso;
280	  }
281	}
282	
283	function formatDateTime(d: Date) {
284	  try {
285	    const date = new Date(d);
286	    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
287	  } catch {
288	    return String(d);
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function pad(n: number) {
293	  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
294	}

1	import { buildRaceSlug, getRaceIdFromSlug } from "@/lib/public-site";
2	import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
3	import type { RaceListItem } from "@/lib/services/races";
4	import { listRaces } from "@/lib/services/races";
5	import { getCompatibilityContainerForRegistration } from "@/lib/services/rider-bridge";
6	import type { AppRole } from "@/lib/user-roles";
7	import { hasRole, normalizeRoles } from "@/lib/user-roles";
8	
9	export type ConsoleRaceAccess = "judge" | "organizer" | "rider";
10	
11	export type ConsoleRaceListItem = {
12	  access: ConsoleRaceAccess;
13	  defaultHref: string;
14	  race: RaceListItem;
15	  slug: string;
16	};
17	
18	export async function listConsoleRacesForUser(input: {
19	  roles: readonly AppRole[];
20	  userId: string;
21	}): Promise<ConsoleRaceListItem[]> {
22	  const roles = normalizeRoles(input.roles);
23	  const races = await listRaces();
24	  const items: ConsoleRaceListItem[] = [];
25	
26	  if (hasRole(roles, "ORGANIZER")) {
27	    items.push(
28	      ...races
29	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => race.organizerId === input.userId)
30	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
31	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
32	          return {
33	            access: "organizer" as const,
34	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/organizer/overview`,
35	            race,
36	            slug,
37	          };
38	        }),
39	    );
40	  }
41	
42	  if (hasRole(roles, "RIDER")) {
43	    items.push(
44	      ...races
45	        .filter(
46	          (race: RaceListItem) =>
47	            race.registrations.some(
48	              (registration: RaceListItem["registrations"][number]) =>
49	                registration.userId === input.userId,
50	            ),
51	        )
52	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
53	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
54	          return {
55	            access: "rider" as const,
56	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/rider/registration`,
57	            race,
58	            slug,
59	          };
60	        }),
61	    );
62	  }
63	
64	  if (hasRole(roles, "JUDGE")) {
65	    const assignments = await prisma.judgeAssignment.findMany({
66	      where: {
67	        judgeId: input.userId,
68	      },
69	      select: {
70	        work: {
71	          select: {
72	            registration: {
73	              select: {
74	                raceId: true,
75	              },
76	            },
77	          },
78	        },
79	      },
80	    });
81	    const assignedRaceIds = new Set(
82	      assignments.map(
83	        (assignment: { work: { registration: { raceId: string } } }) =>
84	          assignment.work.registration.raceId,
85	      ),
86	    );
87	
88	    items.push(
89	      ...races
90	        .filter((race: RaceListItem) => assignedRaceIds.has(race.id))
91	        .map((race: RaceListItem) => {
92	          const slug = buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title);
93	          return {
94	            access: "judge" as const,
95	            defaultHref: `/console/races/${slug}/judge/assigned`,
96	            race,
97	            slug,
98	          };
99	        }),
100	    );
101	  }
102	
103	  const seen = new Set<string>();
104	  return items.filter((item) => {
105	    const key = `${item.access}-${item.race.id}`;
106	    if (seen.has(key)) {
107	      return false;
108	    }
109	    seen.add(key);
110	    return true;
111	  });
112	}

136	export async function getConsoleRaceBySlug(raceSlug: string): Promise<{
137	  race: RaceListItem;
138	  slug: string;
139	} | null> {
140	  const races = await listRaces();
141	  const exactMatch = races.find(
142	    (item: RaceListItem) => buildRaceSlug(item.id, item.title) === raceSlug,
143	  );
144	  const race =
145	    exactMatch ??
146	    races.find((item: RaceListItem) => item.id === getRaceIdFromSlug(raceSlug));
147	
148	  if (!race) {
149	    return null;
150	  }
151	
152	  return {
153	    race,
154	    slug: buildRaceSlug(race.id, race.title),
155	  };
156	}

165	  });

3	import type { Point, TrackProfile, Lane, Checkpoint } from "../track-runtime/types";

5	export interface CalibratorState {
6	  // 赛道元信息
7	  trackId: string;
8	  name: string;
9	  schemaVersion: string;
10	
11	  // 画布 & 背景
12	  viewBox: { w: number; h: number };

14	    src: string;

26	
27	  // 方向 & 起终点

30	
31	  // 车道

33	
34	  // 检查点
35	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
36	
37	  // 交互状态
38	  selectedPointIndex: number | null;
39	  isDragging: boolean;
40	  canvasScale: number;
41	
42	  // 预览
43	  previewProgress: number;
44	  previewHorseCount: number;
45	  previewSpeed: number;
46	  isPlaying: boolean;
47	
48	  // 校验
49	  validationErrors: string[];
50	  validationWarnings: string[];
51	}

53	export type CalibratorAction =
54	  | { type: "SET_BACKGROUND"; payload: { src: string; naturalWidth: number; naturalHeight: number } }
55	  | { type: "SET_VIEWBOX"; payload: { w: number; h: number } }
56	  | { type: "SET_NAME"; payload: string }
57	  | { type: "ADD_POINT"; payload: Point }
58	  | { type: "MOVE_POINT"; payload: { index: number; point: Point } }
59	  | { type: "DELETE_POINT"; payload: { index: number } }
60	  | { type: "SELECT_POINT"; payload: number | null }
61	  | { type: "START_DRAG" }
62	  | { type: "END_DRAG" }
63	  | { type: "SET_CLOSED"; payload: boolean }
64	  | { type: "REVERSE_DIRECTION" }
65	  | { type: "SET_START_FINISH"; payload: number }
66	  | { type: "ADD_LANE"; payload: Lane }
67	  | { type: "UPDATE_LANE"; payload: { index: number; lane: Lane } }
68	  | { type: "REMOVE_LANE"; payload: { index: number } }
69	  | { type: "ADD_CHECKPOINT"; payload: Checkpoint }
70	  | { type: "UPDATE_CHECKPOINT"; payload: { index: number; checkpoint: Checkpoint } }
71	  | { type: "REMOVE_CHECKPOINT"; payload: { index: number } }
72	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_PROGRESS"; payload: number }
73	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_HORSE_COUNT"; payload: number }
74	  | { type: "SET_PREVIEW_SPEED"; payload: number }
75	  | { type: "TOGGLE_PLAY" }
76	  | { type: "SET_VALIDATION"; payload: { errors: string[]; warnings: string[] } }
77	  | { type: "LOAD_PROFILE"; payload: TrackProfile }
78	  | { type: "SET_SCALE"; payload: number };

105	    },

109	      { id: "lane-0", name: "内侧车道", offset: -60 },
110	      { id: "lane-1", name: "中间车道", offset: 0 },
111	      { id: "lane-2", name: "外侧车道", offset: 60 },
112	    ],
113	    checkpoints: [],
114	    selectedPointIndex: null,
115	    isDragging: false,
116	    canvasScale: 1,
117	    previewProgress: 0,
